However, she had no idea that her destiny was about to change when her sister Stacey brought trouble into their lives when a  cold-blooded murder of a young woman's body is discovered on the property of rancher Cal Jackson, bringing the case much closer to home than she ever thought possible and placing her right back into Travis's arms once again.  Relieved and happy to be back with Rochelle, Travis was also scared for her too, especially after meeting some unruly charachters from her past.  When another murder is discovered, the horrifying clues continued to mount and causing Travis and Rochelle to be confronted with the shocking truth forcing the killer in making Rochelle his next intended target  while planning to put her six feet under before the night is over!  a chilling thriller!....thank you..

Five stars!  As 2016 Daphne Du Maurier Award For Excellence in Romantic Suspense and finalist Bookseller'sAward Winner and Best Award finalist, bestselling author Toni Anderson has delivered a pulse-pounding romantic suspense hit series and the action and mystery only gets better in book 4.  Each and every book are definitely must reads!........After catching the infamous serial killer Ferris Denker several months before, who was now about to be executed for his heinous crimes,  ASAC (Assistant Special Agent in Charge) Lincoln "Linc" Frazer was determined of making sure the convicted killer's execution isn't delayed,  but when a young woman's body is found in the Outer Banks of North Carolina and old evidence turns up on her corpse linking it with old homicides,  Linc totally believes they might be dealing with a new type of killer.  Returning home to the Outer Banks to take charge of her rebellious younger sister, former Army Captain Dr. Isadora "Izzy" Campbell couldn't erase the painful memories from her mind when years before,  she conspired with her mother to conceal a crime, and unfortunately for her, Izzy now suspected someone knew what she did all those years ago when more young women were turning up dead and practically discovered in the same location,and even worse,  it soon becomes apparent that these crimes are somehow connected to the infamous killer awaiting execution.  A copy cat?  Or someone who knew her secret?  As leader of the BAU,  Linc finds himself not only assigning himself to the Outer Banks of North Carolina, but working with the gorgeous Izzy Campbell,  and in time, they will find themselves seeking solace in each other's arms.  As the pressure mounts by all those around him to reopen the old case, Linc and Izzy begin to fall hard for each other without the other realizing it, and as their relationship slowly grows, it  gives  Izzy the courage by revealing her secret to Linc.  Unfortunately, he  not only struggles with her deception,  but in anger, he reluctantly puts his career first and casts her love aside, and in that moment, he unknowingly pushes her right into the throes of a psychopath who kidnaps her with murder on his mind.  As Linc races against the clock in cold fear to save Izzy,  he finds himself playing a deadly game of cat-and-mouse with a deranged madman, and he silently prays he's not too late to save the only woman he ever loved!......

*Another great book by bestselling author Kathy Reichs!........While working for the Quebec/medical legal lab examiner's offfice,forensic anthropologist,Temperence "Tempe" Brennen is summoned by her boss to witness an autopsy. At first she doesn't understand but soon realized that the deceased was jewish.  It is protocol under jewish law that the autopsy be done exactly right. As her job was to only be a witness, she removed herself from the room only to be approached by a total stranger.  He never gave his name but instead hands her a photograph of a skeleton and implied that the man who was being autopsied also died died for those bones. Now she was being told that this man may have comitted suicide.  Did he? How could they be certain especially now with all the mystery surrounding this man.  With her curiosity building inside of her, she contacted an old friend.  Archaeologist anthropologist Jake Drum. When she described the picture to him, he is utterly flawed.  He begged her to come to Isreal and tell no one for he has information that will be catastrophic to the biblical world.  With her suspicions being on high alert, she and her boyfriend homicide detective Andrew Ryan travel to Isreal  only to learn a bizarre story from her friend.  Could it be that he really did find the bones of Jesus Christ?  Could this photogragh be linked to the St. James ossuary that he claimed to have found?  Were people trying to have him killed and why did he distrust the government of antiquities.  As their quest continued, all three of them will find that their lives are in constant danger and that no one can be trusted. From learning about the black market, possible murders and a 2000- year old mystery before them, they will soon realize that its become too dangerous but little did they know that it was about to be alot sooner than later!.........This book was excellent in my viewpoint.  From start to finish!........  Thank You

users.query: I'm not usually impressed with police procedural books, but this one is very well done. I have already purchased the second book in the series, and will keep an eye out for the third. Highly entertaining and highly recommended.

cands.text: This was a very enjoyable read. Brought the characters to life. There were a few "outside the lines" actions that would NOT occur in real police work, but they didn't detract from the overall story. Just bought the next book from Ms. Wolfe and look forward to a terrific adventure.

This is a terrifically entertaining series, even if all the weaponry and vehicle availability is a bit over the top. Have read both books out, so far, and am looking forward to the next in the series.

This is the first of a four book series, and IMHO it is an outstanding series. I picked this first book up very inexpensively, as a "teaser", but it has been worth it. I just bought the fourth book in the series, and while parts may be slight "draggy", the whole series is a great SF read. Highly recommended.

I have read every one of John Sandford novels, and IMHO, this may be the best yet. His writing is crisp, exciting and very realistic. as a retired police commander, most "police" books are a turnoff,  but not Sandford's works. Davenport is highly realistic, and even his failures are believable. A prior Prey story had to do with an assassin (I can't recall the name) and up to now, that had been the best. This one tops it, particularly in today's political climate. I won't spoil it, but the ending shows that Lucas will be back in the game. Can't wait.
This is a great new series. Only problem is that the first two books are out, but the third is not yet available. Very well written, and better editing than most of these newer books.

I rarely read "true police" stories, since I spent so much time in the business myself. But I wound up buying this one, and couldn't even finish it. It is poorly written and doesn't come close to reflecting law enforcement at ANY level.

I have read both of the books in this series. Normally, This series would have turned me off, because the "relationship" with the SDPD is just not realistic. The principal in the story is a drunk who was fired, and while she seems to be a good investigator, she has too much baggage to keep intimating they would take her back. That's not to say that friends on the PD wouldn't back her. That was the negative. The positive is that these two books tell an interesting and entertaining story. I look forward to the next chapter and hopefully, wrapping up the Laughing Man so she can get on to other things. I do recommend this series.
This is a very entertaining new series. I enjoy logical science fiction, and this kept me interested. I'm halfway through the second book, The Cost of Victory, and looking forward to the third.
This two book series was well written and enjoyable to read. Recommended.

This series is terrific for those of us who enjoy "light" SF reading. The author doesn't get too bogged down in massive detail, but moves the pace along nicely and this second book of the series has opened a new frontier for hi to pursue. The only bad thing is having to wait for the next installment. Highly recommended for some light reading.
This is the second book in a series, and I am looking forward to reading the next one. If you enjoy military sci-fi, then this series should appeal.

Good story and I am looking forward to the next of the series. This book started as somewhat of a downer type story, but as the end approached, became much more interesting. Can't wait to see how this plays out. Keep it going Mr. Allen.
This is one of the better Harry Bosche books in the series. Harry is usually a little TOO synical for my taste, but here, he is no longer a cop and it seems to have mellowed him Great story.

Terrific series, and this may be the best yet. My only regret is that there are no new books in the series. Mr. Stinnett says he re-wrote these from some short stories he had written earlier, and the dates indicate that, but this is too good a series to end here. Hope with all the positive feedback, the author will soon be out with more of this series. As long as we have the war on terror, this story line is timeless.

Reading this book, and the two sequels took me back to my teen years, reading Lucky Starr, Isaac Asimov and so many other great adventures. Obviously, much of the stories stretch credibility, but they are terrific fun to read. Looking forward to the next in the series.

This has been an interesting series, except...the main characters keep getting into impossible situations and are bailed out at the last minute by some heretofore unknown creation. It is an interesting story line, especially the AIs and some of the technology, but seriously, the "impossible" situations are a bit too much. Have enjoyed all three books, but this third was just a bit over the top. And, yes, I recommend them and will buy the fourth, but I hope some of the issues left hanging will sort out a bit cleaner.
If you are a fan of good science fiction, with lots of human drama and space action, this series fits the mold to a T. Can't wait for the next book in the series. Very enjoyable escapist reading.

Another winner for Mr. DeLeo. I have read almost all of Mr. DeLeo's books, and while there is quite a bit of bleed-over from one series to the next, they are still enjoyable escapist reading. The one thing I wish he would do, especially with this series is to expand the planning leading up to each hit. Many seem almost impromptu and while that works on some of them, a more complex and even dangerous execution would add depth IMHO. I highly recommend this series for those who are not squeamish,

I have read most of David Baldacci's books, and I think this is one of his best, by far. It is very convoluted, and quite a few twists and turns are somewhat baffling to follow, but it kept me enthralled. I can highly recommend this on as an unpredictable thrill ride. The ending is somewhat bizarre but it wraps things up nicely. This would make a good movie, if someone ever picks it up.

I found this to be an entertaining read. My main criticism is that some of the characters who were developed early and were interesting were simply killed off. The revenge for evil things done to the main character took too long, IMO. I intend to read more by this author.
This is a terrific salad dressing that we found years ago, but it had become almost impossible to find in our local stores. Then my wife found it on Amazon and we stay stocked up on it.

As always, Daniel Silva is one of my favorite authors, and The English Spy comes through, once again. Gabriel Allon is the leading protagonist, but a "new" character has been introduced; thus the English Spy of the title. Allon has still not taken over as Chief of the office, but is getting closer. I can highly recommend this book to fans of the genre.

I've read all of Daniel Silva's books and have thoroughly enjoyed his stories involving spy/assassin Gabrial Allon and company. In this latest chapter, I think he has told a marvelous story without quite as much of the violence that has occupied some of the other tales. Like most of this type of book, one must suspend belief just a bit in a couple of the twists and turns, but Silva holds it all together quite well. In my opinion, this may be his best work. I would like to see him develop young Peel into a formal part of the team, and the new character Zoe could introduce some interesting possibilities.

This was a replacement for the same pan we have had for 15 years, but the old pan was damaged. This is my wife's favorite all around pan and is large enough and deep enough to prepare almost any dish. this is a terrific addition to any kitchen.

We have several Berndes pans and they are outstanding pieces of cookware. Highly recommended. If you can afford them, they are the best, in my opinion. Just make certain you follow the care instructions.

users.query: This about the best Fabric Repair kit I purchased so far due to it's simplicity. It comes with a color matcher so that you can match the color of the fabric fairly accurately. This fabric repair kit is for small jobs only such as cigarette burns and/or small tears. For bigger jobs I would recommend a professional. In any case, you mix the materials until the color matches the item you want to repair then you spread them over the damaged area through a small cut-out screen so that the mixed material spreads evenly. This takes no more than 15 minutes. After that you let it dry overnight and voila, the damage is repaired and barely noticed by guest that come to visit. (You can always tell where the previous damage was done if you look hard enough though)...

cands.text: You need about an half hour plus to sew these on your sweater or jacket but they are worth if, very high quality
The color never seems to match any of my black clothing. Its the same color as a Sharpie black magic marker.
These work great so far and they look good. I have not tried putting them in the wash yet so I can't comment on that.

The leaves on this plant started wilting even though no heat, or anything was applied to them ? I had to cut them off because the wilted tips looked absolutely horrible. Who wants a wilted faux plant ? other than that, the vase is nice and the parts that did no wilt look OK.

I'm not sure how good of a protector this is since I have not dropped my iPhone on hard cement, or have it fall down a whole flight of steps or anything like that. I does keep scratches and dirt from accumulating on my phone so I would say it's doing its job. I thought about some other smart phone protectors but they were big and bulky and make it even harder to easily fit in my pocket. Another thing is that I really like the look of my iPhone(iPhone 5) and really don't want to hide it under some ugly looking case. That's like owning a BMW  and driving around with a car-cover because you are scared the car is going to get scratched. I like this protector because it doesn't get in the way and so far no scratches !

I put this up in about 2 hours with breaks ! The instructions were easy to follow and there were NO missing items as is often the case with online furniture purchases. Getting the item inside the door was another story. This is a very heavy item(at least while still in the box). It takes at least two people to carry it.  I hope this means that the cabinet won't  wilt during the humid summer months. This item is well worth the price, I was looking for a quality Rustic style cabinet, which did not break the bank and this cabinet fits the bill.

Works better than my Weller and Elenco 25W  soldering irons for certain jobs. I purchased this iron to repair a wire that got loose on my DSLR camera which worked pretty well. The standard size soldering irons would have been to big too fit into such a small area.  Lately I have been using it to solder electronic parts to printed circuit boards on Electronic Hobby Kits.  Again and in my opinion, this mini iron works better than my standard size irons. The small size makes it easier to get around especially if you are soldering sensitive parts like Integrated Circuits  and electrolytic capacitors. This iron has plenty of heat. Like another reviewer said it rated at 20W, but works like a 40W. The higher heat lets me melt the solder instantaneously, without having to keep the iron on a part for too long like other 25W irons. Also, the on-off switch comes in very handy because you can leave the iron plugged to the mains while it is off.  With other irons you have to remember to unplug them from the mains which can be dangerous or it can ruin the iron. I'm so happy with this iron I'll probably get another one as a back-up. They are cheap enough.

THE BAD-----
The tips burn-out pretty fast and there are no replacements.
I replaced all the original lugs on my car with these. Love the real gold color which unlike the orange color of others, matches my car's color.

These are heavy duty shirts that are meant to be worn in cooler weather. You wear them in the summer months and you will sweat your "you-know- what" off ! These shirts are washable and do not shrink when you wash them. I have about 4 different colors.
I purchase this hopping it would match my dark oak furniture but instead it was more like black than dark oak. Lucky for me the scratch was not that big.
Fantastic tinner. A must have on every work bench. Super Fast shipping.

This project was easier than I thought. Being a beginner with not the best of eyes this is the smallest board I have ever worked on so I was expecting a frustrating experience trying to solder the parts on such a small board. With that said, I put this kit to the side and worked on easier projects. The kit took a very long time to arrive at my home, I'm guessing the manufacturer is not local. The kit came without instructions, but the instructions were emailed to me by the manufacturer about 2 weeks before the kit arrived . Tell you the truth, I didn't really need the instructions to put this kit together. Everything was self explanatory on the well laid out board. I did need the instructions to operate the clock and Alarm.

I spent maybe 1 hour attaching the parts to the board and another 2 hours soldering the parts and removing shorts and bridges. As soon as I connected the battery, the clock started working and the LEDs would blink every second in unison with the Second(s) panel. For this kit being so small, I used Lead solder rather than the more unwieldy UN-leaded solder. I used a 20W Radio Shack  pencil solder iron sold right here on Amazon because of its small size.  I'm still trying to figure out why some numbers do not display fully, but it might have to do with the solder connections ? Everything else including the buzzer seem to work fine.

It took me a whole 5 minutes to put this thing together. Unlike other lamps at this price range the base is pretty heavy which makes the lamp pretty sturdy even on a thick carpet like I have in my living room. The best thing about this lamp is the shade. It spreads the light out pretty evenly and the light that comes out is beautiful and soft. I just wish it was a little taller.

Fun and fairly easy to put together with no instructions required. This is my second Icstation C51. I managed to damage the PCB board on the first one, but because it was so cheap, I didn't bother trying to fix it, just ordered another one. The reason why I say "fairly easy" is that you have to be real careful soldering the IC station to avoid bridges. Bridges and cold-connections will definitely affect the way the LCD display operates. In any case, it took me about an hour putting it together while watching TV and drinking coffee. I would definitely recommend this kit for beginners like myself who are just learning how to solder.

For operating instructions you can contact the seller and they will email them to you.  There is a long wait for this kit to arrive since it's coming all the way from China. It took 3+ weeks  for mine to arrive to the point I forgot I even ordered it. If you don't mind waiting, this is a fun kit to put together and can be useful in a variety of situations if you can get creative.
Hard to read and not properly labeled, but for the price not too bad. I think a base beige color would have been better than blue.

A few months ago I had to shoot pictures at a social event at my job, which required a lot of cheesy snapshots. I was dismayed after I downloaded the pictures at the greasy and shinny(reflective) look on the faces of my subjects. I spent hours in Photoshop trying to fix this issue before I delivered the pictures. The thing is, I had this diffuser in my bag all the time, but did not want to look like the man-from-mars with it on my flash. I'm so sorry I didn't use it. This definitely cuts down on the reflections and smooth  things out. It is not a studio Soft box but it does help. The diffuser collapses for easy storage, so you can keep it in your bag forever.

This is a very well made umbrella for the price. The shaft is made from solid metal and is painted black so it doesn't dent or scratch like my other umbrellas. The interior is a satin silver/white that doesn't produce any color shifts. The Black cover is easily removed although it might take you a couple of minutes the first time you try it. This umbrella was made for photography, it is not a regular rain umbrella that was modified, so I'm sure it will last a bit longer. I like the size of 32", perfect for individual portraits and couples, plus it's easier to carry and set up than the 45" or 60" sizes. If  you place your light-source towards the end of the shaft you have a 32" light which is plenty for most situations.
For quick fixes of stationary items this works, but if there is any push/pull pressure between the two items you are trying to stick together this does not work.

I have the original Wedding Photography Art Business and Style and although it was a little dated, it was one of my favorite books when it came to wedding photography. This version is even better and pretty up to date technologically. The author uses the same no nonsense style he did in the original, so its easy to stay focused instead of wandering or being taken somewhere you really don't want to go. This book explains everything you need to become a wedding photographer pit-falls and all. There are many pictures in this book, but unlike other books they are not the self-promoting type of pictures, or do they delve into specific styles and techniques. If you don't have a list of what equipment to bring to a wedding you will surely know what to bring after reading this book. If you don't know what pictures to take or how many to take, you will find out after reading this book. This is the most important part of the book in my opinion, because if you don't know what the must-have pictures are or you forget you have to take them,  your wedding albums are bound to fall short. All in all this is a great book, packed with information and easy to read.

Easy to put together but the instructions are not quite right

*** Changed rating from a 3 to a 5 after I sat down and really read the instructions.

I first started looking at Sanus Speaker Stands until I noticed their shortest stand was 22 inches off the ground. I wanted some speaker stands that would be close enough to the ground, not too close, but close enough so that the Base would not dissapear into thin air. These stands fit the bill at only 8 inches off the ground. Assembly was easy and compared to my "Cheapo" stands that tend to wobble whenever I nudge the speakers on top, these are solid as a rock. The strong heavy base reduces vibration although I'm not a vibration freak like some stereophiles. These are the best speakers stands and the best looking ones I have purchased so far for my set up, which consists of two main speakers and two auxiliary speakers to increase the sound stage. I don't beleive in surround-sound, because I think it gives you an artifical sound stage. Have you ever been to a concert where the music is coming from North, South, East and West ? No it mainly comes from straight infront of you.
This watch eats up your phones battery like there is no tomorrow. It is totally useless unless you like fancy toys...

I really don't like to write negative reviews, but the SX3040 is a huge step down in build quality and sound from previous  Behringer sound enhancement units. First of all the thing looks like a kids Christmas toy with all those meaningless flashing LED lights. When I listen to music I like to  relax not have a bunch of lights going off all the time. Then there are the gaudy non-professional looking plastic buttons.  The sound does improve a bit, but this unit is more like a high-tech EQ than an sound enhancement processor. I only had it for a week so maybe I got a lot to learn, but right now I'm thinking  whether I should keep it as a back up, send it back, or give it to my son. Maybe he might find something to do with it.
Way to big for my fishbowl. The leaf looks and feels very plasticky. It is now sitting on a shelf in my closet.
Extremely boring. If your sleep tablets are not working please watch this show, it will have you sleeping in no time.

users.query:
This book was just everything I hoped and prayed and wanted and needed it to be, and then it was even better than that. God, it was just so beautiful in both spirit and prose. I seriously want every person I know to read these two books. It's hard for me to explain what makes this series so wonderful to me and the only thing I can come up with is these books have the most beautiful SOUL. The story is honest, believable, fluid. The ups and downs are heart affirming and heart wrenching and the characters are real, beautiful, flawed and perfect all at the same time.

Rhyson is one of my favorite male characters of all time. He is gorgeous both inside and out, talented, smart, funny and completely head over heals for Kia. He is also flawed, damaged and desperate to hold on to the love of his life. Watching him come to terms with his actions and their consequences and seeing him work for forgiveness and redemption is simply a breathtaking journey. Kia is an amazing female lead. Her strength and determination is inspiring, her heartbreak and insecurities are humanizing and her love for Rhys is a thing of beauty, but watching her figure out how to not lose herself in the Rhyson's shadow is what makes her character so much more captivating than I'm used to reading. These two characters are so multi-faceted, so complete, so extraordinary and yet so completely down to earth, that you can't help but feel every emotion they feel.

Kennedy Ryan is simply an amazing writer. She understand intrinsically how people interact, love, fight, play and connect. Every emotion, every reaction and every consequence was real and believable. There were times I wanted to scream at these characters, times I wanted to comfort them, times my heart broke for them and times I rejoiced for them. Every emotion was present and accounted for and Kennedy pulled them out of me even when I didn't want her to. I always feel some kind of emotion when I finish a series, sometimes happiness, sometimes sorrow because it's over, sometimes frustration because I did like the way something was handled. When I finished this series I felt like rejoicing, like my heart was full, sated, and joyous right down to my soul.

cands.text:
This is simply a wonderful conclusion to a beautiful and beautifully written love story. I adore Rhyson and Kia, yet I was worried that this book wouldn't live up. I am excited to say I was completely and utterly wrong. It more than lived up....it exceeded. This couple is just compelling, endearing and so completely romantic. This is what I read romance books for....this kind of story right here.

You really need to read the first two books for this one to work for you. Go ahead, do it....they are spectacular. But this book just adds so much to their story. Now that they are together, getting to experience them figuring out exactly what that means and how that works is a gorgeous ride. They have issues, all couples do and their issues are handle so realistically and so beautifully. I literally couldn't get enough. This will forever be one of my very favorite series and Rhyson Gray is one of my very favorite BBFs. He's not perfect, he's real and romantic and spectacular.

This book is actually more like 4 1/2 Stars for me. I really loved it (probably more than Claimed which I did not expect). I thought this was great. So HOT and sexy and dirty of course. BUT more importantly, the story was so good. I loved the characters, I loved their journey and the realistic way the relationship was portrayed. This book was more emotional for me than the last one...I cried, I laughed, I yelled, I got angry and frustrated and all of the good stuff you want from a book. I can't wait for the next one, bring on Ryland.  An ARC was provided.

Potentially my favorite NA book ever. I could not have loved this book more. It was gut-wrenching, emotional, sad, romantic, hopeful and so damn real.

I'm not going to lie, Keira is different than most of the female characters I read about and probably not as likeable as most. She's confused and insecure and needy and selfish. But I think if you can be non-judgemental and really look at how she got in the position she's in, I think her behavior is at the very least understandable and at the very best what almost any woman would do in the face of Kellen Kyle.

Kellen Kyle is the be all, end all, most beautifully damaged man ever written. He is flawed perfection. He will ruin you for all other men.

The love triangle is harsh and painful and sad as hell but believable and oh so addictive. Really, there are no good guys and no bad guys and no villains, just three people in a no win situation. My heart was crushed by this book, broken into a million little pieces and then put back together piece by painful piece.

It was perfection....I can't wait to read the next three books

**update**  I am just finishing up the 4th book in the series and HOLY HELL it just keeps getting better and better.

I love this series, I recommend it all the time. And I was waiting for Jett's story from the very moment I met him. This book got me right back into it. I loved seeing some of the events from the previous books from a different point of view. And it takes a lot of skill to write about things we know and still make it feel fresh and new. M.Never nails it. I loved getting to know who Jett was and how he became that man. However, I was even more enamored with London than I was with Jett in this book. She was freaking fascinating and her story was just heartbreaking and amazing. I adored her and her relationship with Jett was so intense.

This story is full of surprising twists and turns. Things I never saw coming, and I love that in a book. Predictable is boring, and this book is neither. It just missed being a five star read for me, though. My reviews are always spoiler free, so I can only say that there was one thing in this book that didn't work for me. One of the characters had a surprising reaction to a bit of information that was revealed and I just wasn't convinced that the reaction was true to character. It would have worked better for me if that particular plot line had gone a different way.

That aside, people who love Jett will not be disappointed, people who want to love London will be ecstatic. Definitely a great addition to the Decadence After Dark Series. I hope there is more to come.

I'm loving this series so far, It's keeping me completely sucked in. This book was definitely lighter and less traumatic than the first, but that was a great reprieve. . It's nice watching a love story unfold after all the darkness in the last book. I'm basically binge reading this entire series at this point.

I absolutely this book! I read a lot of these rockstar romances and this is one of my very favorite! I love both of the main characters, completely real, believable, insecure, flawed, strong people. There was just the right amount of backstory to really flesh out the characters and make you feel like you understood their motivations and reactions. I thought the sexual tension and the drama and the romance and the friendship and the obstacles all seemed true to real life, not manufactured to cause drama. God, I could FEEL the attraction, the frustration, the joy, the release, the heartache and the love.

And for the record....Jonny 'Slater' Voughn might just be the best book boyfriend I've ever come across.

All of the peripheral characters and storylines were great too, not too much, just enough to add to the story.  Emmie's relationship with her brother was a nice addition. I can't wait to read Derek's story this year. In the mean time, I am starting over at page 1 and reading this entire book again!  BTW this is a standalone novel!

Jewel E. Ann is possibly the best author writing romance these days and this book is no exception. It was PHENOMENAL. I have never been so happy, angry, destroyed, enamored, furious, satiated, and thoroughly in love with a book. My text convo with the friend that encouraged me to read this one is hysterical. I cursed her, I praised her, I told her we weren't friends, I told her I would love her forever. Yeah...it's that kind of book.

What ever you do...READ THIS BOOK and DO NOT give up. You will want to quit, you will be too angry to continue, you will think all is lost. Read it anyway...the payoff will be worth every minute of the journey!!!

And yeah....the audiobook is wonderful too!!!

After Book One in this series I was eagerly anticipating Book Two....(OK that is a total understatement...I was desperate for it) and HOLY HELL it did not disappoint. Sometimes it's hard to figure out exactly what makes a book great, but in this case it's easy....a great story and three amazing characters. I loved the journey this book took me on, I loved the ups and downs, the things I saw coming and the things I never expected (actually..those parts were my favorite). I loved the struggles and the triumphs, the redemption and the forgiveness...I loved all of it

Landon, Asher and Breslin... these three are what made this entire series so good for me. How rare is it to have a story with three main characters that are amazing, relatable, fully fleshed out with backstory and have strengths and flaws and character and heart? Umm.....rare.

Just when I thought one of them was becoming my favorite...BAM, the POV would switch and someone else would start stealing my heart (and yes...I'm including Breslin in this. This story is not all about the boys, she was every bit as important to me). Landon was amazing. He was the calm in the storm, the safe place to land, the voice of reason throughout the story, but my favorite part about Landon was went the cracks started to show and he stopped reining in his emotions. It was epic. And then there was Asher...I adored Asher. I love a damaged, misunderstood, tragically heroic bad boy and Asher was the perfect example of that. His pain was so palpable, so exposed. I just loved him passionately. And Breslin, the girl stuck in the middle, only sometimes she seemed more like the girl stuck on the outside, or the girl stuck in the past. I just got her. Her fears, her hang-ups, her emotions were so on point. And her evolution was a beautiful thing to watch.

Also... this book was exceptionally hot. Just... so, ummm... hot.

This book just surprised me. Ashley Jade did some things...some really freaking SMART things that I was not expecting and they made this book for me. I will say there was a lot going on in this book, and I'm not sure some of the subplots were completely necessary, but they didn't detract from story and they were handled intelligently and clearly. Actually, they were surprisingly uncomplicated. At it's core, this book is a beautiful, poignant, unconventional love story about new loves and old flames and first times and second chances and what you're willing to do for your happily ever after. It's really quite spectacular and...complicated.

5 Stars

Sincerely, I thought there was absolutely no way that this book could be better than the first book in the series.  I mean, come on...The Hook Up was almost perfect.  But for the second time in a week, Kristen Callihan has proven me wrong!!  I actually liked this book better.  I loved Gray...every damn thing about Gray...he was perfection.  And Ivy was a wonderful lead female character.  I loved that she wasn't perfect but that she was fun and smart and perfect for Gray.  The story was great, not a rehash of the same old, same old, but smart and new and covering territory I haven't seen handled this well before.  This book should not be missed.

I loved this book....LOVED IT.  It was hot, it was romantic, it was angsty, it was sweet....hell, it was just everything you want a good novella to be.  These brothers, Hunter and Kyan, are hot, but much more importantly, they are so endearing and so very VERY different.  And Calla is a great female lead, strong and smart and fumbling her way through this situation she unexpectedly finds herself in.  What impressed me the most was how invested I was in these characters and how quickly Victoria was able to make me care about each one of them.  This story is compact, but it doesn't miss any of the important beats a romance novel needs to hit and it doesn't skimp on romance or heat or heartache or ....well anything.  It doesn't skimp on anything.  I've read it twice and I have no doubt I will read it again.  Did I mention it was HOT?

So I loved Alexand I really really liked Garrett, but it turns out I didn't really know what love was until Zack. I adored this book and Zack and Ben.but especially Kate. Kate is amazing.

This is the absolute best book yet in an amazing series. Because of the subject matter, Zack was so much better than the vast majority of books on the market today. Having been introduced to Zack and Gina in the previous two books, I was instantly and more acutely drawn into Zacks pain. It made for a heart-wrenching story right from the start.

Zacks pain and guilt over Gina and her death were so wonderfully expressed and emotionally believable that the story came across as incredibly REAL. Thats what made it better than most of the books out there, the emotions, the angst, the conflicts and the relationships were so damn real. I felt Zacks pain. I understood his guilt and I believed his fear.

And Kate was a phenomenal character, one of my favorite female leads in a long time. I LOVED the way she handled everything thrown at her with grace and love and understanding. Her connection with Ben was wonderful and her care and compassion for Zack was a beautiful thing to see. It was terrific to see a woman with poise, control and character.

Book 1 in the series, ALEX was fabulous. Book 2, GARRETT was great too. But this book.this is the ONE! This is one of my top reads in the last two years and read approximately. 150 books a year. Its that good. Definitely a book I will go back to again and again.

This book was a really tough start for me. The first few chapters were a little hard to get into, the writing was choppy and I was having a little trouble following the characters and plots. THANK GOODNESS I did not stop there!! The book really improves by chapter 4 and actually becomes pretty spectacular.

I liked both of the characters and the story took a couple of turns I didn't expect, but completely loved. This book is really a book about finding your way and figuring out what path to take. There is also a major plot point that I won't give away, but that was so big and so well done it made this book feel like nothing I've ever read before.

The sexual chemistry between these two was palpable and the tension in the book was wonderfully crafted. Beau was a guy you kind of think is a jerk at the beginning but you quickly come to realize he's a good, no great guy. There is a nice slow burn and a believable friendship that develops leading to a very realistic relationship. There are so many things going on with these two, but all of the issues are believable and work with each other so it never comes across as false drama, a definitely plus.

I laughed, my breath caught in my throat, my stomach dropped and my tears fell. The book was good and I'm definitely going to seek out the next book in the series.

I received and ARC in exchange for an honest review.

Loved this book. I love rockers and second chance romances and a million other things this book delivered. Everything about it was good. I'm a huge fan of books that deliver on angst and this one did that in spades. I also love books with flashbacks and this story used them just perfectly. There were a few editing errors, but I have a pretty high tolerance for those. The book itself is really enjoyable. I'm probably going to start book two right away.

This book was cute and funny and hot and everything you would expect from J.D. Hollyfield and K. Webster, but what kind of took me by surprise was how emotionally involved I got in these characters. I was totally hooked on the romance and the relationship. I'm not going to lie, of course I did a lot of laughing and gasping in surprise, but I also shed a few tears and swooned hard. I really loved both characters. And the secondary characters were a great addition, adding humor and drama to the entire story. I will definitely be grabbing their books when the time comes.

This story deserves more than 5 stars, way more. I was simply amazed that so much story, so much emotion and such amazing characters could be conveyed in a short novella, but Erica Alexander does it spectacularly. I was so completely invested in Zac and Lilly. Their story is absolutely beautiful, the writing is beyond gorgeous and the why the 17 wishes are tied into the plot is brilliant.

This book is an absolute must read. And for me, it is a must read over and over again. It's amazing that Erica is a first time author because this book reads like the work of a seasoned professional. I read a LOT of short stories and lots of anthology shorts and I can honestly say I have NEVER read one better than this.

I was apprehensive about reading this book only because I loved it's predecessor, Worth the Fall, so much.  I was worried that my expectations were set too high and that I was destined to be disappointed.  I have never been so happy to be wrong.  I loved this book, absolutely loved it.

The lead characters in this story are so wonderfully written.  Both are strong and independent, but dealing with the ramifications of damaging events in their past.  Both believe that they are too damaged to risk getting involved in a relationship, yet they are drawn to each other despite their desire to remain emotionally detached.

This story and it's lead characters are so different from the first book in the series and the story has a much darker undertone.  Their tragic  pasts are difficult to comprehend, but are handled with a wonderful sensitivity that makes for a very emotion ride.  There are parts of this book that were so beautifully written I had tears in my eyes.

I loved this book, really loved it. Plus the added bonus of getting to visit Matt, Abby and the kids again was awesome.

Believe me, this is a book I will read more than once while I wait patiently for the next McKinney novel!!

I received an ARC in exchange for an honest review.

I'm not sure if I've mentioned this before, but Jewel E. Ann is undoubtedly the best author writing books right now. That is not an opinion....it's a fact. Her Jack and Jill series was my absolute favorite read of last year. Seriously, if you haven't read that yet.....RUN AND GRAB IT !!! (Hint the first book, End of Day ,is free right now.) So when I found out Cage and Lake were getting a book of their own (and a second chance) I was ecstatic. I was worried though....I mean I had such high expectations and I knew there wasn't going to be as much action as there had been in the JnJ series so I had doubts. Silly stupid me. I should know better. Every Jewel E Ann book I have read has been SPECTACULAR and this is no exception.

Cage and Lake are wonderful and it is so great to get to hang out with them again. Both of them will melt your heart and then, when they are together the heat will melt your lady parts. (Can I say that?) But what makes this book extraordinary is the fact that the story is not extraordinary. These are two real people, in real life situations, facing challenges and trials and every day life and they are trying to figure out how to do it together. Funny things happen because that's real, sad things happen because that's how life is sometimes. They have ups and down, they have stops and starts....it's glorious. I adored every minute of it. Cage is right up there with the best BBFs ever written but Lake? Lake is messy perfection. I loved her

As with every Jewel book, One has ALL the emotions....EVERY.SINGLE.ONE. I laughed loud, I cried hard, I swooned big time and I cheered like crazy. This book.....this book is the ONE.

Loved this one. I was blown away by Amy Jo's writing. THIS is how you write a book. The romance was believable, the struggles were realistic, the ups and downs were not overly dramatic, they were relatable. The characters were genuine and endearing and the side characters were a spectacular addition to the story. Great great book. Also, the audiobook is simply amazing. The narrator is fantastic.

This was my first MM book and I was apprehensive about venturing into a new genre, but I loved the rest of the series and I loved Guy so I decided to give it a try. I LOVED THIS BOOK. I was floored by how invested I was in these characters and this relationship. Heavy subject matter, but handled with care and consideration. I was literally blown away.

This book is incredible, brilliant even.  Seriously, Laura Kaye gives a master class on how to write a novella. How she manages to build a beautiful, compelling, believable love story with fully developed characters in what amounts to a 12 hour time span is simply remarkable.  I LOVE this book. Caden and McKenna are both amazing characters and so completely engaging.  You will root for these two, you will love these two, you believe these two characters both as individuals and as a couple.

I've probably read this book 10 times, maybe more.  It is my 100% guaranteed go to recommendation when friends are looking for something great to read.  I've gifted and loaned this book dozens of times and EVERY SINGLE PERSON has agreed that is was wonderful. Easily in my TOP 10 books of all time. (Not exaggerating).  You want this book.

WoW... just WoW. Where has Nicola Rendell been all my life? Her writing is fantastic, her story is fantastic, her characters are absolutely fantastic. I could not have loved this book more. Easily in my top 10 for 2016. EASILY.

I completely fell in love with both characters. Mary and Jimmy are so multi-dimensional, so believable and so unexpected. I was invested in both of them from the very first chapter. Nicola does a perfect job of making you feel every emotion right along with the characters, of making you love them and understand them without bogging the story down with endless internal dialogue or overly flowery prose. She writes real emotion, fast and intense and relatable. This story moves fast, but the pace is perfect and believable. I literally couldn't put this one down (yes I slept for three hours last night but TOTALLY worth it.)

I'm not kidding when I say I am in AWE of her writing. This, ladies and gentlemen, is how it's done. This book right here is how you build a story. I will read every single thing this woman writes....EVERY.SINGLE.THING. (Also her knowledge was clearly evident and almost perfect.)

Amy Jo is an amazing writer (if you don't believe me just read her book Off Campus!! It's one of my favorite). So when I found her M/F/F erotic novella Callie, Unwrapped, I grabbed it immediately. I mean menage erotica from Amy Jo is a must have. BUT what ended up blowing me away was how much MORE than erotica that book was. It's an amazing story full of characters with the kind of depth you don't usually find in erotica or novellas. I loved how well rounded the story was, how invested in the characters I became and how much I needed to find out where this story goes.

Gabe and Callie have history and heat and a newly divorced Callie is looking to expand her horizons so to speak. So  Gabe and his new girlfriend are willing to lend her a hand. This story is HOT, crazy hot. But it's also sweet and deep and nostalgic and a whole bunch of other things I never expected.

So, bottom line is this....READ THIS. I promise you won't be disappointed. If you have ever thought you wanted to give an Amy Jo book a try, here is the perfect opportunity. Read THIS. If you never thought about reading an Amy Jo book (first, what's the matter with you???) Second...Read THIS.

It's January and I can tell you whole-heartedly that this book will be in my Top Ten for 2017.
Here's how I know:

This duet is in my Top Ten Books of All Time (as in one of the very best stories I've ever read).

This story is simply the most beautiful, uplifting, heart-breaking, love-affirming, soul-shattering roller coaster I've ever read. I can only say I am so beyond grateful that Mia Kayla took me on such a breath-taking ride. I'm not going to tell you this book is flawless because the beauty of this book is its flaws...its flawed characters, its flawed love, its flawed circumstances. I loved every single page in this story...even the ones I hated.

What blew me away, more than any other aspect of this book, is how much I LOVED each and every character. I think that's what made this story unforgettable. Sam is clearly torn between these two amazing and amazingly different men in her life, but you will be too. I understood Sam because I also loved them both. I adored Hawke and his crazy life and his beautiful words and intense love. But I also adored Josh and his calm strength and his beautiful heart and his compassionate love. Crap...now I'm tearing up just thinking about them. It's just stunning to me that Mia was able to make me love them both so completely. And Sam is a great character. There is nothing weak or selfish in her feeling for these two. She is a loving, caring, independent woman who has had her fair share of heart-break. She is in a situation that no woman would ever expect to find herself in and there are simply no easy answers. She is never careless with her feelings or callous with her love.

This is not a book about cheating, that's not what's going on here. It's a book about circumstances you don't plan and feelings you don't expect and people you never see coming, but who matter in ways you can't control. It's about the decisions you make and the decisions that are made for you. This book is about all the best parts and the worst parts of falling in love. It's about falling in love fast and falling in love slow and friendship and passion and hurt and heartache. It's about love.

This book is a love triangle, honestly the BEST love triangle I have ever read. It is NOT a menage or a threesome (Nothing wrong with those...I read them too. That's just not what this duet is). I know not everyone loves a triangle...read this one anyway. I know people like the concept of a once in a lifetime love that is like nothing the H/h have ever experienced before....read this book anyway. I know not everyone embraces the idea that you can love two different people for very different reasons at the same time....READ. IT. ANYWAY !!! I would absolutely hate to think that anyone would miss out on this absolutely breath-taking love story because they were afraid to take a chance on it or because they had a preconceived notion of what a love story needs to look like.

I just can't believe how freaking brilliant it is. I honestly laughed out loud, I ugly cried, I panicked, I screamed, I swooned, I hurt, I healed and I loved. THIS is why I read. This feeling right here....like I can't get enough and I never want it to end.

I loved this one, specifically because it just did things I never expected it to...and I love that. I was yelling and crying and cheering for these characters. It was so real, it just felt like a sports romance with all the fluff striped away and all the reality exposed. I read books to feel and this book let me feel everything, highs, lows, love, hate, anger, joy, fear, forgiveness...everything.  Loved this one big time.
