In Love With Paris...
Travel to Paris from the Luxury of Your Favorite Reading Chair!
Can you imagine the excitement of being offered an all-expense paid vacation by your boss to travel anywhere outside the States that youve always wanted to visit? Can you imagine catching a glimpse of your favorite author as you arrive at the airport, purchasing her newest romance novel during pre-flight activities at the airport, and then discovering that youll be sitting next to each other on an international flight? Can you imagine picking Paris as the city of choice for your trip and then bumping into the most handsome man ever in the airport with the last name of Paris?

Mr. Simon wishes to honor his daughter Janelles life by giving the amazing gift of an all-expense paid trip to the young women that have become like daughters too through their hard work at Simons Department Store and their encouragement and support since his daughters death. Paget Murphy is the head art buyer for Simons Department Store and has chosen Paris with a focus on seeing the originals of her favorite artists at The Louvre.

Pagets story begins as her best friend Carey drops her off at the airport with instructions to have the time of her life and to capture every memory of this exciting trip in the gift of a journal. The dialogue between characters is fun and natural. The insertion of French phrases by the sexy handsome stranger is a definite lift to the romantic development and blends into the story perfectly without being forced. The journal entries capture a young womans thoughts and feelings and add to the visualization of the sights and sounds not only for a first visit to Paris but also for all of the first buds of a new romance.

This story was published prior to the tragedy in Paris 13-Nov-2015 that is forever etched in our minds as is the date of 11-Sep-2001. It honors the City of Lights in the loveliest of ways from scenic descriptions of hotel and museum interiors to jogging paths to creating the realistic aromas and flavors of French cuisine as though the reader can join the characters in each taste sensation at the cafs whether indoors or outdoors. Avec l'amour  Paris de l'auteur Sharon Kleve et les lecteurs du monde entier. Prires pour la paix sur la terre. Joyeux Nol  tous! [Translation: With love to Paris from author Sharon Kleve and readers from around the world. Prayers for peace on earth. Merry Christmas Everyone.

I'm off to my reading chair to read the other 6 stories in this collection.

Kisses and Strudel is the first story in a series entitled, Places to See and the travel will take the main character Aubri for her first travel abroad for a vacation in Germany. This is a beautifully written novella for reading pleasure during the Christmas holiday season. It is also a story that unfolds with hidden treasure that will spark inspiration regardless of the season or time of the year that the reader discovers this story to read. Its also the perfect story to challenge all book reviewers that decry a novella solely on the length of the story for within this story is not merely a Christmas romance but an uplifting message of hope and joy.

The inspiration from within this novella is two-fold with approaches to life after two different kinds of grief  after a parents loss of a child and after a tragic accident, a young mans loss of vision.  Mr. Simon and Ryker Forst could have become bitter through the circumstances of their life journeys. Each man could have wallowed in grief.  Instead, Mr. Simon has turned the grief of the loss of his young daughter into a gift of love and living life for the young women that became like daughters to him through their support in his darkest hours of grief. Ryker Forst has chosen to never say never and to become as self-sufficient as possible not only so he can help continue the legacy of the family business but to challenge himself to live fully every day. What an extraordinary way to develop the Places to See series with a story of inspiration to be open to all the possibilities that life and loving have to offer. Some haven't had the connection to a mentor or a friend to help build their self-esteem. Some only see obstacles and detours on their life journey. Reading this story might also give some the hope and strength one needs to find within to believe in the possibilities that change offers even change that can only begin after the loss of a loved one or after a tragic accident.
Based on the authors dedication, Many thanks to all the wonderful people of Germany who made our trip an enjoyable and memory filled adventure I would guess the exquisite details of this storys adventure is due to the authors own experiences during a trip to Germany. Whether the trip to Germany was created for the authors research or the story was created from the authors memories of a wonderful vacation in Germany, readers are treated to intricacies that can only be captured through first-hand experiences.

In addition to the intricacies of what becomes Aubris adventure in Germany, there is the authors talent of expressive writing that brings vivid visualization for the readers imagination. This is a glimpse of one of my favorites from this story: Gently, like the brush of a butterflys wing, he drew his index finger over her eyebrow, across her eye, cheek and then down across her lips.

Mr. Simon says, The thing which puts me at peace is knowing she (his daughter Janelle) lived before she died. She spent as much time as she was able with her family, she traveled the world, and told me she fell in love. This is what I want for you. Gifting Kisses and Strudel could be your most meaningful present of the holiday season if youd like to give someone a heartwarming read to comfort, to inspire, and to quietly and encouragingly express step outside your comfort zone and every day is a new day. Read Aubris story and see for yourself. Its a story to share again and again  You can change something that you aren't happy with at any time.

This book was selected for me by my Secret Santa as part of the SantaThing 2014 created by LibraryThing!

I have previously really enjoyed novels with the character detective Harry Bosch and this novel is no exception. I was riveted! In fact, due to the storyline the reader is also introduced to Jaye Winston, a FBI agent who asks retired FBI agent Terry McCaleb for his help. This is apparently the 2nd appearance of Terry McCaleb so I will look forward to reading the first book in his series in the future.

This novel has twists and turns that my anticipation would imagine are very similar to the twists and turns in true investigations. I was also enthralled with the courtroom scenes as in some legal thrillers the courtroom scenes become dull and actually provide more cloud cover than addition to the novel. Michael Connelly's courtroom scenes are dramatic, enlightening, and definitely add nuances to the storyline that are subtle and deftly written.

I also felt that in light of all of the violence across our country that this novel is also a poignant reminder of how much everyone in law enforcement sacrifices of themselves and to their families in trying to keep their families safe, protected from their ups and downs during investigations, and the daily struggle to "do it all" and "be all" to everyone in their professional and personal lives. I have always had the utmost respect for everyone in law enforcement but this book renewed my respect for their dedication "to the job" and a most sincere wish that we could all appreciate the safety and peace they bring to our daily lives. Perhaps in 2015, we could all give back to them whenever an opportunity presents itself and perhaps to create those opportunities of appreciation.

users.query: I really did not like this cereal. It's very, very sweet and also has a really strong maple flavor - couldn't taste any pecan flavor at all, just extremely sweet, overpowering maple. And if that weren't enough to turn me away from this product, it turns to mush in the bowl. Before I'd eaten half my breakfast, the cereal was just a mess of mushy, grainy junk in my bowl. And I didn't take two hours for breakfast - the cereal goes to mush in about ten minutes or less. Maybe it's what some people want....but definitely not me.

cands.text: This is a good cereal, both in taste and in its composition. For medical reasons I need high protein, low sugar foods and it is very hard to find a breakfast cereal that is both. It also tastes good! The reason I gave it only four stars instead of five is because the company that makes is states it uses "non GMO soy" and as an educated consumer, I know that there is no reason to avoid any GMO foods.

Very good cereal - the cinnamon taste is just right for me, not too strong but definitely there. It is really hard to find a food product that is both high in protein but low in sugar so I very much appreciate this company. Keep making your products just like you are! Please!!
Strange taste - not terrible but not at all like candy.

Good flavor although not as cheesy as they might be. I only gave them four stars because they are very thick and substantial - I guess I was expecting something a little thinner and potato chip-like. However, as a high protein,low sugar snack, these are excellent - just be prepared to need to really chew!

It is very hard to find good-tasting foods for someone like me who's had a partial gastrectomy - we need high protein and low sugar and carbs. This company makes a number of food products that are great for this restricted type of diet. And this tastes good! A little apple taste, a little cinnamon taste and a good crunch - very good way to start my day!

Pretty good as long as you don't think you're getting anything remotely resembling a cookie - which is kind of what the package implies. There's nothing cookie-like about them. But they are tasty if you like cinnamon. I would say they are basically a miniwheat biscuit - dry and crunchy. But if you want a tasty, crunchy, dry snack with your coffee (or whatever your beverage of choice is), then you'll probably like these.

I like this coffee quite well - it's as described, a medium blend. I found it had good coffee flavor without any bitterness, seemed like a nice smooth cup of coffee to start my day with. Plus I'm trying to buy only these biodegradable-style coffee pods so I don't throw any more trash into a landfill than I have to. These work just fine in our new Keurig 2.0 coffeemaker, so...good coffee, good pod....good deal!

The reason I gave only four stars is that the cereal bowls are just plain cereal bowls - no holiday design. And the coffee mugs could have had something more festive than just red. So, I like the two sets of plates with the holiday design but I feel like everything should be Christmasy, not just half the set.

I bought this in January - I've used it only a few times and have never overloaded it. Yesterday, I put a half gallon of milk, two cans of corn and a package of Jiffy muffin mix in it - that was all, four items - and the handle broke when I picked it up. Don't waste your money on this basket - there are a lot of sturdier, better shopping baskets out there.

This is a very good clock for the price. It's very quiet and I like the soft egg-colored background of the dial. So far, keeping accurate time as expected. It was very easy to set.
My only negative comment is about the packing and shipping, not the clock. When it arrived, there was a small chip in the wood - I could cover it with scratch remover but someone was obviously careless at some point in either assembly or shipping. Also, there was a noticeable speck of something INSIDE the dial cover so I had to take the glass off and clean it.
But I still feel it's a good buy because the clock really is very nice-looking. And quiet!

This is probably my husband's favorite tea and I've tried several different kinds. I feel positively British when I brew us a "cuppa"! It has good flavor without any bitterness - it's just a good kind of tea for anytime.

This is probably my husband's favorite tea and I've tried several different kinds. I feel positively British when I brew us a "cuppa"! It has good flavor without any bitterness - it's just a good kind of tea for anytime.

This is a strong, healthy plant. It came fast and I planted it as soon as it arrived. Within just a few days, it was sending out new leaves and now after about three weeks, it's easily twice the size as it was when it came. It has even started making one or two tendrils. A very good plant from a very good seller.

Takes a little effort to get it up into a basket shape and a little more effort to make it go back down - otherwise, I'm satisfied with it. I can carry two gallons of milk in it and it handles it fine.

It's not perfect but in my opinion, it's still much, much better than the scoop and repeat (and repeat and repeat) method of cleaning our pets' litter boxes. This system really does work! Sometimes a clump of poop or peep sticks to the inside but I just dislodge it with a litter scoop and then roll it with the rest of the "presents" our cats leave for us. You have to use a good clumping litter but I've found that one or two rolls of the litter box, then I empty the tray and hey, presto! it's done! Takes less time and a lot less handling. Plus our son told me about the Litter Genie and the end of the tray just fits the opening in the Litter Genie - it's great! We have three cats and a kitten (no, we're not crazy cat people - our daughter is a veterinarian) and all of them made the switch to a different litter box without any problems. Last big plus - I'm not leaning over an open litter box breathing in the litter dust for several minutes at a time while cleaning them. I liked our first one so much I bought a second one and I'd do it again in a heartbeat - best system I've found yet if you have cats.
I got the larger size and it's plenty big enough for our two 14 lb. boy cats. I should add, however, that you do need some room to roll it so I would say it's not going to work very well in a small, confined space.

I just wanted some snack bowls for our evening popcorn and I had no idea it would be so hard to find a good size. Well, these are just what I was looking for. They're sturdy enough that I think they'll hold up - so far, no problem running them through the dishwasher. The colors are quite close to the picture - so....pretty darn cute. And they - for us - are just the right size for a nice serving of popcorn!

Our son has this same teamaker, and when we visit him, he would make the best tea I'd ever tasted. So, I got one of my own and I'm happy to say that the tea tastes just as good in our own kitchen! It seems very well made - the controls are clear and easy to use. I like the keep warm function and also that the owner's manual not only tells you how to use it, but has tips for when NOT to put sugar in your tea (oolong) and also that it is perfectly all right to reuse the tea once or twice. I've done this, and just set the brew for "strong" instead of "medium" and the result is just as good.
It is expensive, but this is one time when I think the product is worth the price.
Do be sure to read the manual - this is the only kitchen item I've ever owned that instructs you to not put the pot under running water and not to wash the inside (the tea is supposed to gain in flavor the longer it's used with no more than wiping out with your dishcloth).
If you like tea, get this - it's like the difference between instant coffee and coffee made in a good coffee maker.

Very good coffee, good taste without being too strong or bitter. Plus, there's a tab to pull off the foil top for recycling - really appreciate the extra effort! We have had absolutely no problems using these in our Keurig so I'm very happy to find pods that I can recycle instead of adding to the landfills.

The turban had a very odd and to me, unpleasant, feel and odor to it when it came. The fabric felt almost oily or greasy, like it was leaving something on my fingers. It also had a strange  smell - I had to wash it three times before it was acceptable to me.
It also was absolutely IMPOSSIBLE to fasten it using the very BIG button and the very SMALL thread loop that it came with - there was no way that little bitty loop would go over the button, plus the loop wasn't even elastic, it was thread. So I had to remove the button and sew on velcro strips and now it's just fine. I now really like it - the fabric is very soft and very absorbable and I can wrap it around my head and fasten it with the velcro and voila! done deal. So.... three stars for the way it came and the work involved in making it useful. Otherwise, it's a very nice shower turban.

These are beautiful little strawberry plants. The order was for ten but the seller put thirteen plants in my package. Every one is strong and healthy looking, long thick roots on each one. I just got them today and have just planted them so I'll have to update this in a couple of weeks as to how they are growing.

It's very soft and thick - the reason I'm giving only five stars is that the color pictured is not at all the color of the mat I received. I wanted this kind of slate blue to go with my bathroom - what I got is a lightish teal color. It's very pretty if you wanted turquoise but since I didn't, I'm disappointed.

They fit very well over my prescription transition lens glasses - I thought they might feel awkward or heavy but they don't. I feel like I'm just wearing regular sunglasses when I drive and I like that when I arrive wherever I was going, I just take them off and I already have my glasses on - no switching back and forth all the time. What a great idea for those of us with transition lens who want (or need) sunglasses for driving!
I also really like the color and pattern - it's bright and chic without being flashy.

These are much wider than a standard medium - I'd say they are a wide fit, made for a heavier foot. They seemed like a good shoe but I can't really give a review as the sizing is just not true, so I couldn't wear them without them flopping off my feet. If the company sized them like most shoe companies, I'd say these were an 8.5 or even a 9 wide.

It's a nice boot but this brand apparently runs quite small. This is the second pair of Propet shoes I've tried - different styles - and both have run very small. I normally wear an 8.5 or 9 but in this brand, I need a 9.5. I've never had any other brand with this big a discrepancy in sizing. The boot itself is fine but the company didn't have anything larger to let me exchange for nor do they offer free returns. So....don't think I'll ever buy their shoes again.

I like it. It was easy to assemble (but helpful hint - pay attention to which way you place the connectors; I had to take one end apart because I didn't make sure that I had the holes pointing up and down for the rods that connect each shelf to the next one). It really holds a LOT of shoes - I got every pair I own out of my closet and off several small shoe stackers; now they're all in one place on this handy dandy unit. It's not terribly stylish but it is very functional and that's what I was after. For me, the size is just right - fits in the corner of a spare bedroom and now it's so easy to see what shoes I'm after. I highly recommend it!

users.query: i want to love this dock, but after killing 5 lightning cords ($100 in cords) in 4 months I can't like it.  The dock offers no support for the cords so when you dock it moves the Lightning port ever so slightly until after a few weeks it breaks and the cord stops charging.  I thought it was a fluke at first, but when it kept happening I knew it was the dock.

cands.text: I've been buying the Mophie Juice Pack Air since 2009 and I've had three of them break so far.  They all break at the same place:  the USB port.  Apparently they didn't put any glue on the USB port and it's just barely hanging in there, after a 3-12 months it will always break.  There's a Youtube video that shows how to take apart the mophie so it should be easy to open and glue yourself.  I have two more Mophie cases on the way, I will take these apart and glue them before I start using them.

It worked fine a few times, but all it took is letting water in once and the $950 phone is dead.  Maybe after sitting in rice overnight the phone will work again but it's been a few hours and there are no signs of life yet.  I should have known better than to trust a $15 plastic pouch with a $950 phone but I trusted all these fake reviews.

I've had this... oh, I don't know, over a year at least, maybe 2 years, and it's almost completely full, with camcorder USB cord, digital camera cord, ipod dock, webcam, printer, and micro USB cord.  My PC usb ports are full too, with keyboard, mouse, external DVDRW, usb cord to Belkin 7-port, USB thumbdrive and Apple ipod usb cable.

Since the Belkin is almost full I was looking for a new USB hub and saw a 10 port powered generic USB hub for $8 shipped, but the reviews on Amazon said it wasn't good so I decided it would probably be safer to buy another Belkin, after all I've had so much luck with it and they are stackable.  I was pretty surprised to see all the negative reviews.  Granted I purchased mine at retail (not on Amazon) so maybe that made the difference, but still this Belkin 7-port hub has worse reviews on here than the 10 port I was considering.

Now I'm not sure what to get, the reliable Belkin that everyone says isn't reliable, or a cheap generic USB hub that only a few people have problems with?

One thing's for sure, if anything suspicious does happen I'm checking the Belkin USB hub first.

I bought one of these pouches on amazon two weeks ago and now I'm back looking for a real waterproof case because my iPhone 6 plus is dead because this let in a little water.  Don't trust your $950 iPhone to a $10 clear pouch.  I tested mine too and it worked great dipping it in some water but the moment it got bumped around in the pool it allowed water in

Never used the battery and it's dead.  Put it on the ryobi charger to make sure it's full and left it there for weeks, now it doesn't hold a charge and is dead.  The charger doesn't recognize it anymore

The mesh wifi is good, but the support is amazing.  They reply in minutes, and when one of my luma wouldn't change to solid blue and wouldn't reset they sent me another one in two days.  Amazing service!

I've had this remote for nearly a year and after reading all the complaints about the rechargeable models I'm glad it's NOT rechargeable.

The newer models like the Harmony One apparently suck the poor rechargeable dry in no time and when it no longer holds a charge the proprietary rechargeable battery is hard to find and expensive at $45+.

Thankfully I just have to pop in 4 AAA batteries (I use Sanyo Eneloop precharged NiMH batteries) and I'm off and running again.  They last a few months with daily use.

Also these remotes are dirt cheap, selling for less than $50 online.  I found mine at a thrift store for $5!  Apparently they didn't know what they had.  I really don't understand spending $150 on a remote to turn on the $500 52" Plasma.  $150 could be spent better places in my opinion.

Shame Logitech doesn't sell anymore AAA powered remotes anymore, but I guess they're trying to make extra $$$ from battery sales.

The 550 is also one of the few non-rechargeable models to support 15 devices.  I sometimes wish it had a color screen but then I remind myself it is just a remote, it's function is to turn on other color screens ;)  I honestly don't think I'll ever upgrade unless everything goes radio frequency.

I purchased this to plug into an outlet that's inside a wall mounted cabinet.  Unfortunately this is so large it covers both the outlets and then some, not giving enough room at the bottom to run a Ethernet cord.  Since these have to be plugged directly into the wall and not through an extension cord I can't use this.  If the plug rotated or had a short extension cord or if the Ethernet ports were on the side I could use this, but since it does not offer any of those three options it's worthless to me.  When I finally did plug it into another outlet the speeds were 1/5th the speeds of a desktop sitting right next to it with a PCI-E AC1900 wifi adapter.  I thought powerline ethernet was suppose to be fast?  This is much slower than wifi.

WARNING:  Some sellers shipping cables NOT Xbox 360 S compatible.  Even though the description says this cable is compatible with Xbox 360 S hard drives the seller shipped a old cable that does not work.  I have left them negative feedback but this is still a pain since I needed the correct cable.

UPDATE 2015:  I own two of these and I want to like them, but the desktop software is horrible, it's always losing connection.  Only time they ever work reliably is when they're connected by ethernet cables but I can't run cables all over the house.  Dropping down to 2 stars because I do not like these cameras and would not recommend them.  Everyone that asks about them I tell them no, don't buy them.

OLD:  Ok it is working properly now, but it was a pain to setup and sometimes the Eye4 software won't work for days for not reason.  I bought a brand new 2014 $170 dlink "HD" camera and it actually had **worse** low light video quality.  This vstarcam is actually very good in low light even without the nightvision on.  Also the framerate problems I was having was due to poor wifi signal.  I plugged into ethernet and it's perfect now.

OLD REVIEW:

Short review:  do not buy any vstarcam

Long review:  I had a lot of hopes for this.  For years I was using a old computer with a webcam hooked to it running Yawcam to broadcast what the webcam saw.  Old logitech webcam, but it was still good enough for a clear 720p image.  But the computer was old and struggled with serving the video over the internet and recording, and getting all the various software to use one webcam was a pain.  Plus video at night was too dark.  So I went looking for a all-in-one solution:  a camera that would record and broadcast good HD video, look good at night, and be wireless.

Wow was a I disappointed.

First, setup was a breeze.  Hooked it to power and ethernet, downloaded the app, scanned the barcode on the camera and voila!  I was watching video on my phone less than 5 minutes after opening the box.  Impressive!

Then it was all downhill.  Video is not HD.  Not 720p.  Maybe poor quality 480p?  240p?  Whatever it is, it's horrible.  Closest thing I can compare it to is old flip cellphones that had cameras and you could take videos but the videos were really pixelated?  You can tell what's going on, but you wouldn't want to use it for a birthday party.  That's what this looks like.  Does not look like any 720p camera I've ever seen.  I've seen video on Youtube that is suppose to be from these cameras and the video is decent, maybe I just got a defective one.

Next is the problem with wireless.  No matter how close it is to the router it drops the framerates, sometimes as low as 0.7 fps.  Yes less than 1 frame a second.  That's truly bad.  And even when it does make it to 15 or 20 framerates the video is so choppy that there is no way it's really 20 framerates a second.  I thought maybe my wireless was bad but even next to the router the framerates never go above 20 fps.  I even bought a wireless booster and put it halfway between the router and camera, still drops to 0.7 fps.  I give up, there is no way for this camera to work well over wireless.

But the worse problem is I can't view this camera in a browser.  That's important because I am forever tied to their software, I can't just open up any computer or tablet and type in a address and start viewing, I will always have to hope they have a program compatible with the device I'm using and download that software and enter my password before I can start watching.  This is NOT a IP Camera.  I will not work with all the great surveillance programs out there.

So to wrap it up:  video quality is bad, the framerates are bad, and I have to use only their software.

I plugged in the batteries, it started charging the first battery and when it was done it started charging the second battery.  Well worth the six bucks to be able to plug them all in and come back later and have all the batteries charged.  It is flimsy but looking at the photos I expected that.  I didn't notice it getting hot.
Don't get this if you want to use it with your iPad or iPhone because it won't work

UPDATE:  11 months and the motor burnt out and needed replacing.  Reverse worked for awhile but now it won't reverse.  Remote still doesn't work, seat still broken.  This is junk.  Power wheels still working fine after 7 years.

UPDATE:  it's been ten months and the seat is falling apart.  This is the most disappointing purchase I've made on Amazon.  For the price this should last longer than a year.  1-star

THREE MONTH REVIEW:  now it dies after a few minutes. Think it's shorted out inside because it acts like it wants to start and gets to 3.7v and then dies again and repeats.  He has a powerwheels that's over 10 years old and still going strong while this thing didn't even last 6 months.  I had to disassemble it and reapply the clamps on the battery because they were loose.

ONE MONTH REVIEW:  First, this does not do 5 miles per hour.  Top speed even without a child is 3mph which is a average walking pace.  I bought this hoping my child could drive while I ran next to him but it's too slow for that.  Low speed is about half that.  Second, my 40 lbs almost 3 year old is already too large for this.  You can see how close his knees are to the steering wheel.  I will keep it but there is no way 5 or 6 year olds could fit in this comfortably.  Third, as you can see from the photos of a Cayenne and this together, this is more closely related to a Porsche Cayenne than a Porsche Boxster, with the quad exhaust and the led lights in the grill like a Cayenne.  It might sound like I'm complaining but I'm not.  I took it to a car show with my kid and everyone was more interested in this little car than any car there.  "Wow is it playing music?", "I like the blue lights in the wheels!", "How much was it?", and "Where did you get it?" were only some of the questions I spent the day answering.  It's a very impressive vehicle, with a real leather seat, working doors, working horn, and MP3 player that came with built in children's songs.  He hates when I take control with the remote though, but if you have a younger child too small to reach the peddles that remote would be perfect.  I like that the remote has a instant STOP button so if he tries to drive off I can just press that and stop the vehicle instead of pressing reverse.  I do wish it was a little larger but it fits easily in a trunk or small SUV better than a larger powerwheels ride-on would so that's one advantage of it being a little on the small side.  UPDATE:  added new photos of batteries and battery compartment under seat.  Used two 6v 4.5amp batteries.  Looks to be plenty of room for upgrading to a larger battery.  UPDATE:  I did upgrade to a 12v 9ah battery and now it will travel for hours.  It's great.  Friend bought a cheaper generic version for their baby and it's very jerky, too jerky for a baby because the neck jerks back.  This accelerates smoothly, although I have been having problems with the car not moving forward.  Press on the pedal and it does nothing.  Backward and everything else works so I do not know what is causing this problem.  It's not all the time, very sporadic.  Dropping rating to 3 stars.

Bad battery issues.  Phantom 2 vision will flash red, screen says there is a battery issue and it lands itself.  Seems there are a lot of people having this problem on the phantom 2 vision Amazon reviews.  I just want to exchange the battery but dji does not make it easy to contact them.  For $130 I expected a more reliable battery.

this works better than my 2.1 amp home chargers which is important because in the car I use the phone as GPS so I need a good charger.  Not only does it maintain the charge while the GPS is going but it also provides enough extra power to charge the phone up, I would say about 1% a minute, which is amazing considering the GPS is sucking the battery dry at the same time.  Highly recommend this to everyone

I've had the MX 5000 for almost 2 years now and I'm very disappointed.  For no apparent reason the mouse will suddenly "slow" and drift from where it should be pointing.  Also the keyboard will randomly decide to get stuck on certain keys and just continue to type them as if I'm holding them down but the key itself isn't stuck, it's like it lost connection mid-sentence and decided to just keep going.  I think both these problems are related to being Bluetooth so my next mouse and keyboard will probably be wired.

UPDATE:  the cloud storage prices have changed and are incredibly overpriced.  Now there is only free which doesn't offer enough and Premium at $15 a month which offers 30 day storage and unlimited rapid recaps.  I bought this for the rapid recap but paying $15 a month is ridiculous.

OLD REVIEW:  Doesn't work on PC, even through a browser, I always get a error message, and when I tried to view cloud stored videos like rapidrecap the flir.com website kicked me out of the website saying my password didn't match.  App works well though, the only reason to buy this over other WiFi security cameras is the rapidrecap feature and that worked perfectly on the app.  I have many other brands of security cameras that do a much better job of recording and work on desktops but if I need to see what happened it takes forever to scan through hours of video to find what I'm looking for.  Not only does this have the rapidrecap feature, but if I need to see more of a specific clip that I saw in rapidrecap it allows that too.  The app also allowed me to easily download the video and share on iOS.  Would probably be a good dashcam since it allows you to stream directly to your phone, so if you needed to show an accident to someone you should be able to wirelessly transfer the video to your phone

i bought this and a competing product to compare.  The other waterproof case has a black border around the sides and top which blocked the camera on the iPhone 6 plus.  Not a problem on this, completely clear and the photos look great and the touchscreen works thru the pouch even underwater.  My only complaint is it is a little tight, it was not easy sliding the phone in and out, but other than that this is the perfect waterproof case for the iPhone 6 plus

Seal broke to our underwater light and costs nearly $1,000 to replace and required draining the pool.  Figured even if these flolights need replacing every few months we could replace them for dozens of years and it still be cheaper.  After reading reviews we bought 4 figuring we would need to replace them often.  So far only 1 failed and it's probably because we didn't store it in water over the winter and it dried out.  This winter we will keep the pair in a jar of water from the pool to keep the internal parts from drying out.  Yes it sucks that a $20 light failed after only 1 year but it's better than the alternative and I like having the lights on all the time, I don't have to turn anything on to see the pool at night.  EDIT:  after 12 months 3 out of the 4 have failed.  That's $60 a year, which means it would take 16 years of replacing these to reach $1,000 the light costs to replace.  We like these better than a regular light because they're always on, we can look out at night and see the pool glow.  We will keep buying them even though they break frequently until something better comes along.
Works perfectly, the lasers are easy to see and the motion sensor works great

The frustrating part is there's no LED or button on the keyboard to indicate if it should be on or not, I can't tell if it's a hardware or software problem, the software just says to swipe my finger and I do so and nothing happens, the software behaves as if I haven't swiped my finger at all.

It's still a very quiet keyboard so I may still keep it, but I was disappointed to see it doesn't work as advertised and therefore can not recommend it.

I had my doubts this could be as good as they say since regular 80mm fans are about 30cfm and they're claiming 78cfm from this.  Wow was I wrong.  It easily beat the 120mm fans I own and even at 5 volts it moved more air than 80mm fans at 12v.  If you have to have a 80mm fan and want high airflow then buy this fan.

the video quality of this thing is horrible.  The picture is very fuzzy, far worse than 20 yr old home made VHS recordings, and the LEDs for use with nightvision are so close to the camera lens that they end up washing out the picture and all you can see is this bright glare.  The nightvisions looks like I'm trying to take a video with a giant maglight held right next to the camera lens.
