And these are just two drinks out of One Hundred that have been tracked down and exposed to sunlight and brought back so you can vote on your favorite.

cands.text: The Drunken Botanist: The Plants That Create The World's Great Drinks. Who knew? Cocktails are all the rage with the trendy of many ages. There is even a show on NetFlix. This book is a real treasure trove of information about cocktails, I'm surprised that MADD, hasn't sued the writer yet. Remember to drink responsibly and to always use a taxi or other public transportation after a day imbibing.
Intriguing and somewhat exotic the coffee exceeded my expectations and will be ordered again.
Intriguing and somewhat exotic the coffee exceeded my expectations and will be ordered again.
Maxwell House International Coffee Dark Mayan..6cans @7.4ounces. A present that has been recieved and I've been profusely thanked for the purchase.

Leroni of Darkover, is the kind of anthology I like read before going to sleep. Pleasant stories by women(and men) writers, some who are published elsewhere and some who seemed to write just occasionally for Marion Zimmer Bradley's different anthologies. Leroni, fills in the gaps of the in the shadows of the Darkover history, with occasional forays into potential alternative backgrounds for some of Marion's favorite characters. If you read the Darkover series but not the different anthologies, do your self a favor and pick up the Leroni of Darkover and enjoy the world of Darkover again and again.
Interesting blends and choices a little bit frou frou for me but the ladies at work sure enjoy them.
I BOUGHT THIS FOR A FRIEND WHO HADN'T TRIED 8 O'clock coffee. They thought it tasted great and really liked the arabica beans and the mildness whic allowed them to have more coffee.

MZB's Sword and Sorceress II, is a great add on for my home library. Yes, I prefer printed materials on paper. I tried a NOOK, but really with the advent of large television sets, who wants to strain their eyes? I prefer the more visceral feel of a printed book.
 I have read as many Marion Zimmer Bradley, works over the years as I have been able to lay my hands on. But was a late comer to her anthology series(s). Then to my surprise I found that what she liked in different authors are basically what I like too. So I have been on a quest to ferret out her anthologies. Her wry views on life at the start of each story, are as much of a treat as her books has always been to me.  Each Christmas,  I go vainly in search of a new novel even though she has been dead since 1999. So I troll the second hand stores and Amazon, in a never ending quest to find her printed gold.
Grove Square cappuccino is a good value and tastes great.
Sometimes you don't feel like making your baklava at home as a treat this a a great value with a good variety of different baklava(s).

Buy this book, if you can't buy it, go to your local library and check it out or download it on Kindle. S.M.Stirling and Margaret Atwood are some of the best writers of dystopian futures that are currently writing today. Dies the Fire, has a great opening that grabs you by the throat and doesn't let go until later in the series. You don't have to believe me, just read it yourself and see how far you want to ride along with characters and plot lines. You won't be sorry.

Let me tell you, I buy this product as an ongoing present for my sister. The price I found on this shipment was the best I had ever seen, and jumped right on it. If you find a bargain like this snatch it. I was able to buy twelve 8.2 ounce containers for just under $28.00. My sister tells me the flavor is perfect. Personally I like a tbsp or two, stirred into a large cup of regular coffee. Perfect after blowing a little snow out of the driveway.
The organization I work for seems to like the tea assortment and if they don't they haven't told me about it.
Raya's Kitchen 2 in 1 Lemon Zester and Cheese... its okay I was actually expecting something with a little more substansial feel or heft but it does work and works well.

General Foods International Suisse Mocha Coffee Drink Mix, 8-Ounce Tins 6 of 6 pack. I buy these like cans of ersatz coffee for my sister, who seems to just suck them up. What I really like buying them from the Amazon subscription service is that the price is way cheaper than anything I can find in store. My sister loves most all of the flavors and she really enjoys the treat when I over whelm her cupboard with her favorite coffee supply. Even if it is an ersatz coffee in my world.

Hi, bought the Camano Island Coffee and since it's delivery have been enjoying it daily. Friends and family are enjoying it as well. Although my 85 year old father asked, "if the well had been acting up lately" when he first started drinking the Brazil Dark roast.
I'm looking forward to trying other products by the Camano Island Coffee Roasters group.
Caza Trail Coffee, Coastal Blend, 100 Single K -cups Nice mellow flavor mekes glad to go to work to enjoy a cup of coffee before begining my work day.

S.M.Stirling, I love your books of the Change series. This one however just is a little more annoying. Although I do plan on picking it up and trying again in February. Although I picked this up in May of 2008, and still haven't really cracked more than the first four chapters and this is the start of 2013. What can I say, I'm still working on assorted stories by Twain, Kipling and Dickens and I started reading them in childhood. I didn't with you until I read your collaborations with Anne McCaffrey.
I used this product in an office environment. The ladies I work with really enjoyed the taste of the coffee. Way to go Grove Square!! Your cappuccino made a lot of women happy.

All of the Gabriel Allon books give you a good mystery and and a fair amount of art history in each book. On the positive side Daniel Silva, is a good writer with great sources; on the negative side whole passages and parragraphs are lifted from one book to the next. Every description of either Gabriel Allon, is the same word for word in every book as is the basic write up of his team and evry mention of King Saul Boulevard. If I had tried doing that in either high school or college evey teacher would have circled the phrases and sent it back for either more description or to be reworked completely.

Todd Mccaffrey, what can I say? Your mother was still alive at the time of you writing this book yet you couldn't pull this story out of the doldrums. It is an interesting story arc but to be told in such a manner as to kill the franchise. You labor too hard on the background and mild geo politics.
Maybe I just got spoiled by the way your mother wrote all of her books (okay,not the Acorna ones). But your plodding needs help. Have you considered working with any of the people who collaborated with Anne, on any of her other series? I think you are too close to your mother's style to handle it lighter. It shouldn't be rocket science for you. Although Anne, did have some great rocket science books and some truly spectacular short story anthologies. Please get some writing help.

What can I say? I bought an Kodak Easyshare camera on Woot.com, for a ridiculously low price but I needed a case and an SDHC card for it so I came to Amazon to buy them. Chek out Woot.com, they have great specials on a lot of either new items or refurbs. Amazon, shouldn't mind the plug as thry liked Woot.com, well enough to have bought the company a while back.

I bought this as a present. And have heard nothing but good things about the gift. If you like Bruce Lee, and who doesn't this a great gift for the hard to shop for friend. Bruce, was the originator, and now the only way to find better dialogue and action would be to watch a Tarrintino, film. But remember it is based on what has gone before

Good re-boot of the series. Although in some ways predictable.. even logical. I'm not really sure they needed three discs, but that seems to be the latest marketing ploy. Bonus information was a little limited, but if Mr. Nimoy, would happen to die before the next film at least they do contain some good interviews from him and many of the other original cast members.

users.query: Great glasses. Please bear in mind, these will not protect your face from lava.

cands.text: Doesn't work that well. It works for it's intended purpose to an extent. But fog will eventually develope. Also, there are unintended consequences. Chief among them is the fact that for days afterward, there will be a film on the windshield that makes glares 3x worse. A morning glare on glass treated with this is nearly impossible to see through. It's like it diffuses the light across the entire area instead of letting it penetrate. Not a great trade off.
Could be better. Everything is great except if you clean the lenses while wet, or wipe them off while wet, you run the risk of stripping them of the coating.
These were great for my students! They reshaped them into Tribal masks.

Absolute crap. Covered in scratches just from me rubbing air bubbles out. Then, about 10 million micro air bubbles are trapped underneath it making it look like fogged glass. Ill just spend the extra to buy a 9h glass cover.
These will make some great Jell-O molds for funky British house guests!
Love these headphones. Buying another pair later this summer before I go on vacation so I can always have a set charged so I cant hear my in laws While I am driving them to the beach!
Swipes like a dream. I bet I could even put jello and pudding on the windshield and wipe it off with no smears.
My wife loves these shoes. She wears them to work, even though she is teaching gym. She says they are better in her feet than anything else.
We have these to a baby gift to a history teacher. We put little speech bubbles with their famous quotes on them.

This product surpassed my expectations! It is way more comfortable than the more expensive name brand rings I have bought previously. It feels less bulky on your finger.  I will definitely be buying this brand again in the future.
Doesn't fit adult faces well. But it's fun and good.

Hey, they work!
Exactly what I need. It lit up the lights. Just match the numbers because there are different ones.
The hat itself is great. The shields are horrible. They are uncomfortable and do not sit well. The Velcro does not hold and the s pins slip out. I don't even bother with them anymore.
These do not work as well as the ones from the store.. Three washes and its peeling. Are they expired?

Floats! I wear these everyday spring, summer and fall, and almost even in the winter when it doesn't snow. Never a single issue from these. My last pair lasted me 7 years until my new puppy ate them. These will probably last a lot longer since the dog quit chewing shoes. (Dog pictured for emphasis.) But these flops will stain your feet if you wear them while wet.

These will probably last a lot longer since the dog quit chewing shoes. (Dog pictured for emphasis.) But these flops will stain your feet if you wear them while wet.
Saved my phone a time or two. Great protector. Great price.

I really love these. I am the son of an executive pastry chef, so I have been using these my whole life. But I haven't had any for a while since I got married and didn't have easy access to my dads equipment in the kitchen.

These bend perfectly to fit the bowl. They are easy in the back pocket. They are standard size, so if you have an average hand size, they will be amazing for you. They are a bit stiff when trying to mold to the bowl, they will strain your thumb a bit. However, one or two runs through the dishwasher and they become a little more maluable.
We have spent about 40-50 hours making candy and such for Christmas. They've been great.
Great shirt. Fancy fishing my friends. I just am scared to wear it because I fish with chicken liver. Haven't had to test the stain removing factors yet.
Niece loved it! Her dad hated that they lit up. So I'm happy.
Seems to hold and work and stuff! Yay for hipster products that work!

Doesn't work. Did all the setup and the watch keeps disconnecting. Apparently they know about this issue because the guy didn't even try to trouble shoot when I called. He said that the only option we had was to send it in for repair for an undefined amount of time. No thanks. Make your product work right the first time.

We ended up researching the issues, and yes. This is a common issue. Appentley motorola is not the company it used to be. This was an issue in generation 1 and they didn't fix it before rolling out 2.

Either your product works or it doesn't. I know, obvious statement, but if you buy it, I guess it's a gamble.

Exactly like the description says. Columbia makes some fantastic outdoor wear, and that's why I keep coming back year after year. If you want a lightweight rain jacket that can be worn year round, I would definitely recommend this one.

Wow. That's all I can say. I just bought one from Walmart on clearance. I've been watching about 6 stores for a while and Walmart put their floor model for $140. So of course I bought it.

Brought it straight home, hooked up the gas, and cooked dinner. I could not wait. I will properly season it tomorrow.

But dear lord, this thing heats quickly, transports easy, and is just amazing. I worked in a restaurant for years. After I graduated and got a teaching job, I have begun to miss the flat iron grill cooking. I truly love cooking on one and the food is like no other. I made my wife Mexican food and toast and eggs for me. Barely any cleanup from 2 completely different meals. Took 10 minutes for the plate to initially heat up, and 10 minutes to cook 2 restaurant style meals.

I imagine I am going to need to buy stock in propane at this rate, because this is going to be amazing.

users.query: I bought this bra in a department store but on a whim I thought I would check on Amazon, and there was the same bra, but in so many other colors. I had to add to my new collection as there were so many delicious colors to choose from. This is a great wireless bra. It has enough padding and shaping to look like it has underwire but is much safer for one's health to not have wire across the chest. The front adjustments make it easy to fit and the slightly wider band on the bottom makes for a very comfortable fit. Ladies please get rid of your underwire bras. It will lower your chances of breast cancer.

cands.text: I love this bra. I was searching for Warner's new Cloud bra in different colors, which is also a wireless shaped bra, when I came across this little beauty which was not in department stores. This leads me to believe these may have been last season's stock. I really prefer front close but they are hard to find esp. in wireless. This fits great, gives great cleavage and no hooks in back to stick into my bony spine. I searched for other colors too and purchased a black one. I really didn't need more bras as I had purchased the Cloud bra in 4 colors, but could not pass these up. This was well worth stocking up on. I wish I had found this one before purchasing the other Warner bras but Warner is consistent in making lovely wireless bras which are much safer for women than the underwire. Go Warner!

These were nice bralettes. The price was great as were the colors. There was a little too much fabric for me, and the fit was loose. I wear a 34C bra and the S/M was a little loose. If you need more coverage and support, this could work for you.

I love these Anemone bralettes. They are so comfortable. I bought five more in different colors. Would rather wear these instead of a bra, but just bought five new bras before finding these little lovelies. So will use these for everyday as they are so comfortable, and keep the bras for outings and dressing up. My husband loves the look of these. Rather sexy.

This is a super little bralette. The fit is snug but stretchy. It does give light support. May not be for larger sized women. I like the padding as it covers any show through. You can remove the pads if they don't work for you. Very comfortable and pretty. Nice not to have any clasps in back to dig into spine.

Cute little top. The rouching in the back gives it a waist defining shape unlike most scrub tops. Nice little details also make it a special compared to your basic scrub top. Definitely worth a few extra bucks for the look and shaping.

These earrings absolutely look better in person. I am really pleased. They are very different and hang beautifully. They shiny and move well. The price was right and I am happy I took a chance even though I did not need another pair of earrings.
These were quite puny in fabric, so while they fit big, they didn't cover much. May be fine for the younger set but not for someone older with curves. I had to send them back.

Very nice chain. It is thin, which is what I wanted. Most chains are too thick for my slender neck. It has a nice sparkle to it. It is very hard to find a 17" chain so it took several tries to find this baby. It is a keeper.

I liked this chain but unfortunately the silver color was a little darker than my other silver chains. I wanted to use this to layer and maybe it was not a 925 like my other chains and pendants, so that is on me. I returned the chain only because of that reason. Otherwise, it was a lovely chain. It was sturdy, would hold a heavy pendant and had an a very different look. The seller refunded my money promptly.

Good quality but somewhat stiff and scratchy. They feel like they will hold up better than other organic pillowcases I have bought that started to fray quite quickly even though they were softer. So there is a compromise there.

This is a fine book. Easy to read. Interesting story. I am just getting back into reading after a long illness and am still finding my niche as to what I like to read. I have never been into romance novels, or generally books directed mainly about women and for women per se. The main character is very insecure, and as I have not finished the book yet, I have the feeling that she will rise to the occasion and become quite brave and surprise us, but for now, there is too much emphasis on her naivete and lack of confidence. I have nothing bad to say about this book. I always enjoy historical context in a story and this is what I am enjoying most as I know nothing about the BBC and England during that time frame. I like gain some historical knowledge even if it is woven into fiction. I did not give it five stars as my tastes run more to deeper reading, pure history and maybe some science fiction. I would recommend this book to the casual reader, and if you like a bit of history thrown in, you'll enjoy it.

I have used Starwest products before and have been satisfied. So when searching for a new supplier of Essaic tea, I turned to Starwest. An Essaic tea must be freshly made, and having it organic is essential in cancer treatment. This is the original formula of herbs. I have all my cancer patients on Essaic tea, and I use it periodically as a liver cleanse for myself.

Just bought a new set of Corelle dinnerwear. The Urban Arc collection is a modern look but does not have all the accessory pieces that some of the other patterns do. So plain white was the answer. Also bought a serving plate in white. It is smart of them to offer plain white pieces that would go with any of their patterns.

Naturalizer shoes are almost always spot on for size. As I wear a size 4.5, it is hard to find shoes, but Naturalizer always has a nice line of casual shoes in small sizes. They are made well, and last a long time. I just wish they would make trendy high heeled shoes for the smaller sizes also. This is my second pair of this style in this rose color. I also have the patina which is a very versatile color.

Naturalizer shoes are almost always spot on for size. As I wear a size 4.5, it is hard to find shoes, but Naturalizer always has a nice line of casual shoes in small sizes. They are made well, and last a long time. I just wish they would make trendy high heeled shoes for the smaller sizes also.

I like the idea of these spots as I have a few shoes that do press. I have yet to get the hang of placing them and getting them to stay yet, but I believe I will get there. They are a great idea and will save me money on bandages to protect those delicate areas that rub,  as these are reusable. The prize on Amazon was an add on so it was nice to save a little money as these silicone products are not cheap.
I have been buying these at the local craft store singly and been paying the same for one as for both of these. Can't beat the price.

Nice little statue. It is small but I wanted something for a small space. I like the resin as I am prone to dropping things. I like the ivory as opposed to some of the bronze and darker colors I saw. This is light (and lightweight) and the ivory color suits my decor.

This was a gift. An older family member was having trouble setting digital alarm clocks so we needed to simplify. I looked for a small manual alarm clock that would be easy for an older person to use and set, while small enough for a little night stand. This fit the bill, and the vintage look matched the decor of the room it was intended. We are both pleased

This is working great for my short spiky haircut. I like that I can use one product to style and place. There is a slight fragrance which may be natural, but does linger for a bit. I am used to using organic products that are fragrance free but since my original product changed its formula my hairdresser suggested Paul Mitchell as they are more natural than others. I am sensitive to fragrance so it may just be me as it is very slight. But I would recommend this product if you need a very strong hold for hair to stay in place all day.
Enjoyed this very much. Any dog lover would. Liked it so much I also purchased the author's second novel "Two Good Dogs". Read them in that order. The context is better.
Great high energy dance beats. Some great collaborations. Very enjoyable. I bought another Disclosure CD also to add to my collection.
Great CD. I am enjoying the music of this duo. Great collaborations = great music. Keep it coming.

Great task lighting. Has been a big difference over my old desk lamp. Did not realize how much brighter the right lighting can be. Perfect for my aging eyes. The slim silhouette takes up very little desk space. Just a nice perk.

users.query: in this one, the fight is still going. Colin learns more about himself. the  public is  learning more about soulguards. we learn more about  the kresh. the story is still going strong.

cands.text: this is a good story of a secret society fighting demons to save the world. since the fighters are so long lived, the story takes place over decades. it never feels like a long time. there are already 5 books in this series, and i hope it keeps going. Colin is a boy raised by 2 of the elites of the soulguard. he knows his duty to protect. this book begins his journey. not into adulthood, but into his  life as a soulmage and the changes he starts in the guard. really good read.

after the battle in Kansas, things get real. now the secret is out to the world and everyone needs to work together or we will all die together. this book deals with the wait for the attack from that Kansas gate. everyone knows it will happen, but not when. and now  the guard have  to work with the government and that is never easy. whatever happens, the soulguard is still ready to protect the earth.

things get interesting in this one. we aren't told much about the ppl supporting the MC, but they r shown. u get a better feel for what is going on in the background. i would like to see where the story goes next.

This was a good sequel. As with the first book, we did not stay on Tanner. We saw a lot of the background politics that were happening on both sides. We saw Tanner run into old friends and make new ones. There was also a good amount of fighting. It wasn't pretty, of course. Still, I would like to see where the next 2 books go.

This book continued the drama after book 1. Grant gets a chance to finally play the game as himself. From the begining, the voices are screwing with him. He doesn't start in a town like all normal players. That divine attention just doesn't help him. His journey both in game and out is interesting. He is still a broken man trying to find reasons to continue. His therapist is mentioned often as is the advice to concentrate on one thing and finish it first. Good book!

this part of the story focuses on Jon trying to get home in time to talk to the keepers. so the  whole book has a countdown in the background. also, more focus on the  prophesy is seen. as in what to do if it comes to pass. how to help and protect people. more thought is given to the reality of an extinction level event and  how  to save  people. how do u get people off a planet? what ship do u use to transport them? where are u taking them? is there enough food and sleeping space on the ship for them? so, Jon has started thinking  about the  practical things and  making plans. i can't wait for what comes next!!!

I'm reading this series because I just finished the Trapped Mind books. Loved that series. This is very different. Different,  but good. The fighting is a lot, but it just follows the story. This was good and interesting. I'm gonna read book 2 next. I want to see where the story goes.

The series is still doing the right things. As the story opens, it starts where it left off. Richter is getting back to the village after time away. We are reminded of the big battle from the last book and the lives lost. Things move along at a fast pace as always. We are also violently reminded that Richter is immortal and has many enemies. He gets more quests and is still determined to grow and protect his village. I want to see where it goes next.

Grant's story continues. this book, like the others, tells the story both in the  game and out of it. Grant is still dealing with his loss, but he seems to be getting better. of course his sister doesn't think so because of what he did in the last book in front of his niece. not to mention the  letter. i can't say too much about  the  game without giving away too muich. suffice it to say he doesn't spend the whole book delivering letters. we end up meeting a bunch of new game people and  characters as well. there is still a lot of grinding to be done. the story surprised me in a good way and kept me guessing. it got more into the AI side of things. the final battle pulled my hearstrings as i yelled WTF??? the end was a mystery, wrapped in an enigma, deep fried as a burrito. there is more to come from our future robot overlords and this armor polisher is ready!

I've just finished this book and want the next one. what more needs to be said. the writing is still great. the first half of the book is quite bloody. the fight for devil's crater was hard fought and long. after that is concluded, it is time to start thinking about the future. Dave starts thinking about the races that wil be returning. time to gear up!! seriously, how much longer to the next book?

it's funny how many people read this book because they are waiting for the next Daniel Black book. i admit that is what i did. Daniel got us here, but the book made us stay. from the start where the heroine is stuck on a planet with some screwed up women to the treasure hunt and beyond, the book keeps ur attention. whether it is the plight of the poor mouse girls or the strict guidelines of meeting the head of the Yakuza, the book keeps u interested in what is happening. i still like Daniel Black better because it is fantasy and i've read those books a million times. but this series looks to be a very very very close second. looking forward to the next book in either series.

This continues the series in the regular fashion. There is an issue to be solved that leads to more issues and then the end. We don't see much of his children, but they do make appearances. The story is still interesting and worth reading, if you have read this series. There are some spelling and grammar errors, but not many. Definitely worth the read and stars. Waiting for the next one.

This the second time I read this book. it still works for me. it isn't about the action. it is about trying to learn about something that was violently taken from the world. great read. im going to re-read the rest of them.

i was excited about this story because it is two characters that we know. first, when she was rescued. then her dealings with Dimitri and Honor. Holly has been a background character since book 1. Venom has always been mysterious and sleek. this was a good way to see more of the two of them. as i finish this, i wonder which of the seven will we get to know next? and when can we find out more about  the legion? either way, waiting for the  next book.
Cori wakes up changed. not just the way she looks, but her powers too. this books deals a lot more with terrorism as well as trying to find the mastermind.

i didn't want to read this story until the 2nd came out. i should have waited. now, i have to wait MONTHS for the 2nd to be  released! this was a great story. because the level cap was 10, there wasn't as much rpg stuff as i would have expected. instead, u spend ur time thinking about  the issues Hector is facing in the  real world and  in the game. i don't want to spoil it, but the stories are engaging. the NPCs that he meets. the  players. the story in the  game. the things  happening in real life or  the outer world. i can't wait to see where this story goes!!!

this was a good spot to end the arc. although it is more like the first part of the mission has been completed. there is still a lot more to go. it was good to see how the wives handled being in charge and how others reacted to them. it will be fun to see more lions in the future as well. and The First was his usual self.

This was a great story that did not follow the regular paths set by others. It is a story of being the  last of your kind and being hunted down. this is not for the faint of heart. there are a lot of characters that you get to know right before they are torn to pieces. you will still enjoy the book.

great book. this book takes place in the catherine kimbridge universe. she has a small cameo. AG decides to give his all to the marines. because of his tragedy, he doesn't have much else. he does well in boot camp. i'm looking forward to the rest of his career and am thinking about  reading more of the Kimbridge books because of this.

If you liked the first 3 books, then you will like this one. It starts with the wedding. Our heroes all get together for that when madness ensues. As expected. Good book. Kevin is a wimp thru most of it, but wakes up by the end. Jack is his usual psychotic self. Alex is happy to be married. Victoria is happy to see her friends. More ghosts and demons. Looking forward to the next one.

this was a good story. groundhog day in a game where the goal is to kill as many people as possible. and then what do u do when it starts to change. there were some grisly times. like when he had a cheese grater and  nail gun as weapons. a change of pace from the fantasy game books.

it has been a while and still no book 2. this book was very good! the story was great! it had an interesting world that i would love to return to. the end as well as  the piece of book 2 painted a great picture of where the series could go. i want to know more  about the bad guys and the universe at large. seriously, where is the next book?

this was a good one. most of the story was the heir finding out  the preparations made by his  great grandfather. the nuclear war that happened was but a blip in the book. it is a good story with a touch of romance.

this is a typical boy finds magic book. what makes this interesting is the history of the world and the people within. we see how trying to do good can cause pain. how not everything is as it seems. and, of course, there is a phoenix. nothing better than a phoenix. still, it is a good story that has me reading the second one.

users.query:
Purchased 2 pairs for Christmas Gifts. They both loved them and have worn
for a couple weeks.  They like the style, comfort and warmth on cold days.

cands.text:
Purchased these for my daughter for Christmas gift and she loves them.
She has worn for a couple of weeks now and is pleased with the break-in
and feel on her foot.

Purchased for my daughter Christmas 2016.  She loves them.
Last year I purchased 2 of a different Muk Luks for my girlfriend and my oldest daughter
and they love them and have lasted over a year and still in good shape and functional
as a foot warmer/slipper.

Tough pants to handle the outdoors while hiking the Appalachian Trail.
My girl loves these.....I have 7 pair myself and comfortable and tough!

I wear a men's size 9D and ordered X-Large as per their sizing guide and I am glad I did !!!
They is almost too small, my toes are at the edge of seam.
The Baffin Base Camp Insulated Bootie fills good, but don't think this is as warm as a
down bootie.  The color of Espresso is a nice color brown and not real dark brown.

I Puchased this for my daughters 33rd birthday, This is a fantastic, very colorful well made jacket.
It is very warm and fits as expected.
She loves it.

The Outdoor Research Helium Pants is my go to for summer
rain gear. It is for the minimalist weighing 5.1oz for medium,
nylon-ripstop with Pertex rain shell that is so lightweight.

These items will NOT fit the Honda Inverter Generator, it uses different threads, they make a different one

I have a Walmart Powermate 2000i Inverter Generator - by the way had this for 5
 months and used extensively and never have had an issue, it's quieter than Honda
and Yamaha and runs on for 11 hours at 50% load on 1 gallon gas.  While I wasn't
for sure the threads on both of these items would be the same or would fit my
Powermate 2000i Inverter generator and took a chance buying it. From extensive
research prior to purchasing the Powermate 2000i Inverter Generator I read that the
Walmart Power 2000i Inverter Generator engine appears to be a Yamaha MZ80 clone
with parts interchangeable with genuine Yamaha engines and indeed they do use same
parts. It looks like the metal oil filler and magnetic dipstick are precision machined
and fit perfect. Both have rubber gaskets which helps to seal. The magnetic dipstick
works by pulling some very fine tiny metal particles out of brand new engines and I
found some, but very little after running my new gen for 1st 8 hour break-in time.
I changed the oil to Mobile 1 synthetic.  I also purchased from Amazon and installed
a Hardline Products HR-8061-2 Hour Meter/Tachometer and purchased Kill-A-Watt to
track voltage, amps, etc while using my generator. Next I will install gas feed system
to extend run time.

When both of them found out the real truth, will it break what they have when it all started with falsehood. This is an amazing book that touches on BDSM . It was very well written. If this is your cup of tea, you won't be disappointed. I received this advanced reader copy voluntarily in exchange for an honest review.

Amber is a spontaneous woman who just woke up one day that married life is not exciting anymore especially with her husband pushing to have a baby. Karen has been suffering from grief after losing her daughter and has closed off memories of her which succinctly wore down her marriage. Amber found out her husband got his best friend's wife pregnant. Karen thinks her husband is cheating on her. After a series of events threw the women on each other's path, can they find what they are looking for. Find out for yourself. I do not necessarily agree with the characters' decisions but this book took me for an emotional ride.

She is a curvy woman but after 2 miscarriages , she let herself go. Dan works for the CIA and perished on his last mission. Before he died, he asked his partner, Sheikh  Bilaal to give his wife Irene a child. A year later and he was on his way to America to find Irene while she is on the verge of self destruction. But what if his punishment is the best kind that ignites every cell in her body. What started as hate turned into something both of them did not expect. So I am now on my third bag for my leaf blower/mulcher.  It seems like this is a great product overall, but the bag has one serious design flaw.  If you overfill it, just a little, the bag blows a part from the plastic.  It has happened to me twice now.  Yes part of it is my fault for not paying attention but also part of it feels like built in destruction.

Going forward I will keep the bag strapped over my shoulder at all times, I think the combo of the weight and the air pressure is causing the failure.

3 stars because I fell it is half my fault and half theirs.  That being said, its a good product but you have to use the shoulder strap which can be annoying.

Pros

Great bag for EDC and urban commuting, but the quality is so poor that I cannot recommend it.  There are numerous bags out there with this almost exact design, but the quality is awful, go with another brand.

I really wanted to like this bag.  I tried to like it but in the end it is way too much of a niche bag.  Really its more of a murse than an urban commuter bag.  I live in NYC and commute on the subway about an hour each way to and from work, so having a good messenger bag is a must.  My every day carry items I keep limited (1L water bottle, micro umbrella, pepper spray, ipad, phone, glasses, bandanna, ear plugs, wet wipes, reading glasses, key ring, ear plugs).  I figured this bag would be perfect and when my old bag got a big tear I ordered it.

Unfortunately, this bag is really meant for someone with very specific needs.  It has a major flaw which was a deal breaker for me.  It has a lot of pockets (11 or 12 in total) but they are all really small or really tight, including the main pocket which has a doubled cloth liner which makes it smaller and tighter than a regular main pocket.  So if you have a whole lot of flat or small items you need to carry every day, then this bag may be ideal for you.  But if you need to carry some larger items, you're going to most likely drop them all into the main pocket and let them all tangle up with each other.

It really reminds me more of a canvas OD green women's purse.

Pros:
Solid construction
Looks good (actually got a compliment on it)
Lots of individual pockets

Cons:
Main pouch plastic clip broke the first day
Pouches/pockets are really tight and/or small
Clear plastic pocket seems mostly useless beyond putting your contact info
Shoulder strap was not easy to adjust
Double lined main pouch is a nice idea with very poor execution.

Like I said I really wanted to love it, but in the end I gave up after using it for less than a week and ordered a real messenger bag.

Bought this for use as my bug out bag.  Amazingly sturdy and well built.  Lots of pockets, space, and hooks, holders etc.  Waist and chest straps for extra support.  Lots of tightening straps as well.  Even fully loaded it was very comfortable.  The shoulder straps have great padding.  Bag can hold a lot or a little depending on your needs and is extremely versatile in regard to how many hooks, holders, velcro pads, straps etc it has.  Well designed and well built.  Buy with confidence.

I really like this bag.  Well made and super convenient.  You may not use all the items that are in this bag, such as straps, pockets, etc.  But if you do need them you'll be glad they are there.  Super tough and rugged.

Cannot ask for much more.  Very high quality, was shocked at how rugged and durable the material is, definitely high quality.  Assembles in about 10 minutes once you get used to it.  Breaks down completely into one bag with a shoulder strap.  I'm 6'3" and fit very easily and comfortably inside.

A few things to note, if you paddle in the wrong direction you won't get very far.  There is a front and a rear.  You will need to dry it off before you deflate or else you can trap water inside that will lead to mold growth, not fun.  You should definitely check out your state laws and definitely the USCG regulations regarding kayaking in fresh and/or salt water.  Life jackets are not only a smart idea but required by law.  Make sure you get ones that are USCG approved and meet the required standards.  Most fines for maritime infractions are quite expensive.  If you take this on the ocean you'll need a flash light or lantern as well, even if it is day time.  A whistle is also a good idea to have along.

Overall it is a great item that is well made, easy to use and fun.  They have great videos on their web site on how to assemble and dis-assemble the kayak.
Love these...they work really well and thus far have not had any typical issues like leaks or rips or such.

years ago when these didn't exist and before GoPro i used a 8MM Cam corder suctioned cupped to my car with a $150 professional movie studio suction cup camera holder. To protect the camera from the elements i found a plastic box which i mounted to the camera holder. Anyway, then i spent the $400 and got a GoPro. awesome camera. About a year later the WiFi crap chute back came out, spent $100 on that and it never worked right. Eventually the sound on my GoPro started to act up. trying to fix it, the 3.5mm jack broke and now it's an - Silent video camera... So i decided to try this thing out... $50, 1080p 30fps, built in wifi, built in LCD screen, among other cool features... WOW. you can't go wrong. It comes with a crap load of mounts, Gopro compatible, then you can get a kit on Amazon that comes with more mounts that you'll ever need for $15.... these camera's are the shizzle. I haven't tried WiFi since my phone is old and full, but if it works with problems i'll update my review. (The video is something i put together for a forum to review the overheating issue of my car. It's various clips i took with the camera. It's the main reason why i got the camera since the GoPro had just broken and i needed to record audio.
