Worked great.  Lot of labor.
We had this about two weeks.  It does everything it is supposed to but for a hundred bucks worth of vegetables and a half hour worth of work you get 4 dollars worth of juice and then it takes ten minutes to clean the thing.  So it is easier and cheaper to buy V8 Vegetable juice.  I returned it and they did not give me any hassle.  I think we had to pay return shipping or a re-stocking fee, but it wasn't bad.

cands.text: I purchased this item for use in my pest management company after shoulder injury.  It does the job, and it is definitely a time and effort saver.  Mainly it eliminated my having to pump by hand which, given the shoulder issue, was a blessing.  But the device has several glaring faults.  First, the fiberglass spray wand is cheaply made and cracks if it gets cold.  Granted, you shouldn't leave the thing outdoors in the winter anyway, but a B&G brass wand sits in my truck year in and year out and does not split in the cold.  For a few more bucks they could include a heavy brass wand.  Further, the plastic handle / valve is cheesy and can only be locked ON, but not OFF.  Even with the power off there is still pressure in the line and there is always the possibility of a siphon.  For safety when riding in a moving vehicle a pro would want a positive OFF, in addition to turning off the power.  Second, the battery is a 12V LEAD acid battery.  It weighs about eight or ten pounds.  That's like adding another gallon of spray mix to have to carry around.  It makes the tank unwieldy. This big battery gives very very long spraying times... on the order of 20 hours straight.  But who sprays 20 hours straight?  In reality, under professional conditions, I spray a total of about two to four hours per day with the unit.  So a battery with 1/4 the capacity would do the job between overnight chargings.  I retrofitted it with a 12v Li Ion battery which weighs 1.5 lb. and does the job fine.  Finally, the tank has molded in brass sleeves into which screws pass from the black base to connect the tank.  Unfortunately they molded them in so deeply that the plastic is paper thin.  They started leaking and I had to take the whole device apart and seal them with PolySeamSeal.  In summary, it is not awful, but it is not pro-quality.
Excellent.  Works precisely the same as the one sold in the pool store for three times the price.

Fantastic!  I got rid of my gasoline powered backpack.  You can use it for gently cleaning the workshop of sawdust without blowing over projects, or squeeze the trigger all the way and clear leaves under bushes with ease.

I love it BUT... I do take exception to the reviewers who say that it is just a snap to install.  It is more like a snap and a few clicks, and one or two password attempts and a curse word or two.  But once that is done, it is fabulous!  One thing to pay attention to is that during install it asks for the NETWORK password.  This is not the same as the short and simple password provided for most devices to connect to your network.  In the case of my FiOS it is the long drawn out PW that goes to the router.  Why are there two?  What is the difference between them?  God only knows. I am not a techie so I surely don't.  But that was the mistake I made which led to the cussing until I had the bright idea to try the "other" password.  Once Roku actually connects to your internet you have to register it online... another thing they do not disclose up front.  It's easy to do as the device gives you a code, but that means that in addition to your Roku device now you need either a laptop or a phone app connected to Roku on the net.  Register the Roku and then, and thank goodness you are now on the internet... you will then have to choose which of many different systems or content providers such as Netflix and Amazon that you want to use with Roku.  And you will have to register your password for each and every one of them.  Once done, Roku will not ask again.  Ao all in all it is not as portable as they make out... but I would still recommend it as a great way to have lots of content on that second TV without adding another cable box.
My wife loves it.  I had to order it by name.  I had one before and the dog got hold of it.  Chewed it and ruined it.  My wife was ready to cry!
absolute junk.  Does not read anything whatsoever.  Lights up saying ready, then does NOTHING at all.

Not the quality of the OEM.  I bought this because the suction cup on my OEM Tom Tom tore after many years of good service.  The rest of my original was perfect. I have no problem, as others have, with the suction cup on this unit.  Mine works perfectly.  However, I thoroughly cleaned the glass with alcohol and dried it prior to installing.  The problem I found is it fitment to the original GPS.  The round clip in mount between the GPS and this device depends upon an interface where one circle or ring snaps into another.  The outer edge of the replacement is a couple thousandths of an inch too thick to allow the Tom Tom to get completely inside, so it pops out of the mount every so often.  If you manage to force it in there it is so tight that it cannot move for adjustment.  I also found, as another reviewer noted, that the ball and socket joint allows uncontrollable swiveling.  However this can be fixed by tightening the two screws.  To fix the problem I found, I took the mount ring and ran it on 200 grit sandpaper and now it is fine, but you shouldn't have to go through all this to replace such a thing.  It ought to work out of the box.  Finally, note that the parts of this item ARE NOT interchangeable with the original.  You cannot take one part of this and just replace what is bad on the original because this is metric and the original is SAE.  So the screws will not fit one to the other, you can't just take the mount ring and swap it to the new suction cup as I tried to do.  Everything is off by a couple thousandths of an inch.  I would not buy this item again nor recommend it to anyone.
Does the job but fails to satisfy the "Idiot Light" on the machine.  So it still thinks I need a replacement cartridge.

Bought this to use in my pest control business.  Worked great for a few months.  Then started flickering while in use.  Cleaned it, reseated everything and it was fine for a few more months.  Used it yesterday.  Today it will not turn on at all.  Tried fresh battery, nothing.  No light at all.  Cannot be returned so I am stuck with an expensive aluminum tube.  DO NOT BUY!

Excellent product.  Well made.  Gave as a gift so can't comment on sensitivity or ease of use. Recipient says it works great.
Arrived on time and in good condition.
This did a great job when I had the winter blues.  It was actually prescribed for me, by name and model.
Really does a good job on torso acne.  I use it more or less as just a topical creme rather than a wash.

Let me state up front that I am a professional Pest Controller, so bug chemicals are my wheelhouse.  This is the only product I was able to find on the market that has this excellent combination of active ingredients and that was the sole reason I bought it.  All the other stuff these companies advertise is a lot of baloney.  The only thing that matters in a pesticide is the actives.  From that perspective this is the best I have seen for this purpose and the science is sound.  As a bonus, it has a very pleasant smell.

As for the applicator, it is a joke.  A completely over-engineered and entirely worthless gimmick.  The product itself comes in a squeeze tube that requires you to break off the tip then pinch a little bubble to squeeze the material out.  All this applicator is, is a plastic container purported to make those two operations more convenient.  It does not.  It makes them more complicated.  A case COULD be made, waaayyyyy on the outside of reason, that it would make it easier for an elderly person or someone with Arthritis, as it increases the amount of area in the hand... but that would be a stretch.  It's just something to put the little tube into to snap it and squeeze it, and that is very easy for the average healthy person to do by hand.  It is also cheaply made.  Mine broke into pieces on the first use.

So the take away here is that Bio Spot Spot On is a great product but the applicator is junk.  So just buy refills and don't waste your money on the applicator.

Exactly as advertised.  Had it connected and running on my PC, Android phone and Android tablet within ten minutes of taking out of the box.  Most difficult part was figuring out how to use the code scanner on the tablet.  Had to download scanner app first.  Only suggestion is that there should be a way to put a shortcut to the app into your saved apps.  There is none, but there is a selection check box to turn on the app automatically when the device is plugged in, which works perfectly.  After all, if you plug it in, you want it to turn on anyway, right?  It's just that if you want to turn it off and then back on again, you have to unplug it and plug it back in.
The diameter of the camera is smaller than you'd guess, less than 1/4 inch.  So it will slip easily under or around almost anything.  Comes with a 90 degree angle mirror, which is plastic and cheesy but does the job.  Also comes with attachments of a magnet and a hook so you can pick stuff up.  You can take pictures and video with it as well.  It it FIXED focus, so anything closer than about one inch is fuzzy.  Past that all is in focus, but it is not a telescope so although it is in focus it will not be sharp or magnified.
The led lights are adjustable from very bright to totally off.
I am in the pest control business and this will work perfectly for looking into chimney flues and under decks to see if animals are in there.

Let me be upfront here... I carry a prejudice against anything Chinese.  So I went into this purchase with a predisposition to review this unit badly.  I bought it because I am cheap and this one is the only cheap one I haven't tried.  At this price it is only a few bucks more than the Hudson, which I own and with which I am unimpressed.  And the My4Sons unit is just a rehash of the Hudson.  This unit is a little smaller but one less gallon makes it 8 pounds lighter and that is a plus, especially since they are still stuck on using a Lead Acid battery which itself weighs 8 lbs.  (Only Solo offers a Li-Ion unit and I wasn't spending 400 dollars.)  As for Chapin... They are the world standard in junk.

This one has these advantages over the named competitors... Metal wand vs plastic or fiberglass.  The wand also telescopes which no other sprayer offers.  Hose attached to the side and easily replaceable or repairable.  All the other manufacturer's hoses are either connected inside the case, requiring disassembly for service, or are clamped in such a way that you have to cut the hose off.  Comfortable handgrip on wand vs mainly clumsy ones elsewhere.  Shoulder straps can be snapped on and off for ease of donning and doffing.  Others are either permanently affixed or fall off too easily.

Hose assembly is straightforward and dependable.  Heaven help you if you buy a Chapin... the hoses and spray handles leak and when you tighten them they break.

Pros:  Dual filler openings on top.  One with a strainer, one without.  Adjustable spray pressure using a "dimmer switch".  You can adjust to ANY pressure, not just L-M-H.  Extremely powerful.  With the wand extended and the power on high it snaps the wand back in your hand.  Quiet.  On low power you can barely hear the pump run.  Battery molded into bottom of spray volume reservoir.  This keeps the battery stable so it doesn't slop around like the Hudson.  Recharge cable just plugs in vs a screw in connector.  Time and effort saver.  Comes with multiple nozzles and several replacement rubber seals.  Straps are a little thin and made for people smaller than Americans, but still it fits and due to the shape is very comfortable to wear.

Cons:  for one thing it is molded in Barnham and Bailey colors.  Recycle Bin Blue, Sunshine Yellow, Neon Lime Green and Nuclear Accident Orange.  You won't sneak past the neighbor's house wearing this thing.  It is also labeled "SPRAYER" in four inch high letters, in case you mistake it for a paintbrush.  Spray nozzles are cheaply made and do not give a nice pin stream.  Even the twist and mist one is cheesy.

Neutral comments:  The directions are in English, not Chinglish.  That's nice, but the instructions are pretty much unnecessary.  Comes solidly  packed.  No wasted packaging.  The wand will bear watching as other reviewers note that it does not hold up and will develop pinholes.  I'll update if this happens once I have had it a while.

For reference, I am a Professional Pest Controller so I give a backpack sprayer a workout and I have tried them all.  Pricewise... I get 200 bucks per job, so if the thing lasts me one season it will be well paid for.

Initially I felt that this was a fine product.  However, since that time I have had constant problems with it in that each time I stamp a check the stamp stays stuck in the deployed position and I have to whack it on the desk to get it to retract.
Does a great job mixing protein shakes.  Holds a charge a long time.  Powerful enough for this use.  Not sure if it would be powerful enough for much pastry baking type use.  Very simple to clean.
Works great!  Has a built in LED that takes a battery, but you do not need to connect it.

Well made product.  Takes same battery as my other rechargeables.  Solid construction.  Lights up body fluids nicely.  However, after a few months it simply stopped working.  Battery is good.  Light tests ok.  Seems like the LED itself is defective.

This is the perfect surveillance camera!  Very easy to install and use.  Intuitive interface.  Only thing I overlooked is that it does not have a zoom feature, but that was my mistake in not getting the correct model.  This does everything they say it will do and more.  Interface allows you to click one button and it rotates through its entire field of view automatically.  Also allows for an administrator level, operator level and guest level of access so that you can set up cameras and let others only point them or even only view them.  An outstanding camera.  I had previously bought a Drop Cam and returned it because it only records to the cloud.  This allows you to record directly to your hard drive or other storage and it will do the recording automatically in response to motion sensor as well.  If you need a security camera, baby monitor, or just want to watch what the dog does when you leave the room, this is the one!
They are exactly as advertised and are more or less the standard in the industry.  Only complaint is that the glue oozes so they stick to each other once you tear them apart.

I am not crazy about pleated pants, but apparently the Powers that Be have decided that big guys' pants should be pleated.  They arrived and fit perfectly and the quality is great, but when I sit down I get this balloon around the front that settles out to a tent shape and makes it appear that I am perpetually overly excited.  Not thrilled.  But the wife thinks they look great on me (when I am standing up anyway, LOL) so I guess that is what counts.

Cheaper too!  The ones at the local places are twice the price and the plastic is throughout.  This one has a rubber donut in the center making it a lot easier to attach to the cue stick.  Nice item.  Good value.

I submitted a prior review but it bounced because I mentioned the way it was sent.  Let me try to rephrase... There are carry straps around the mat when it arrives.  These are apparently cinched down hard at the factory to make it convenient for shXXXng.  But this causes them to cut into the mat fabric and leave permanent grooves which are unsightly and annoying.  Other than that it is a very high quality mat comparable to those seen at local stores for twice the money.

users.query: What a great movie. I am sure there have been many who have said it better than I can but this movie is a classic. a must see for everyone.

cands.text:
This movies is so funny there aren't any old stale jokes there's just great actors doing a great job at doing impossible things.
Everyone in this movie played it for the laughs. I just loved it.
This was an absolutely wonderful movie. The stories are all different yet intertwine with each other and are worth seeing over and over again.

I loved it, loved it, loved it.  It had every perversion in it you could think of.  The actors were absolutely great in their roles and needless to say weren't bad to look at. This is not Easy Virtue 2 the first movie they played together in, but it is just as good.
This movie made history come to life for me I just loved everything about it. This whole series should be required for our schools to show.
excellent movie great story and performed to the hilt by top of the line actors.
It was a very good film.  The cast was splendid.
I enjoyed this film very much, the acting was at it's best and the story was by John Grisham nothing else needs to be said.
A wonderful movie about loss and finding life worth living again.
This is one of Clint's best.  I loved the story, the acting and the movie.  This one  you can watch over and over and still enjoy.

What a great movie and it was based on a true story.  Eric Lomax and all the men who worked on the railroad were true heroes. Colin Firth did a magnificent job of portraying him. I hope this film gets awarded, it deserves it.
Another wonderful movie Colin Firth, Helen Hun and Bette Midler in the same movie you just know it is going to be good.
This movie had everything great acting, great music, great story, and an exceptional cast.  The tango alone was worth the price of the film.

I did not expect to like it as much as I did.  It was a different view of Robin and their cause which explained a lot. I recommend this movie to those who enjoy their action heroes live rather than made by computers.
It's got everything I love in a movie, great  story, great cast, and great excitement. I can watch it over and over and not get bored.
Colin Firth is always worth watching and this movie had a story that  was a bit different than I expected so that why I  gave it 5 stars.
Wonderful acting by the entire cast.  I enjoyed this movie very much it is a great love story I intend to watch it again.
Great movie, story and cast do an all out job.
I didn't think I was going to like it but the more I watched the more it got to me.  Johnny Depp was the biggest surprise of all.
The movie was very enjoyable.  The acting was great by all the stars, young and old.  I only wish was for a box of Godiva to watch it with.
This movie really got to me from beginning to end it holds on to you. Annette Bening was just great.
Two great actors in a action packed film  I'm glad I got it.
I bought this without truly knowing what ii was about.  When I found out, I threw it away. I am not against homosexuality, I just don't want to watch it.
The stars that were in this did the best they could with the storyline they had to work with/  I still love Aidan Quinn.
This is one of Aidan Quinn's best movies I loved it and everyone in it played it to the hilt. It was beautifully filmed. I wish he would make more film like this.

users.query: So far so good. No issues. Seem a little flimsy but the price was right. There seems to be some redundancy with a couple of them.

cands.text:
Three months with minimal use. So far so good. No problems.

UPDATE: One year later and a month after the warranty it totally crapped out. I am an amature user so it wasn't beaten down with overuse. I fell for all the bells and whistles that I didn't use very much.

The reason why it continues to receive at least three stars is not because of the unit. Do not buy it. It is cheap. HOWEVER!! Amazon returned to me 80% of the original cost and sent me a prepaid shipping label which in my opinion is a completely fair deal. Now I am not an employee or stockholder or being paid to say this. I rarely gush about companies, but they have surpassed every expectation of customer satisfaction. Now,  to be fair I am a prime member and I spend quite a bit with them, so I assume that may have played into the deal. But... don't buy this unit. Only heartache awaits. Buy Quality and you will rarely if ever be disappointed.

So far so good. Very accurate. My only critique so far is it doesn't automatically turn off after a certain amount of time of nonuse, which means I will need to replace those lame expensive round batteries a lot.
4 stars because the jury is still out. I've had it a couple months. So far so good. Don't try to run 2 wireless devices at the same time, there will be problems.
Works great. Easy repair. My only complaint is that it had to be shipped from China, which means a long shipping time. I bought 2 for future repairs because the price was right.
Great quality. Solid construction. I should have went with these in the first place.
So far so good, I've owned it for two months  and use it as a chair. It holds up to my 200 pound frame easily.
Not bad for the price. But I went ahead and upgraded. There was too much buzzing and clicking. Bought an mpow and the difference is huge.
It works as advertised. The only problem is light bleed over from buttons.
Still working flawlessly after a couple years and a few different applications.

I see no problems. Diagnostics confirm they are running properly. I put them into my:

HP Pavilion 17.3-inch HD+ Display Laptop (5th Gen Intel Core i5-5200u Processor, 6GB DDR3L RAM, 1TB HDD, Windows 10)
High quality. Worth the extra bucks. The clarity is noticeable when compared to the lower end connectors.
Poor quality. I can't send them back because it will cost me $15... they will sit on a shelf for a while until I have a garage sale.
Love it. The only drawback I can see is the volume control needs to be protected. If the unit bounces around in your pocket you get a sudden blast  or drop in volume.
Found a better price somewhere else after but other than that this is a good product.
I like it. Good for daily use and for air travel as it meets most airline overhead requirements. I plan on getting quite a few years out of it.
Good tight construction. Great price. No noticeable crackles or hiss. Highly recommend this product.
Not too crazy about this thing. It works and the price was right but I don't think I would recommend it to anyone.

Good functioning multi USB port. I haven't detected any lag when I load this thing up with various USB gadgets. The only real design flaw I see is the main USB plug and the power plugs on the sides. This seems to make for a cluttered desk. I do like the look of it which is why they may have had some issues with the aesthetics VS engineering. On off switches would have been nice but of course that would up the price.

I am new to electronics and this came highly recommended by one of my YouTube teachers who was not being paid to sponsor it.  So I bought it and I am highly impressed as I learn even more everyday about this amazing new hobby. It is not a professional grade but it works for my needs.
More space on my old laptop is always a plus. So far it is working flawlessly. System and programs boot up nicely. No complaints.

I have ridden a bike as a primary means of transportation for quite some time and these tires have held up extremely well. I was going to go the Schwalbe route but the price was out of reasonable reach for me at the time. Don't get me wrong those are some superior tires but these seem to fit the bill for my budget. No complaints.

Well, I gave it some time before I wrote a review. It is a good little video/music/internet gadget but then again so is my phone. I bought it as a reader. I do not like the glare that tablets are prone to and wound up buying a Paperwhite. It is good for reading magazines and comics though. It does shut off from time to time and I'm not sure why. The Bluetooth works well. I had to buy a mini sd card reader to transfer files so add that to your expense along with protection. I'll get some use out of it.

Excellent cooler for weekenders. It is sturdy and lightweight. It kept everything nice and cold for a 2 day camping trip which is about the extent of our needs. I can't see spending anymore for a cooler unless you have some extreme conditions that require a hardened cooler. As always, with my Prime membership everything arrived right on time.

users.query: I cancelled the order when I discovered that the Christmas present wasn't going to be here for Christmas.  They should really make that clear when you buy things from them - they don't actually HAVE this, but have to order it from a third party.

cands.text:
I had a bad report about this - but my family  opened the box and said it IS red. The box said it was white, so that was a misunderstanding.

Just as described, and my mother is very happy with it!

I am unable to even try the machine since I don't have 6 AAA batteries, and it doesn't ship with the power cord!?
It had better be fabulous. I am thoroughly irritated that I bought the thing and it arrives unusable until I make another purchase, and wait for that to arrive.
This is my purse calendar of choice. Great info, good sized blocks for notes. A great little date book!

Purchased a second one of these, and it arrived missing the same part!!!!!

Now I have to write AGAIN and ask for the part, AGAIN. Really irritating!

The tent arrived missing pieces, but their customer service was wonderful and got us the missing parts quickly.
The fabric is thinner than the standard ezup, but boy do they give you wall options! Loads of walls (6), solid, with zipper doors, and a screen wall that allows air flow. It also comes with sand bag weights, and guide lines. All of those items are "extras" with the competitors.
Overall, you can't beat the price. I think we will try to be a little careful of the fabric, as it is light weight...but the tent hardware is a nice dark gray and seems heavier than ezup.
Crossing our fingers It's as good as it seems at our next event!
I love the information in this calendar. I buy it every year. The astrology calendar goes in my kutchen, and this one goes up in my office.

I ordered this from Amazon and it arrived broken.  I called the manufacturer and they did honor the warrantee, and they did send someone to fix it - after 3 weeks!
The worst things:
1. It is extremely heavy and the delivery will drop it in your driveway.  Unless you are able to easily lift and maneuver over 300 pounds in a large box, getting this in the house will be a challenge!
2. Once together, we plugged it in and it automatically included just a little.  Just enough so I couldn't fold it up for the three weeks I waited for someone to come repair it.  We were climbing over the broken treadmill in our small house the entire 3 weeks.  That was a drag.
The best things:
1. It seems like a good treadmill (now that it works).  The controls are easy to use and the deck is spacious.  I walk - not run - but it seems like it would be fine for running too.
2. The instructions for assembly were OK.
3. They did in fact fix it.

Summary - I wouldn't order anything this big from Amazon again.  Too hard to get repairs and it was really hard to get it into my house and up the stairs.  If I bought this from a local sporting good store, they would have offered home delivery and setup.  I am sure it might have cost a fee, but I think it would have been worth it.
Just as they appear, they arrived quickly and they work well.
Been buying this for years. Love the clear notations about astrological events.

I loved this and I wish it would hold up longer.  I bought it not long back and one of the settings areas is already showing a burnt out number.  Because it is digital, once the numbers burn out you can't see them any more - so kind of useless then. :  (
So nice! The arrived fast, well packaged, and are nice, heavy Brass! Wknderful!

Disappointed. The clock arrived OK, and worked for a week or two.  Then the alarm stopped working. Pretty quick for it to die in my opinion.

The clock still tells time, but it is useless as an alarm clock, which is what I bought it for.
My own fault really...thought I was buying pillows, not covers. And no time left to get pillows before the holidays. Lovely fabric and very well made though.

Wow does this glow! I had it my bureau, and went to bed and noticed something bright on the bureau. Took a minute to remember it was this pain jar.
Can't wait to use this in art projects.

I have loved this movie for years, so I was very pleased when I saw it available here.  The shipper was overseas and I was nervous about the quality of the DVD - but it was a regular, first run DVD, packaged normally.
The quality isn't like a Blue Ray - but it isn't a Blu Ray - so that is somewhat expected.  I don't believe they remastered this for newer machines.
Still a great movie and a highly enjoyable 'chick flick'.
Enjoyable documentary for anyone who loves Hollywood glamour and jewelry! The discussion about color and brading was an unexpected bonus.
Love this show/movie. The songs were fun at our Halloween party.
Fantastic for lovers of this unique band.  I wish they would just let you rate things without a word count requirement!
So yum! And lower glycemic eeaction, so better than other syrups. I subscribed we like it so much!

Let me start by saying I a HUGE fan of this type of candle!  Unlike most "real flame look" candles, these really do look like real flames! The magnet inside is the secret, it makes the 'wick' dance and move, looking amazingly like a real flame. I game one I got in a store to my elderly mother because she loves candles, but is nervous about forgetting them now.  She loves it.  And the timer function is terrific - it just goes on at dusk, then shuts off several hours later.  And we get about a year out of one set of batteries.
The BAD part - the (literally) stomach turning smell! For some unknown reason, they took this wonderful product and made it smell like some kind of horrid chemical vanilla.  At first I didn't think it would be too bad, but after putting one in our library and leaving the room, when I came back an hour later I realized the room ha suffocating smell. Not sure how long it will be before the smell finally goes away. I am admittedly sensitive to artificial scents - I get headaches from them.  For that reason I only buy unscented candles. I have been putting it outside on sunny days to sit in the cold air hoping it will off-gas the fragrance soon.  If this just wasn't stinky I would have ordered several of these as Christmas gifts.
I wish they would stick with what they do well - make a really cool candle - and leave artificial fragrance to the makers of cheaper candles.

Nice robe, and nicely made, but runs quite narrow thru the hips. Not ideal for women, unless they are quite a bit smaller than average for the size. I ordered a size that is normally quite roomy for me, to allow extra so it would be relaxed and comfy. It just barely fits. Just a word of warni g, nice, well made, but order very large to get the right size.
This is an easy read, and fun (if you like history). Interesting topic. I will be in a reenactor event next month, and wanted to know more about how I should look and behave as a camp laundress.
This is a really beautiful book! I collect all types of art books, and this ranks up there as my new favorite coffee table book.  Beautiful pictures, engaging writing style, really gorgeous book!

I love these, with one qualifier...the top section above the rod pocket is a tiny bit too big, so it flops. This is because the fabric is so soft. If they made it just a little smaller, it might stand up nicer on the rod. I plan to try starch at some point. They look beautiful though.
Love the artist - the song "Needle in the Dark" is worth the price of the cd!

users.query:
'The Rest Area' is about a trucker, named Randy, who pulls into a seemingly innocent yet small Rest Stop. Due to the fact that he really "has to go", he ignores the signs (eerily quiet, strange graffiti on the building, etc) that something just may be amiss. . .

Aside from the very end (epilogue), which I felt took me out of the reality of the story, I enjoyed this one.

This story is a quick read (under 15 minutes) and is, for me, a nice introduction into Davis' work.

cands.text:
'The Rest Area' was my first introduction to Davis, so I have not read any of his other books. When I saw that this story  is a short based on a series that I have not yet read,  I hoped that it would be a stand-alone story (and it is).

I do not want to tell you anything about this story, so as not to give anything away. I will say that I really dug this one, and I will be purchasing 'Hatched' the first book in Davis' 'Invisible Spiders' series.

This is a quick read quick read (under 15 minutes) and is, for me, a nice introduction into Davis' work.

I do not want to give away any plot details (better that you don't know anything) other than to tell you that each story in this anthology is horrifying in its own right. Ford pulls absolutely no punches in these tales, in fact, he pushes the boundaries quite far!
(let me just say that 'All I Ever Wanted' was not something that I would have ever chosen to read, yet I could not stop turning the pages!)
Ford does that to you - he sucks you in, from the get-go, with superb character development, and then takes you on a riveting (brutal & graphic) journey that leads to a climactic finale!

If you have never read Brandon Ford, then start with this one - he's at his best here!
(I guarantee that you will then be checking out his other books!)

Wow! What a story! Do not start this book unless you have at least an hour to spare. This story will grip you, immediately, from the prologue until the very end. (I started this book at 11 last night, figuring that I would read a chapter or two, before bed... Needless to say, I was riveted to the story and just had to finish it.)

This story is as addicting as its subject matter, and just like the habit, you want to stop (reading) but you can't!

I love everything about this book, from the cover (designed by Lutzke himself) to the Chapter Headings (very revealing in their downward spiral).

I will definitely be reading more of Lutzke's work!

Whoa! What a spectacular short story!
I definitely recommend buying this one.

Looking for something short and sweet, with perhaps some Christmas flair, I decided upon this story; my first by J. T. Ellison, and it definitely will not be my last!

Ellison had me completely enraptured from the very first page until the very last page! Fortunately, I had just put my kids to bed, because I read this one straight through, uninterrupted (a Christmas miracle!)

Not only will you get a great story, for a buck, you also get some great "special features" - including the author telling you about the story's inspiration, as well as some other author's notes, plus an interview with the author, an essay written by Ellison, and upcoming peeks - great stuff!

Enjoy and have a very Merry Christmas!

This one is a great short story that packs a punch!
(Even though I rated it the same as Seat 6A, I enjoyed this one even moreso.)

I will definitely be reading more of Bray!

Ford is one of those authors who makes you feel as if you know his characters personally, and he more than delivers in this one!
He has yet to disappoint!

This story takes place over a two day span (in early January, 1998) where you first meet Jake - a 27-year-old unemployed man, who spends his days watching the streets below his NYC apartment in search of someone new to murder.
(it is no surprise that you will soon discover just how sadistic and mentally unbalanced Jake is!)

Thrown into the mix of characters are Chelsea & Haley (two roommates who despise one another), Susan (a girl from Jake's past), Arlene (a friend of Chelsea's), and Gladys (Jake's unemployment officer).

Stir the above, and you have the perfect concoction that builds up to a riveting, tension-filled finale! What more can you ask for in a great book?

The best buck that I've spent, in a long, long time!
This novella reads like a 'Sin City' comic...
Definitely recommended!

The tag-line for this one is "*Horror at 30,000 feet*", and that sums the story up nicely. It is a tight-written story. When a flight attendant and the black-eyed man have a battle of wills, you can feel the intensity roll off the pages, and the ending alone makes this a story worth reading!

One more thing before I move on to the next one, in case any of you are already Bray fans (this is the first story that I have read by him). At the end of the story, it is mentioned that this story is part of Bray's "Taste of Fear Series" It is stated that next in the series is a story titled The Reef, yet I am unable to find it (or any others in the series) anywhere. . .?

Thomas S. Flowers has done it again! He has crafted yet another tale that puts you directly into the skin of the main character, where you actually feel like you are within the story itself.

This is a story that you want to read, after having had a really bad day, because I can pretty much assure you that your bad day is not near as bad as Von Whitstein's days. This one is guaranteed to make your day better!

If you have already read Ford's first novel [Crystal Bay] then you already know what to expect from Ford, and he doesn't disappoint.
Once again Ford has written another fast-paced novel, with believable characters and an interesting plot.

Ford paints a vivid picture when depicting the murders that take place within this novel. They are brutal & graphic, yet your eyes remain glued to the pages!
If you are looking for a great, fast read then look no further!

This is probably the greatest collection of short horror stories that I have yet read!

Here is a brief breakdown of each of the ten stories:

Story #1 - 'Stranded' - a story about a man caught in a bizarre time-loop, with a terrific climax! 5 Skulls

Story #2 - 'No Such Things As Monsters' - this is my second favorite story in this collection. Truly horrifying! 5 Skulls

Story #3 - 'Sick Day' - this one ended too soon! (warning: this one will make you gag!) 5 Skulls

Story #4 - 'The Messenger' - my least favorite in this collection, however it is still a solid story! 3 Skulls

Story #5 - 'Deadfall Lane' - this one is, by far, my favorite in this collection! 5 Skulls

Story #6 - 'Water and War' - a thought-provoking story about an alien. 4 Skulls

Story #7 - 'Stones' - another story that makes you think! 4 Skulls

Story #8 - 'Deathbed' - a very well-written story about a father and son. 3 Skulls

Story #9 - 'To Catch a Fly' - a story about a convict. 4 Skulls

Story #10 - 'Ugly' - an absolutely brilliant twist-ending in this one! 5 Skulls

So there you have the ten tales within this collection. I didn't even mention the incredible Foreward (which immediately grabs you!)

Israel Finn writes with spectacularly, vivid clarity. His stories suck you in and are totally immersive! He has a talent, in spades, for great storytelling! I am definitely looking forward to reading a novel by Finn!

I LOVED the 1st half of this book! Absolutely fantastic! A fun, nail-biting adventure.

Then, the book suddenly jumps ahead, seven years later, and shifts in a completely different direction.

I am not saying that the latter half isn't good, it's just different. The book, as a whole, is a great read, I just enjoyed the first half more than the second.

The authors of this collection of short stories could not have picked a more appropriate title. Appalling Stories - that is what you are going to get - No Holds Barred writing - exactly as advertised.

I cannot wholeheartedly recommend this book as this is not be a book that I would normally read. (The reason that I did so is that I am familiar with two of the three authors - Dubrow & Zacek.)
With all of that said, if this book sounds like your cup of tea, then I am sure that you will enjoy it, as the stories are well written.

The top three stand out stories to me are:

1. Bake Me a Cake (by Dubrow)
2. It Doesn't Affect You (by Hair)
3. The Bitterness of Honey (by Dubrow)

I also enjoyed (is that the right word?) Dubrow's Melanie's Becoming, which fell just short of 5 Stars.

Bake Me a Cake is the very first story in the collection and (for me) the most shocking! If you can stomach your way through this story, the rest should come easier. I think the authors chose well making this the first story, as it perfectly sets up what this collection is all about. There is always two sides to a story... These stories are going to make you uncomfortable and angry!

As for the other stories in the collection - for the most part they are all decent - there were only two that I didn't really care for - the others were each average. The Bitterness of Honey is definitely my favorite story of the bunch!

If you're looking for a rapid-fire, page-turning Western to read, look no further than this!

This book opens with a bang and doesn't let up until the insanely climactic showdown!

Wales' is one of those writers who places you right in the midst of his story.
It feels like you are really there, smack-dab-in-the-middle of the lawlessness of the Wild West...

I chose this one solely based on the author and its size, so I did not even read the above book summary, I just dove right in. Needless to say, it was a jolting dive! The story opens with a shockingly, gruesome discovery and never lets up!

Whoever says that originality is dead has obviously never read Jasper Bark!

I will say that this story goes pretty far out there and definitely will not appeal to everyone, so don't say that you haven't been forewarned.

My only real issue with this story is a minor one. The main character is named Jim Mcleod and another character is named Kit Powers (these are both real-life authors, whose names I am familiar with, but whose works I have not yet read). That being said, their names were a slight distraction which kept me from being fully rooted into the story. Other than that, this was a welcome introduction to Bark's writing-style.

BONUS:
This book also includes another story by Bark - 'How the Dark Bleeds' (a fascinating story about blood! I may have enjoyed this one even more than 'Run to Ground') It looks like this one is also in Bark's 'Stuck on You' collection. There is also an excerpt, at the end, of the 1st two chapters of Bark's 'The Final Cut'.

On top of all of the above, after reading 'Run to Ground' you learn that it is part of a story-cycle known as the "Heresy Series". ('How the Dark Bleeds' is also part of this series, as is 'The Final Cut')

This book also includes an essay by the leading academic expert on the Qu'rm Saddic heresy - Nicola Tanthur PhD.

So, whether you buy this book in print or digitally, you get your money's worth!

Now this is a great little short story! This one grabs you right from the get-go and doesn't let up. So step right up and read about the "secret freak", the "Freak of Freaks" and see what he has to tell you!

This is a super-fast read. (5 minutes maybe?) Not a whole lot to say about this one, other than it is a well written story (taking place when Native Americans were prevalent). I am not sure what sort of creature the main character is, but this story will make you wary of whom you should trust.
Completely not what I expected from this book, yet it is still a great read, from its horrifically tragic beginning all the way through to its climatic ending!

I am not sure how I missed this one, back in 2013, though I am glad that I stumbled across it now...

Whether you agree with King or not, this is definitely a good read!
(well worth the buck!)

I am not sure how this one slipped through the cracks, but it did. Released on Feb. 28th, by Subterranean Press, Hellraiser: The Toll tells the story of what transpired between Clive Barker's The Hellbound Heart (published in '86) and The Scarlet Gospels (published in '15).

The Toll is a short Novella (73 digital pages) that flies at a breakneck pace, from the Prologue all the way through to the Epilogue. The story is by Clive Barker, but the novella is written by Mark Alan Miller(?!?) I am not sure how that works, as there is no explanation. I will say that the book is also available in Hardcover (for $40! - a bit pricey for such a short story). Even though I own both The Hellbound Heart & The Scarlet Gospels in print, being unfamiliar with Mr. Miller, I opted with the considerably cheaper $3 e-book.

Having now read the story though, I will be keeping an eye on the price of the Hardcover as the story is that good! Miller has written a completely engrossing tale, with such a jaw-dropping revelation within the story that I wrote the quote and then deleted it and then rewrote it and deleted it once more. However, I feel that it is best for you to discover it for  yourself.

ENJOY!

The 3rd book in the "J. B. Collins" trilogy (preceded by 'The Third Target' & 'The First Hostage'), 'Without Warning' is probably my favorite of the three books (beats the first by a hair!)

What a book! Edge-of-your-seat from beginning to end! And what an ending it is! I love when an author bucks the trend - totally refreshing! You will not forget this book!

The Swarm By Frank Schatzing

"The #1Blockbuster German Bestseller about an intelligent life force that takes over the oceans and exacts revenge on mankind."

This book is utterly fascinating! I do not believe that I have ever read a book filled with so much informative knowledge! (the amount of research that went into this book is mind-boggling.) Think Steve Alten on Crack The science behind everything is extremely complex, yet Schatzing makes it all completely understandable, and every bit of this story is explicitly visual within your mind's eye.

This is a book that lovers of any genre will thoroughly enjoy. There is something within for everyone.

I will let the book description speak for itself. All I will say is that this book will definitely be a contender for my "Best Book of the Year", come December.

Steve Alten is my favorite "faction" writer, and this book is a perfect example of why. It is a page-turner in every sense of the word!

Enjoy and remember, "The truth will set you free, but first it will piss you off."

If you have never read anything by Frank Wales, you are missing out on one of the horror genre's best authors!

His debut novel, 'Booger', is one of the strongest debuts that I have ever had the pleasure of reading.
His sophomore effort, 'Gamemaster', is just as strong.

However, with 'Friend', Wales has officially joined the ranks of Garton, Ketchum, and Laymon.

The character development in this novel is top notch!
It is refreshing to read about such "honest" characters, and I definitely recommend this book to anyone out there looking for something new and original to read.

cands.text: I love the Lake People books, because I find the entire premise of Unknown and La Famille to be just fascinating. These books never fail to get you right in the feels, but this one was particularly heartbreaking - and hopeful. Full of twists and well-developed characters!
How do you not love grumpy bear Bishop? He was so bashfully cranky, but with a heart of gold. I was so happy to see that he and Ava got their own book, and it didn't disappoint!
What an incredible and unique take on on a classic tale! McMaster has built a rich, vivid world and deeply-layered characters here.

I'm currently re-reading this in fervent anticipation of "Forests of Dreams" which is supposedly coming out soon! And I realized that I hadn't yet left a review, so I figured I'd go ahead and spread the word about how awesome this author is, and how much I enjoy her (non-Bubba) work.

Picking up after "Sea of Dreams", "Mountains of Dreams" explores a very different reality in the US, and it's fascinating how things play out. The characters are developed, and Ms. Bevill is excellent at utilizing foreshadowing. There are no random dangling plots with her, which is something that I really appreciate.

I don't have enough nice things to say about all of the books by T.S. Joyceand Ive read them all, by now! I have thoroughly enjoyed each and every one of them. She crafts multi-faceted characters with real depth and emotion. I love that the conflicts are always outside or internal forces; its always about a villain or an internal battle (sometimes both!), never about cheating or people purposefully hurting each other. I do wish that the universe was the same across all of her books, but I love the crossovers in the ones that do exist in the same universes. All in all, I would definitely recommendthe books aren't a difficult read, but they're just consuming enough. 10/10!

It took me awhile to get into this one, but once I did, I was hooked! Despite the slow start, I found myself wishing that it wouldnt end.

My primary complaint is that theres too much tell and not enough show. Were told about a lot of things that happened or are happening, but we don't actually experience much of them. The story ends up oddly rushed in places, while entirely too much time is spent on inconsequential things which I suppose go toward world-building, but felt more like a lecture than exploring a new world  all this time spent leading up to the trials, and then the trials themselves were over in about a minute. I didn't feel like things really picked up until halfway through the book, and then they were rushed and it was nearly over. I also felt like I missed some things along the way  I was confused by the familiars, and didn't realize that Arianna herself could also shift into a wolf until at least a few chapters in. It also ended kind of abruptly, so Im hoping that we won't have to wait too long for Book 2  and hopefully, Book 2 will have more meat to it.

With that said, overall Jaymin and Leia have once again hit it out of the park! Their unique blend of mythology is as engaging and compelling as ever. Ive been a fan for a long time now (of the writers individually and their collaborations together), and once they work out the kinks, I think this series will become iconic. Cant wait for the next one!

Reviewer Wendi Adams summarized my feelings about this book extremely well. The reviews on Amazon aren't reflecting it, but Goodreads reviews are - we're not the only ones. I'm pretty much done with this series. I've never understood the choices Scarlett makes in her love life  in the last series, she never even seemed to particularly like Eli beyond basic friendship (and sometimes not even that), while the build with Jesse was excellent, but yet she ended up with Eli? I was so excited that she and Eli were over in this new series, hoping that finally the way would be paved for her and Jesse. But this Jameson thing came completely out of nowhere, and I strongly disliked the character and how manipulative he was - Jameson was a bad dude, no matter how hard the author tried to make us sympathize with him. I also felt like a lot of backstory was missing - I only vaguely remembered who he even was, and even that was a struggle. Heck, I even felt like I was missing things within the book - when/how did their relationship even turn romantic? What just happened? I was so confused and turned off of the whole book.

Like others have said, Scarlett also seems to have gotten less mature and more unlikable. Her judgment is somehow no better than it was at the beginning of the first series, despite all shes been through, with the possible exception of being a bit more respectful to Dashiell. (Also, theres a backstory Id love to read!) And in this book, she was much less tempered by the more likable characters surrounding her.

I thought the overall Vegas plot also left a lot to be desired. It had some really interesting potential, but it just fizzled - the ending of that whole arc was just anti-climactic and kind of a letdown. And why are they even called Skinners? I was expecting something so much more sinister.

I did adore seeing Sashi, and would love to see more of her. I'd also like to see more of Lex. But I don't think I particularly care to continue the Scarlett Bernard arc.

I honestly can't recommend any of the works by this author strongly enough... I have high standards, and I've gone back to re-read her books several times. She also always delivers and doesn't make her fans wait forever for the next book and new work, so I'm willing to purchase her books and keep supporting that!

Her books are also actually long enough to sink your teeth into, which I adore. I can't recommend strongly enough. Be prepared for all the feels!

Honestly, it earned an extra star from me just for that, even though it wasn't the greatest thing I've ever read. It was nice. It was sweet. An easy read, and I'm not devastated upon finishing, so there's that! Faith continues the tradition of somewhat annoying, slightly stupid women in this series, but again, huge improvement on the last. Loved Matt and that whole side of things.

The first book in this series held great promise.

Unfortunately, this follow-up disappoints--over-the-top camp, OTT accents (seriously, I don't need to sit there and try to figure out what the heck Tallon is trying to say; his voice was well-established in the first book), and don't get me started on how obnoxious the "guardian angel" is--he's a completely unnecessary character who doesn't even deliver comic relief!

Overall, nothing really happens in this book. Lily and Tallon never make any real progress. I'm not even curious about what will happen in the future with this series, and that's saying something.

Overall, I'd advise skipping it unless you're extraordinarily easily entertained.
My heart ached for Becca and everything that she went through. This was a beautiful story about pain, loss, and growth. Hopefully, there will be a follow-up!

Lauren Blakely hits it out of the park again! I've loved everything of hers that I've read so far! She writes a great story that makes you FEELI laughed, I cried, I hoped. Would highly recommend any of her works if you're looking for a wonderful, engrossing love story!
