That's what happens when you bring together great characters and Rock N Roll romance. I highly recommend this book. Happy Reading.

I received an ARC from the author for an honest review. First, Wow. I was blown away. What a deep emotional read. I loved this book! First the author writes wonderfully. I love the whole British vibe through the book the catch phrases add so much to the book. Dex & Emily. What can I say I fell in love with this couple. Which of course did not start out as a couple. Then there is Jared and Rachel the two loyal friends. Dex has left the states for London University for a fresh start and to make a better life for himself and prove to his Aunt Sarah that he is worthy. Dex has demons and the way he handles his demons is to stay far away from people which means lots of meaningless hookups. No one can hurt you if you don't let them in. Emily and her friend Rachel leave the comfort of home for an adventure in London. Emily is shy and reserved while her friend Rachel is very outspoken. They compliment each other. As the story progresses we find Dex and Emily falling for each other. Emily has her bad memories as well but has no idea of the burden Dex has been carrying over the last 10 years. They help each other, love each other and slowly start opening up about their troubled pasts. Emily's New Life Plan is not going according to plan but she does not care she realizes her friends are worth more than an adventure at University. Let me say this book was a roller coaster of emotions up down twists turns. It was a tearful romance and heart breaking at times but I could not put it down! I highly recommend this book and I can't wait for book 2. Thank you Nicola. Happy Reading everyone.

Hello I received an ARC from the author for an honest review. Wow what a ride, so emotional. This book kept me awake with my Kindle long into the night. I am so glad Victoria asked me to review this book. Josie Seth and Blake. I love that her best friend is a guy, we all have guy friends but Seth is Josie's rock. Blake the man Josie fell for hard, but Blake has secrets. An emotional twist and turn of love, anger, hurt, betrayal, and friendship. I will definitely keep my eyes open for Miss Victoria's next book in the series. I highly recommend you read this book. If you did not get a chance in 2013 you should put it up on your TBR for 2014. As always I do not give spoilers I just wish you all Happy Reading, from The Book Vixen with love. xoxo

I received an ARC for an honest review. This book is all honesty. Kayden rocked my world. I loved Untangle Me. The story of Sophia and Kayden got me in the heart. Kayden tries so hard and loves even harder. Yes he's a little messed up but aren't we all a little bit too? He wears his heart on his sleeve. He craves intimacy and is a very sexual person. It also goes deeper than that and reveals his addictive naure as well. Kayden's demon is alcohol, a very subtle foe. This story was raw, emotional and intense. I feel like Kayden is talking to me as I was reading the book. He's a good guy that's had some bad things happen to him. (all in the name of love) This book was written with lots of emotions and feelings put into the character. If you have not picked up this series yet I highly recommend that you do. I expect great and wonderful stories from Chelle. As always no spoilers just my recommendation to give this book a chance you will love it just like I did. Happy Reading from your favorite Vixen.

I received an ARC for an honest review. I loved the book. I thought it was fresh and original. It was also rough & raw at the same time. You are exposed in this story to real life issues (mental illness) and what it takes to care for a family member. You also get the intense emotions and feelings between these two characters. Torin & Chiara, two different people one fate, to meet and fall in love. Well not at first you see, Chiara has a story. The story of a young woman left to her own means of survival in order to care for her mentally unstable sister while her mother deserts them for her own independence and new life. Chiara is head strong and determined. She did not set out to become a high class escort, no she chose this path as a way to survive. Torin has always been a fighter from the streets to the Octagon, he has always fought and fought hard. Torin has no desire to fall in love and get married. He saw first hand what marriage did to his mom. No, Torin wants the Title and will do anything for it. One night Torin & Chiara Meet and it's powerful, hopeful, emotional and at times very turbulent. But this is what we love! The romance the angst, two people who want to be together but know it can't ever be possible. Torin fights for Chiara the same way he does in the ring to win no matter what. I would definitely recommend this book it's a very compelling and interesting story, there is a lot of background to the story and you get to know the characters and see what makes them do what they do. It's all about love, loyalty and the Happily Ever After? Well I will let you be the judge of that! Go ahead and grab a copy. Happy Reading from your favorite Book Vixen.

I received an ARC for an honest review. This book had my emotions all over the place. It was a good story but it jumped around so much and at times made little sense to me. Emma was too up and down not trusting Carter and seeming to do it all wrong. It was not until towards the end that she finally started to come into her own in the story. Emma's infatuation over Carter made her weak. Don't get me wrong I liked the book at times it was hard to read due to the mob violence. But it also had it's endearing qualities, Emma really was a lost soul and wit the help of people Like Amanda and Teresa she is able to make friends. Plus I felt it was a little too long at over 300 pages. Carter as her life long friend turned mobster does end up sacrificing a lot for Emma but in the end he too comes out a better person. Tijan wrote a captivating book I just felt it could have been better in some areas and less in others.

This story is an emotional roller coaster of highs and lows. At times I just wanted to toss my Kindle and others I was like I can't stop. The main character Cali Monroe went through some heart wrenching pain for the loss of her brother Ben. As well her as her wrath/love for Logan Waters, Cali takes on the "mean" girl role at College. The story developed well and presented great the topics such as death, suicide, and learning to move on. I liked the poetry aspect of the book as well. This will make readers heal and love along with Cali and Logan. This read will make people to stand up for what they believe and be brave enough to grab onto your dreams no matter what. But more importantly to make it happen.

I received an ARC from the author for an honest review. Burn baby burn! I loved the second book in the series. Ms. Brooke writes one heck of a good story. Burn continues where Spark left off. Eric & Velaney are the perfect couple, but both have ghosts of their pasts that still haunt them to this day. Eric loves and cherishes Velaney and only wants to be by her side for the rest of their lives. Velaney is guarded and cautious, she's been taking care of herself ever since she left her parents house of horrors at 18. Her best friend Carissa is the only one who sees Velaney for what she is, a kind and loving person who with the right man in her life can be the best woman she can be. Eric is determined to be that man no matter how much or hard Velaney pushes him away. This book is full of emotion, heart break and most important love. I have gotten to know Brooke over the last few months and I know she writes from the heart with a passion for her characters. If you read Spark you must read Burn. The book ties lots of the plot together and it comes together seamlessly. Plus there are lots of good little surprises as well. I am honored hat I received the opportunity to read and review Burn. I highly recommend it. Happy Reading.
A great book. Highly recommend as a read you won't be disappointed. I loved the story. A different kind of love story with all of the twists and turns that make it great.

I loved Hilary's writing style. I fell in love with the characters right away. Eaven & Talon are perfect in fact I have not fell in love with a boyfriend/girlfriend music couple like these two in a while. I love Eaven's friend Ivy, she's perfect for Eaven. Ivy brings out the best in her friend. There are lots of twists and turns that make this a great first book. I messaged the author when I finished to ask when book 2 would be out. Chelle Bliss I loved this book so much! Thank you for writing this story. Throttle Me was everything I hoped for and some surprises along the way. When the author asked me if I wanted to read the book I jumped at the opportunity. I have read her previous books and loved them and when she started throwing out ideas about this book I could not wait. Enter Joseph Gallo, aka City. Holy hot Italian goodness. When I started this book I thought my kindle was going to catch on fire! City is 100% Alpha Male. Suzette which I loved the moment she encounters City. As they get to know each other there is lots of steamy sex and sparks fly. Suzette is a simple girl who is a teacher, she normally does not step out of her carefully planned world. Suzy is not convinced the Joey is right for her. See Suzy has this "list" and Joey does not fit on this list anywhere. It takes some convincing by City and Suzy's friends to get her to let her guard down and see City for who he really is under all of the tattoos, a kind and loving man. City is always there for Suzy through the good and the bad. Lots of twists and turns in this book. There are also a couple of return characters from previous books as well. I love how Chelle wrote them into the story. I love the large Italian family and they loyalty and bonds shared by the family. Honor and respect being the core values, and they love to have fun. The ending to the book was perfect. Not what you expect, that's for sure! This is book one of many (I hope) as long as Chelle keeps writing I will keep reading. I highly recommend this book you will not be disappointed it is original in the story and the characters. Happy Reading from your favorite Book Vixen.

First let me say that I could not put this book down until I finished it. Nina Levine and her Storm Series is soooo good! Thank you for writing a great follow up book to Storm. Fierce was just that super Fierce. You got a closer look at Scott as well as Madison & J. Enter Harlow the sexy new girl in town. Harlow moves to be closer to her mom so she can help her out with her business. She meets Scott one day when he brings a cat to the vet where Harlow works. Sparks fly and sexual tension heats up the pages of my Kindle. Scott is loyal to his core all he cares about is family and his club. When it looks like Harlow may be in danger Scott takes over and shows everyone including Harlow that he will do anything to keep her safe. The book is full of twists and turns and Scott finally has to see that he and his step brother Blade are not all that different when it comes to honor and loyalty. This is book two of the series and I can not wait for more from author Nina Levine. A highly recommended read from your favorite Book Vixen.

I read the reviews and was impressed that many found that their children would play for hours and months.  Happily and thankfully, I can say as a mom of 4 boys 6 years old and under the reviews were absolutely correct.  I just ordered 2 more 100 piece sets to add to their collection. I would admit that even both Mom and Dad geeks like playing with it too.  It is rare that I place a review on items I've purchased, but this is one that deserves high praises.  The first night my 6 years old stayed up till midnight playing the Magna Tiles.  And he is the one that is usually running around making noise and breaking things.  Apparently all it took was the right toy and we can see what we thought was true before. He has an exceptional awareness in building and attention to detail.  The rest of the boys, our 3 years old and 23 month old twins are having fun playing with what our eldest makes and they build something as well.  From space ships, cars, houses, castles, different designs and such.  You can make mazes pretty quickly and they can have fun breaking the design and building it right up.  The little ones are still puzzled how they stick together, but they will catch on soon enough..  We love this toy! I highly recommend it to all parents that would like some more peace and quiet or some more reading time. As well as just another alternative to teach children how to build and stimulate their creative side while having fun.
My favorite slippers so far! Very comfy and not too hot for warm weather area like where we live in.  I have better grip on the floor when walking inside the house especially around the kitchen area.
Great story, great rules to live by for anyone trying to survive. It has a lot of great lessons to learn young and old.

They are a bit bigger than I thought.  They are very comfy even though it is warmer weather that we live in with AC on.  Very cute Cat slippers, got lots of compliment from people who have seen it.  I almost forgot to take it off while going to go get grocery I liked it so much!

It is very lightweight, easy to wash and just the right size for me.  I can easily say that this is more for a feminine size head.  For me it fits just right and have some space to not feel too snug in the face.  Winter running is tough and I needed this especially since I tend to have a cold longer.  I still carry a tissue when I run since I'm breathing through the balaclava and it does get wet.  So there is no skipping washing if you are running with this.  I love the design and it matches my SmartWool sweater that we bought previously.  My hubby says now I really look like a Ninja :).  I highly recommend for anybody else that doesn't necessarily use it for running.  It protects you very comfortably.  I love wearing when it is very cold.  Better than just wearing a scarf.  If you have a head cold this is definitely it.

I've tested this while snorkeling.  It absolutely works.  I may need to get more.  As long as you seal everything velcro and the zip locking option it really does keep everything nice and dry.  I put the apple watch, couple iPhones and car keys. Initially tested with just paper inside just to make sure there was no leak and sure enough it protected all our devices. It's also great for anywhere especially in the beach to keep the sand away.  Very easy to use and there is plenty of space, while not being too bulky.
Kept me in suspense. Reminded me of spending more time with music and a bit of my childhood growing up traveling with family.
Great set of Pens.  All my kids love using it especially me!  Very easy to carry and organize and vibrant colors.  One of my favorite color sets for sure!

cands.text: SIZING IS DEFINITELY AN ISSUE WITH THIS PRODUCT.  I HAD PLANNED AHEAD (I THOUGHT) AND BOUGHT A LARGER SIZE TO ACCOMMODATE SOCKS.  HOWEVER, EVEN THE THINNEST OF SOCKS ARE IMPOSSIBLE TO WEAR -- WITH A TOO-SNUG PAINFUL SHOE THAT IS SIZED, I BELIEVE, SMALL.  HAVING READ SOME REVIEWS IT APPEARS THAT SOME EXPERIENCE TOO LOOSE A SHOE WHEN BUYING LARGER SIZES TO ACCOMMODATE SOCKS  NICE DESIGN, ATTRACTIVE PATTERN...BUT SIZING IS AN ISSUE THAT, FOR ME, RESULTS IN DISAPPOINTMENT.  ALSO, IT WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE THE PATTERN ON THE LEFT AND RIGHT SHOE APPROXIMATE THE SAME IMAGE; HOWEVER, ONE SHOE PRIMARILY HAS YELLOW VISIBLE AND THE OTHER HAS PURPLE PREDOMINANT.

This item is not a shoe; these are essentially a pair of "slipper socks"  with markings on the bottoms.  (There are no protective shoe-level soles.) The packaging references  "Airplane  Hotel  Cruise" and "Lounging Cooking Reading."  However, these slip-on foot coverings are more reminiscent of 'hospital socks' (but provide less coverage as they are designed as flats).  This flimsy item suggests a classic fabric pattern and "Mary Jane" shoe design but should NOT be confused with shoes or fully functional slippers.  The price is high, in my opinion, for the product.  The product page and advertising suggest the product is/may be more than what it is in actuality.  The product does not appear "durable" and some review postings confirm that this suspicion is reasonable.  The product label states that the item is "recommended for indoor use only" and "Made in China." Even if this item fits you may not consider it appropriate or safe to wear. NOTE: I POSTED THIS REVIEW O APRIL 16, 2018 RE. THE ORDER I RECEIVED ON APRIL 16, 2018;  AMAZON HAS, HOWEVER, POSTED MY REVIEW WITH 2017 REVIEWS.
THE MEDICAL THEME OF THIS PAIR OF SOCKS IS WELL DESIGNED AND ATTRACTIVE.  I PURCHASED THESE SOCKS AS THANK YOU GIFTS FOR  MEDICAL STAFF.

Fair warning about this product:
1.  No labeling on product re. fabric content,
2.  No labeling acknowledging whether flammability standards are met,
3.  No care instructions,
4.  No identification of country of manufacture,

Bottom line:  This is a problematic product that is badly stitched, with cut differing from sizing norms, with fabric differing from product page, and that does not have product labeling re. fabric, care, place of manufacture. I do not recommend this product.

users.query:
Lord is a troubled man. Having had a tough childhood, he has reunited with his brother, helped run their pawn shop, Chains, and is trying to make a better life.
Elle hasn't had it easy herself. Her father passed away when she was young, and she never got along with her stepfather or his son. To say she and her mother have their differences is putting it mildly.
When Elle forces Lord to give her a job at Chains, the sparks begin to fly - and MAN! do they fly!
As with the rest of the series, Meghan brings these amazing characters to her writing that make you want to keep rooting for them and holding out hope that there's more. I cannot wait to get more from her!

cands.text: The characters, as always with Meghan's books, jump off the page and bring you to the Quarter. Love reading this series, love these characters and Meghan's writing!! Cannot wait to see more of this series (I know a few characters who need books...let's make this happen!!)

I have thoroughly enjoyed every book of hers that I have read, and this is no exception!
This is one of those stories that you read, and as you go through it, you see it going one way and are suddenly surprised at the path the characters choose. And such well written characters, with flaws and strengths that are both admirable.
I don't know how she does it, but this series just gets better and better!! Amazing, beautiful and angsty...I am running for the next book!!

Just when you think, "What can she do to change this or fix that?" Meredith goes and blows it out of the park! Beautifully written and riveting, there is nothing bad I can think of for this book, never mind the series. Seeing some loose ends tie up, finding more questions, and feeling somber to know the series will end after the next book, I completely devoured the book! I can't think of anything else without gushes about certain things, stressing about other, and giving out spoilers. If you've enjoyed the series so far, you absolutely WILL NOT be disappointed!
What felt like a completely different book from Meghan still gave me all the feels her other books do! The pull between the main characters was amazing and heartwarming. One of my new favorites!!

Meghan March knows how to write hot, sultry and emotional, and this story has it all!!
Seeing these two characters, one who has been sheltered and unable to truly live, and the other who has forced themselves into *mostly* solitude, and watching them find their way to each other is amazing. Getting little peeks at our other Beneath friends is also wonderful.
Definitely can be read as a stand alone, but I suggest following each story and seeing where the couples came from and found each other.
Holly and Creighton just came to life in this series, and it was so well done!! Cannot wait for Meghan's next story!!

Nicole has done it again.
The start of a series, and I couldn't put it down after chapter 1! The characters are well written, and you just can't help but fall for them! I cannot wait for more!!!

Just when you think it can't get better, Les and Michelle blow it OUT OF THE PARK!!! Following Molly and Joe through their final chapter is uplifting, beautiful and also sad. I will miss them, but what a way to go out! The beauty, the anguish, the twists and turns - I can't stop gushing about this book. If you haven't grabbed any of the books, you need them all now! Highly recommend this book to anyone and everyone!
Meghan March had met, and possibly exceeded my expectations with this book! And I cannot wait to read book 2!!

** Possible Spoilers **
When I first got this book, I will admit that I was a little apprehensive. I love her mother's work, but sometimes it doesn't translate from one generation to another. So, it took me a few days to decide that I wanted to read the book - WOW. Just, wow, and not what I expected, and amazing. She really made me feel for these characters! And, because I suck at reading the synopsis, I didn't even know what I was getting into. I love the freshness of this! Many other authors have tried to take these creatures and turn them into something else. I like that they weren't referred to as vampires - I think that made it better. Some of the same attributes, but still different and..interesting! I like to see how people can change a being we all know about, and this was seamless. Great first book, Eden! I can't wait to see what else is brewing in that head!

I am becoming quite the history reader - and it's blowing my mind a bit!
Ellie Midwood puts you right in the scenery that you're reading about. The characters seem real and you find yourself rooting for their cause. And the side characters - you find yourself loving and hating them, and scared because you know you shouldn't like the Nazi at all, but they're real people, flaws and all. I cannot wait to get into book 2!

Seriously, just when you think "it'll all get better" or "what else could go wrong" you'll be shown!
Nicole has such a way with these characters!  Miles and Grace are amazing and so REAL!! And the more we learn about the Paranormal Peacekeepers, the more I want THEIR story.
You need to grab this book, grab this series, and hold on tight!!!

Roni Loren delivers again!! I love all these novels and cannot wait to get my hands on the next one (starting it now). The depth of the characters, the view of previous characters, all of it - SO GOOD!! I am so glad that I searched her to find out that the novels didn't end with Grant and Charli!

Uh!! I cannot wait for the final installment of this one! Meghan keeps you wanting more, and the relationship between Holly and Creighton is killing me!! Gripping the edge of my seat and wanting it to end the way I want it to - I'm holding out for my...I mean, their happily ever after and wanting to keep them apart from interference! These two need to get straightened out and determine that they are where they belong!

In true Yolanda fashion, she took this book and knocked it out of the park!!
The first in a series, Swing has everything you've come to expect from Yolanda. Of course, this does end on a cliffhanger, but the premise itself is thought provoking. And how it's left?? I can't wait for the next installment to see how she works it!

Always keeping me on the edge of my seat!! Arianne knows just what to do to twist, shift and change the story you thought you were reading. I thought I knew what path we were going to take, but was pleasantly surprised and in awe at the things Arianne comes up with. I cannot wait for the final installment, and will be waiting on pins and needles!!!
I loved revisiting the characters of this book!! Cannot wait for more of this series!!

I hadn't read the others in the series, and there was no issue following this one!
Watching Jeff and Mia try to find what they once had is endearing.
Dealing with the past and current from chapter to chapter is perfect! You see where they were and what brought them to today.
Great, and cannot wait to see more from Helen!

As expected, Julie Richman always writes such amazing characters and stories that you cannot help but fall in love. I absolutely enjoy every one of her books, and this was no exception.
When first looking at the story, I worried because I did not like Zac from what I saw in the rest of the books. But, as I expected, Julie got you to understand his character and know what was going on behind the scenes.

I started reading A Taste of Pearl and loved the story! Such a great read! I would definitely suggest reading all 5 books - the last two are a re-telling from Alexandre's POV and its great to see what he went through during the story. I'm going ti auggest this series to my bookie friends!!

Ok, I'm gonna be honest: I'm not sure how to start this review. I just finished the book last night, and I'm still thinking about it...contemplating it...and trying to work it into words. Ok, here goes...
Sam had a rough time growing up. He lost his father first, them his sister. He and his mother are the only family they have. He decided to try to carry on with his father's hobby, and has made a damn good living at it.
Levee has also known loss. Losing her older sister, she has taken it all and tried to make something phenomenal of her life. She may have succeeded in some senses, but there's still something missing.
They meet, and not under the best circumstances, and find that they have different things that tie them together. And they have to determine if they have enough to hold them together.
Beautifully written, Sam has moved his way it my favorite book boyfriends.

When I began this book, I didn't know what to expect. It starts out a little unusual, with notes from "Sloth" to "R". Learning that Sloth and R were starting to develop feelings toward each other, even though they had never met...I still didn't know what to expect. I was a little uncertain, but am so glad I continued.
An unusual story, I enjoyed every last minute.

So, I'm just finishing this book, and it's taking me a minute to work through all my thoughts.
This book is amazing - that I can tell you.
Watching Ransom torment himself over something he couldn't have stopped...or, he could have, but his fear pushed him to the events that caused his pain.
To watch Aly fall for him, even though she knew what she was giving to him might not be returned.
Watching Ransom's family root for them to get together, even when neither thought it would happen.
And the ending...I think that's what's holding me up the most. I won't talk about what happens, but I cannot wait to see the next book!!

This is a follow-up to Thin Love, but I haven't read it yet (thought I've purchased it and moved it to my "read really soon" list), and I didn't feel like I should have.

Eden is a wonderful writer. This is the first of her books that I've read, and I will be checking to see if Thin Love is her only other book. Any and all of my friends should check this out ASAP!!

I know I'm a little late reviewing this book, but I just finished it and can't contain my thoughts! Such a beautiful story! The main characters are beautiful and their struggles, though common, are so heart wrenching! I cannot wait to get the next book and start reading it! Great job, KA, I'm blown away!!

users.query: The book focuses more on the making of the movie but Eugene Allen's story is still interesting. Nice retelling of the history of the civil rights movement. I'll try Situation Maid - From Cotton Picker to Presidential Cook, the Story of Lillie Nelson (Ethnic & National Biographies & Memoirs) next, since this is my week for African American biographies.

cands.text: Like some of the other reviewers said, I wish the story had been longer. But it kept me engaged. Plenty of excitement and adventure. I kept switching back between this one and Situation Maid - From Cotton Picker to Presidential Cook, the Story of Lillie Nelson (Ethnic & National Biographies & Memoirs).Love both.

Shelby Foote's examines all the small details that made the Civil War such a compelling event. Reading The Civil War by Foote is like examining every page of the Official Records of the War of the Rebellion - but without the heft and weight of all those volumes. His examination of the motives and personalties of commanders on both sides is worth the price alone. Foote is a master story teller. I highly recommend this set to every Civil War buff. I'm also reading A Stranger On My Land (Civil War Romance Series) (Volume 1) about the battle of Lookout Mountain.
A heartwarming story. I'm definitely looking forward to the next book by Sanders. This and Everlasting Light: A Civil War Novella (Civil War Romance) are my two favorite books this summer.

I have Foote's other works but the compact size of this book allows me to read on planes. The beauty of Shelby Foote's writing is that he uncovers all the nuances that are so often ignored in other historical writings. Foote is a master story teller and national treasure. I'm also reading A Stranger On My Land (Civil War Romance Series) (Volume 1) , a Civil War romance about the battle of Lookout Mountain.

It's loooong but if you want to get a feel for the Civil War it's a good movie. Lots of reenactors in the movie. Daniels does a great job as Chamberlin and I thought Duvall captured Lee perfectly. If you enjoy Ken Burns Civil War you might like this one, too. I also enjoyed A Stranger On My Land and Everlasting Light (Civil War Romance Series). (these are short novellas) The stories are less about the war and more about the relationships between soldiers and their women, but sometimes that puts you in the moment. A Stranger On My Land

I loved everything about Untamed Land - thought it was wonderful. Riveting plot and terrific character development. This and Everlasting Light: A Civil War Novella (Civil War Romance) are my latest historical favs.

Excellent mystery. I had trouble putting it down. If you're looking for a great book to take on a trip, I recommend you snag a copy of this one. Resnick writes a compelling, suspenseful book that keeps the reader deeply engrossed. This one and Redeeming Grace: Murder at 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue (Thriller & Suspense, Political Intrigue) are my two favorite summer reads so far.

Kept me turning the pages throughout the book. Definitely one to read. Well thought out plot with lots of intrigue. Strong female protagonist and excellent pacing. I found this and Redeeming Grace: Murder at 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue (Thriller & Suspense, Political Intrigue) to be both excellent suspense novels.

This book was pretty good. More like your typically read Christian fiction. Predictable in parts but a clean, sweet read. I liked Becalmed: A Carolina Coast Novel (Romance, Contemporary, Women's Fiction) better but this one was definitely worth the money.

This is not the first book I've ready by Mike Dellosso and it definitely will not be the last. As with all Dellosso book's the story grabs you by the throat and holds you hostage throughout. Great message regarding how we need to make the most of the time and life we have. This and Redeeming Grace: Murder at 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue (Thriller & Suspense, Political Intrigue) are my two picks this week.

A heartwarming story from the first kiss to the last tingly embrace. (Loved the ending!) Nate is a man's man through and through. A service man marred by military experience. I'm definitely looking forward to the next books in the series. This and Becalmed: A Carolina Coast Novel (Romance, Contemporary, Women's Fiction) are my two favorite books this summer.

If you are a fan of character development, clear plots, and great dialogue, this book is for you. The prose is skillfully written and scenes wonderfully painted. The moral themes of the book resonate with believers and nonbelievers. That said, readers need to know the author is a pastor and writes from a Christian world view. It's a sad fact, but some reviewers post negative (and often nasty) reviews in order to kill a book's sales, simply because they dislike all things relating to God and Christ. This review will not show up as a verified review but I did purchase the book at an author's book signing. I believe in the book. I believe you will enjoy it, too. This and The First Christmas Carol - A Miser, A Manger, A Miracle are my two favorite books this week.

Apparently Brits and Yanks come at novels with different expectations. No question, for me, the book started slow but eventually it became a better read. But then, I'm used to fast food. This one needs to be savored over a long dinner. Novels like Redeeming Grace: Murder at 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue (Thriller & Suspense, Political Intrigue) and any thing by Dan Brown is more my style but I found this one entertaining.

Nice summary of the battle. I bought this version so I could read it while traveling to and touring Civil War battlefields. I've throughly enjoyed it so far. I also read A Stranger On My Land and while it's a romance, the battle scenes were pretty good. Thanks to the editors Charles River for this series in Kindle version. Much easier to carry my eReader than a case of books.

Haven't finished reading my advance review copy yet, but so far I'm enjoying the truth found in this book. As soon as I finish reading A Stranger On My Land (Civil War Romance Series) (Volume 1) I will add more to this review, with highlights of what I find interesting.

If you like love stories, you'll like the early Nick Sparks books. He's a master at drawing emotions out of readers and this one is no exception. You know at the beginning this is not going to end well for the reader. [ No spoilers, I trust you will buy a copy and read it yourself ]. After wiping away the tears I bought Bahama Breeze on the recommendation of a friend. Breeze is nothing like Message in a Bottle but Breeze was funny. If you love beaches, boats, and having your heart massaged by a master story teller, grab a copy of Message in a Bottle.

I came at Soul's Gate a little reluctantly. As a fan of C.S. Lewis, I struggle to find any contemporary writers who craft a story as well as Lewis. The premise of Souls Gate drew me in, though. The writing is clean, the pace, fast. The characters were presented as realistic without the normal stereotypes you find in Christian fiction. This book and The Maze: A Christian Fantasy Novel (Angels & Demons & Lost Souls) both made me made me question if there were things going on around me in a spiritual realm. If you are looking for good clean Christian fantasy, I would recommend Soul's Gate and The Maze. You won't be disappointed.
I chose this book because I loved the cover and title. Hard not to like a woman with a hummingbird tattoo on her shoulder. First day into the book and I'm LOVING IT.

Confession: I "purchased" this book for free. I met Millie at a writer's conference a few months back. We shared the same literary agent for a while. So when I saw her book for free I thought I'd grab a copy. The first page warns that if you're one to skip prologues answer a few questions before you jump ahead. I couldn't, but that wasn't why I kept reading. The facts of China and the way Millie tells a story kept me reading past the first page of and the next and the one after. Here I was wrapping up my devotion time (I read a daily devotional from Christian Devotions Ministries on my Kindle) and I'm still reading about Chinese emperors and the Opium Wars and the conquest of...

Finally, I stopped. I have to write, too. That's my day job. But I WILL return to this book later today during my reading time. I bought the book for nothing but there's nothing cheap about Hungry River. From the little I've read, it's priceless.

More thoughts on this book later. Eddie Jones

I love highlighting sections of nonfiction books that speak to me and Plan B by Wilson and Our Authentic Selves: Reflections on What We Believe & What We Wish We Believed (Christian Spiritual Growth) are defiantly two I'll continue to highlight and share on Facebook. Wilson nails the emotional roller coaster so many of us feel when we pray, claim God's promises, and still find our life spiraling out of control. Terrific book! Well worth the price.

First off, I'm a believer so I gravitate toward books like this and God's Provision in Tough Times - 25 True Stories of God s Provision During Unemployment and Financial Despair (Christian Spiritual Growth) Still, no matter how many times I hear of others hearing God, I'm still moved when I read their stories. This book isn't The Shack but for an inspiring (and short) story, I highly recommend it.

"Two pairs of dead eyes stared up at me, their gaze placid rather than terrified as I would have expected. Had the victims died like that, with an eternal stare of serenity for their murderer? Or had the killer posed their eyes as he did their bodies?" Murder, a killer, and a corpse - classic thriller opening. Great job by the author. Love this one. Also like Fatal Transaction (Thriller & Suspense, Cyber Crime).

I pushed through this one and found this one interesting at times. Like Becalmed: A Carolina Coast Novel (Romance, Contemporary, Women's Fiction) and The One You Love (Emma Holden suspense mystery #1)better but I give it a 3 because it's not the worst novel I've read this week.

Bought this one because I had just finished reading God, Me, and Sweet Iced Tea: Experiencing God in the Midst of Everyday Moments (Christian Spiritual Growth) and the similarity in the titles caught my eye. Sweet Tea is a devotional and this is memoir but both kept me reading. Jesus, My Father bogs down in the middle but as memoirs go, it's pretty good. It's always a challenge to create drama from chronological events but the author does a pretty good job. Definitely worth the money.

This was an excellent series and I was so blessed to have met the author in person this past summer in Harlem at the book fair.

The storyline was excellent and I was able to follow the story without having to wonder who she's talking about.  Excellent work Racquel Williams.  I'm so glad my sister suggested this book to me!  Can't wait for Part 2.  You have definitely gained a new fan and supporter of your work.

What, this  took me on a roller coaster ride of emotions.  I wanted to choke Bailey for some of her decisions but I have to give her her props.  She was one bad chick. I need part 2 in my life so I can find out what happened between her and Red.

A rollercoaster ride for sure.  The chicks in this book are crazy as hell over men that don't belong to them.  Got to read Part two to see what happens.

This lantern is a MUST have for camping, power outages, and even just a general light source, as it gets impressively bright! Simply slide up the light and you're good to go.

This device can be powered by its internal rechargeable battery, 3 AAA batteries, and even solar power, which I thought was cool. The rechargeable battery life is OUTSTANDING. I could not get this thing to die. It lasted well over 15 hours of being turned on, suggesting that you will rarely have to charge this device.

The solar panel is kind of a gimmick. Does it work? Yes. However, don't expect to leave this device out in the sun for 20 minutes and be given a fully charged device. This device will take at least 24 hours of direct sunlight to function on solar power. This is more of a last resort or emergency feature. Think end of the world or out backpacking in the woods without electricity situations.

The lantern comes with a hook attached to it so you can easily hang the lantern up if necessary which is a good feature.

Overall, this is a wonderful lantern. The battery life is outstanding, and I really enjoy that you can power the device three ways; battery, rechargeable DC battery, and solar power. While the solar power is a cool feature, the panel is small, so it takes a very long time to charge. Use this feature only as a last resort.

If you do a lot of late night activities like I do, you're going to want a headlamp like this one. Powered by 3 AAA batteries (not included) this headlamp will provide you with an impressive amount of light while remaining comfortable on your head. For a device with a small bulb that runs on 3 AAA  batteries, the amount of light you get with this device is rather good. I was able to navigate my pitch black basement very easily while wearing this headlamp.

What I like best about this lamp is that due to its light weight design, I have a very good amount of light everywhere I turn my head, without even noticing that the lamp is on my head. I have used similar lights in the past that are rather bulky and heavy, making them less than ideal for long term use. Also, with this headlamp you actually can go running while wearing it (unlike similar devices), due to its light weight design.

The lamp features 3 modes: Bright, low, and strobe. Each light mode can be activated by pressing the power button once the device is on. I usually only keep my device on Bright (or high), but I can see how the strobe feature may be useful for grabbing somebodys attention or even blinding an intruder.

Overall, whether you want to be prepared when a disaster hits, or are simply looking for a headlamp to use around the house, it doesnt get much better than this headlamp. With that being said, I would absolutely recommend this headlamp!

I was provided this headlamp for free for evaluative purposes. This did not influence my rating of this product. All opinions are unbiased and my own.

The EnergyFlux rechargeable hand warmer is a great idea that could be better executed in my opinion. It simply does not get hot enough for those cold New England days that anyone from the area is used to. I would describe it as lukewarm at best even at its highest setting. I bought it for my girlfriend who has very cold hands, and she ended up never using it because it didn't get hot enough. In fact, the disposable hand warmers made of iron that you can buy at the dollar store get warmer than this product did.

I know everyone's idea of warm differs, which is why I did not rate this product any lower. I guess the product just did not live up to my expectations.

In this day and age, it is a bit difficult to come by a standalone radio like this one. When emergencies strike, or if youd like consistent music to listen to (without wasting your cell phones data), its great to have a dependable and easy to use radio like this one.

The radio runs on two AAA batteries, and can be used in either AM of FM mode. Further, the radio is able to be tuned with a tuning dial. Other radios I have had like this only have a scan option, which makes it incredibly difficult to find a radio station you actually want to listen to. The radio also sports a headphone jack which means you can listen to your music without disturbing others. Finally, the radio features an extendable antenna to increase your reception range.

While the radio is excellent for listening to weather, or emergency alerts, I feel that the speaker is not really adequate for music, especially the louder you get. In short, the speaker is kind of small, and sounds begin to become distorted at louder volumes. If you want to use this radio to listen to a talk show, or as previously mentioned, the weather or other news or emergency alerts, then this radio would be perfect, especially for an emergency supply kit but for listening to music? Not so much, unless of course you're using headphones

I was sent this radio for free in order to evaluate and provide my honest feedback.
Very bright flashlight. Makes a perfect compact light for taking the dog on a walk on a dark night. Has a strobe feature which was interesting!

Excellent pack of replacement batteries for the Canon EOS T5 Rebel. Bought them for my vacation to Costa Rica because I didn't want to miss a moment, and I didn't. They work just as well as the factory batteries, and work with your Canon charger. A great accessory for your camera!

So far this solar powered light by Falove is working perfect! The package itself comes with everything you need to begin using this light, including mounting hardware, should you choose to affix this light to a surface.

We have had issues with cars being broken into in the area that I live in, and I get that it was time to look for a good deterrent. Most criminals (if they're smart anyway) will not go near a house that is well lit, out of fear of being seen. This is why I have this light mounted to my front porch. Not only will this deter potential thiefs, this will also ensure that there is always a light on when I get home late!

In order to begin using the light, first make sure the panel has sat outside all day absorbing sunlight. Next, push the button on the back of the light to turn it on. If you do this during the day, you MAY notice that the light does not turn on. This is because the light is set to power on ONLY if the solar panel detects darkness. You can easily cover the solar panel to test the light. Its really that easy.

While this light works very well, I do wish the light spread out to a larger area. It covers a reasonable amount of distance, but I expected a bit more. I may need to purchase a second one in the future because of this.

Overall, if you need a reliable and bright light in an area that does not have access to electricity, or you are looking to cut back on your electricity bill, this is the light for you.

I received this product at a discounted rate in order to evaluate and leave my honest feedback.

This is a very bright flashlight that is the perfect way to make sure you never get left in the dark. The flashlight features 5 useful modes which include: low light, medium light, bright light, strobe, and SOS. Strobe is quickly moving flickering of the light in order to get somebodies attention, while the SOS moves in slower intervals using what is commonly recognized by outdoorsman, military personal, emergency workers and more, as Morse code.

While I think this is a nicely made flashlight, I do have a few things I feel are worth mentioning. First, this flashlight does not come with a battery or charger for a battery that you would purchase. This means that you must have your own 18650 Li-ion battery in order to use this flashlight. I cant imagine these batteries being too expensive that the manufacture cant provide one, so I think they definitely should consider this for the future. It is important to note out that thou can purchase a 3 AAA to 1 18650 battery converter. This allows you to use 3 AAA batteries in place of the lithium ion battery, which solves the issue of having to charger the flashlight. Luckily for me, I happen to have a few of these adapters at home. I recognize that not everybody has this adapter at home, so if you plan on purchasing this camera, make sure you purchase the adapter as well, or you won't be able to use it!

Next, this flashlight is not extendable and does not have a zoom future like similar flashlights do. The zoom feature allows you to focus all of the light onto a small area to make objects or even people more visible. For example, if I were standing 25 feet away from a sign and couldn't tell what it said, by using a zoom feature, you can easily make out what the sign says. It would have been cool to see this feature in the flashlight as most similar products do have that feature.

Overall, this flashlight is very good. It gets very bright, but without a battery or charger, or at the VERY least the 3 AAA battery adapter, this flashlight might leave you wishing you went with a different one, if you do not trendily have a 18650 Li-ion battery or the adapter kit at home. I will admit that the light is very bright, and the flashlight itself feels incredibly sturdy.

This flashlight was sent to me for free by the manufacturer to test in exchange for my honest opinion.

If you are camping, hiking, or backpacking an in area that is out of the way from civilization, youll want a survival bracelet like this one. With this bracelet, you have all of the essential tools to ensures that you can survive until rescued, should anything bag happen to you.

The bracelet itself is a 6-in-1 design which includes: A compass, a whistle, a knife, a flint, a bottle opener, and of course paracord, which has many potential uses itself.

Everything on the bracelet works very well. The compass syncs up perfectly with the compass on my iPhone, the flint strikes nicely, the whistle is loud, etc. The one piece of constructive criticism I have is that the area that the flint is positioned in is less than ideal. When attempting to create sparks, the striker can sometimes hit the plastic buckle (as pictured), leading to deterioration over time. Not a huge deal, but definitely something for the manufacturer to consider over time.

Weve all been there before. You get settled in to your comfortable bed, you're ready to sleep. Youre just about to doze off and you realize you left a light on. GREAT! Usually, youd have to get up and go show it off but with this D-link smart plug, you no longer have to!

This plug is the perfect way to power on your devices without even getting up! You can turn your lights on and off, turn on the TV, and even turn on your coffee machine to begin brewing as you hit snooze a couple of times on your alarm clock.

Setting up this plug was really easy. Simply plug it into your outlet, download the D-Link mydlink Home app, and the app itself will walk you through the entire process.

Once the app is installed, you can plug in any device you would like to power from your phone. Whats even cooler about this is that you can set a schedule for when you would like your device to power on. This means you can come home to a well lit house, or have your coffee begin brewing before you even wake up. How cool is that? Just make sure you turn on the power button on the plug itself, or else you may think that the device doesnt work, when in reality you just forgot to turn it on!

The one piece of criticism I have is that the app is a bit buggy sometimes. Sometimes you may have trouble finding your device.. or it may take forever to load. If this happens, I have found restarting my phone fixed this error.

Overall, while the app itself could use some improvement, this product is wonderful. Never again do you have to get out of bed to shut off or turn on a light. Also, the fact that you can schedule when your appliances power on guarantees that you never have to come home to a dark house again.

When you wish to use the corresponding row (going across) simply push the button in, you will see a red light appear indicating that the powerstrip is on, and you will be ready to go! I never have to search for an additional outlet, and if I only have my iPhone USB cable on me, I can still charge my phone because of the 4 USB ports on power strip. Out of all the power banks I own, the Poweradd Apollo has quickly become my favorite. In this day and age, we depend on our cellular devices for so many conveniences, Including but not limited to: GPS/Maps, Communication, Information, and so much more! By being so dependent on our cell phones, we quickly drain our batteries, rendering our devices temporarily useless, and potentially putting ourselves into harms way. This is where the Apollo bank by Poweradd comes into play. This device quickly charged both my Samsung Galaxy S5 and iPhone 6s Plus in a device test, just as quickly as having the device plugged into a wall outlet. Any device that is powered by a USB charger can be used on this device. This device features 5000 mAh charging power, a backup solar panel for sunlight charging, a micro USB cable to charge the device, a carabiner to clip the device to your bag, and even a small LED light that can prove to be invaluable in emergency situations! This Charger includes 4 blue LED lights indicating how much power the device currently has. 1 = 25%, 2 = 50%, 3 = 75%, and 4 = 100%. To turn on the LED flashlight for this device, simply hold down the red button above the Poweradd logo to turn it on, and again to turn it off.  It is just about the size of a Samsung Galaxy S5 for reference.

IMPORTANT: if you are sitting here thinking you'll only charge your devices using solar power from now on, this isn't exactly ideal. While this CAN be done, it would take a very long time to charge this device solely using solar power, close to a few days. The solar power feature is intended for situations where you do not have access to electricity, such as when camping, backpacking, traveling, or even during weather emergencies. This is especially useful in New England Winter's when the power is frequently out for days due to severe snow storms. Overall, I think EVERYONE should own a solar powered cell phone charger in case of emergencies, and the Poweradd Apollo is one I would HIGHLY recommend!

This wireless presentation remote control is the perfect way to give off a professional and prepared appearance when delivering powerpoint presentations! It runs on one AAA battery. It features a "back" and "forward" button for delivering powerpoint presentations, that can be used to quickly go through your slides. This helps you focus on and engage the audience instead of staring at the computer screen. What I also like about this remote is that it has a laser pointer function, which has proven to be very helpful when presenting to large audiences! The USB dongle for this device is located inside of the remote itself, which I thought was convenient, as I am ALWAYS losing USB dongles for my other devices.

One IMPORTANT thing to note is that you have to physically turn this device on before using it! It is not that intuitive, as most of us are used to simply plugging in USB devices and having them work. A blue light on the remote will flash once it is on! Remember to turn your device off to save battery. Overall, this is a wonderful device that everybody should use to during powerpoint presentations to come off as more professional!

Saying that this light gets bright is an understatement. Pictures and videos truly cannot do it justice, but be sure to check out my before and after picture anyway! This light completely illuminates my entire driveway! After our cars were broken into (no signs of forced entry, no windows broken, no alarms went off), we felt it was time to look into a deterrent as we wait for our surveillance system to be installed.

Whats really unique about this light is that it includes the option to plug it in using a standard wall outlet. I actually cut that piece off when installing my light as I didn't realize we couldn't utilize that function based on where we wanted to install the light, but it DID work in the wall with that piece still installed. Youll more than likely need some sort of extension cord, as the cable itself is only about 3 feet long.

If you're like me and don't read instructions, Ill make understanding the knobs really simple for you:

LUX: Do you want the light to turn on during the day? Since you probably dont, turn the knob to the crescent moon shaped setting, as this means it will only work at night.

TIME: How long do you want the light to say on for? I keep mine set about 1/4 of the way on, which lasts about a minute or two,, but the minimum is a few  seconds (kind of useless really) to a maximum of 8 minutes (according to the instructions).

SENS: How far do you want the sensor to detect motion? I have mine cranked up almost all the way, since as previously mentioned, I want to deter those who shouldnt be on my property.

While the SENS or sensor setting took some getting used to and adjustments, Ive finally set my light so that it will turn on if somebody is even on my sidewalk. which is around 30 feet or so. This is perfect as our cars were all just broken into, as previously mentioned. If you're trying to figure out the sensor settings, turn the timer on its lowest setting so that you don't have to wait minutes for the light to turn off.

Overall, this is an incredibly bright light. It includes everything you need to install, and is really easy to set up. Although the settings do take some playing around with, once you figure out which settings work best for you, youll find that this light will blow away your expectations!

I don't like sending him outside unless a light is on, so I usually have to get up and turn on the light for him not since installing this motion detector light! As soon as he walks by, he is immediately greeted with very bright LED lights, so he can have an idea of where he is going, especially when walking down the stairs.

The light runs 100% on solar energy. If you keep it out in the sun all day, youll have more than enough energy to meet your lighting needs. The motion detector on this light is very good, and has a very good range. From just about 15 feet away the light detects motion and will turn on for about 15 seconds.

The light comes with mounting equipment which makes affixing it to a wall or any other surface a breeze. If you're looking for a dependable. and impressively bright solar powered light, I would absolutely recommend this one.

Oh Lord, how I've come to love my sunflower spouts!!!  They are so delicious, and good for you.  I had a big pile of them on grilled hamburgers last night!  Awesome!

These seeds seem to be very high quality.  I've tried some other seeds with middling to poor results.  But these always turn out great.  I love them, and just ordered a big batch of new seeds.

Here's how I grow them.  I bought two plastic shoe boxes from the dollar store, drilled holes in bottom of both for drainage.  I cut a piece of plastic craft/embroidery mesh to fit the bottoms of both boxes.  I put a half cup of seeds in a mason jar, and soak over night.  Then I drain and rinse twice a day for 3-4 more days.  At this point, there is a half inch white shoot coming out of most the seeds.  Then, dump into one shoebox on top of the mesh piece, spread evenly.  The mesh will provide a foothold for the roots.  Place the second box ON TOP of the newly sprouting seeds.  Put a good amount of weight in the top box.  A few cans of corn, a brick, etc.  This will help the sprouts take root, plus build up some strength.  In addition, it will make the sprouts all grow to about the same height, which looks nice and is easier to cut.  After a few days under the weight, the sprouts are greening up and pushing upward, then remove the top box and let them grow a few more days.  During this entire process you should be rinsing and draining your sprouts two to three times daily.  Leaving the top box in place, I run water between the two boxes, which helps the sprouts from moving too much, helping them take root. As your sprouts feel more secure, run you fingers over the tops, under running water to help remove the black shells.  A few stubborn shells will need to be picked off.  You don't want to eat the black shell, or the root portion.  When ready, slice near the bottom.  An advantage of the plastic mesh mat is that you can lift it out of the box to make slicing at the base of the sprouts easier.  I usually cut what I need and keep rinsing to keep them fresh.  But if you cut them all off, they keep pretty well in a plastic bag in the fridge.

And if you were REALLY SMART, about half way thru this, you'd have started a second batch, that can go under the box with the other sprouts!  Keep it going!  You won't want to be without these sprouts in your kitchen.

I moved into am apartment complex with brick walls. We have shared WiFi that is 250Mbps, but I could never get a good signal with my laptop. I bought this adapter, plugged it in, installed the software and it worked great. I bought a 10 foot USB cable and put it out on my balcony nearer to the complex's router.

I then plugged my own router into the Ethernet port of my desktop computer and bridged the WiFi and Ethernet connections so that I could re-transmit the WiFi. I can now use my screaming fast WiFi on all of my devices!

I have transmitted about half a terabyte so far with this adapter across all of my devices and it is going strong 24/7.

If you use this same setup, make sure you are transmitting on different wifi channels than your complex. Also, I am sure there are probably better ways to do what I did, but I already had the router and I like to be able to have a reliable antennae if I need it.

I bought this cable to connect my modem to the router. Cat6 is overkill for an only 20mbps conection, but I like to have the highest quality products on my network. This cable is sturdy and seems like it could take some abuse.

This would be a 5 star network card if my bluetooth worked, but it doesnt yet. Hopefully an update will be released soon. I will update the review when it is fixed. Luckily I don't really need to use bluetooth. I get great speeds on wireless AC. I use this with an Intel NUC BOXD54250WYKH1 Intel 4th Gen Intel Core i5-4250U. I haven't had any other problems. I use this mostly with wireless N and wireless G networks at my university. I am using a 5GHz connection right now. I do not have any problems.

I would recommend this product.

I use this for online tutoring to write math equations. It works great. I don't use any of the extra features this pad has. I usually use the snipping tool to create a white space where I then draw math equations in various colors. It works great!

As a tool for my weekend job, it has already paid for itself and will continue to do so.

I had never heard of TP Link before, and I needed a cheap router to take to college so I bought this one.

This router is great. I have a linksys WRT610N router at home, and it costs 5 times as much, and has many comparable features, including a few bandwidth monitoring features that the linksys does not come with.

The GUI is very easy to use, just go to 192.168.1.1, type admin for username and password and you are in. I didn't even need to use the installation CD that came with the router because it is so easy to use.

The router that I got looks completely different than the one in the picture even though it has the same model number, and I actually like it better.

I have the Intel Ultimate N 6300 adapter inside my laptop, and my wifi connection maxes out at 150Mbps, not the claimed 300Mbps. I do get the full 300Mbps with my linksys WRT610N.This does not matter very much because internet connections are usually not that fast, but if you are transferring files you will notice the difference.

I will post some pictures of the GUI, and the actual router on the main product page. I will update if any problems arise.

Now my Wi-Fi devices are not dropping off when I am in rooms that are a distance from the room where my actual base Wi-Fi router is placed. I have a number of devices that require charging: IPad, IPhone, IPod, Kindle, etc.. This multi USB charger is has enough amperage capacity to charge multiple devices at one time with an amperage capacity of 6.8 amps. Every device that I know of charges at 5 volts. So the 5 volts divided by the resistance of the device or total resistance of all devices equals the current (amperage) draw. This will be in the thousandths of an ampere total. Therefore, the current carrying capacity is there but you will probably never come near using anywhere near the maximum.

Also, using this type of charger or any wall outlet charger lets you charge the device without opening apps on your computer like ITunes or GPS or other auto-update programs. Use the computer USB port only when you need to.
