cands.text:
Cheaply made and the noisemaker only works if you bang it on a hard surface.  The green part is glued on.  That will be destroyed quickly.
Not durable and could actually be unsafe as a dog toy.
The dog likes it but the noisemaker only works if the toy is turned upside down and then right-side up.  The dog hasn't figured this out yet.
We're now on our 4th one.  But it's the dog's very favorite toy, so what can we do?  Sure wish they made the "voice box" somewhat more indestructible.
This thing is a hoot and the dog loves it!  He carries it around a LOT.  Makes a lot of noise and goes on forever.  His motto:  "Toot your own horn."
Sturdy and the dog loves the crackle noise.  Whatever pleases him pleases us.  He's a medium sized dog about the size of a Boxer.

This and the Chuck-It "Flying Squirrel" are my dog's very favorite toys.  He also has a glow-in-the-dark Chuck-It ball he's very fond of.  The neighbor dog was fond of it too, and stole it.  Just got a replacement today.  The other toys he loves are the "Look Who's Talking" toys from Multipet.  Yes, he's a very spoiled guy.

My dog grabbed this and ran to show the neighbor lady

Celebrity Pet Toys are amazing - cute, creative, well made and I want to collect the whole set

This one is called "Slug Grrr" - cute!

When we went to the dog park, my dog would steal other dogs' toys and play "keep-away" - plus, he would not always come when called.  I've only had to use the "vibrate" feature and sometimes all I have to do is PRETEND that I'm holding the transmitter.  We live on acreage, so the 1/2-mile radius is a godsend - saves me a lot of hiking.  I get a lot of questions from people who have considered a "shock collar" and they are relieved to know about the "vibrate" feature.
These are my dog's favorite toys.  He has worn the old ones out.
I guess the secret is not to let the dog KEEP it after you throw it.  I turned my back for a few minutes; then heard the dog cough and found the frisbee in tatters.  What a waste of $20.

This was supposed to be for the cats....but as soon as the dog got a look at it he claimed it for himself.  Still chirping but the cats are feeling left out.  :(

It's very cute...I can see why the dog wanted it.
This is one of his favorites and he carries it around for hours at a time.  Kinda hard on the ears but when we say, "Brawk - Polly Want a Cracker" he goes to his toybox and pulls it out.
These are supposed to be CHEWS.  They're hard as a rock.  I crushed them into a powder and added them to the dog's food.  Now he won't eat it.  Would not buy again.
I love it but I should have purchased it while my dog was still a puppy.- he's afraid of it
Dog didn't play with it AT ALL.  Small, too rigid, BORING
Dog went crazy for this - plays it over and over and over.  Driving us a little crazy but it's so funny we don't mind.

So far, they prefer the "scratcher" that they were already using - a shop broom head bolted to the wall of the stall.

Neither of our two horses has expressed much interest in this device.  I'll try it in a different location and hope for the best...
I bought it as a gag - and it scared the dog.
We already had the Deedle Dude rabbit - I wish they would come up with a different SONG for each toy in this line....but the dog loves it, so what the heck
The dog adores this and the recording quality is much better than I expected.
They don't hold up well at all.  I expected better quality from the "Kong" brand.

The software is for a WEBCAM not a slide & negative scanner - so now I have a webcam I don't want or need (I already have one).  The manufacturers' sites (there are several) don't mention this product at all.

Have the Chinese embedded a webcam in my computer?

Am a paranoid?

You betcha.

What a disappointing and rather frightening situation this is!
It really does keep your water unbelievably cold.  I wish there was a slightly larger one but this will do just fine.
Oopsy.  They are too big for dog food cans.  These are designed for LARGE cans of cat food only...

users.query: My 10 year old son is a huge minecraft fan. He pretty much likes anything Minecraft. He loves the figures, this one included, but prefers the animals and things like zombie pigmen and creepers. Sorry, Steve!  It's a nicely made, pretty sturdy toy, except the head popped off right away. I super glued it back on and it's never coming off now. too bad one shoulder got glued too, though.

cands.text: Best minecraft toy ever!  My 10 year old son loves minecraft and adores the minecraft animals, especially the ocelot and chicken.  These are well made overall, though the ocelot tail pops out easily, it pops back in easily as well.

My 11 year old son is a Minecraft super fan. It's a nice playboard with cubes and 4 minifigures.  It's a great way to get started collecting the minifigs.  It's fun even without the  App for making the stop motion animation, but this is something my son really enjoys.

My son is totally obsessed with Minecraft.  He dove into this book immediately and keeps running to me and telling me his latest discovery.  We did the directory adventure together and the results were jokes and really fun.  this is text only, but cute, and my son loved it.

Wow this toy is HUGE. It really makes a big impact in the box and out. It is loaded with fun sounds and things to do. This would make a great gift for any young boy. My son is 10 and is still in love with this thing!
This is a really fun toy. The eyes light up and the dino roars when you press the arms down. I had to remind my husband that it's a toy for the kids and not him!  Nice and big and sturdy!

Instant fun in a box!  Dragons are always cool and when you add a crossbow you can't go wrong.  I always thought playmobil a little high end price wise, but after buying minecraft toys, their prices seem a lot more reasonable for what you get.  Good quality, as always.
My 5th grade son loves this book.  He says there's angels and demons and that's great!  He loves fantasy and sci fi. He actually stopped playing minecraft to finish reading this book; it's that good.

My 10 year old son and I love to play our original bopit. It really belongs to my 15 year old son, who have had this toy for many years.  I had to try this smaller version, which I figured would be easier to handle for  younger kids with smaller hands.  I was right about this, but what I pleasantly surprised about was that it talks to you! In a man's voice, it tells you to bop it to start, and if it's idle for a minute it says, "I'm falling asleep".  Also, when you miss a move,  it tells you what level you are on, like, "Level 9".  Maybe current larger versions also have this talking, I'm not really sure. I just know our ancient old bop it does NOT talk, but it's still going strong.  I love this small version. Easy to carry in a bag or in your car!

My autistic 9 year old loves this toy.  It's really fun how it lights up in addition to sound (though lights really are battery eaters).  It came with batteries, which is nice.  The only thing would make it 5 stars is if it walked like some of the fisher price dinosaurs do.  It turns out my other 9 year old son likes this toy a lot too, even though it says for up to age 7.
Such a fun item. My autistic 10 year old son loves it, and he doesn't like a lot of toys. I'm sure it's great for toddlers too. high quality and nice reusable tray.

This toy is adorable. My autistic 10 year old loves it.  uncle milton toys are great. we also have the moon toy.  I love that it has a remote control. It is a lot smaller than the picture shows. It's about  10 inches or so tall and 6 inches wide.

This toy is a lot bigger than I expected and it's so cute!  My autistic son will pretty much only play with bath toys, so I was glad to come across this one for his birthday. Works great, makes a little noise but not so loud he covers his ears.
My autistic son is only interested in bath toys and TOMY makes some great ones. This one is a nice big toy and does a lot of things in addition to being a wind up toy.
Super cute toy for toddlers. I like that it plays music, but you have the press the nose several times to get to the songs.  all in all, we do really love this toy!  so fun and cute.

My son is 10, so a little over the recommended age, but he loves building toys like magformers, and these are no exception. In fact, we all like building things with these. He uses his cars and planes with the stuff he builds.
I tried it out with the 13 yr olds, the 8 yr old and the adults, and everyone found it boring and/or frustrating.  Perhaps we don't have the attention span for this toy!

Neat toy for kids with small dogs! The cardboard dog is also really fun. I love that kids can keep coming back to this and adding on color as they wish. It's big enough to be impressive, but not so big it takes a commitment of space in your home. washable markers are a MUST and glad that the toy company recognizes this.

This toy is really colorful and cute. I love the dual propellers and theh bear pilot. It's a little bigger than I expected which is a good thing.  My son loves filling up skis to make sink and then emptying them out to make it float.  It seems well made.  It had a very slight soapy/perfumy smell when I opened the box; maybe it's the recycled box it comes in.

A high quality book which I found very cute. My 4 year olds were way too young for this, but my 9  year olds liked it a lot, as did I.
There are a couple of fold out items that always add a little bit of unexpected fun, especially the map.
It also has a great ending!

My 10 year old son likes this book a lot. Sometimes I'm not sure what he'll like and what he won't.  He's a big fan of harry potter and series like fablehaven.  I like the cute koala bear on the cover! He said "it has a really good twisted ending". My son is an avid reader and I'm glad to get this book which we later pass on to our elementary school.

I got these in all silver and I think they are extremely well made and sturdy. Heavier and nicer than I expected, certainly for the price, considering that I paid 6.80 for them!  I wear these 24/7 and they never poke the back of my ear the way studs can. I didn't know how to open them at first, but they kind of pop open with an invisible hinge in the bottom middle of the hoops.
Soft and beautiful. Low pile makes it easy to vacuum. I love thin, nonslip rugs like these! The colors aren't too bright, but are still colorful.
Great price, and matched the chair I got my son. Fun item.
Gorgeous gloves. I was worried they would be too big, but fit perfectly.

terrible quality, and the box was beat to pieces when it arrived. one slat was broken in half, that looked like it was broken in production, not in shipping.
awful all the way around.

users.query: I love the vampire movie series of "twilight" and so does my 16yr old gdaughter. I finally got a kindle fire and downloaded some books to read. She was looking thru my selections and saw the serenity series and downloaded the first book on to her Iphone.she read it and called me up to order the next book and didn't care how much it cost. It is so good to see her reading again,and my mind is at ease knowing that she has been doing this instead of running the streets..lol this is a good book to read for anyone.she cant wait for the other 2 books to come out.."buried bk#2 and captured bk#3 in the series..Marissa Farrar is one of her fav authors now..

cands.text: I am voluntarily leaving a review for this free book. It is the first book that I have read from this author and I really enjoyed it. I liked the lead character Deanna. She is a reporter but has only gotten "fluffy" stories and has been ready for a big story for quite some time. She finally gets her chance when a murder occurs. She begins to investigate with the help of her computer and smart phone savvy grandmother. This is also when she meets the handsome sexy new detective,Tyler. It's a good story with a good mystery of who done it.

I really love this series. Deanna is learning so much about her gift as a psychic medium and trying to find murderers and stop more deaths from happening. In this book,her family comes to visit,but she is having a hard time with them around. She begins to doubt her abilities. I like where this book is going with its characters,but I find Deanna to be a little rude and conceted In this one,which I didn't care for...but that being said,I loved how things turned out towards the end. The real killer was a surprise. Heading off to read the next book in this series now.

When I start each book in this series,it's like I'm coming back to family. I really love this series. There is witchcraft,a hunky detective who just happens to be a wizard ..and really knows how to use his wand.lol, June has really gained the confidence she needs to develop her potions using her gift and relying on her own intuition. Her relationship with Oscar is going in the right direction. People are coming to her shop for her "magical cure",and someone in her cozy town has a baby secret....Tonya is such a great writer and this one is another hit!

I got a free copy of this book from an author event and my review is voluntary. OMG...this book was amazing! This writer really knows her stuff. There is so much "sitting at the edge of your seat" suspense that will not let you put the book down! As you begin to know the main characters, you start to learn more and more about them. Some are truths and some are lies...and its the lies that create the story. The main female Rae, is married ( to Julian) and has a 2 week old son..trouble is....Julian is a terrorist arms dealer. His dad is the leader. Rea has recently found out and  made a plan that after Julian leaves for one of his "meetings" she has packed a bag for her and her son, sneaks past her guards..and heads back to America to start a new life...without Julian.  and thus the story begins.......this is the first book that I have read from this author, and if her other books are even half as exciting as this one was..well then I will getting them also. great writing talent here because when she describes a situation, you can actually visualize the facial expressions on Rae..and "feel" her fear..and that is some darn good writing!!!!

What an amazing talent this author has. Her writing really makes you feel like you are right there,watching everything that is happening. This is a very easy book to read in one evening. And as always,the mystery is very well thought out with twists that you don't see coming..  I definitely recommend this book to all mystery readers.

I am really enjoying this series. In this book, Lily Ivory is becoming much more comfortable with using her witchcraft. She has finally found the place she can call home without feeling like a freak. She has caught the eye of 2 sexy men...who can't stand each other. Lol . When a man with a strange past is murdered,she is asked to help find the murderer,but this won't be easy with other strong witches trying to stop her. There are parts of the story that seems to drag on a bit for me..this is not to say it's due to bad writing at all...it's just not something I like that's all. I love the suspense toward the end of the book and how it makes you want to pick up and read the next book right away..!

when Melissa writes a book,she puts her heart and soul into it. She usually adds a piece of her own life in the story line and this one is no different. This series is such a treat to read. you will find yourself laughing at times and other times crying your eyes out,so have lots of kleenex handy.lol to me,this book shows a family love that is so strong that even when one is gone,their love continues with the rest into another family of love, and this keeps that lost member alive in everyone's heart. Age doesn't matter when it comes to real love. disclaimer. I belong to a readers group and received this book for free, but my honest review is left voluntarily.

This was a good story. The main character,Samantha, has quit her teaching job to open her bookstore,her dream. In her spare time she is also stirring a murder mystery that the reader gets to follow as well. There are some similarities in both which at times had me getting them mixed up. I love the fact that Sam's grandmother and her elderly friends are helping Sam to solve a murder that happens in Sam's yard. The characters are fun. The family rivalry is just like any other family's life. This was an enjoyable read.

what a fun and amazing story.  I love this author. her characters are strong.this is the beginning of a new life for Dr. De who inherits her grmas house and money..she also has inherited her psycic abilities and begins to forsee the deaths of little girls. she can also see ghosts,as well . she begins to help the police find this crazed killer. Even tho this is a mystery,some of the side characters are what make this story so fun,like a drag gueen,a sexy ex priest and a maid who just happens to be a ghost. I am so looking forward to reading more in this series

I  read and really liked the first book in this series,and when I began reading the second book, I had to read back the beginning of the first one because I thought I started the wrong one. Book 2 is exactly like book I,even the part where after she decides to help clear her friend from the murder and she walks out of the friends house and her boyfriend is standing there waiting for her...I have never written a bad review before but I am very disappointed with these first 2 books..story was good just not twice...but I will read the 3rd book and will see what happens there. I received this series in exchange for an honest review,so I didn't lose any money...

I voluntarily am leaving a review for this book that I received for free. This is the first book that I have read from this author and I didn't know what to expect,but as I read the first couple of pages,I was hooked! This author writes very well. You immediately fall in love with the main character. She is an everyday kind of girl,leads a normal life as a photographer,who just happens to meet a prince! When he runs away from his royal obligations to " find himself" he ends up going away with her to a hideaway. This is a fun story about how two opposites attract and the difficulty they go through. Very good story that I would highly recommend

I won a hard copy of this book and lent it to my daughter..she had never heard of this author and was skeptical of her writing. She started the book with her doubts but when she was finished she wanted part 2 right away..lol and also wrote this short review..."very moving,this story touches all of your emotions.cant wait to read Desert flower" ...hope this review helps..thanks

I love books from this author and this first book in a new series is awesome... it has fun characters that will make you laugh out loud. It is a very lighthearted "who done it" that is so well written that you can finish it in one night...and you will because you won't want to put it down!!! If you like to read a fun cozy mystery with zaney witches in it..then this book is perfect for you. I definitely recommend this book...great job Leighann,another winner!

I received a free copy of this book and my review is voluntary. I just loved this book. I have read other books from this author and they were also great. This is the first book in a new series and a totally new genre for her. She did an amazing job and let her creativity really flow and shine with this one. There is such a fun snarkiness between the two lead characters. The Stern, strict boss that everyone respects and is afraid of..who just happens to be the sexiest vampire elf around,lol and his new assistant..a vampire herself, is not afraid to speak her mind to her boss in spite of everyone else's fear of him. And that is what attracts him to her..and her to him...without telling you too much, you really have to read this fun book. There is a scene in the elevator...that will make you spit your drink out when you read it (my advice..don't drink and read,lol) I can honestly say that I cant wait for the next book in this series, especially because of the "surprise" at the end. I will also warn you there is swearing and graphic sex scenes in here, so if you're put off by that, you will miss a very fun and crazy book....because it all works in this book. I am 60 and wasn't offended by it because it really went with the story..

I am used to reading ghost stories. This is a whole different type of book for me..vampires,werewolves, shifters... but when I read the synopsis it sounded pretty good. I started reading this and could not put it down ! I read it all in one night. As you read this story, you are drawn into the world of Alayna and her tragic accident that claims her family and causes her to find a new life...and that she does.! She catches the eye of the most handsome man that will do anything to protect her and love her..wish we all could find someone like that..lol. but anyways back to the book. I am glad that I read this and cant wait for the rest of the"juniper Grove" books. Very good writing here because you really feel the heat and emotions as they happen in the stroy...thanks for writing this Jaidis and waiting for more !

When I first read the blurb for this,I was hooked and preordered it right away. I got it yesterday and read it all in the same night. I loved it. The chemistry between the single mom and her teenage daughter is so well written....love that this young single mom has the courage to raise her daughter on her own,in a fairly new place she inherits from her uncle..no job,and lots of challenges..and having a large,dark haired,sexy sheriff as a neighbor,just makes it a little harder,especially since she knows dating him will lead to trouble. Lol...and becoming a P.I. with no experience what so ever,well that just adds to the excitement.. great characters,fantastic writing,and can't wait for the next book...definitely recommend that you read this fun book...yeah,and btw, Hunter is MY book boyfriend,lol

This is by far my favorite book in this series to date! I love the adventures that Lilly is thrown into. there are not as many characters to keep track of and is much easier for me to follow. In this storyline there is a lot of mystery and some "catch your breath" moments. I certainly recommend this book for all mystery lovers! !!

well this one took the series to the top! there are new characters introduced in this book,and they are all so different..but they are all important to the storyline. Juliette really knocked this one out of the park. I really enjoy this series, good job..now,on to the next book..you should really get this series and join me on this adventure.
Loved this book. It was suspenseful,you never know what is coming on the next page.looking forward to the next books.! have read a few of this authors books now and have really liked all of them !

I read this book from a collection of stories called "haunted house mysteries" . At first I thought all the stories were going to be scary or gory...but I was so wrong... the ones I have read so far are cozy mysteries,which I love!!!  This particular story is such a fun read. A single mom and her daughter move into a beautiful old Victorian home in a new town. This is where they meet a long lost aunt,and find out that they are all witches! and to top it off the handsome sexy neighbor is a wolf shifter. This story is so full of fun with the lead character,who has a wonderful and snarky relationship with her teenage daughter. I have never read any other books from this author,this was the first,but it won't be the last one. I am so glad that I found this author.

This is the first cozy mystery that I have read that didn't have a ghost or a witch in it,and I still loved it.  It is a story about 2 elderly women who live in a small town,the kind where everyone knows everyone,and who is doing who..Lol  but even in a small town,there can be big city crime. Awhile ago,there was a very gruesome rape and murder in the mansion that is now a bed and breakfast/hotel. The killer was never caught,but the townspeople had their suspicions about the handyman who worked for the victims,thinking he was the guilty one,and that the crooked sheriff was protecting him.  One day,the granddaughter of one of the elderly women just disappeared and was never found and there were no clues to what happened to her...then one year later,another girl goes missing. The 2 elderly women,one who is a feisty gun toting lady (Eleanor),and her best friend Aggie,the 72 yr old who is thinking about sex again, begin to ask questions and start an investigation into what happened to the 2 girls and who is behind it all. This is their story...they are funny,they fight,and now they kill...read this book and join them in their escapades,and laugh with and at them, as they go on their journey ..you won't regret it,and you will do as I did and get all the books in this series,to continue the adventure...

If I ever needed some investigating done, I would want Agnes and Eleanor on the case.these two senior sleuth bff' s are the best.they look outside of the box,and prove,what may look obvious,might just not be what you see...When Agnes marries her love Andrew, and Eleanor marries Mr. Wilson,they both embark on a honeymoon cruise together...and as everyone knows,trouble follows these 2 ladies,and even some dead bodies ..well more often than not,lol and just because it's their honeymoon,it doesn't stop someone from getting killed on the ship. Malcolm,the stiff,is a rising gun singers manager and very close friend. She put all her trust into this man..why not? After all,he has her best interest at heart....or did he? She hires 're duo to investigate the murder,and as the suspect list grows,they keep hearing what a nice guy Malcolm was,...who would want to kill him? Even for a time,Agnes and Eleanor wonder too...until they put some pieces together..even the cops couldn't do that..this is a fun read,with a nice "who done it?" Plot...fun happenings with Andrew and Mr Wilson learning how to control his new motorized scooter...good laughs,as usual from this author.

This is a wonderful story set in a beautiful Hawaiian resort. When Gaby needs a change in her life, she decides to move from the cold windy city of Chicago to the tropical warmth, white sands and crystal clear blue waters...how can anything bad happen? Feeling confident about the move, she opens a travel agency at the Aloha Lagoon Resort,knowing how hard starting a new business can be. She gets a good feeling when an attorney books some ideas for a large family who he works for...thinking this is a great start. While on an outing, this attorney gets killed...is it an accident or is it murder ? Thus the mystery begins and secrets come out. As the story progresses,there are more suspects. Gaby doesn't have time to wait for the police to investigate so she becomes partners in crime with the sexy helicopter pilot Rick Dawson. Together they begin the journey to get answers and save Gabys business. I really liked how the characters come together to help her. This is a very good story that I recommend to all mystery lovers .

users.query: Andy Stanley explains how guardrails keep you from going over the "cliffs" in life... Instead of getting as close to the edge of danger as you can, go only to your "guardrail".  Applies to everyday life and is an invigorating concept. Helps with your life, and your kids life. Andy is entertaining and amusing while being one of my favorite "life changers"!

cands.text:
My review can't do this justice. Christopher Greyson is a first rate author. What Grisham teaches us about lawyers, Greyson does as perfectly about cops. Can't wait to get into Jack Knifed.
Read this. It's superb.

...is the only way we can fight our battles. Artist Jackson Linder lives this out, with the knowledge he cannot accumulate tomorrow's victory today. A sobering thought. Temptation overwhelms him, yet it dissipates with a whispered prayer. Another inspired book by Raney. Encouraging and genuine!

If the characters could speak to us, whatever they started to say, it would end with the quote above. I so enjoyed this story. It was even educational regarding the troubles in Ireland. A very interesting group of travelers from all over America, prepay for a guided tour of Ireland.  A delightful read without profanity or graphic sex. The relationships formed were fascinating and some very unpredictable. Genuinely sad pasts were revealed, and realistically progressed toward healing. The tour driver, local Irishman, Conor, was proficient at handling all types of personalities. No one was so far fetched as to be unbelievable. But some were definitely irritating people, which made the story all the better. Music, pubs, tea and scones, families and singles, gave this the unique Irish flavor I love!  Truly sorry to see this story end. Not one dull moment. Fabulous.

We are very pleased with this product. We haven't used the shock button but there has been great results with our wild rescue poodle. He attacked anyone near him. Within two days, he started changing. He has become calmer and walking him is now a pleasure. The sound and vibration buttons have worked to rein in his viciousness. He is becoming so much happier as he learns he has nothing to fear. It took having the collar to settle him as people passed by. He is a happier dog and so are we. We didn't want his training to be punitive in anyway and it hasn't been. If you're hesitant for any reason, I would encourage you to purchase the Lobo Collar. It's been a superb training tool.

What a great read. Historically accurate about the rough drought time of the 30's, which changed many lives. Bringing families out of Kansas and Oklahoma, to lead new lives in California. My grandparents did this so it was especially nice to read such detail of the mixed feelings leaving brought. To some hopefulness and sorrow to others.
The characters were realistic and varied. It was a time of people striving for greater morality and self control, and yet people were flawed. I wish this was as long as Gone With the Wind. There is so much depth and richness in each character to elaborate upon. But the she's the writer and I'm not, so probably this is ending is perfectly timed.
I will read anything and everything this author writes.
A great piece of history. Remembered it from childhood. Did not disappoint at all. Superbly written and acted.

Really intriguing story of a retired FBI agent on the investigation following President Kennedy's assignation, and his now grown daughter, a successful federal prosecutor, trying to right the wrongs leading to the accused gunman's rapidly approaching execution after fifty years incarceration. I usually write too much. Suffice it to say, this is superb in every way. I didn't put it down. Lis Wiehl is a magnificent story teller. MUST READ!!

I'm not a romance novel fan. This is not a sappy fairy tale. It's a meaningful story, plausible in today's world of social media which can leave a sense of "no place to hide" when you're in a dangerous relationship. Refreshingly hopeful, Raney guides Maggie into the arms of the Giver of true Hope. Truly lovely!

My heart was deeply touched by Alan's story. Having a father much like his (sans the physical abuse) is very difficult to convey to others who have been loved by their fathers. I appreciate how grueling this must have been to write. It's quite an accomplishment to have completely forgiven such brutalizations as his father committed. To me, Alan accurately shares the horror of a young child who cannot know what will keep him safe. I think it will prove to be just as the author hoped, a rejection of this behavior becoming acceptable. I agree with the conclusion of his father being mentally ill. I hope one day to be at peace with the reality of accepting that my abuser was/is mentally ill, and the responsibility is not mine. God bless you, dear Alan. You've done a good job.

Dan Walsh is a superb story teller. One of those writers so good I stay awake reading till I can't anymore. He can write about multiple eras with equal ease and authenticity. Love this book. Love this author.
Really funny. Danny DeVito at his disgusting best! The nightmare you never expect when you find your birth parents. We loved it.

This second book in the series is every bit as interesting as the first. This was so very touching and beautifully written. Not sappy. Never corny. But deeply moving with lots of adventure. I particularly like the few parts written from the dogs perspective. His thoughts, basically recognizing key names and words, were also fun to read. I can't handle any abusive innuendoes, and there are NONE in this wonderful story that brought me happy tears! I hope you read it.

Great story teller. I loved Call the Midwife so this title grabbed my attention. Though entirely different in that this nurse has a family and chose the adventure of living in rugged, primitive and extremely harsh conditions, she tells a interesting, vividly descriptive story. The true characters in this book are simply intriguing. I loved it. Sadly ends too soon. What a courageous and heroic woman this nurse was. Sure hope there is a sequel.
I don't read books with this much profanity. My favorite genre, but sadly misses the finesse of expression without stooping to swearing to give impact.
Couldn't get into this. Great title. Too much swearing for me.

We have a Lobo collar for contact with people training. This collar is used when we have to crate our dog and leave him home. Continuous barking when we're out just wasn't an option with apartment living. This collar has solved that problem. And our dog is much happier by not working himself into a frenzy when left alone. He sleeps calmly and is content when we return home. An absolutely simple way to make your life and your pets life easier.
Subtle wit, interesting plot, good dialogue. I can't do him justice, but this is an author you must follow. I'm in love.

There was not one slow or boring moment in this extremely entertaining book. Though my beliefs are nothing like hers, I think the author has an uncanny ability to beautifully weave a vivid tapestry of colorful characters with definite personality traits. They were all believable. Great story.

DC Smith is a brilliant detective, who has no problem letting the bad guys underestimate him. Still very much in the game, he's near retirement age. Yet with new technology and procedures, he's able to discern a great deal from his vast experience. Superb mystery writing, with subtle humor. There's plenty to savor - glimpses of life in Britain, good food, lovely gardens, beautiful scenery. Treat yourself to a very enjoyable read.
My ten pound poodle lived this but had the rope separated from the ball within the first day. Recommend a different design. May as well just buy a tennis ball. Though he likes chewing the rope.

This is absolutely the BEST decaf espresso coffee ever!  Previously we used world market's  Italian roast. They had a radical price increase, so we tried this. A forever choice for us! Superb! Strong! Great buy. Could not be more pleased.
Hoping for a funny take on The Godfather. Pathetic attempt. Juvenile humor. Jackie Chan style humor would have made a great difference.  Could not get past ten minutes...and we tried!
Fun movie. Loved the music and era. Thanks Clint Eastwood

users.query: Roberta's books are always great reads. I always recommend her books if you like historical fiction with accuracy, humor, detail and a good love story. Be prepared for the reality of the times, though, she doesn't pretty them up, which just makes it more real.

cands.text: I've loved Deanna Raybourn's books since I read the first Lady Julia Grey book - Silent In The Grave. The Veronica Speedwell books are just as much fun. The stories are filled with interesting characters and situations. A good mystery and a very entertaining read. I recommend reading these two books in order, starting with A Curious Beginning. I pre-order any new books by Deanna.

I'm never disappointed by a Nora Roberts book. Her characters are complete and likeable. There's always some humor which is a requirement for any books I read. The suspense is good. Alice's story is well written and so tragic. Bodine and Callen's romance is a good one, as is the other romance in the book. I love the Montana setting on a western resort and working ranch. Enjoy!
I have read several of this author's books and have enoyed them all. If you like Jennifer Crusie I think you will like Lani Diane Rich.
I love this series. Good mysteries, fun characters, some light humor. I love the historical setting. I look forward to more books about Dr Benjamin Bones.
I've always liked Sandra Brown's books but had gotten away from them but i'm back now - reading new ones and rereading old ones. This one did not disappoint me in any way.

I've read them all now and can hardly wait for #20. If you like unique but believable characters and a fun mystery, these are great books. Start with Cocaine Blues and read them all. I love the 1920's Melbourne Australia setting. Phryne is a free-spirited lady with compassion and wit, though she has little patience for those who cross her.

Another fun read from Ann Charles. I love the characters even the ones I love to hate! Pretty much everyone is a bubble off a plum - it just makes for a funnier book. I'm so happy my mom is not like Deborah! Mystery, humor, love and sex a fun series. Don't be afraid to buy an Ann Charles book - any of em - but read them in order for more fun!

Another fun read from Ann Charles. I love the characters even the ones I love to hate! Pretty much everyone is a bubble off a plum - it just makes for a funnier book. I'm so happy my mom is not like Deborah! Mystery, humor, love and sex a fun series. Don't be afraid to buy an Ann Charles book - any of em - but read them in order for more fun!
I love these books. The characters are well drawn, the book catches your interest right away! I love everything I've read by Barbara Hambly!

Woo-hoo!! Another Ann Charles book! Even better the beginning of a new series! If you haven't read any of Ann's books this is a good one to start with. These are funny, sexy and a great mystery too. This one is set in the jungle - an archeological dig in a Mayan temple. I loved the Mayan background. Ann's characters are always fun and I love they're connected to her other series. The hero, Quint, is The brother of Claire - the star of the Deadwood series - the start of my love for Ann's stories. I really like that Angelica - the star of thes book - is an archaeologist. I foresee more fun books in exotic locales. Keep writing them Ann - I'll keep buying!!

This is a fun book, like all of the Robyn Carr books I've read. Real life situations, humor, happy endings. Just the kind of book I enjoy most. In this book, Charlene has a series of things happen with her mother, daughter and ex-husband that cause her to tell her steady boyfriend, let's get married. Then with so much going on in her life, she's unable to really plan this wedding - or is it that she doesn't really want to marry Dennis? There are several stories going on with the characters, something that I also enjoy. Fun book - read it!
Loved all four books! Read one after the other and they're all different and they all made me laugh. I read everything I see by Jennifer Crusie!

I love the Amelia Peabody books. The characters are real and fun. The stories are great mysteries with lots of humor. This one, set in Egypt in 1874 - 1875, introduces us to Amelia a determined, unorthodox English gentlewoman; her companion, Evelyn; and the Emerson brothers, Radcliffe and Walter, who are archaeologists. Amelia quickly falls in love with the pyramids and proceeds to drive Radcliffe (known as Emerson) crazy. They are two peas in a pod. Read this if you like mysteries with humor. In fact, read anything by Elizabeth Peters. I've never been disappointed!

I love the Amelia Peabody books. The characters are real and fun. The stories are great mysteries with lots of humor. This one, set in Egypt in 1874 - 1875, introduces us to Amelia a determined, unorthodox English gentlewoman; her companion, Evelyn; and the Emerson brothers, Radcliffe and Walter, who are archaeologists. Amelia quickly falls in love with the pyramids and proceeds to drive Radcliffe (known as Emerson) crazy. They are two peas in a pod. Read this if you like mysteries with humor. In fact, read anything by Elizabeth Peters. I've never been disappointed!

Another fun read! I love the characters Nora creates. The secondary characters add so much to the stories. I always pre-order Nora's books and I'm never disappointed. There's mystery, humor, feel-good moments - they make me laugh and cry. If you've never read Nora - start with this one.

Such a fun series.if you like humor, mysteries and sex, you'll like this series. In fact, you'll like all of Ann Charles books. Boot Points is a good taste of the series but please start with the first one to really enjoy these books
this is one of Jennie's first, maybe not her best, but a taste of what is to come... I've never been disappointed in a Crusie book. The other two books were fun reads also.

This is the first book by Robyn Carr that I read. I absolutely love this book. Four very different women brought together by writing. They all have different issues. They are brought together one summer after their dear friend Gabby dies. Elly is given the task of going through Gabby's writings and photographs so she moves into Gabby's house on Olive Street. One by one the other women join her as their lives implode in different ways. This is the story of how they learn who they really are and what they are worth as women. It's a beautiful story of friendship.
I really enjoyed this book. Maggie is a feisty, smart p.i.. there's humor and excitement in this story and a good mystery. I'm definitely going to continue with this series.

I don't normally choose books set in Africa but when the author is Deanna Raybourn I grab it and growl. I enjoyed this story very much. I met Delilah in the novella - Whisper of Jasmine. I was glad to read about her further. Delilah has caused a scandal - again- and is sent to Africa, Kenya to be exact, until it blows over. The descriptions of Kenya, the people, the animals helped me understand why people would fall in love with Africa. Great story.
love this t-shirt and so does the guy I gave it to. It is as described and fits well

I very much enjoyed this story, really two stories. Carrie is a successful author of historical novels. She is drawn to Scotland to write a book about the failed attempt of King James to recover the Scottish throne in 1708. The story takes on a life of its own and you are reading Sophia's story in 1708 and then Carrie's. Many of the things she writes she later find to have been true, such as the actual layout of the castle even though it's a roofless ruin in present day. She thinks she has named the characters and later find out they were real people. The concept that Carrie has inherited memories through DNA makes for a wonderful story. This is a book of two good love stories.
I'm very satisfied with my paperwhite case. It's just as advertised, fits my paperwhite like a glove. The company is very easy to work with.

This is a good, interesting story set in England during the early years of WWII. You get a sense of what the English people were going through in the country and of the great efforts put in by people working undercover. A paratrooper's body is found on the Farleigh estate, his chute failed to open and he is unrecognizable. It is quickly determined that his uniform is not quite right and he's most probably a German spy sent to make contact with sympathizers in the area - just who are they and what are their plans? I very much enjoyed this book.

users.query: Great knife, seems to be well built, and was fairly sharp even upon receipt.  I like it.

cands.text: Great knife, seems to be well built, and was fairly sharp even upon receipt.  I like it.

This thing is great, cuts smoothly, and leaves you with exactly what it was meant to be. A lot of cut paper all at once.

The blade safety latch could be stronger as ours broke, but it is away from prying hands. So not an issue for us.

Awesome scissors.  There just comes a day when you say to yourself, why did I not buy a better pair of scissors long ago.
That is what my girlfriend says now.  We will no longer waste our money on cheap scissors.  Kai, or nothing.
Excellent belt.  I just started wearing a belt recently as I never really needed one.  It isn't overly stiff, which is nice.  Provides a nice stable platform, but allows for movement.
This is the purse I got to complete the set for the wallet for my GF.  Sh absolutely loves it.  It feels good, and is made very well.  Definitely a keeper.
This thing is deadly accurate, and has a good amount of penetration power.  I have been extremely pleased with this so far.

This is the best tablet I have owned.  I moved from an iPad, to this and I haven't been disappointed.  It is quick, snappy, and operates without any flaws.  The only gripe I can come up with is that the Touchscreen is sensitive when you don't want it to be.  This would be alleviated with a digitizer stylus, but I can't find it anywhere.

So far this case has been outstanding.  There really is nothing we can complain about for this one.  It does what its supposed to, looks great, the color is outstanding and the quality has been excellent with the covered buttons that are easy to press, and give good feedback without putting too much pressure on the buttons on the ipad.  Highly recommended.

This was a great deal.  Wish it would have come with bigger batteries, but I found them for cheap on Ebay.  I picked this up for less than $60 on a lightning deal.  The drill isn't great, but you know, it gets the job done.

So, even though I sourced this via Costco, I thought I would write a review.  The sound is very good for something this size.  Has great bass, midst could use work, and highs get a little hiss, but at the listening levels 95% of the time, it just sounds good.  Wish battery life was a bit better, but that is nitpicking for the sound you get.

One thing that would be nice is a portable battery box to extend life of the speaker for those long beach days.

It works very well for my purpose.  I can carry most things are there are many pockets for whatever I do require carrying.  Pockets are all different sizes, and the back is really tough.  Very impressed with it.  Highly recomended.

So far this router has been amazing.  It has decent range, and allows a lot more devices to be connected.  No more dropped connections in this house.

First things first, I went from a single N band router, to this.  This allows so much more flexibility in the way I can connect devices. I got rid of cable over a year ago, and we just stream everything that we want to watch.  The old router would stutter, and kick devices off if we were streaming.  This router, never had an issue, even with 27 devices connected.

Range is the only fault I can really give it, but I switch to 2.4 if I need a little more range.  The 5ghz transmitter seems a little weak, but it still covers my whole house, including the garage.

The firmware and GUI is very good, but is limited.  For a basic user that just wants a router that works, and requires minimal work, this thing is perfect.  I wish this had at least an option for the transmit power so I could jack it up a few mW.

All in all, this is an excellent router that gives good features like external media, prioritization, MAC address blocking, website restriction, parental controls, etc.
This works right out of the box, very simple.  Name it, and start connecting.  I highly recommend for the ease of use and functionality at this price ($160).

Had this for quite a while.  However, the fence has broken on it.  I am hoping I can find a replacement, but having trouble locating one.  It lasted 2 years, and needed a brush change, but it worked well up to the fence breaking.

I have the other kreg jig with the bigger guide and bit.  This one is prefect for thinner wood, and can really limit the impact the pocket hole has on the appearance of the final product.  Still the same hold, with a smaller screw.

Great phone for just a basic home phone.  I use this in conjunction with an Obi200 to have VoIP service as I just can't see myself paying $15 a month for phone.  It works great, and the voice is nice and clear, the ringer is plenty loud.  We only needed a basic handset and this was perfect.
Just like the kreg drill bits.  I think these are even a little smoother.

This is a great popcorn maker for a smaller family or even a single person.  I highly recommend it as we use it for our front room which is being turned into a multipurpose home theater.  It is great because it brings movie popcorn to home.  No more craving popcorn, just got to get up and make it.  True kettlecorn taste.
Same quality as the more expensive sanders, without the premium price.  I have grown to like the Wen products.  They good quality, and operate just like all the other gear out there.

Best faucet I have ever owned hands down.  It feels solid.  My only gripe is the way that the faucet sinches down to the sink.  I wish there was more contact area to make the installation a little more solid.

So far loving this grill.  Burgers that come off this are the best tasting burgers we have ever eaten.  I would try and avoid using it for more than an hour everyday, it pulls 1.5 kw from a socket.  Make sure nothing else is on the circuit.

So far so good.  This mattress is a lot stiffer than our old memory foam mattress.  But it is still soft when you are laying on it.  The honeycomb matrix on top of the mattress really is soft and supple, but very supportive at the same time.  My back is sore a little, but it is because I am adjusting to it is all.  I wake feeling very refreshed every morning, and the soreness is gone within a couple of minutes.

Not only is it soft yet supportive, it is actually very cool feeling.  I am a sweaty mess when I sleep, and living in Hawaii doesn't help that.  The material that this is made of is cool to the touch, and doesn't trap heat in like my old mattress.  I used to sweat and sweat on that mattress.  The true test will come this summer when it is humid and hot, but so far, this is the coolest mattress I have ever slept on.

I would love to try one of the pillows out to see what it is like, but I can't justify an expense like that right now.  Maybe later on.  I enjoy a good pillow, and this material really has me curious of how it sleeps as I have a thick neck, and a heavy head.

I use it to light up our main bathroom.  It does very well and uses so little power that we have started just leaving it on during the night to have some light for the kids.  I like the cold white, I like the brightness, and I like the way it illuminates the room.

These are absolutely perfect.  They are larger, which is great for my 17 inch laptop.  They also have small ventilation holes on the bottom so that the system can breathe.  Also great for eating, love them.

users.query: I started with this book in the series and found it easy to follow. Going back to read the first two books now. The story and characters are well developed with a great storyline, twists, drama, betrayal, love and hot love scenes. It's an erotica love novel and thing move fast.

cands.text: This story has action, drama, suspense, mystery, friendship  and love all wrapped into one. The story and characters developed throughout the book. I throughly enjoyed this book and love this author. Can't wait for more in this series.

As I was looking for another book to read. Now I have another great Author to follow. Yes I started the series with book 4 BUT will be reading the rest. I wasn't lost with the characters by starting with this book. The storyline and characters developed nicely, held my interest throughtout, and read this in a day. There's love, romance, suspense drama, mystery, domestic violence (non descriptive), family, trust, murder and  HEA. Must read and you'll be hooked not only with a new series but a great Author.
This book didn't develop  for me, not alot of background information. But an introduction to a new series that I believe will be starting.
This book is the first in the series and is absolutely wonderful. It really takes where you are right there with the characters.
This book was laid out well. The characters were well developed with a great story. It had love, drama, humor, friendship and a contract. Must read

This story was awesome. Characters developed nicely. The storyline was suspenseful,  humorous, loving, loyality and held up with family  ties. Held my interest from cover to cover. It was a super weekend read for me. Can't wait for the next book. I won an ebook of my choice from this Author.

This story was awesome. Characters developed nicely. The storyline was suspenseful,  humorous, loving, loyality and held up with family  ties. Held my interest from cover to cover. It was a super weekend read for me. Can't wait for the next book. I won an ebook of my choice from this Author.

This is my first book by this author and won't be my last.  Its a good story, moves along nicely and the 2 main characters have chemistry. The story line is believable and it kept me engaged with the story. I couldn't wait to see what was going to happen.

What an awesome story. From the humor, to the suspense I was hooked. Although this is part of a series I started with this book and was able to keep up with the storyline and the characters. I'm purchasing book 1 now.

This book was a gentle read and love story. Good clean romance to read for an afternoon. Was hoping that another/sequel would come out with 2 of the characters that played an important part of the story. Will read other of her books
Awesome book wish this series would be continued. Impulse buy and glad I bought it.love story with a twist of mystery.

I enjoyed the book with all of the emotions , twists and turns that happened. It's a nice weekend book for someone to read. After reading the other reviews it sounds like their was a previous book prior that introduced these characters and this was a "follow up". I did not read any previous books and kept up with the story line quite well. So I would say it is a stand alone.

Sierra is a successful independent woman, who has come into her own. Boone is an army medic, who has thrown chance to the wind to volunteer at the Phoenix VA. He does so hoping that he can reconnect with the only person who's has shown him love. He is determined as he she is stubborn, to reconnect with her.
I received an ARC for an honest review

I won a copy of this book in a contest from the Author. I am glad I did this book was awesome. Characters developed, suspense, love, drama, and trust made this an awesome story. I can't wait to  read more from her.

I have become an avid reader of historical romances mostly mail order brides. Although this book is set in the same era, it is based more in a larger town than my previous reads.  I must say this book had and kept my interest from start to finish. It had romance, mystery, twists and frienship. This is a nice read and worth the time and money.

I enjoy this author her writing and story telling is wonderful. Although this book can be read as a stand alone, I strongly urge you to read the other two books. The characters float in and out of them which enhances the storyline.
This books/series is absolutely wonderful,  Strongly recommend this book and series

The dynamics were different for me in this book. I missed the drama and suspense that was involved with the others. This is book 7 so the characters were developed,  the storyline predictable. But was about young love mixed in all their family members. Nice read just different for me.

I am just starting this series and am looking forward to see the other characters and their stories. This was an enjoyable fast light read for me. Sometimes reading these books it is hard to imagine their way of life back then. The Author did a wonderful job keeping us in the era.

that is the beginning of a decent series. The first couple chapters gives you quite a bit of background information, although helpful felt it was a little much. Loved the strength Aimee. She makes you laugh with her smart mouth and sense of humor.

This is a must read book from the Moroad MC Series., with some great twists. This is the first book that I have read from Debra Kayn and I loved it! This story has many layers and twists.  I plan to catch up on the series; Thank you for the great read.

This was an awesome storyline with the characters developing nicely. There was humor mixed with alot of heartache. The thing that bothered me about this book was with new beginnings the Author changed the heroine name from Amelia to Amy. That would have been fine except I didn't care that both names were used the rest of the book. But that's on me. Nice read
This was not for me. I didn't care  for the storyline, lack of character development, or the authors writing style.  Not every person has the same tastes in books.

The author leave us with 2 unsolved murders, a brother in jail, and another brother on his way to sobriety. Its told in a 3rd person, lack of interaction with characters. Bought the 8 pack of books thinking it was a series. Nope returning it.
I can't read a book where there's minimal communication between the characters. If you can then this book is for you, great story line, characters develop nicely, and it's a tear jerker.

users.query:
Needed to get a new container, as our old container used to get ants, moths and other pest inside the food...some people will say it's not a problem, but we'd prefer our dogs to not eat that nor bring that inside.

(+):  Most durable container I've used, easily keeps bugs and pests out, includes a 1 cup food scooper, easy to maneuver with built-in handle cutouts, small foot print and large capacity.

(-):  Doesn't quite hold 50lbs. of food, but I'm sure it's dependent on the kibble volume.  We have 2 small breeds of dogs and 40lbs. of food fills this up to about 95% capacity.  Minus 1-star for the inaccurate weight report.

Highly recommend and well worth the cost!

cands.text:
(+):  Small kibble size is great for smaller breeds; our 2 Chihuahuas love it!  Food seems very fresh (almost moist) and one of the only foods we've purchased that they actually acted like they wanted to eat.  Over the last month, we've noticed less plaque buildup on the teeth, so that's a huge plus.  Their stool size has dramatically decreased, which means they're absorbing more of the nutrients and less byproduct/filler is going to waste.  This food is half the price of Blue Buffalo and it seems to be better all-around.

(-):  None

Highly recommended!  No problems and our dogs love it!

Super high quality, especially for the price.  These containers are great for lunches on the go, or for meal planning.  Dishwasher and microwave safe, you really can't go wrong.  It's also great for people who don't like all their food mixed in together.  And when they wear out and/or break, we'll buy more.  For the price, they will easily pay for themselves.  I also like how I can toss my lunch into a backpack or my briefcase and not have to worry about it spilling.  The lid seals tight and the container is thin enough to fit into nearly anything.

Every time somebody sees these, they always ask: "Where did you get those?"  They're great and we use them every day!

(+):  Amazingly durable, keeps items fresh inside each compartment, everyone will be asking you where you got this item.

(-):  Difficult for even adults to sometimes open.  The seals are very good, but it can be extremely difficult to pull open.

This drawer holds 32 pods and is basically a no-frills drawer.  Looks nice and the finish is not quite a matte black, but more of a black eggshell type finish.  No major complaints.

I'm deducting 1 star because when you have the drawer filled with 32 pods, the ones in the back seem to get stuck or catch underneath for whatever reason.  I can't seem to figure it out.  My best guess is because each row holds 8 pods, but it has room for 8 3/4 of a pod.  It allows too much movement of the pods when opening and closing and they flip up into each other.  Small compliant, but worth mentioning.

Our 15 month old daughter loves this toy.  It's probably one of her favorite bath toys!  That alone is a huge plus for us!

I noticed some complaints about mold growth, but we've had it for several months now and it is doing great.  When she's done in the bath, I just leave the fishing string extended so it can air dry.  I can see some problems presenting themselves if you leave the string retracted, as it may never dry between baths.

Highly recommended!

By far the better option over the typical space saver bags.  These are durable, easy to use and come in a wide variety of sizes.  The best part is that most of the bags are the larger size, so you're not stuck with several "leftover" gallon-sized Ziploc bags like the competitors.

We're currently using ours to store all the baby items and clothes, just in case we have another girl.  We've compiled an entire closet's worth, probably more, in just a small plastic bin.  This is a huge space saver and it's amazing quality!

Highly recommend these bags!  Can't say enough about them!

Absolutely the best fogger I've used.  The price also can't be beat; around $2-3 cheaper than Lowes, Home Depot and Wal-Mart.

(+):  Easy to use, non-chemical scent, leaves ZERO residue behind, dense and deep reaching fog.  Had a infestation of pantry moths in the garage (contaminated) dog food and this wiped them all out the first time.

(-):  None

Highly recommended!  Purchase this 3-count kit and be done with the pests!  I originally bought 2 boxes, thinking I'd need the 2nd, as I've done before, but now I have an extra on hand.

It's okay...
Pros:  It froths almond milk, 2% and half and half quite well.  Compact design and feels quite powerful.
Cons:  Cheap plastic construction.  Upon removing it from the packaging, the chrome finish is already wearing off in places.  I don't expect it to last long; will probably have a dull gray unit after a few uses.

Dum Dums are the classic candy to have on your desk or for a simple treat.

(+):  They're Dum Dums!  Everyone loves them!  This bag offers an exceptional value and has a great mix of flavors.  They're only 20 calories a pop so it's easy to not feel guilty.  Also, if you compare them to other suckers on the market, these are very basic in their ingredients, which is a huge plus as well.

(-):  Deducting 1 star for two reasons... Several of the wrappers are very loosely wrapped, which means whoever grabs it will probably discard it.  In my bag of 300, there were about 4 pops that were completely unwrapped, as the wrapper fell off in transit.  The other issue is that my bag has more bubble gum and strawberry milkshake flavors than all the others.  Not a huge problem, but just noting.

Highly recommended!

Disappointing shaker bottle that probably should be returned, but not worth the hassle.

(+):  Great price, lid doesn't leak when sealed properly, mixer 'jack' works better than most spring balls (no clogging or clumping)

(-):  Upon opening the bottle, it reeked of a chemically/plastic-y smell that I haven't been able to fully get rid of.  Letting it soak in hot dish water overnight drastically helped, but it still lingers.  The bottle is advertised at 28oz, but it's really 24/25oz.  I definitely cannot get 28oz in here.  Questionable durability as the plastic seems pretty cheap, especially on the handle.

Overall, I can't recommend this bottle.  While the price and design are tempting, it falls short of nearly every other shaker bottle on the market.

These are great package bags, which rival the eBags units.  I would actually say that they're of higher quality than eBags and of course, as an Amazon product, offered at a much more competitive price.

As a frequent flyer, these bags help organize my duffel and also allow me to organize my items by event/day/week/etc.  They're great when I'm going to multiple destinations and just need to toss a bag into my backpack or laptop bag.

No complaints with the bags, though I deducted 1 star because of the potent plastic-y/burnt rubber smell upon opening.  A quick wash in the washing machine resolved the issue, but it was a little disappointing that they had some odor to them.  Overall, recommended!

I'll keep this review short...

This gas can is leaps and bounds better than all the environmentally sensitive cans you see on the market now.  I understand the need to limit the amount of fuel spilled, but they're actually counterintuitive!  I spill fuel all the time with those plastic, gimmicky latches and get extremely frustrated.

This can works as expected and as it should.  I haven't spilled any fuel either.  Additionally, while it's a 5 gallon can, you can get about 6 gallons in it.
