So far, these are doing great! The last ones were the original, I think, and their time was up. These are easy to bang out the dirt and seem to hold lots of it! They're not the strongest material, but have been holding up to weekly banging off the dust & dirt. I haven't tried washing them, but I don't see any reason they wouldn't hold up. Fairly well made and a good price!
No issues. They work great, so far. reasonably priced also.
These are not very good and I couldn't wait to replace them! They left streaks since day one...I'm glad they're finally gone! PIAA make some good ones - of course, they're much more expensive!

They fit well. Seem like they'd give basic protection, nothing more. a little pricey. I have small hands and these fit well.

6/3/17 Update: Well, I now rated these a 1 star. The fit got worse and they are too big. Also the left hand glove is falling apart and has holes in it. the right is holding up a little better - which is weird since I'm right handed. I would not recommend these...

See the pictures. I've used them 3 times for cutting wood / branches and 2 times to put branches into a chipper. No excessive force or anything - I wasn't ripping trees down with my gloved hands. These are now useless.

Time to look for something that actually holds up

I know they make Insane sauce also, as I have it! This stuff is HOT!! I use ghost peppers in cooking also, but this stuff will blister your fingers! I can only use a dot - not a drop - a dot! ;) If you like hot, with flavor, this stuff is it!!! Use with moderation! :) There are cautions all over the bottle!

OK, these are not that bad, however, they are not the best quality and I recommend A-Zoom Precision Snap Caps. They are more expensive, but really worth the difference! The MTMs are hollow and flimsy and chip easily. You get what you pay for.

Very good! We use 1/2 cube in a cup of hot water for a tasty broth. It's a little salty, so a little more water helps. We also use the cubes when cooking. It's a little pricey, but you get a lot of cubes for the $$
no complaints! it taste fine, cooks up well. It's a lot of oil, but can't beat it for the price and that it's organic!
Good jars. I've been canning for a while and only once did one of these babies crack when I put it into a boiling pot of water. These are well made and large enough for any project.

Love these! This is our second one. They are thin on top and the rubber insert can be inverted to clean. I really like how they made the metal thin enough to almost sit flush with the sink basin. Thicker ones prevent the particles from going into the strainer.
Not bad. Not warm enough though. I have a small, size 7 men's foot, and these fit well. Not sure how they'll last...
I like it. It's healthy and picks up the flavor of what you're cooking fairly well. Supposed to be very healthy for you :)

I've been buying these for 2 or 3 sets now and they do really well. I don't get to the track very often, nor ride the back roads as much as I like, however, when I get in the twisties, these have very good grip! I ride lots of streets and highways and these tires hold up very well in the rain also! I recommend them

This stuff has good flavor and heat! I like hot stuff, and their Insanity sauce it HOT! I also got their Ghost pepper sauce and WOW!!! That's insane! This has a good garlic flavor and enough heat that I can put some on - not just a drop.
Good gloves. Fit my, male, smaller hands very well. Not much use yet, so can't speak about dependability.
they work well. a few pop off in the wind, but they're ok
well made but barely fit our sink. So far, they seem to work ok

Well, I've bought these before, so I "assumed" they'd be the same. However, this latest batch of 2, well, not so much. One seems OK, the other, it barely lights up in the dark, even when fully charged. Not sure what the issue is, since we like the other ones we've bought. No, we haven't contacted the manufacturer...I know, I should...

So far, so good. Easy to assemble - good instructions. Lots of power! The hose length is sufficient. I bought a pressure control part to add to it to vary the power...time will tell just how well it does.
Love Amy's products! When we ate this one, we had to grab the can and make sure it was vegetarian! Very good, not spicy at all though, but that's easily fixed. It's thick, tasty, and filling.
These are really good! I buy them by the box full and eat them almost daily :) And, they're organic! And they have a mild spice that's very flavorful.

Seems like a good product. Not super well made, but who knows if it's made in the USA. It was WAY better packed than their oilskin hat. I haven't worn it, other than try it on. I'm a 42" in jackets, but after reading comments, I ordered a Medium (I was going to order a large). I'm glad I ordered a size smaller as the medium is still a bit too big. So, order smaller than you expect!
Hopefully it will hold up in the WA rains...the hat too!

users.query: Bought these on prime day, July. It's January and I just wore through. Believe it or not, that's good for me. Nice thick material. Great pocket on the leg next to the knee. Awesome for a knife.

My husband really likes his new sweater.  It is nice and thick, and the patches are well sewn.  It's much higher quality than I expected :)  Great purchase!

My husband has fingers that get dry and crack open.  These are a great deal and really help him protect his poor fingertips :(  the fingertips are very sensitive when split open, and these greatly reduce the pain by holding the cut closed.  Before finding these, he had to wear full gloves, which could be sweaty and hot.  So nice just to cover the injured finger.  He uses extra large for his thumb.  Large for his fingers 2-4, and medium for the pinky.

I bought this for my daughter to wear on a thin necklace. She loves it and wears it often. Beautiful quality, detailed and a nice weight (not too heavy so that it hangs at the throat, and not so light that it feels cheap) beautiful. After a little over a year of use, a little piece chipped off, I contacted NINAQUEEN. They responded immediately, replaced the charm, and were really nice :) I adore a company that has good customer support. These guys stand behind the quality of their product.

I am more than happy with this case.  The leather quality is great.  It is lined on the inside, and the groove's that hold it upright work really well.  Very sturdy.  It opens easily and folds all the way back with no problem.  Very sleek.  The fire feels protected, the leather covered braces both protect and hold the fire in place.  And when I need to slip it out of the two lower braces (to set it up) it pops right out.  I couldn't be more pleased :)Beautiful product.  More than worth the price.

Bought this May of 2014 for just under $8. It has worked really well in the 3 years I have had it. (Now it's Aug 2017) Has nice deep pockets to hold the bottles of shampoo, conditioner and body wash. Dries really quickly and never molded. I finally went on a cleaning frenzy and decided to put it through the wash... Not good. Seams ripped out and metal grommets fell out. So, I am back for another! It worked so well and was nice and simple, so I am not going to shop around. Just going to repurchase. Wish it was still $8 :/ oh well... :)

I ordered these in the two nude colored styles. I bought them to use under dresses with a bralette and underwear under them. Used them for the first time yesterday and they were great! Comfortable, stayed in place.  Could use the bathroom and pull the underwear down far enough to pee just fine without taking the bodysuit off or pulling the bodysuit down. No visible lines on the dress. Just like thigh high stockings and garter belt, only they go all the way up to a tank top. I didn't see anybody else using the body suit for this purpose, so thought I would leave a review :) I won't be using it for the romance purpose... as I don't think i look very attractive in this :/ I look better with more on, lol
I do like the smaller net better, just a personal preference. The large net does however seem very sturdy and has small netting at the toes which was very thoughtful of the maker :) for reference, I am 150lbs, 5'4. Net nylons are very adaptable to different body sizes and stretch well. I'm sure these would fit somebody bigger or smaller than me just fine.

I purchased 2 adult large pairs, and a child size.  They are really solid and fit well.  My kids are thrilled.  They look like they will last for a long time.
My only complaint is that the 2 large pairs arrived in black, with pink accents.  I didn't see any indication of this when I ordered them?  Now that I look at the order page, I see the indication that they are black and pink.  Blind as a BAT :/  It is for my 2 sons, so the pink is :(
Our skates arrived in just over a week.  I did note from other reviews that some people had a long wait...so we hated to send them back and try to exchange colors.  Instead (being that there are only a few small pink accents, here and there) we took permanent red markers and the pink became red :)  It isn't wiping off, looks sharp :) The wheels are black with pink- almost purple logos....now red logos :)  Worked very well!
the quality of the skate is a 5, doesnt seem right to give it lower stars for color that I may have just not noticed when ordering?  Does seem like they could have indicated color more clearly...the picture of the skates on the order screen looks red and black to me???  The picture on the box they come in shows red and black.
 But, the product is awesome.
We are very happy!

I'm 150 lbs, 5'4 and bought medium. They fit  well but i have to agree with another reviewer who said they are just one step up from granny underwear. Pretty full coverage cut. But they look just like the picture, so can't complain.
I have taken a star away because the first time in the wash the lace on 3 pairs ran and ripped. I have VS underwear that have lace and they do great in the wash/dryer, so, the quality is not great. Bummer :/

I bought 8 c in nude color.  I usually wear a 10 in street shoes and have a wide foot.  I wear flip flops most days, but like a little slipper type shoe for dressing up :)  for years I have worn leather, split heel shoes, purchased from payless shoes.  Amazingly, they have lasted really well.  They do get wet in rain, but otherwise, dry right up and are comfy!  (I had operations on my feet as a teen, and comfort is really important for me) Only problem is I only have pink and black.  Really wanted a nude color.  Unlike my older two pairs, these bloch ballet slippers have no drawstring and are a double lined fabric shoe. They are very comfy and I love the look!  I read that other reviewers wash them when needed, and that sounds perfect for me.  I will try and update as time goes on and see how they take the abuse.  My only complaint is the sizing system.  I sure had to read reviews and look around to figure out what size to buy.  Seller should put in parentheses what street size goes with each ballet slipper size.  Shouldn't have to go through so much effort to figure out what size to purchase.

Wow. The seams are reinforced, the color rich, no sharp edges...solid. Doesn't hit at the neck, so no interference with her collar and no choking. I couldn't be more satisfied. Well worth the cost. I put it on a standard poodle service dog.

I am pregnant and bought this bra looking for something comfortable for my poor expanding rib cage :/ I'm usually 38 B but am presently 42 C. I went with extra large. It's very generously stretchy, I don't "fall out of it", it is enough of a layer to make me look like I have a bra on. There is an extra layer of thin net material at the breast area making it less shear.  It is unfortunately quite visible around the neck area, even with t-shirts. But, the visibility is worth the comfort :) I also purchased the cosabella bralette style in extra large and the bralette feels tighter in my ribcage in comparison.

Really cute. Mostly cotton and they don't stretch out. Wash well and don't shrink. My daughter loves them and looks very cute :) bought size 8/10 for my 6 1/2 year old, 55lb daughter. She generally fits in size 7/8 or medium in other stores. My 11 year old daughter is bummed they don't sell her size :) great product.
My daughter is now almost 7 1/2 years old and the underwear are too small. Bummer, being that they are size 8-10 :/ she is 50" tall and weighs 61lbs.

I bought this for my husbands vizio tablet.  It has beautiful, high quality feeling leather.  Red stitching around the edges (nice touch!) And a cool plastic fitted case to hold the tablet firmly in place.  I couldn't quite tell what held it in place, when I ordered this.  But was pleasantly surprised by how well the case worked.  Unfortunately, within a week or so, the leather began to bubble at the binding area.  I assume the glue isn't holding the leather and the liner together?  So, back it is going.  Is this a flaw in the product?  I don't know.  So, I am not going to withhold a star for it.  The product is a beautiful one.  Maybe, we got a lemon (a lemon, that needed more glue..lol)  But, to Amazons credit, they are refunding and paying for return shipment.  Unfortunately, I can't order another, because it is out of stock.  For those of you wondering...my husband was so pleased with his new case, that he didn't even fold the jacket all the way back.  Used it like a book. Open, then closed.  So, the bubbling at the binding wasn't due to abuse.  I only hope I can find him another that makes him equally happy :(  But this was too expensive to keep it with the binding separating.

Just received this in the mail yesterday and immediately had to use it!  The silicone is nice and thick.  Feels sturdy and like it will last.  I loved the ease of it.  No dishes to wash.  No counter full of flour to wipe.  Didn't even have a cookie sheet to wash from baking my bread on it.  I did use my own recipe, and it was a little too big for the Lekue Bread Maker...started to gush through the two ends when I began baking it.  So, I undid the latch and let it cook as an open bowl.  Had a circle bread instead of a loaf.  I'm thinking my next try with the Bread Maker, I will just split my loaf into 2 and do two loafs :)  My only complaint is the recipes that came with the Bread Maker.  They have the normal cup measurements and teaspoon/tablespoon measurements for most of the ingredients.  But the liquids (water and milk) are measured in ounces.  On each recipe!  I am going to have to google the ounce into cups equivalent for each recipe and write it on the recipe myself.  That's kind of a bummer :/  Complaint aside, this is going to be so nice for the winter.  Lots of soup with a fresh loaf of homemade bread :)  And the house smells SO nice!

I love nude colored net stockings. I am 5'4 and 150lbs. I went with reviews instead of the suggestion on the size chart, and bought L/XL. Fits perfect. I'm around a size 10? Really like them and am going to order a few more right now :)

These are really nice :)  Nice and thick, but they dry fast.  Happy colors.  I am replacing some non-cotton ones that spread lint more than they clean, as you wipe the table.
I do warn you...the kids splashed food onto the wall.  I took my dish cloth and scrubbed it off...evidently too hard.  The color stripes ripped right out.  It was evidently too much for it.  But, as this isn't the intent of a dish cloth, I am not docking any stars for my foolish mistake. I have had them for a few months now, and with normal use (wiping counters, kids hands and faces) they have held up great.  When they get old and icky, I will buy more again.  Nice product.

We have a large family with many electronic devices, so I have done this "screen protector" thing numerous times.  I really like the tempered glass protectors.  The TruShield Screen Protector came with a few extras, that I really liked.  First, USPS damaged the package in shipping :/  Fortunately, TruShield uses a hard plastic, very oversized package which left the screen protector in perfect condition.  Along with the glass cover, there was an alcohol wipe, a small fabric dust/smudge wiper, and a sticker for dust removal.  I've never seen a sticker in any of my other screen protector packages.  I didn't see any instructions for how to use it?  So, after using the alcohol wipe, and then the fabric to clean the screen...I took the back off the sticker.  I pressed the sticker on the screen and then pulled it off.  It left a beautiful, clean surface.  I proceeded to do the entire screen.  Awesome!  Love the dust sticker (I put it's wax backing back on and kept it :)  When we applied the glass protector, it just slid right on and adhered instantly.  Couldn't be happier!
EDIT:
We have had the screen protector on for a few days and the kids keep complaining that there are dead spots.  We checked with a paint program, and dragged our finger all over the screen.  Sure enough, there were areas where the touch screen was not responsive.  We did a hard reset to see if it helped, no go.  Then, we opened up the tablet and made sure all the ribbons/wires were plugged in properly.  Still, dead spots remained.  So, finally, decided to remove the screen protector.  Did the same test on the screen with the paint program, dragging finger all over the screen.  Perfect.  No dead spots :/
Going to have to give this only 3 stars.  I have other devices that work perfectly with a glass screen cover.  So, it may just be the Nexus 7, 2nd generation is over sensitive to screen covers?  I don't know, I'm not a techy.  But I do know that the touch screen worked poorly with the cover on, and perfectly with the cover off.  The TruShield had easy application, a nice feel, and is crystal clear...but if it affects the touch screens sensitivity...those points account for very little :/

Our family has five h107L's. Two of my kids decided they were ready to move up to the fpv version (h107d). After some reading comparing the h107d, h107d+, and the desire, we went with the simplest, the 107d. Didn't like the altitude hold on the h107d+ or the desire. Also didn't like that it took a different battery. My kids wanted the flying experience to be just like their h107L, but with the added screen. They also have lots of batteries from the multi packs we bought for their h107L, and these can be used with the h107d.
We have found that the controller eats AA batteries. I'm ordering some rechargeables right now. The screen is in color (which suprised me) and incredibly clear. When the controller gets low on batteries the screen gets glitchy, so it is pretty obvious when battery changing needs to be done.
My son really likes the camera looks straight ahead of the plane, so you can see where you are going. He returned a different brand fpv because the camera looked down instead. I assume they are for different purposes? The h107d is for zipping around and looking where you going, and the one we returned was for flying high and showing the ground beneath the plane? That's my guess?
Did not come with a prop guard, had to buy one separately. Really saves the plane and cuts down on replacing the propellers, so you definately want to buy a prop guard.
We are really happy with the h107d  (and love our h107L's as well) my kids range in age from 6 to 20 and they all fly these with... Varying skills, lol. Love hubson quadcopters :)

I ordered 2 standard covers for my outdoor chairs.  I hoped they would fit, but couldn't be sure, due to the fact that the dimensions are not given?! crazy????
My chairs are pretty square, 30 x 30 x 30. The standard cover is just a bit tight.  And doesn't quite cover the bottom of the chair.  It isn't too awful bad...but I am worried that one of the kids might sit on the seat while the cover is still on it, and rip it (it is rather tight)  So, I am returning them and ordering the tall size.  That should give a bit of room.  I sadly had to google search to find the dimensions. (I wish I had done google search before ordering the standard size :/ I relied upon another amazon review that claimed the cover was 29 x 32 x 33.  This is just not the case)
The dimensions are - STANDARD 28.5"L X 25.5"W X 26"H.  I will update when I receive the tall covers, and will put the dimensions here on my review.  When I googled the dimensions of the tall, I found a few different sizes, so I guess we will see? A bit of a pain, but Amazon was easy with the return and the quality of the cover appears to be exceptional.  Just wish they had the dimensions on site amazon :/ oh well...
UPDATE:
Okay.  Got the new tall covers and they are perfect.  Funny, I was searching for the dimensions to put on the review, and only one of my 2 boxes gave the dimensions.
HIGH BACK PATIO CHAIR COVER 32.5"L x 25.5"W x 34"  H
They are quite a bit roomier.  Fit my 30 x 30 x 30 chairs perfect (not tight, not ridiculously baggy.  I'm really happy with them.

I ordered two sizes of this outfit for my 2 week old baby. Bought 3-6 months and 6-9 month. There is VERY little difference, if any, in size. I put it on the baby today, and it's a little big, but not bad. Not going to fit him long, but very cute and I love it :) but sizing is goofy for sure. Can't say if it shrinks in the wash as I haven't washed it yet...I plan to try and just air dry and skip the dryer. So worth the $3!
Update:
It is now march and baby is 20 pounds and  6 months old. He can still squeeze in the 6-9 month which is awesome :) when I bought it he was around 10 pounds and he didn't fill it out... But with a long sleeve onesie under it for warmth, it fit well enough, and looked cute. Now he is rolly polly and looks very heroic in his turtle suit :) talk about getting my money's worth, lol! Oh! And my favorite thing about this outfit is the cape :) and it didn't shrink in the wash.
best outfit ever... And I'm not even a big ninja turtle fan?! So glad i bought it, i have really enjoyed seeing him in it.

Bought this to go on the kitchen wall, to hold the small oven.  I was very surprised with the quality of this thing.  Very heavy and solid.  Reminds me of scaffolding :)
Only problem we had is that the oven was small enough that we didn't need the arms of the shelf pulled out.  We ended up just removing the adjustable part that pulls out, and just sitting the oven on the solid arms.  We chose to do that due to the facts that #1 it looked funny to have the shelf stick out further than the oven, and #2 it looked funny for the oven to not be near the wall.  So, simple solution was to just make the arms smaller by removing the part that slides out. Hope that makes sense?
Anyways, this is by far the sturdiest shelf I have ever seen.  It isn't going anywhere!  Which, is what we needed for a hot oven, 5 feet up off the floor.
Awesome shelf.  Industrial quality.  One of the best purchases I have made on Amazon...and I have made a LOT of purchases :/ lol

users.query: So far, so good. I've been using it on my iPhone charger and my iron cord. Will find more that I can use this and will update my review. In the meantime, it is doing its job.

cands.text: It's ok for now. Noticed my computer response is slower. But as long as I'm protected then it's good. It's no use for my iPhone and iPad.

Finally used it last night. I have no complains. My rice cooked fast and my dinner was awesome! For the price, you can't beat it. I'd recommend this item.

Latest review: 6.30.11

Been using this for a month now. And so far, it's working fine. I'm actually buying one for a friend of mine as a housewarming gift.

I used it for the first time last night. As other reviewer stated, mine lasted 2 hours in a very low setting. I will try something else and maybe I'll just give this one to my neighbor's kid as a toy.

Review Update 5/26/16:

I recharged this again yesterday and tried it again. This time it lasted about 30 minutes. Junk. Now I'm embarrassed to give it away.

Just ordered this item and I must say, you get more bang for your buck! Super easy to apply and the price is just super duper cheap! Compare to the one I used to buy at Apple store. Get one yours today! I will do business again with the seller after I run out! Woot!

This case is nice and simple. I like the grip and the charge port and IR are not obstructed. It comes off and on easily. I had a little hard time hooking up the lanyard so I leave it unhooked for now. And you can't beat the price.

The only thing I don't like about this case is the bottom opening holes. It has a little thingy sticking out so you have to kind of pull it out of the way every time you insert and remove your charger. But other than that, the case is nice and I like the frost white color.

For the price, you really can't beat that. It's ok I like it but not totally love it. It makes your phone appear naked, which is cool. The back scratches easily even if you handle it with care and bottom front edges are a little sharp though. But other than that, it's fine.
It works fine. No complaint at all. It arrived on time before my international flight. Will order more to give as gifts. My luggage was untouched and these locks seemed to be safe.
It works fine. No complaint at all. It arrived on time before my international flight. Will order more to give as gifts. My luggage was untouched and these locks seemed to be safe.
Loved this product! Made my phone more sophisticated. Will try out other colors too. I would recommend this product :-)

Love this movie. It came out a few years back but I was still able to download the digital copy on my iTunes. So far so good. I can't believe Daniel Craig retired from making James Bond movie. He's still my favorite James Bond forever and ever.

It's really good! Expiration date is best before Dec. 2017. I will try to limit 5 macs or less a day or every other day or just whenever I crave for these . I deducted one star why? $18 is a little too much though. I will try the coffee glaze next time.

Tungsten  has been my favorite of all. It lasts a lifetime with no scratch and as stated by other customers, I agree that this one is a nice ring. Simple yet elegant. As you can see on the picture I posted, I put the ring always on my right hand.

First time I ordered this item at Amazon coz I bought it before at ZAGG directly when I used to have an older model of iphone. It's easy to install just be patience and take your time. Although when you buy this directly from ZAGG, they have a lifetime warranty replacement for free you just pay the shipping. I bought it here because it's cheaper. It does look authentic in case you're wondering.

I don't know why in the world people think this will protect your phone if you drop it. This is to protect your iphone from scratches only. lol

Great protection! This is my fourth time purchasing this software. I never had a problem or any kind of virus. Very easy to install and cheaper price here on Amazon. I'll purchase again next year when I'm almost due. I'd recommend it.

I've been using Pilot G2 gel pen since 1998. Seriously. Same point and color. This is the only pen I will use forever and ever until I cannot write anymore and nothing else. I always keep a back up of this.

I upgraded my phone to iPhone 4S and needed a nice, sleek and simple case. Anyway, this case is OK and will not bulk up the phone at all. It also has a good grip and won't scratch your phone from putting it on and off. The only concern I have is the hole for the silent mode button isn't completely aligned. I hope it won't push the button inside over time and cause some damage to the phone. It's a nice case for the price though. But it's NOT perfectly suitable for iPhone 4S from AT&T.

I've had this on for about 3 weeks now on my iPad Pro. It was a little tricky to put it on. You get two pair. I'll probably get the anti-glare next time after I get tired of the clear ones. Not bad for the price.

I am liking this key ring. It's very easy to hook and unhook any keys into it. I like the fact that you won't need any sub key ring for small holes like your car keys. I would definitely recommend this and will order more soon in different colors. Woot!

After reading positive reviews and received reasonable answers from "customer and answer" section, I decided to purchased one. I picked the City Night design. It fits my iPad Pro 9.7 and all the opening ports are lined up and not being obstructed. The cover magnets works fine. I'm giving this five stars for now as I can't tell how long it will remain intact with home use. I will probably buy a few more in the future and I hope MoKo will come up with more interesting cool designs. So far the City Night design is the only one that caught my eyes. You can't beat the price.

Fossil watches are very strong and durable watches that last a long time. All you need to do is replace the battery of course. I bought this watch for half a price here on Amazon for a gift to my auntie. I'm sure she is going to love this watch! The color is just brilliant. I'm not sure if this is for men as the model/serial number is made for woman. Maybe because it's a midsize watch and it's a trendy size nowadays for women. But hey, if any guy buy this for himself then good for you! lol

Anyway, it's a beautiful watch for casual or dressy for women. Buy it right now here on Amazon for the very low price. The retail store price of this is $135 plus tax of course. I'm a happy customer!

I used this last night. I didn't even fill it all the way with water. First boiled to rinse then second boiled I made a cup only for my tea. I'm not sure what other are saying that it won't shut off. It did auto shut off. So I have no complains. It's faster than my usual heating up water using my microwave. I'd recommend this product.

Amazon's status says 'on its way' but it arrived already lol. Very reasonable price for three screen protectors. I don't get why some people were complaining. It's not suppose to cover the entire front of your phone. And if they made it like that the edges will start to curl and peel off easily. If that's what you want, get a saran wrap. You know what I mean people? The rating that I gave is for JETech and thank you!

users.query: Loved it. That cliffhanger was terrible though. Need to know what happens asap! Loved them together again and can't wait to see them grow more

cands.text: This one had me worried that there wouldnt b a happy ending. I was kinda hoping for a little change up with the conflict though. It was the same thing over and over again. Overall a great series though.

I only got about halfway through the book. There was no backstory or build up at all. They were sleeping together in the first chapter. There was also nothing to really get to know that main characters.

Mace and hailey were amazing together. I loved that he saw right through all her lies. I wish her brother wouldn't have been pushing her to senn because he was a jerk to her. I thought the conflict that happened towards the end was a little unneeded. However I still loved the book
Loved it. Tm Frazier sure knows how to bring a story to life. I'm interested to see where the cliffie leads in book 2.
So happy to see skull and Beth finally get the happy ending they deserve. They were both so stubborn I was kind of worried it wouldn't happen.

I was happy to find out this book wasn't as bad as some of the reviews made it seem. Max and belle were justifiably angry at each other. I didn't expect them to fall back together easily and Im glad they didnt. I did feel as though there were too many flashbacks. I thought the past chapters kind of messed up the flow of the present chapters and I think it could have been explained with less interruptions to the story. However it was still a great read.
Loved Logan and Emily. I wish she would have been more honest with him but overall I likes how it ended. Anxious to see what happens with their story.

Very interesting story line. Wish the main couple would have met sooner. I thought 33% into the book was a little too long to wait. However once they did meet there was an amazing dynamic between Trevor and Ella.
I didn't quite care for the pace of this book. I thought it took too long for the main couple to finally end up together. Still an interesting read and look forward to the next one.
Loved torch/hunter and Katie. The meshed perfectly. Can't wait to see what happened to Beth and skull. They deserve their happy ending

There was definitely a lot going on in this book. Sometimes I was a little confused trying to keep everything and everyone straight. I loved that Shelby took charge in this book and didn't let all the boys decide everything all the time. I felt kinda cheated with the ending. There were some loose ends that I wish would have been tied up.
Loved this book. I had a feeling that what happened in the battle would happen. Loved the chemistry and strength between the main couple. Can't wait to read the second book
Loved this book but kinda thought the buildup took too long. I hated the end conflict because I thought same should have known better. I did love the chemistry as well as how accepting Sam was.

While I enjoyed this read I thought there was a little too much drama to consider it a light read. I thought there was a little too much back and forth during the breakup part of the book. I had also heard the book was funny and I didn't find it very funny. I still enjoyed it but it wasn't entirely what I was expecting.

This book definitely draws you in. Willa is hilarious. They guys are all easy to love in completely different ways. I love the relationship the brothers have with each other as well as with Willa. The ending was kinda abrupt but I can't wait to see what happens in book 2.
This book had me in tears laughing so hard at certain points. I loved it. It was weird and quirky. It ended a little abruptly but I know that's because the story carries on with the next couple.

I waited anxiously for nick and shaya's story. They were prefect together. I didn't like their reasons for staying apart or the intentional hurting but they ended up being epic.

Side note.. I think the author needed to pay more attention to what was being written. One thing would be said and a while later it would be something else. Maybe better editing to catch things like that. Didn't take away from the story but it was annoying when I noticed it.

Cross was pretty heartbreaking. I really felt for Con, Erin, and Stone. After the way things seemed in Hold, I was unsire of I would like this one. I absolutely loved it, things were not at all how they seemed. Con having to deal with a betrayal and loosing the two people he loved most. Erin being pulled in so many different directions and having so much put on her shoulders. Stone trying to be a good person, which ended up hurting his brother and the tragedy that took erin and landed him in prison. These three characters had to go through so much and it brought me to tears. I can't wait to see how the brothers are doing 4 years later and to see how they move on and past the misunderstanding.

While I enjoyed this book it seemed a little unnecessary because randy and lily already had their happy ending. I loved seeing the group again but would have rather it focused on one of the couples we haven't heard from yet
Not really into the whole love triangle. I'm not sure I like the direction the story is taking. However I still feel the need to find out what happens.

Such a weird start to an awesome relationship. Lane hart seems to enjoy the miscommunication issues. I was starting to worry this book didn't have a huge conflict in it until bam right at the end of the book. Excited to see how maces book plays out.

I was wondering how long it would take the 6 of them to figure out about Willa.... other than that this book keep me captivated by it. I'm interested to see how the group dynamic will continue to progress. Willa is hilarious and never disappoints with what comes out of her mouth.. or her mind. Can't wait for seduction!

Lucian and lia have an amazing love story. It broke my heart at all the the tragedies they had to go through to get their happy ending. I did fine the dialect to get a little cheesy at times but I loved both Lia and Lucian. I'm looking forward to reading rose. The initial set up from lia and Lucians story has gotten me pretty excited for rose and max.

I'm not sure what it is but I'm having trouble connecting with the characters in the last few books. I'm not sure if it's because they are in nocturn falls or what. I was glad to see some humor come back in this one. I feel that's been missing from the past few books. I also didn't like how down about herself Ellie was.
Overall good story but could have improved on the flow of the story some. I will be reading book two

users.query: Written in the first person, this tale opens up the town librarian's thoughts and perceptions of life, which changed considerably during her job's duration.  Her closed-up life and attitudes were changed a great deal by a 6 foot five inch 11 year old boy who came into the town's library.  This not an ordinary story, nor an ordinary librarian.

cands.text: This author captured well the childish thought processes of hope and determination, reminding us to live in a grown-up reality.  A very well written story, with nothing unintentional to deviate from the conclusion.  The pace and the building tensions were perfect.

This story takes a while to read.  Most of it is sad and depressing, but many of our values and strengths are put on a testing ground.  The elements of our lives are common ground for children, too.  I won't spoil the ending (although I think more editing should have happened), but the lessons are thoroughly appreciated.

Poor bored Alice, who got an idea to donate books to an area of Kentucky that really needed them.  The shock of this backward culture profoundly changed her and her life goals.
There are all kinds of contemporary applications I can apply these ideas to, and the lessons don't change over time.  This is a great story and good read.

There are all kinds of contemporary applications I can apply these ideas to, and the lessons don't change over time.  This is a great story and good read.

I can think of few things strongly changing my life from ten years ago But this mystery had one that changed several lives. This was very enjoyable to read and I would enjoy reading the next. This has great characters and humor.

This story is interesting.  It's full of quirky details that are just part of the town of Mulberry, N. C.  The past and present merge with people unconsciously following patterns of local history.
Humility and passion follow understanding.  I liked these characters very much.

This subject has always been a difficult area to talk about, much less to demonstrate within a whole book.  Various areas of concern are brought out and tied cleanly together within the plot.  This is a difficult story with a great pace, and by putting the subject within a local, personal area brings supportive hearts to a deeper understanding.  Great writing.
This story steams along, both in action and thought.  Expect romance (adult), and a considerable amount of involved tension as your present world fades away for a while.

At 62, Maggie thought that life would just stay as familiar as it always was.  But things changed, and she changed, and suddenly she had a new occupation and widened interests.  This story led me not an ending that I certainly did not anticipate.
Excellent writing and plot.
I liked the setting and the number of years in the story that allowed our heroine to mature into a good life.  The book reminds us about the toughness required to mold a life in the early West.
This book has a complicated plot and is a very good read.  However, the story is enlongated and could have used a little more editing.  Adults only, please.

I was expecting this to be written far too simply to enjoy, but the writing was good, and the plot was not simple.  It was enjoyable reading.  Getting into the 16th century life was a good reminder of our improved facilities today.

It's hard to face a tragic past, but that's what this book is all about.  I found this protagonist was smarter that several of the last, and the writing was improved, also.  This is a complex plot, making it hard to put down.  Good reading.
Don't start this book unless you can read it in one sitting.  The plot is paced to chain you to your chair.  Actually, I think the book could easily have been extended and perhaps should have been.

These 3 books are the record of  Eliza, who is a 5 ft. 9 inch blossoming, awkward young woman.  She has goals in life - to run her aunt's former business, and to discover where she fits in and belongs.  But she finds herself getting in all kinds of situations in which she needs a little sophistication to aid her extraction.  She needs to find it soon.
Great books to read!
Despite several uncomfortable timing skips, this story is so similar to people's lives.  This author shows that the visible hides the underneath truth so well.  Good reading and good lessons.

The imagination in this book was great.  I couldn't put it down.  I finished it with the wish that these things could really happen to everyone immersed in a troubled life.  Everyone that enjoys the movie "It's a Wonderful Life" will love this.

This book is raw, cold at its heart, and difficult to either read or put down.  You will not know where the plot is aimed, and it changes, going back and forth.  It is well written, but when you finish, you will be relieved to finally enjoy your own life. Use caution when selecting it.

This little story is a very simple, straightforward small book that really should be a read-aloud story to fourth graders.  It has a good place in literature, but there is nothing intriguing or profound in it.  The idea that angels are confused or independent of God's instruction is questionable, but the angels have unique personalities that are endearing, and their motives are innocent.
This is a sweet, sweet story with unexpected characters in a small, unexpected city.  I really loved it.  It will make your day.

Terrific characters and a convincing plot equal a thoroughly immersing novel.  This book was conceived with the intention of never allowing readers to stop reading it.
The isolated location on Vancouver Island really influenced my imagination into the story.  This is a great read.

Our heroine has a problem that's shadowing anything else she tries.  Why did her parents die?  As professional and experienced as she is, this drives everything she does.
This is a well-paced, very well written book, a pleasure to read. Some answers lead to the next in the series.

This is a dear book.  The author is very frank about his experience, which he initially was silent about, but couldn't keep inside.  This is a family man who dearly loved and was loved.  His recounting is very personal and will offer hope and faith to anyone who reads this.  Great, and easily read.
This is a quirky, whimsical wonderful book that I couldn't hardly put down.  I loved reading it.  Some of it is fantasy, but you almost wish it could happen to you, too.  Great characters.

The pace of this book was very uneven.  The first half seemed very slow, but the last half was throwing important scenes very page or two.  It was more than I was comfortable with reading.  The basis of the Brother's Bond wasn't explained very well and needed to be more integrated.  My guess is that the following books in the series were set up better.

users.query:
Unfortunately for "American Gangster", it tells a story within a genre that has provided some of the richest contributions to pop culture over the last half century.  When holding Ridley Scott's foray into the world of the mob against most average films, "American Gangster" looks like a classic, but when compared to The Godfather, the crime films of Scorsese or even The Sopranos, this feature seems stuck in a pair of cement galoshes

"Gangster" details the meteoric rise and fall of Frank Lucas (Washington), a 1970s narcotics drug lord from Harlem.  In what could be a lesson in an introductory business class, the film shows how Lucas was able to create a monopoly in the drug world by providing a better product at a lower price.  A true capitalist innovator, Lucas achieved his bargain basement prices by eliminated the dozen or so buffers between the opium fields and the street.  He flew to Southeast Asia himself, bought his product and had his family sell it on the street.  With no skimmers taking a piece at each port, truck depot, or airfield, Lucas built a company that crushed his competition.

Because of the skills of Denzel Washington, Lucas is both monstrous and human.  His work ethic, creativity and dedication paint the picture of a man who could have been the CEO of a major company had life dealt him different cards.  Instead, he built an empire described as more powerful that the mafia.  His counterpart (and equal in many ways) is Richie Roberts (Crowe) the unrelenting by-the-book New Jersey cop who brought him down.

By casting these titans as leads, Scott is able to camouflage many of his flaws.  Washington and Crowe both deliver what for other actors would be career-defining performances, but "Gangster" doesn't offer the total package of other crime stories.  It lacks the humor and cinematic artistry of Goodfellas and The Sopranos and fails to grasp the regalness of The Godfather.  The most creative element of the film is the Scorsese-like trailer with the retro sounds of Jay-Z`s  Heart of the City.  Many films would fail when compared to the best of the mob genre, so that does not mean "American Gangster" is without merit.  With two of America's finest actors at the top of their game and an irresistable story that brushes up against Vietnam, Ali and Nixon, the lack of creativity on the part of Ridley Scott is all that's keeping this from being one of the best films of the decade.
