I was very excited about receiving this compilation.  The idea is very unique and pretty well thought out.  I'm not a huge fan of the whole zombie idea in general, but combine it with Marvel characters and I'm sold.  The back story is a little lacking which I guess is why some people recommend reading the Army of Darkness VS. Marvel Zombies before this one.  I didn't so I can't really say anything about that.  The story was fun, the artwork was excellent.  The artists took old Marvel comic covers and redid them as zombie characters which is a very neat idea.

To me though the story was lacking something, I can't quite put my finger on it, but something just seemed to be missing.  Aside from that I'd say give it a read.  It's quick, the price is right and I don't think you'll be disappointed.

Easy to pull for new work, seems like a quality product.  I referred to the testing of the wire by other users in other reviews during my research and this 14AWG seems like the real deal.  Wired my basement up in a few hours for 7.1 surround and I'm excited to eventually test it out knowing that I got quality wire to go with the system.

UPDATE:  Finally got to test this cable out with an older Onkyo 5.1 system.  This stuff is garbage.......no I'm totally joking.  It actually sounded better than any of the stock cabling that came with the Onkyo.  Clear as day even the 25 ft runs I made for the back speakers.  Very happy with this purchase....

***Warning, A little bit of spoiler info in the review

I liked Marvel Zombies, I thought it was a really cool idea that deserved my attention.  And I love Army of Darkness (Evil Dead 2) a lot.  I thought the cross would be double fun.  However, I found myself being a little disappointed in the end.  The art was fantastic, but the whole story felt a little cheesy (which I do understand is what makes AoD good) and unfinished with very little explanation as to how the virus even found its way to earth.  There were even parts of the story where you can really tell the authors ran out of ideas and just started taking short cuts and making crap up.  For instance:  the part where Ash needed a diversion to get to the ship to make it to Doom's castle and the zombie children were in the way.  The authors just made up a team of somebodies as a diversion then said they were brutal taken out off page.  I laughed pretty hard, but realized this was just part of the easy way out mentality of the authors.  If I had started reading this story with no expectations I probably would have liked it a lot more.  But I read Marvel Zombies first, then this one, so I expected a better back story and a little more serious storyline with Ash's off humor as an added bonus.  If I could do it over again I would have read this one first then Marvel Zombies, I think I would have found the 2 graphic novels much better in that order.

I thoroughly enjoyed Vol 1.  The world is out of the Crisis, so they think, and the big 3 are all missing...Superman, Wonder Woman and Batman.  With these three gone and countless others missing or dead after the last Crisis, other super heroes try to step in to take their place.  Black Adam seems to have gone a little police state nutty, Booster Gold is trying to capitalize and Lex Luther is trying to repair his always tarnished image while still screwing people over... and a few other very interesting story lines going on at the same time. The art is good and the action will keep you interested.  I don't know that I would recommend reading this without first reading at least Infinite Crisis.  But to fully follow this I'd say Identity Crisis, Crisis on Infinite Earths and Infinite Crisis are a must.  There are a bunch of side stories that go along with these but they are not completely necessary.  Aside from that, this is a great story worth trying out.

What if villains team up to fight evil?  I know it's been done before, but how many stories out there haven't been?  Regardless, this series ended up being a surprisingly good read.  I remember looking at the cover and browsing through the compilation and thinking...oh man this is going to be cheesy.  But to my delight I really enjoyed the character development and the few twists the authors threw in.  Basically, Lex Luthor creates a team of super villains to take on the super heroes of the world.  But many villains refuse to join in.  A smaller team of villains is created by "Mockingbird" to fight the growing team bent on world domination.

  Like I said, the overall story has probably been done before, but if you know the DCU then you know they'll stop at nothing to surprise you in the end.  And surprise me they did!  I gave 4 stars because I don't think they kept Black Adam's abilities and ruthlessness consistent with other stories they've written about him.  But that seems to be my problem with Superman stories as well, you give someone godly powers and you end up having to tone them down for the weaker fights so they don't dominate the battle in a few minutes.  Anyway, worth the money and worth the time to give it a quick read.

Pretty much just plug and play if you're looking for a simple setup of one of the prepackaged OSs.  I'm very experienced with Linux, but found the setup of this device to be beyond beginners.  Pretty much just a kickstarter that allows you to graphically select what OS you want to us for this thing and then tells you how to download other OSs or Apps once complete.

The Marvel Zombies main story is a fantastic "what if?" situation with very little background as to how anything happened.  "Frightful", however, doesn't really help explain where the virus comes from but does give the full background story of the Fantastic Four portal talked about in the main story and introduces the Skrull civilization and their purpose on earth.  This story was at times a little difficult to follow.  I found myself turning back to previous pages in hopes of finding a little more enlightenment on latter parts of the story.  This tends to be the obstacle of time travel and trans-dimensional gateway story lines.  However, character development was spot on and the art was at its best.

****Spolier Alert - (stop reading unless you want to know the ending)****

My only real complaint, though, is the ending.  I may be alone on this, but I found Dr. Doom's sudden sense of caring and honor at the end a little too abrupt.  Don't get me wrong I thought he was very cool for taking the N-Zone beast into the Zombie dimension to save everyone.  But thought that it was a little unlike him.  I felt like the authors may have just run out of ideas and said, "hey Doom needs to redeem himself so we'll have him be the martyr here so that the reader will view him as a hero instead of a misunderstood villain."  Again, this may be just me, but I kind of felt that.

****Spolier End****

Aside from that I really enjoyed the story and thought it really helped explain a lot of the missing pieces from the main story line.

I decided to write this review without reading any of the other reviews just to see if my feelings were pretty common among its reviewers.  I said that this would be the one game that I would go out and buy when it came out and it was.  The original Fable is one of my all time favorite games, it was just so unique, and Fable 2 is...good.

Pros:
-The graphics set a new standard for environments that just grab the player.  Beautiful scenery and shadowing.
-Weapons are good, about the same as far as Fable 1 goes.
-Clothing is also about the same as Fable 1 with a few new options.  However, 2 doesn't have armor ratings and I can't remember if Fable 1 did.
-Magic is also about the same as Fable 1 but now with power level selecting.
-Lots a properties to purchase and lots of people to interact with
-Great music and sounds.
-They fixed the whole good/evil points system in this one where killing a bandit while not in a quest doesn't count as evil any longer.  If they attack you you get good points for killing them now.
-They cleaned up the expressions options by providing an easy to use expressions wheel.
-Combat movements are a little more fluent now
-Demon doors are still a great addition, but it seems like there are less of them...
-You don't need to continuously play to game to accrue rent...awesome!
-The horrendous aging methods from the original game have now been adjusted and are supposedly a lot better.

Cons:
-With added functions comes added difficulty in controls.  I've still not figured out how to consistently execute a roll or how to use the different magic levels feature.  I just push the buttons and hope they work.  It seems as though nearly every button has 3 or 4 possible actions.
-People interaction is again a little difficult.  You can focus on one person but you can't make everyone else go away so they aren't affected by your expressions.
-The jobs are interesting but very monotonous.
-The dog idea to me is useless.  Takes the fun out of hunting and discovering hidden treasures.  I don't mind if it wants to help me find buried treasure and growl when enemies are near.  But it finds everything which completely takes the fun out of finding hidden things.  And he's supposed to attack enemies, but all I've seen mine do is stand there and get hurt.  Maybe mine's broken XD.
-My biggest problem with this game is that it's so much like Fable 1.  It's pretty much the original game with lots of added features and expanded levels.  The storyline is even almost identical with different characters.  Don't get me wrong it's still a great game, just a little disappointing for the nerd that I am who has been waiting for months for it to finally be released.  I guess I just expected too much from the game.
-What happened to the alignment picture of the character when you go in to the menu to see how good or evil you are?  They totally ditched this concept.  I loved to see my character standing there either looking all holy with white lights flashing behind him or evil with red all over and flies all around him.

All in all I still like the game I'm just somewhat disappointed.  I think this game could have been so much better if they mixed it up a little instead of taking Fable 1 and building off of that amazing platform.  Maybe take a small page from the Diablo series and add some armor ratings and random drops or something.  I don't know, something seems to be missing and I gave 4 stars for that reason and for the fact that it's just too much like the original game.

It's a little unsettling how much more this thing picks up than out older Bissel vortex type of vacuum.  The house and carpet just seem cleaner after using this vacuum and the proof is in the container after finishing cleaning.  All of the attachments work very well as well.  My only complaint is that the vacuum itself seems very rickety.  It seems like all of the plastic components that make up the vacuum are going to break all apart whenever I pick it up and move it.  But so far it's been fine.

The suction on this vacuum is unreal, though.  Almost to the point of being annoying as well as we have hard wood floors with multiple place rugs.  This thing will latch on to those rugs and drag them around because the suction is so strong.  We have to usually anchor one side of a rug before vacuuming.

We also really like the fact that the base and arm are detachable and can be carried around for cleaning hard to reach spots and stairs.  At the end of the day, we have had no issues with this vacuum and really find it to be a good value for what was paid.

My father-in-law gave me this router to setup as a remote access point tethered off of a very nice Linksys router.  He had given up on the this router due to its insistence to constantly drop connections multiple times a day, randomly slow to a snails pace on a regular basis along with other various things a router should not do.  I turned off all services and simply put the Belkin in to gateway mode.  Even now, the router with almost all services turned off, still drops connections and randomly slows down multiple times during any given day...etc.  Here's the kicker though, I've actually put the wireless SSID into hidden mode for a "little security by obscurity" because this router's software (most recent firmware) has a bug that makes it IMPOSSIBLE to change the default username and password.  I'm not expecting someone to walk in to my house and plug in to the router to take it over or anything, and WPA2 isn't getting cracked anytime this decade, but still, it's obnoxious.  I've looked all over the web for a fix or a firmware update and all I can come up with is that Belkin just doesn't care to support their hardware in any way what so ever.  Belkin suggests a few things about the problem on their support page, but nothing even came close to being an actual solution.

My recommendation about Belkin, especially after their scandal of paying people to give good reviews for their routers on Amazon, stay away for them all together until they care enough to produce a good router that can ethically earn it's good reviews.

UPDATE:  I've just tried out the file/backup USB port on the router and surprisingly it seemed to work and the setup was as easy as plugging in the USB drive and then hitting the IP to open the folder.  I own V2 of the hardware, so this may not be as easy for other versions like V1.

UPDATE 2:  Scrap the above update, this thing needs to be reset almost every time you plug in a new usb device.  In addition, I purchased a dual drive external enclosure and two drives.  Hooked them up to the router and it worked ok.  But as soon as I partitioned the drives into multiple partitions, this piece of junk stopped seeing the drives all together.  In this day and age for a piece of equipment to be unable to recognize more than one partition on a hard drive is just ridiculous.  I'd update this router's rating to a negative star if I could with an additional negative star to Belkin in general for just being a bad company with shoddy products.  I'm never buying anything Belkin again.

Using these with my Dewalt router and loving the cuts and quality of the bits.  I really don't have much more to say about these aside from what the description states.  I'll say, exactly as described as far as I can tell.  I am a hobbyist and not a professional wood worker, so maybe the needs for constant use would be different.  But for me these are great, and very affordable.  The metal quality is on par with what I would assume I would be getting from MLCS bits.  So I have no complaints at all.  The nice wooden box is a bonus in my opinion.

I tried this in my car which has the antenna in the back of the car. The sound from the device to my receiver was fine. The problems I had were

1.  The sound volume is atrocious. I maxxed out the device volume, the phones volume and had to turn the car stereo up waaaay past where I would for a cd just to hear the music.

2.  The sound distortion on the louder music is terrible. I thought it was because I had the device and the phone volumes maxxed, so I tested various volume levels on all three components. I could never get rid of the terrible sound distortion.  This isn't the same as station interrupt from another signal either. This was consistent distortion of louder volume singing.

didn't expect a whole lot from this since it's not nearly as pricey as the other more well known name brands.  But I was shocked by how well this basket did on out recent trip.  It had enough room to fit our large suitcase, workout bag full of baby clothes and our twin baby stroller.  Nothing was stacked so the load wasn't that high up either.

The quality seems pretty decent despite how lightweight it is.  Time will tell if it will stand the test of quality, but for now it seems well made.  My only complaint is that the nuts that screw on to the bracket bolts are very tight and difficult to screw down as they are an odd shape and sort of small.  Your fingers will hurt after fastening all of the brakets down.  Aside from that this rack is a pretty decent purchase.

**UPDATE - I lowered my rating 1 star.  After realizing how difficult the knobs are to turn on the attachment pieces and the fact that this thing spews rusty water all over my car after a rain storm now...it gets a lower rating for being cheaper than I originally supposed.  Time definitely tells all about a product.

leaves something to be desired.  This lightweight, collapsible lantern with built in dimmer is good at what it does, provide enough light to illuminate a decently sized radius around itself.  Is it a gas lantern...no, but is it about the same an LED headlamp but providing that same light in a 360 degree fashion...it sure is.  We loved this lantern, even after our first one stopped working and we had it replaced under warranty by the cool people at the head quarters in Salt Lake City, UT.  However, the battery life is not as good as would be necessary if you were going for a few days camping/hiking.  My wife and I just got back from a 3 day camping trip where this little guy provided about 2 hours of light every night for cooking and in the tent time and it burned out on us on the last night.  If you add that estimate up, that's about 6 hours on high, where the instructions state 10 hours on high.  This was the first time we'd used this lantern, and the batteries were new, since we had the old one replaced by headquarters.  I'd give the Orbit less stars, except everything else about the lantern is pretty cool.

Always a fan of Wagner brake pads.  I've used these same brand and type on two cars now.  Easy to install and the ThermoQuite require no extra grease of lube.  Just pull off the old pads and slap these suckers on.  I've been using a pair on one of my other cars for about a year now and I've never heard a peep out of them.  They're still going strong so I'll definitely order these again in the future.

users.query: One size fits all says it all. I have a medium to small head. It fits fine. If I had a big head it would squish my brains and my eyes might pop out. It will keep me warm on those days I walk the dogs into the wind and will also fit under my Mad Bomber hat.

cands.text: HANDWASH ONLY !!!!!!!!!  Star off !!  Otherwise warm, comfortable and handsome hat

I have been wearing duofolds for many years and the comfort level is great. It has been about 5 years since my last shirt and the elbows are wearing out so it was time to replenish. The new shirt I am wearing now is thinner than the older ones...same weight. I cannot find ANYWHERE a large-tall. On the large the sleeves are too short as is the waist. I am 6 ft and a skinny 155 lbs. I would suggest an extra large if you want proper sleeve and waist length. But as I wrote the comfort level is great.

The construction of these long johns is excellent. They are way better then anything you are going to find at your local superstore. I am 6 feet tall and a thin 143 pounds. I bought the mediums and they are not too short and the waist band sits and fits fine. The ankle cuffs are long and tight. They are not as warm as I would like. Wool does a much better job but for me they will be OK I think under a pair of flannel lined jeans.  I would not recommend these if you have to be out walking or working below 15 degrees but if you are in a warehouse where it may be 40 degrees all the time they will work.

Spacious
Great Fitment
EZ to work with
$100, are you kidding me?
Owners Club at Famous site
NO Packaging or shipment issues (window not scratched)
Dual windows
Room for plenty of fans(fan hub) yet closed enough to keep dust out and has easily removable dust filter
No LED lighting (never thought I would want it)
Rear of side panel edges somewhat sharp and could cut
Directions could be better
No 3.5 inch external bay for card reader
Front USB bay cover could be a problem...I have to make sure not to snap it off when open
Accessory box not attached to anything in case but no window damage

I have owned 6 primary cases in 20+ years. Cases have come aloooong way.
I replaced my HAF 922...too many holes, too much dust and dog/cat hair inside
I have had this case for six days and had it apart and back together four times. The side panels are a dream compared to any other case I have had. EZ off, EZ on ! The front bezel and top panels are very easy to remove and replace.

Go read other reviews from here and other sites to get the nitty-gritty.

This is a wonderful case at a great price. If you want more bling consider the Luxe

This is my second one of these and it works for me. This is also my third memory foam pillow. The first was one of those sculpted jobs. It was comfortable but those kind can't be turned over and I like to flip my pillows. When that one wore out I got this one and was very happy with it's performance. Some may disagree but memory foam doesn't last forever. My pregnant daughter came for a visit over Christmas and needed another pillow so I loaned her this one, old version, she just loved it, though it was old I gave it to her. She will never go back to regular foam, polyester or feathers. Needing a replacement I bought another and for this price I doubt I could have done better no matter how many different brands or schemes I might have tried.

This pillow is quite firm but for me it works. I need to keep my shoulders from supporting me too much when on my side. If the pillow got too soft I would sink into my memory foam topper and my shoulders would hurt. The firmness of this pillow lessens but does not prevent that. The firmness also keeps my neck inline with my back preventing a sore neck. As memory foam warms it gets softer so in a warm summer room it will be more soft than in a winter room where it will be more firm.

I use this pillow to sleep not for propping while I read. A fat feather pillow or two works best for that.

The pillow comes in a zip enclosure and had no smell I could discern.

I recommend this pillow but it may not be the one that fits you best but for only $30 give it a try cause down the corner mattress store they want 3X that amount for this type of pillow

Good Socks. They seem to be making them a bit smaller than before.
They don't last as long as I would like but are better than something you might buy at the super store in a plastic bag.

Can't bring myself to spend more on socks than this. Still the best bet for the money

This is a basic timepiece. The watch has date, it lets you read time; standard or military and the face demarks seconds. The band is a comfortable leather that fits my small wrist. The are 9 holes in the band to fit most any wrist. There are two loops on the band to keep excess band under control.

The watch itself is an excellent size for a smaller wrist( I don't want a mega watch on my skinny wrist) The face is easy to see. In certain light the homogeneity of the face give me a moments pause but I can see it fine. In most light EZ BreeZee.

I can't hear it at all.
Indiglo is cool

In short a well styled men's watch.
I like this hoodie so much I was going to buy the company but since I don't have that much money I merely bought another. Tie the strings together when washing and drying. One came out
Hardly all encompassing. Something to look at while you are doing something else. If you want to ID a tree get a local book. Not this.

It fits nicely and seems to be of a quality leather. Came with a stylus that is of questionable efficacy.
It is a tad bulkier than I would have liked. The touchscreen corners and sides are farther removed from the
covers surface than I would like.
Has nice magnetic closure of the right force.
The inside cover has 3 slots. Two are for ??? Credit Cards?? One is for what looks like a fingernail file or emery board ?? You tell me what you use them for..OK?

I would not buy again because it isn't leather I am smelling but a petroleum product. P. U.

Everyone takes something different from a story. I have heard or read that the kind of guy you are is dependent on what you make people think of you.
As long as people think you are something you can or may be. There is truth to that. Then there is the person you think you are or better still, if you are insightful,
know you are. There are two major players in this book. The hero and the antagonist.

I have never read a book (you should study what you read) that points this out so well. It didn't have to be set during the Korean War. These players are everywhere in life.
Who are you? I know I am both.

I enjoyed this story completely. If you are a girl and want some insight into men go here.

I have tried many types of "stop pulling" schemes. While not perfect this is the method I prefer. It is EZ to get on and off. The muzzle type keeps the puppy from pulling less but they are also hated by dogs. My Lab scraped her nose so bad the vet gave us the eye. Our Springer pup would just lie down and refuse to move.

My philosophy of walk is the dog must have fun or why go? Ollie can still do some roaming with this if he wants and that's OK. For the most part I find this comfortable for my arm sockets and I can still control him. Completely worth a try

I can't keep track of how many mice I have had but I do recall my first quality mouse as a Logitech. They make real good products. Logitech has good service after the sale...among the best.
This has a nice size for my smallish man hand. The tracking is different from my previous mouse but that is true when moving from mouse to mouse. Soon I will be used to the M 310 and if I went back to my old mice I would need to acclimate to it. I picked this over the 510 because I don't use more than 3 buttons. The sides are a soft rubber, that is good for gripping. How the mouse will hold up for gaming remains to be seen. 100.000 right clicks isn't asking a lot and I expect this mouse to hold up. The right click could feel more firm? definite? but I expect I will get used to that also. I run a KVM switch and this mouse gives me no issues when switching systems. I like the very small size of the receiver. The signal is powerful enough for me to plug it in down and behind rather than on the desktop with an extender. More desktop space is always a plus

No SetPoint software was included but since it is always out of date the point is moot.

The price was good. No need to go overboard on a mouse. It is a basic mouse and I am pleased with my choice.
Should be on your list if your are a buff. Not as good as Sledge's or Sidney Phillip's book though IMO. Recommended

You can go down the store and see any number of products designed for this purpose.
We have been using this brand exclusively and routinely on our Yellow Lab for 10 years.
The smell is pleasant but more importantly this stuff is very effective
to remove the accumulated ear junk. We semi saturate an appropriate size cotton ball
and push it down as far as it can go. Our vet told us to do it that way and
it is safe....we haven't punctured and ear drum or lost a cotton ball yet.
Make sure you get between the folds and don't be afraid of cotton swabs.
Just DON'T stick cotton swabs way down the ear. After the gunk stops coming out
ensure the ear is dry. Our dogs don't like it but they let us do it as long as we
give them cookies during the procedure. Our Springer has more ear folds than our Lab
and it works just as well for him.

This is the finest product to clean and keep your pets ears clean. Look no further

How this book could get a 5 star review took some thinking. What I came up with is most people have never read a great book so they think that a run of the mill, well written title is great. This book is not great. The cover states "....the next Patrick O'Brian."
What O'Brian had going for himself was his genius and he could impart that genius in his writing. Hammond while a competent writer is not a genius and that why he is no Patrick O'Brian.

I also don't understand why it was necessary to produce a reason to have the hero want to fight the British. Most will disagree with that but I stick with it. Wouldn't it have been novel to have him simply be a patriot.

I enjoyed the parts of the book while the hero was at sea and while he was meeting luminaries of the day such as Franklin , Lafayette and others. What I didn't enjoy and ultimately just glossed over was the description of rooms, dresses and anything else that didn't advance the story. I suppose some enjoyed the love story and no one likes a good love story more than me but this wasn't one of those. It was too much, OH Darling, for my taste. I was surprised to read an oral sex scene.

The history was OK and in parts good as well as accurate.

I don't think I will be reading another of this series.

I think most people will like it though.

If you want good story, great characters and excellent history of the period try anything by Kenneth Roberts.

Well packaged camera. Fits neatly on top of my monitor. Picture is very clear and has several resolution options. The software offers some cutesy pie hair styles. Auto focus works good and is easy to turn off. Would be nice if MS offered some bonus downloads at their site. Good price

9-17 Used to like it  But less then 1 year later it changes beam on it's own. Bright, dim, flash...It's junk IMO. Strap too small to put wrist thru

11-16 Very Bright which is what a flashlight should be. Adjustable beam that is beneficial rather then just adjustable. Bigger then I thought by just looking at picture. Directions included. Very good price.

I need to keep my hand and fingers slightly bent while mousing to prevent my arthritic hands (particularly my index finger) from paining me. If my hand is too flat on a larger mouse the click pressure angle hurts me in short order. I originally bought this mouse for a laptop but when my desktop mouse went bad I switched to this til I could get a replacement. I liked it so much right away I stuck with it. The click area is quite large and very easy to depress. I am now on my second mouse of this model. The first wore out because it is not a gaming mouse per se but I use it as such and after thousands of  clicks it became somewhat non-responsive. If you use this mouse for regular old computering I can't see why it wouldn't last for years and years and years. I have no issue with battery life. Twice I have dropped this mouse on my hard floor and had the lid fly off but it didn't break the mouse so it is well made IMO.

I recommend this mouse 100%

I can see why I always thought Chelios had an attitude problem. The book makes it clear he does. This was a more interesting book then Probert's because he told more stories about players, coaches and refs. The NHL is no place for a nervous person. If you are a fan of Chelios and I am since he was a Wing then you will like this book. There were few boring spots.

Oh, How I suffer could have been an alternate title..poor Max.

The game is no Max Payne 2 and, of course, there is no Mona. I don't like games that won't allow me to save when and where I want but, What are ya gonna do? The lack of self saving was the reason I passed on this game for so long. When I was able to get it for <$10 I did. If I had spent more I would have given it fewer stars.

Graphics were fine but I hated the flashing, glowing and out of focus stuff. Waaaaayyyy to many cut scenes.

Game play was OK. True it wasn't waves of bad guys like Serious Sam but close enough.

Weaponology was bad...Why am I always dropping the best weapon, yep could be me but I wasn't dropping the handgun.
OH look...a golden gun piece...where is the rest of it?

Subtitles in What language? Really dumb.

I have had the game about eight months and am nearing the end of the game. If I had liked it I would probably have finished it in 3 months.

"Oh, How I suffer"  Max Payne

It's been 37 years since I was last in Chemical Equilibrium lab. Using this brought back a familiar smell. I think it sulfuric acid...so
Fe + H2SO4 = purple sreaks that wash away ez breezy

Stuff works fast

The game code works. That's out of the way. Buy on sale...I did. Now is the game any good? For  $2.50 it would have to be real bad not to be worth $2.50. The 400 Days is needed for continuity so buy it, play it and accept it. Choices don't seem to matter though.
I just like Hockey and like to learn about the history of the game. The stories and history in this book made me laugh and I had a most enjoyable time reading it. I recommend this book

Sharpens very well and is not difficult to use. Company does all they can to insure you will be successful in your sharpening via instructions and videos. Replacement  belts are expensive but there are reasonably priced aftermarket belts of unknown, by me, quality.

users.query:
Hannah Sheraton and Billy Zuni have headed north looking for a safe place (as far away from Hermosa Beach, California as they can get) to hide until danger passes (the authorities want Billy back and an Albanian blood feud that is fifty years old wants him dead). After their many trials and tribulations, they finally find a place where they are isolated and feel safe. But everything is not what it seems to be, and soon they find themselves involved in a fight for their very lives Is this a fight Hannah and Billy can win? Can Josie and Archer find them before it is too late?

Without giving away details, the subject matter covered in this book was very interesting and intriguing. You hear about this sort of thing a lot  and maybe see a news story every now and then (I do not live in America, so I am not sure how often it happens, but I have studied psychology there and remember a few very important "big news" cases). I believe Ms. Forster did a brilliant job of exploring the psychological aspects of the overall situation  this is definitely the best and most thought-out example that I have read in fiction.

The location of this book was also described in great detail. I was able to visualise the surroundings (beautiful images, in my mind) and all of different people with many different ways of life (the characters in this story are alike in some ways and very different in others). I could almost feel the coldness and experience the darkness of the night...

Each of the Josie Bates Thrillers (The Witness Series) has been better than the last and this one is no exception. The book was thoroughly entertaining and kept me turning the pages, anxious to find out what direction the story might go next. As soon as I thought I had figured out exactly what was happening, something would change my mind. I did pick out the loony toons of the story, but I think you were meant to. However, having said that, I did not know how far some characters were willing to go until the very last. A great book with a 5-star ending, in this fans opinion!

AfterThought: There is an error on the "blurb" for this book. It has Josie testifying in Washington D.C. and Archer on Hannah's and Billy's trail in Oregon, but those things happened in the last book, "Eyewitness" ...

cands.text:
This spotlight novella gives you an intimate up close and personal look at the mind of sixteen year-old Hannah. Hannah is an intriguing young lady that has been badly damaged. Life has been so cruel to her that when something good happens, she finds it hard to believe that it is real. Be prepared to shed a tear or two because this story really tugs at the heartstrings...

Hannah made her first appearance in Hostile Witness (the first book in Rebecca Forster's Witness Series) as Josie's first client. I have read three books in the series and I am looking forward to reading the rest of them!

During a horrible storm, Hannah is awakened by a man banging on the door of the house. Frightened, she goes to wake Josie. They go to the door, finding a man begging Josie to save Billy Zuni, who is being tossed about by the sea and is drowning...

When Billy is finally pulled out of the water, Hannah rides with him in the ambulance to the hospital... Josie is angry at Billy's mother (who locks her son out of the house frequently) and goes to confront her... She and Archer find a disturbing scene at the Zuni house  two men are dead and Rosa is barely clinging to life Hannah is afraid Billy will be framed and she wants Josie to help him It soon becomes clear that Rosa is not who she appears to be

The simultaneous storylines were interesting and informative  the Albanian blood feud reminded me of the Sicilian vendetta. The plot was believable and well thought out. The characters were likeable or not  depending on their place in the story. The evidence seems to point one way, but there are unanswered questions. There were enough twists and turns that I stay glued to the book and read it late into the night  just to see what happened next. There were quite a few surprises and I was thoroughly entertained by this page-turner!

I am enjoying the relationship between Josie and Hannah and I am interested to see how it develops from this point forward

This legal thriller grabs your attention from the very first page, pulls you in and holds you hostage until the case is finally solved!

I figured out the whodunnit early on, but the book was still interesting and well done.

This book was recommended to me by Amazon based on kindle books I have read.

The plot was well thought out, well presented and believable. The characters were easy to like or hate (depending on their place in the story). The book moved along at a decent pace and held my attention from beginning to end. This is another story I could visualise as I was reading. The twists and turns were unexpected and I had no idea who the real guilty party was until the big reveal -- what a shocker!

MY SISTER'S GRAVE has made me a Robert Dugoni fan. I am looking forward to reading the rest of the Tracy Crosswhite Series and exploring the David Sloan series.

Kindle Unlimited Member

This psychological thriller was one of the best I have read in a long time. I was completely immersed in this story from the beginning and read nonstop until I reached the shocking conclusion. The plot and the main character, Riley Harper, were well thought out and brilliantly presented. The other characters were believable and interesting. There were more twists and turns than a roller coaster ride and plenty of surprises along the way. Just when I thought I had figured it out, I found out there was more to the story. The suspense kept me on edge and I never expected the ending. This is the first book I have read by Mr. Kaufman and I will definitely read more of his books!

Kindle Unlimited Member

Josie is doing her best to take care of sixteen year-old Hannah  to understand, be there for and guide her. Then, Archer is arrested  accused of murdering his disabled stepson two years earlier  a stepson Josie knew nothing about. "For Josie Baylor-Bates there were two people who needed her and no one she could turn to for help. ... She didn't know how to be perfect for Hannah and still do what needed to be done for Archer." Josie will have to carefully balance Hannah's and Archer's needs, so she can be there for both of them...

When Timothy Wren died at an amusement park, it was thought to be a tragic accident. Tim's biological father is back and he has an interesting story to tell. He also has a multimillion dollar lawsuit against the park  a lawsuit that will be worth nothing if Archer is convicted of murdering the boy...

What a great book! The evidence would lead you in one direction, then something would happen and you would second-guess yourself. I did figure out the "who" pretty early on  the clues made it pretty obvious to me... However, I was completely blown away when the "why" was finally revealed!

I really enjoy reading this kind of legal thriller series and I am now a fan of Josie Baylor-Bates. Rebecca Forster tells an intriguing story that immerses the reader in Josie's world. I am looking forward to the rest of the series...

The "blurb" for this book is so descriptive that I cannot add anything to it. If I do, I will be giving away the storyline and I would rather encourage others to read this book -- without me giving away the plot.

Mick Bose has a very unique way of telling a story and he keeps the reader's attention throughout the book.

The vivid descriptions of people and places put the reader in the middle of the action. You can see, feel and hear everything about the locations in the book -- whether they are in the capital of Washington DC or the jungles of Myanmar (Burma). The cast of characters is so richly drawn that you can "visualise" every fight and/or battle that takes place -- you feel the bullets hit, then watch the bodies hit the ground. I was totally immersed in this book and read it from beginning to end without a break (and, of course, the ending leaves me impatiently waiting for the next book in the series).

This new fan highly recommends the Dan Roy series and I will be looking forward to his next book. Well done, Mr. Bose -- another 5-star action thriller!

I bought this books because I enjoyed the Jessie Black Legal Thrillers series. I expected the book to be like that series especially given the fact that Jessie Black is one of the characters in the book & it takes place in that legal setting (she is not the main character). I was shocked to get a few pages into the book and to find that this book is nothing more than a cheap piece of pornography about kinky sex. I immediately stopped reading & deleted the book. If you have to put explicit sex scenes in a book to sell it, you have absolutely have nothing to say that I want to see, hear or read. I would have expected to find this in another book Mr. Winters has written called "Hard Core" because of the cover. Authors need to rate their books as "adult entertainment"  or warn potential buyers in the description. If I wanted pornography, I would have looked for that. Thankfully, Amazon happily refunded my money.

I got this book to do an in-depth look at Forensic Psychology for my classes at Uni. The book has "thirty articles by experts in the field, this dynamic forensic psychology reader emphasizes the ways that forensic psychologists and other clinicians apply psychological knowledge, concepts, and principles on a day-to-day basis." This book is an excellent source for students studying Forensic Psychology.

THIS IS NOT A TEXTBOOK FOR UNI CLASSES. If you are looking for a textbook, please read the details in the "book blurb" or refer to Uni reading lists for text books.

This is the second book I have read by Jeff Gunhus. The plot is well thought out and well presented. The characters are developed and interesting (you like the good guys and really hate the bad guys). Arnie thinks he has found his last victim in the form of Allison McNeil, but little does he know that Allison has plans of her own. The story grabs your attention from the beginning and holds you hostage until the end. With more twists and turns that a roller coaster ride ride and more than a few surprises along the way. You will not want to miss this book if psychological thrillers!

Kindle Unlimited Member

I got this book for furthering reading in abnormal and forensic psychology studies. To me, the book was just "okay".

Like others, I expected more from "Joe Navarro, a former FBI counterintelligence officer and a recognized expert on nonverbal behavior." This book was so repetitive that it became annoying pretty quickly.

There was some useful and helpful information in the book, but it could have been summed up (without all the repetitions) in about 50-100 pages.

I read VIGILANTE ASSASSIN before I read this book so I did not know the full details of the beginning of the relationship between Jake Wolfe and Cody. The relationship between the new Alpha and his war dog continues to touch my heart and impress me.

The scene where Jake becomes Cody's new Alpha was brilliantly written and was one of my favourite parts of the book  second only to Cody's reaction to deep loss prior to that scene.... The banter between Jake and Terrell Hayes is priceless  I laughed out loud a few times (especially when Jake picked Terrell up at the Heroin Hotel and the chaos that followed)... I enjoyed the military acronyms like FUBAR, I recognised them and knew what they meant...

What a great book! I was hooked from the very beginning and felt like I was in on the action all the way through. This was an adrenaline-fueled, loop-de-loop roller coaster ride with lots of suspense and more than a few surprises to keep you turning the pages.

You can tell the author is very familiar with Marines, war dogs, federal, state and city agencies and how they conduct investigations (and treat suspects) and more. He has done extensive research (he lists his sources in the acknowledgements).

I read that Mr. Nolan is at work on book three and I am very much looking forward to it!

This is the prequel to the Jessie Black Legal Thriller Series. It is a novella of about 150 pages.

After she wins a case, Jessie drinks a little too much and makes a mistake that has has both professional and personal consequences. While she is trying to deal with the fallout, Jessie is given a fourteen year old murder case to prosecute.

The story reaches out and pulls you in. Hang on for the usual twists and turns that you have come to expect in a Jessie Black Legal Thriller  it might be a novella, but Grave Testimony is not short on suspense and intrigue!

I have studied Abnormal Psychology  and Forensic Psychology as minors at university level. This book was referred to me by Amazon based on my psychology textbooks that I have purchased.

"How human beings think and behave is an unendingly fascinating study, one that reveals how simple and elegant and, on the other hand, complex and mysterious we are."

I was hooked by the opening scenes, told from a bartender's point of few. Why? I am so glad you asked! When I was working while I attended university the first time (in the 1990s), I worked as a bartender. My customers provided me with numerous hours over several years as "practice" patients without even knowing it.

This was a short read (approximately 119 pages), easy to absorb and understand. This is a collection of the author's research of psychology. The book is divided into seven aspects of human psychology: emotions, personality, decision-making, morality, perception, behavior, and relationships.

This book was recommended to me by Amazon based on books I have already read -- after this, I will NEVER choose a book recommendation from Amazon again. i went by the blurb on this one and thought I was in for a thriller. Who does not like a hero that escapes from a Mexican h*llhole and goes after the mobster that put him there, right?

I was SOOOO wrong. This book was nothing but pornography from the beginning. This was not even "sex sales", it was straight porn, vulgar, disgusting and vile. I hope this author never has kids because his/her opinion of women is very low and men act like animals (Remington Kane is obviously a made up name). I can tell this filth must be popular because there are about 20 books in this series (one of the reasons I was excited to discover a new series to read, but this one gets DELETED).

This book is another great addition to textbooks in Forensic Psychology classes I am taking at Uni.

THIS IS A TEXTBOOK! If you buy the books used, it will OBVIOUSLY going to have highlights and notes made by the student that used the text book before you. It is to be expected, all Uni students highlight and make notes. If you do not want that, you can buy the text book new

This is my third book by author, Jeff Gunhus and I have quickly become a fan. The second book in the Allison McNeil Thriller is even better than the first. the plot is excellent, grabs your attention from the beginning and keeps you turning the pages until you reach the satisfying conclusion. I could easily see this type of story coming out of the top D.C. papers. If a high society call girl were murdered and two cameras were found in her bedroom walls, you could imagine lots of powerful people getting more than a little nervous. Again, the characters are well-developed and interesting, whether in a good way or a bad way. This fast-paced novel has plenty of twists and turns to keep the reader entertained and more than one surprise in store.

I would definitely be interested in reading more books by Mr. Gunhus and highly recommend the Allison McNeil Thrillers to anyone who enjoys a great psychological thriller!
