I have similar feelings about this pill holder as the other reviewer -- it is very well-made, but it is not for me. It's just too small to be useful.

I knew the size before ordering and I wanted it for a standard pain relief pill (I usually take Aleve). I suppose I can cut them to fit, but I'd prefer that they just... fit in the first place.

This would be fine for very small pills like low-dose aspirin, but most others will need to be cut.

It is *very* attractive and nicely finished, though, which is why it deserves at least 4 stars. I received this item at a discount in exchange for an honest, unbiased review, which I've tried to provide here. This is a solid item, but please, check the size of your pill to make sure it will be useful to you.

This is a nice variety of brushes -- they're good for a beginner or hobbyist. My girlfriend is a fairly serious painter, but I'm not, so when I had the opportunity to get these at a discount in exchange for an honest, unbiased review (not all of my reviews are positive, feel free to read others to verify!) I jumped at the chance to have a set to kick around myself.

BRUSH WEIGHT: These brushes are a little bit light. It would be nice if the handles were a little heavier so it would be more evenly balanced in my hand.

BRISTLES: The bristle quality (synthetic) is decent -- it's not world-class, but it's alright for this price range.

FERRULE: The ferrule has some slight gaps between it and the handle, which means when you wash them, the glue may eventually degrade. Again, not entirely unexpected at this price range, but I wish the ferrules were tighter.

CASE: The case is very nice and well-made.

CONCLUSION: This is a solid range of brushes that are reasonably constructed and come in a good case. I question their longevity, but for $20, this is an okay buy. When I need another set, I'll consider these, but will also look at alternatives.

I used to be a pretty serious coffee hound, but I can't handle caffeine by the gram anymore. I still need a boost in the morning, but I don't want to feel tweaked out as I work at my desk.

I also don't want to spend $53 per K-cup. I tried a different, very popular brand on Amazon, and while the coffee was alright, the fiber-pods were a little messy.

Mad Monkey tastes great, is very well-priced, and it's a real K-Cup. My girlfriend is a convert, too -- we start every day with Mad Monkey and now I stock it for our office coffee maker, too.

Now we both say, "Do you want Mad Monkey?" instead of just asking about coffee. Mad Monkey's a pretty cool name for a legal stimulant.

We're on our fourth order of these and have no plan to deviate or switch to another brand. Mad Monkey is awesome.

We needed a big, high-quality whiteboard for our office -- something suitable for daily work and also as a background for video filming -- and the Quartet Prestige 2 Total Erase Magnetic Whiteboard has been an excellent purchase with only two minor problems.

First, we had no trouble with shipping as some other reviewers had. In fact, our problem was that the item came *too* quickly. We had to schedule the delivery for the following Friday (required for such large items) and I got a call three days early that it had just been delivered. I had to drive into the office unexpectedly and move the box, but I can't really complain that shipping was too good and ahead of schedule!

We didn't have any shipping problems as other reviewers had. The item arrived undamaged and the packaging was sufficient.

The whiteboard itself is a perfect blend of quality and flexibility. It's heavy enough to be called solid, but it's light enough to install on drywall and not worry about it coming down. Because of the size and the specific placement we needed, we drilled one hole into a stud. The anchors are thin, soft plastic that collapse under pressure; to get it into the stud, we put a screw in the anchor and tapped it into the hole until the anchor was flush. Then we removed the screw and began to mount the whiteboard.

The instructions do not come with any written directions, only pictures. That wasn't much of a burden because there aren't many pieces and it's clear. The hard work is measuring and making sure the whiteboard will be level. Once that's done and the first bottom piece is installed, the rest is very easy.

Our only real complaint is that the aluminum marker/eraser tray mounted on the bottom (the final step of the setup process) is very cheap. The mechanism that holds it to the whiteboard is simple, but the corner pieces that hold it into place and cover the bottom screw holes do not hold the bottom tray solidly. Obviously, our focus was the whiteboard itself, so this is a minor gripe (especially at the board's price point), but it wouldn't have taken much to have a tray/corner piece that matched the great quality of the whiteboard.

Our second problem was a factory mistake of some sort. The black top corner pieces that cap the screw holes have a right and left; for some reason we received two right pieces. We'd love to have ACCO send us a replacement, but even without that, the exposed corner holes look fine and go unnoticed as they're 7' off the ground.

As for the board, it's exactly what we expected. It marks easily, the barely-visible grid is helpful, and it looks great mounted. A very good value at $291 for a 6' x 4' presentation-quality whiteboard. Koala Fight Media is happy!

We have a 30" Masterbuilt electric smoker that we use 2-3 times a week. We buy bacon 10 pounds at a time and pork/chicken/beef usually 20 pounds at a time, so we deal with a fair amount of meat.

For chips, we use combinations of mesquite, hickory, cherry, alder and apple, depending on what we're smoking and how we want it to taste. We'd never tried Manuka and were intrigued, so we thought we'd give it a try with a 5-pound pork loin and 3 pounds of bacon.

We were blown away with how amazing the manuka-smoked meat tasted -- it was INCREDIBLE, a great mix of full-bodied smoke and sweetness. Seriously, it's the best flavor of chips we've ever used. The bacon was a perfect blend of sweet and smoke, and the pork loin tasted like it had just come out of a pit.

I appreciate that the chips are very small, too. That helps a lot with an electric smoker and they burn evenly. I also had to add chips about half as often as normal.

I received this product at a discount in exchange for an honest, unbiased review, which I've tried to provide here -- though this review is glowing, it is 100% sincere and deserved.

I do wish these were on a similar price point with the other chips we buy (Weber and what's sold at Cabela's/Bass Pro) -- if manuka were cheaper, we'd use them exclusively, but slower burning does offset the price somewhat.

Honestly, though -- these chips are worth it, and we bought 30 pounds of beef today that we can't wait to smoke with manuka chips.

I had an extremely bad experience with the first ab wheel I bought. It was so poorly made that it wouldn't assemble properly, and when I complained to the company they ignored my problem (they just sent the assembly instructions again). I ended up throwing it away -- it's the only product out of hundreds I've bought from Amazon over the years that I actually gave up on and tossed, since it was so cheap that shipping it back for a refund wouldn't have been worth it.

The BIO Core Ab Roller, however, is AWESOME. The rubber wheels make a huge difference. Go to any store with a sporting goods section (I was at Wal-Mart today comparing) and take a look at what's there -- the wheels are generally cheap plastic, which can slip and slide on carpet and hardwood. When you're almost fully extended, slipping is... bad.

The rubber wheels don't slip and can't slip. The quality is outstanding here, and the wheel only takes a second to assemble. The handles are soft but thick (not a cheap covering that will wear off). You push one on the bar, then both rubber wheels, then the other handle and you're done.

The included mat is a nice touch, too, since the main problem with ab wheels is what it does to your kneecaps.

I received this item at a discount in exchange for an honest, unbiased review, which I've tried to provide here (check my other reviews, they aren't all positive!). I am extremely pleased with the BIO Core wheel. With ab wheels, you get what you pay for, so I'm happy to have erased my first mistake and ended up with a well-made roller with a lifetime guarantee in case I encounter some problem in the future.

Laundry is pretty simple for me -- I wash and I dry -- but my girlfriend needed a drying rack for some of her items. This is one of those items that was really nice to have shipped rather than hauling it from a store to home (and since we're about 30 miles from a store that would carry it, it requires a trip).

The price was fine, the build quality is adequate, and it folds easily. We've used this for a few months now and I don't see any reason it won't last as long as we need it to.

users.query: At first I was a little turned off by the texture of these screen protectors.  They are not smooth, which is what I suppose makes them "anti glare".  After using one for a week, I am 100% pleased.  Fits my Nexus 5 perfectly, went onto the screen smoothly.  Wonderful screen protectors!

cands.text: These Husqvarna sunglasses are perfect.  My husband has a pair in every vehicle we own.  They are perfect for driving and significantly reduce sun/road glare.

The screen is huge, but still fits in my pocket, and crystal clear.  The processor is wicked fast for gaming.  The android operating system is very user friendly and easy to customize.  The call clarity is great.  The speakers are loud enough to not need external speakers when you're listening to music.  Camera takes great pictures (and then I took the protective film off and it takes AMAZING pictures)

The charging jack is "upside-down" when compared to my previous smart phone (LG Viper), but that just takes a little retraining on my part.  Battery life is great, but of course it is, it's new... lol

I also got the "Poetic Slimbook Case" for it, which is (in one word) amazing.  Perfect if you want to take a credit card, ID, and a little cash, and leave the bulky purse/wallet at home.
These are not exceptionally bright, but I also went in with low expectations.  In a dark room they add a bit of ambiance.  I purchased one and ended up liking it enough to buy a second.
These are not exceptionally bright, but I also went in with low expectations.  In a dark room they add a bit of ambiance.  I purchased one and ended up liking it enough to buy a second.

These glasses remind me of the ones that my grandmother had when I was a kid.  Much to my surprise, these feel a lot sturdier, thicker, and much less likely to break than I remember.  They were packaged very well, and none were damaged whatsoever.

Top valid complaint... The seams that run vertically through the glasses are slightly irritating since they are so visible, but overall these are great glasses.

Top PETTY complaint... the stickers found on the bottom of each glass were very difficult to remove.  I got off as much as I could with my fingernails, and ran them through the dishwasher hoping to get a bit more off, with no luck.  I ended up hitting them with some goo-gone and got the rest off.

This case is perfect for my Nexus 5.  The card slots are perfect for carrying my credit card & ID without needing to bring my hulking purse with me everywhere.  The "bill flap" does not fit more than a couple bills, and bills need to be folded in quarters to fit without hindering the hinge, but that's no big deal.  Magnetic closure, TIGHT fit on my phone, I am 100% satisfied.  Thank you
The case fits well and looks nice, but is much more yellow than I was expecting. The reds aren't there.

These boots are very comfortable, light weight, and have very grippy tread.  My feet tend to get very hot after wearing boots all day, but that was not an issue with these, they breathe great.  I love the speed laces that can't pop off, and how wide the toe is on the inside.  They are great boots, I can see myself purchasing another pair soon, just in case they get discontinued!
These pillowcases were not as soft as I was hoping for, but aren't scratchy either.  My husband and I both like them well enough
I like the features, but the face is a little large for a Woman's watch.  It fits well on my wrist anyway
Did not work as well as advertised, cleaned but did not polish.  Ended up looking just as cloudy as before.
Did not work as well as advertised, cleaned but did not polish.  Ended up looking just as cloudy as before.
This shower curtain took quite a while to arrive (shipping from China), but it is beautiful.  The colors are true to the image, and it fits perfectly with my bathroom towels & floor mats

While this band fits very well and is completely adjustable, I developed a rash on the inside of my wrist where the two pins in the band met my skin.  For someone who is not sensitive to nickel, this is great, but for me, I wish that I had saved the packaging to return it.
Nice and roomy, plenty l;ong.  Not very soft, not very warm.  Good pockets.  Very good pajama or lounge pants.  Thank you.

It took me a minute to figure out how to get it on, but it is truly beautiful.  My husband loved it, couldn't take his eyes off of me!  I was afraid that I wouldn't like the bottom because of it's asymmetric shape, but it just added to the beauty.  Absolutely wonderful top!!

I am XXL and wear out my shoes fast because of it.  These slippers last for a couple months (2+) before they wear out and you're walking on the hard sole instead of the plush padding.  To be expected when you're my size.  This should not reflect badly on Isotoner's slippers.  They fit wonderfully and are VERY comfortable, until they wear out.

These really do reduce noise, and are VERY comfortable in the ear.  They come with 3 different sizes of ear pieces, so you're sure to get a great fit.  The replaceable tips are very soft.  After a while you forget you're wearing earbuds at all.

These gloves fit the bill.  They're warm.

However, they are quite scratchy (wool), and are not elastic enough to retain their shape.  After 15 or so uses, the wrists are all stretched out and too large to comfortably wear
These aprons cover well, and are nice and thick.  The strings are long enough to more than cover my 2XL frame.  Staggered pockets are a little odd, but the top one is perfect for an iPod!  Thank you!
I got this for my husband, and he likes it.  His only complaint is that it's not spicy enough.  I have no tolerance for spicy things, and thought it was very spicy, so it's up to personal preference.

I was looking to direct the image coming out of my cable box to two TVs, and this should have worked.
However... the two HDMI output ports seemed loose, and resulted in a flickering picture.
AND - IT DID NOT SUPPORT 1080P as advertised.  I bet I got a bad box.
Returned with no issue, purchased a different brand with hopes of better result.  Thank you Amazon!
This fits perfectly between my litter box and toilet, which makes it perfect for scooping duty.  The container itself fits grocery bags perfectly, so cleanup is a breeze.  Recommended fully.

Coffee has to be HOT in order to dissolve this syrup.  If you wait and the coffee cools off a bit, it ends up just being flavorful sludge in the bottom of your cup.  Good flavorful sludge, but not what I had anticipated.

As long as the coffee is HOT, the flavor is AMAZING.  I would buy again.

We have an A-frame bedroom - ceiling meets in the middle at the peak, no straight walls.  I wanted something that I could put on our bookcase headboard to show the time on the opposing wall/ceiling.

Cons: SUPER BRIGHT display.  Being on top of the headboard, it was too bright.  Casts a red light on the bed.  Placed something in front of it and it's no longer an issue.  We didn't need to see the clock face anyway.

Pros:  Projection is clear.  Numbers are about a foot tall, about 10 feet away.  Alarm feature is nice, can use iPod or other media instead of beeper.  Snooze button is LARGE, plenty easy to find in the dark.  Projector arm easy to adjust.

Overall, I would recommend this product.  It would be nice if you could dim the display, but it's not a deal breaker.

users.query: I love hearts of palm, but these were NOT GOOD.  The pieces were small, they were woody (very hard and fibrous) and just overall not good.  I ate them all (I can't waste food), but I won't be getting them again.

cands.text: I've now tried about 5 different kinds of canned hearts of palm, and these are by far my favorite.  They are the perfect texture (I like mine a little on the soft side) and they aren't too salty.  With S&S, the price can't be beat!
I'm on a quest to find a good brand and these are not it. THey are better than others, but most of the pieces are really hard and woody. UPDATE: DeLallo Whole hearts of palm are my go-to! B001M20UXC
I get these through the subscribe and save and I've done the research - this is the best price.  And they taste great.
Orbit is usually my go-to gum brand, and is also usually a great product, but these pieces are hard and not at all refreshing.
These are a great little snack, but too oily and salty for me.  I usually eat regular sushi nori sheets though, so I'm a bit biased.

I've tried Gimme, Annie Chun's and other brands of Korean roasted seaweed, and these are my favorite.  They also happen to be the cheapest  The 24 pack, with S&S is only $8.50, which comes out to 35 cents each!  They are smaller than some of the other packages, but they are the perfect size for a very light snack and to quell the salt fiend.  Other brands are either too oily or too salty, and I didn't get that with these.

These taste EXACTLY like those nasty 80s snacks - Bugles.  Remember those cone-shaped things?  They taste like oil and salt, but not in a good "french fry" kind of way.  Imagine biting into cold oil on cardboard, covered in salt, and that's what these taste like.

I bought these because I was kicking myself for not getting the green and gold Pumas several years ago.  I love Saucony Jazz shoes, and these feel very similar to those - thick and squishy soles with enough support to feel like sturdy shoes.  The tread is pretty aggressive, so I can even wear them in the winters when the sidewalks are coated in ice and snow.

They are so comfortable - like walking on PILLOWS!

I love this brand overall and I've been addicted to the noodles for years now. I subscribe to have them delivered monthly (12 packages....it's an expensive addiction, I know).  I thought I would try the rice last month just to see how they stack up and well, let's just say I won't be getting them again.  Not bad, but the too-small "rice pieces" just sort of melt into whatever you cook them in.  I ate a stir fry over them and they just turned to mush.

I've gotten so many compliments on these knives!  I am a knife snob, so I really got them for their looks; to put on my magnetic knife strip, but they almost completely replaced my use of my $200 Henckel knife now.  I love them!

I LOVE these noodles.  I get a box of 6 packages every month and I have to ration them to make them last. I have been getting them for about 6 months now and never had a problem.  The last delivery I got came after a few really cold days and they arrived frozen. I just stored them as normal in my pantry, but when I went to cook with them, they had lost more than half their volume and never plumped back up when cooked.  They tasted HORRIBLE and I had to throw them out.

This isn't a negative review of the product (which I LOVE!!), but rather a caution for those ordering this in the winter in cold climatees.

I borrowed my friends pair of these several times and then decided I needed them.  I seriously love these boots!  They are cute AND comfrotable, a rarity for sure.  I'm super picky about shoes, but these fit the bill for all my needs.  They look great and dress up a skirt without making you feel too dressy.

These shipped SUPER fast, and came packaged really well.  The first time I tried to brew a batch, they didn't work, but I think the grains were just tired or pissed from being jostled in the mail.  After three days and no fermenting, I poured the sugar water out, and re-started.  They have been perfect since then and I'm getting growth now, too!

The 2nd ferment is key for a good fizzy drink.

I've had these on my S&S list for several months and EVERY SINGLE TIME they arrive dented.  Usually ALL of the can, but sometimes there are 3-4 that aren't dented.  The box they are packaged in (not the mailing package) is ALWAYS also damaged, usually taped up.  It's a shame because I love these -- the perfect texture and taste - but I'm really sick of getting sub-par product.
These took FOREVER to arrive, so don't order if you need them right away.  They aren't as smooth as most bamboo needles, but for the price, I didn't expect much.

I was not expecting much from this coffee, but it was a great flavor - no bitterness, not too sharp, very deep and rich tasting.  Almost chocolately.  I always use my french press, and this was a great eye-opener in the morning.  Definitely will buy again.

DO NOT waste your money on this.  This is not gum, I don't know what it is.  The little pellets are SUPER hard,  no matter how long you chew them, and they don't even taste good.  The package sounds big, but it is actually really small.  Like smaller than those plastic packs of real gum at the gas station, and twice as expensive.

I ordered these in early spring in WI.  They came in a box with frozen packets to keep them from melting.  Unfortunately, they were completely thawed, and about half the bars were water damaged.  The other half were broken into many pieces.

They taste great though, so as long as you don't mind baking with broken pieces it is fine.  Amazon refunded my money, too.

I love beef jerky and I love this brand and flavor of beef jerky.  But when I opened this bag and reached in excitedly, I found that all of the pieces were either 1) ROCK HARD and impossible to chew or 2) soft, stringy, and crumbly.

I'm hoping it is a bad batch, but since I can't return it, I'm stuck with a pound of nasty beef jerky.

I've tried almost all the different peanut flours and honestly, the ones that have nothing added to them and are just peanuts all taste the same.  This JIF, surprisingly, is just peanuts.  All the reviewers saying that they don't like this or that PB2 is better, are really just syaing that they like it better with sugar and salt added.  Which, fine.  But you can add those in yourself.  Or just buy the PB2, which is about twice as much.

For $5, I wasn't expecting much and was actually pretty skeptical.  It does work though, and it fast.  The picture here makes it look a lot better though - when you add the coffee and the mug becomes yellow, you can still see the sad face.  (The yellows don't match exactly).

Still, for $5, I wasn't expecting perfection and this is super fun.

I have been using Crayola since I was a kid (I'm 36) but they were starting to feel "soft".  These were supposed to be harder, and I was looking for new colors.  While there are some different and new colors in this set, they are mostly similar to the 50 count from Crayola.  However, this set doesn't have all the basics - there isn't even a RED??!!

Also, I don't find them any harder than Crayola, in fact they may even feel softer.  Still, great pencils and feel very sturdy in your hand.

I got this as a gift for Christmas and I LOVE it.  This is going to sound silly, but in my 36 years, I never really "learned" how to color.  I'm a scientist, not an artist.  I have been using adult coloring books for stress relief and to feel creative for the last 4-5 years (yep, before this big craze, I was HIP!) but I mostly just colored with colored pencils like I did when I was a kid.  At my most artistic, I'd use light and hard pressure to get different effects.  Then, I read the front part of this book, and looked as some of the example photos and saw how much more can be done with shading and using multiple colors in the same space.  I've fallen even more in love with coloring because of this book!!  I've already colored half the pages in less than a month.  I can't say enough for this book.

I attached a few pictures from here, to show what I have been able to do.

The best part is that these look complicated, but I think the most time I spent on one of them was maybe 3 hours.  Most I've finished in 1 or 2.  I'm an instant gratification kind of girl, so that's important to me.
This is exactly what it says it is, and is much less expensive than other cacao butters.  I have only used it to make white chocolate, but it works great.

users.query:
Really enjoying this series. I loved this just as much as book one in the series.
I was looking forward to Connor's story after reading Forging Bonds. I was not disappointed! I love Connor. He and Harry are perfect together.
This is a great cast of characters. And the author does a good job of getting you into the characters head. I thought her depiction of Harry was wonderful.

It was great seeing Tate & Chris' relationship progress. I like that the book didn't just focus on Connor & Harry but also Tate & Chris and Jesse & Mark. Again, this is a great cast of characters. We were introduced to some new characters I hope to learn more about. And I liked the introduction of the MC. I hope we see them again as well, especially Pony.

Looking forward to more of this series. And I'm going to give a shout out to these book covers, they're absolutely beautiful!

cands.text:
I loved finding out about Christopher & Kyle's history. These two are so beautiful together! Sweet, sexy and so in love.  Protective Christopher's love & affection for Kyle is just swoonworthy!

This can be read as a standalone. But I highly recommend you read the Joshua series as well if you haven't tried it yet.  Grein creates fantastic characters and in turn great relationships.

I loved this book and can't wait for more in this series!

The characters are fantastic! I absolutely adored Sean and Mason. The secondary characters were just as great. Even though they are ball players and the book deals with their careers, the story line is not weighted down by it. So even if you are not a baseball fan, you can still enjoy the book.

This is a great friends to lovers book, brilliantly written with great characters and a believable story line. I felt every emotion these guys did as they fought for their HEA.
The Epilogue was by far one of my favorites, just perfect!

Looking forward to the next book in the series, Cam & Jason's book "Curve Ball"

Def. recommend! 5 stars

I loved this book! I had a lot of trouble putting it down when life rudely called me away. I could of easily devoured this in one sitting.

I liked both MCs a lot along with Connor, a secondary character, who it appears will be in the starring role of book two in the series. *happydances

The sex scenes were off the charts good! Very descriptive...smokin' hot!
I enjoyed the plot immensely. And watching the relationship unfold between Tatum & Christopher. I loved these two together from the start. It was beautiful seeing Christopher learn to trust again after what he was put through by his ex (sorry no spoilers here).
My only complaint would be the resolution of the story line involving Tate's father & brother seemed rushed to me. I would of liked that played out a little further.

This will surely be a reread for me. Looking forward to more of this series.
I would definitely recommend this book!

5 stars

I'm sad that this series is over. But wow, what an ending!
This book was beyond fantastic and my favorite of the series! Even though this can be read as a standalone, I highly recommend the whole Barretti Security series!

Zane and Connor were both special characters to me. And the character growth both individually and as a couple was amazing.
The Epilogue was wonderful and wrapped up the whole series nicely!

I'm going to miss the hell out of all these guys! Thanks to Sloane for sharing them with us!
Just throwing this out there...I wouldn't mind seeing a Brennen book down the road (bats eyelashes at Sloane Kennedy)

Sloane Kennedy is a fabulous writer who gives you great story lines, great characters and tons of emotion. She is one of my favorite authors and an auto-buy for me. Please check her out if you haven't, you won't be disappointed.

5 stars

This series is so addicting, it's my crack!
This book was too short (pouts) but AWESOME! I laughed, I cried, I rolled my eyes (seriously Maddox? WTF ugh!)

I see some people are upset with the direction the author took this book, but not me. I said in my review of Book 2, I was on team Jamie. I wanted Hawke and Jamie together! And I patiently (well not really patiently) waited til midnight when the book downloaded to my kindle to see if I'd get it. Luck was on my side, or was it on Hawke's side. Because in my opinion, Jamie is the right man for Hawke. I believe that with all my heart. I am not going to defend my position on this nor am I going to bash anyone who disagrees. I just want to say I was into Maddox in the last book, I really was. I do believe he loves Hawke, in his own way. However, the dinner party scene with Hawke's family in that book was really the turning point for me. That was when I started feeling a real connection between Hawke and Jamie. A connection Hawke didn't have with Maddox. Yes, he had feelings for him but even then, I believed it was more obsession than real love.

Now I see Book 4 is Joss' book. And I'm anxious for that one. But please, please tell me we're going to get more Hawke and Jamie. I have an itch and I need my fix, please Charity!

There was a couple editing issues in the beginning of the book. The wrong character names used (Jamie instead of Hawke, if my memory is correct) but other than that all was well. Loved the book, love the series!
*It's important to this story to read (at least) Book 2 in this series first. But you do get some Hawke/Maddox story line in Book 1 also.

This book had all the feels! A great addition to this phenomenal series. This is the best in hurt/comfort reading. Sloane outdid herself, honestly the books just keep getting better and better! Looking forward to Vincent's story. Highly recommend! 5 stars

Beautiful!
So much love for Jack, Liam, Big Jack & Jeremiah.
We also got exciting news on Chase & Gray and Xavier & Ben!

This is just a fantastic series by an amazing author. Highly recommend! Can't wait for J.J. & Miller's story!

I had been wanting Teague and Hudson's book from the beginning of the series. I was not disappointed! This was my favorite in the series so far! I love these guys and they are so perfect together. This book deals with some difficult issues and Nicole Edwards does a fantastic job! This was well written, emotional, sexy and heart warming. I can't wait for Roan and I assume Colton's(?) book. Roan needs his HEA! 5 stars

This series is so unbelievably addicting! Like the previous two books in the series, I read this in one sitting.

Again, so much going on...intertwining story lines and so many characters but you never get confused about what's going on. It's easy to follow because the writing is that good!
Some characters I liked in the previous books grated on my nerves in this one. Some characters I didn't like in the previous books won me over in this one. And I really enjoyed where Jake is taking some of these story lines.

Jake did not disappoint with Season Three. In my opinion it was the best season yet! And ends with another amazing cliffhanger that has me asking...when will we get Season Four?

Please note this is an on-going series that you must read in order. If you haven't I recommend you give it a try.

5 stars

I really enjoyed this book. I liked the story line and absolutely loved this cast of characters. I'm looking forward to getting more stories of these hot detectives. My only complaint was the editing. This book had so many errors and it did get distracting at times. But I will definitely continue with the series. I can only hope this author seeks out an editor for future books.
4 stars

I'm really enjoying these books! Considering the books in this series, have at least to this point, revolved around a homeless MC, the books are not angsty. They are fairly light and very heartwarming. Great characters you can't help but root for. And this one featured an amazing dog named Jake.
I'm definitely enjoying these stories, and would recommend!

I loved this book. Great MCs, total opposites, but they have fantastic chemistry.
This is a sweet & sexy read with wonderfully descriptive writing. I felt like I was right there in the scene with the characters. And great secondary characters as well. I adored Granny and Billie especially.
A romance with low angst I highly recommend.

Absolutely loved this book! Fantastic menage! Ren, Declan, and Jagger really did complete each other. These men cared for one another and helped each other heal.
My heart hurt for Ren and all he was going through. I appreciated Declan & Jagger taking their time, helping and not pushing Ren as he tried to come to terms with his grief and guilt over what happened to his Special Forces team. And Declan & Jagger were not without their own griefs either.
I thought the author did an awesome job dealing with Ren's PTSD.

I loved all three of these MCs but my heart was taken by a secondary character in this book...Connor.
Connor and Zane's story is next in this series. And it's going to be another emotional one. I can't wait!

5 stars
Good start to a series. I liked the characters a lot. I'm looking forward to the next book.

It was a long time coming waiting for this book. But it was so worth it!

This book wasn't as angsty as the others in the series but it definitely packed a punch. It also had some humor throughout that helped lighten the story. I loved Brandon and especially Mason in the previous books. We didn't know a lot about them but I just knew there was a story there. I knew these two belonged together and was jumping for joy when I heard they were indeed getting a book.
From the beginning of the book, you'll see the signs that this relationship goes beyond friends, even if they don't. There is an intimacy between them. Brandon going to Mason's apartment in the middle of the night when he can't sleep. Even after getting drunk at a bar and going home with some anonymous woman he picked up. Referring to the pillow as his pillow, and his side of the bed, brushing Mason's hair off his forehead. The banter they have every time he crawls into Mason's bed. No, there's nothing physical going on but it's intimate as hell. And something they both need.
I loved seeing their relationship go from friends to being true to each other. Not just lovers because they really are soulmates. But Brandon has to do some soul searching and deal with some tragic events in his past. That was an incredible journey to take with him. The scenes with Brandon and the therapist were so well written and in my opinion, realistic. There were also some intense and heartbreaking scenes, the cemetery scene being one that will stick with me for a long time.
These two had good communication and I appreciated that Brandon took the advice from the therapist and Cam to heart. And I adored not only his but also Mason's relationship with Brandon's mom. And that Mason was doubtful at first of Brandon's feelings.

So I loved everything about this one. We get Cam and Jake's (Out of the Blue MCs) wedding, catch up with Kris and Gray (Black & Bluhe) and of course get more time with Jet. And now we have another fantastic couple, shh!...but they may be my new favorite!
And then there's the family this unit has created together. Just a super bunch of characters you can't help but love!
5 stars!

*I know these books can be read as stand alones but I highly recommend reading the whole series. You really would get a better understanding of all the characters in doing so. And you will be so invested in all of them and their relationships. R.J. Jones is a fabulous story teller. And although she makes her guys work for their HEAs, you can be guaranteed they'll get it!

This is one of my all time favorite series. I just can't recommend it enough!
I am so ready for Jet's HEA...BRING IT ON R.J.!!!!

Wonderful addition to a fantastic series. Tomas and Wesley were perfect together, I love them both! It was nice catching up with the gang. And we got to spend time with Sebastian and Adam from Aimee's 1st book - Only You.
Looking forward to Maddox's story.
Highly recommend!

Great debut and a fantastic start to a series from a new author. I really enjoyed this story. I liked the plot and the characters - both main and secondary. Looking forward to getting to know these guys more...Cooper, Sawyer, Jackson especially...I really want their stories!
MC Cade was sexy, growly and just awesome. Braden was wonderful. Sweet, loving and just beautiful! I loved his character growth!
I liked the author's writing style. My only complaint would be head hopping between the characters often and without a section break or whatnot. I admit I got confused a couple times, especially in the beginning of the book. It might of interrupted the flow of the book for me just a bit. But I was never discouraged from finishing the book as the story was just that good!
Can't wait for Book Two!
4.5 stars

Gah, I could slap myself for waiting so long to read this series.

Going Under was perfection for me.  It was a heartwarming story of self acceptance, trust, patience, friendship and love. Perfect blend of sweet, sexy and angsty.
Kade always does an amazing job with the characters he creates. Such great character growth! Eddy & Kyle were wonderful together. I loved, loved, loved Eddy! He is going on my list of forever favorite characters.
And the Epilogue was absolute perfection!
Highly recommend!

I love this series so hard. This was a fantastic addition to the series.  I was looking forward to Derringer and Nathan's story and was not disappointed. I love both these characters. And I thought their struggle was written perfectly and the story well paced. I would definitely recommend this whole series.  Looking foward to the next book! 4.5 stars

Perfect.
I absolutely loved this book. What a great start to what is no doubt going to be another fantastic Sloane Kennedy series. This book has it all and will take you on a roller coaster of emotions. I fell so hard for both Dallas and Nolan. These are two incredible men with big hearts and a lot of love to give. They've both had a rough time of it in the past and can't seem to catch a break. And they have some obstacles to climb on the road to their HEA. Be warned: This book will definitely cause you to shed some tears. But that ending...it's everything!!
I can't recommend this book enough. It's well written and has fantastic characters (including some amazing animals, the story revolves around a wildlife rescue/sanctuary after all). I loved a few of these secondary characters and am hoping we see books for them in the future. I know we get a Maddox and Isaac book next. I was intrigued by Maddox and loved Isaac in this book, so I can't wait for their story. I know it's going to be another emotional one.
I haven't read a S.K. book I didn't like, and this one is going to the top of my favorites list. Her writing just keeps getting better. Just beautiful!
5 stars

I've loved every book from Sloane Kennedy I've read so far. This is my new favorite!
Wow, the feels in this book! This is an extremely emotional book. It is very heavy in some places and can be hard to read. (Please note: there are trigger warnings for childhood sexual abuse.)
But as normal for me with Sloane's characters, I was so invested in them and their lives, I could barely be bothered to put the book down. And as excited as I was for their HEA, I didn't want the book to end.

I fell in love with Jonas, Mace, and Cole. All three of them were exceptional characters and the secondary characters were just fantastic! The way their relationship unfolded was perfectly done!
This was M/M/M done right! And their story was engaging from the beginning. Just amazingly done! I can't recommend this book enough!

 5+ stars  I can't wait for the next one! I need Ronan's story like I need air!

I am a huge Piper Vaughn fan! I haven't had the pleasure of reading any of Kenzie Cade's work yet, but will correct that soon. These ladies write very well together! This book was well written and had plenty of attention to detail throughout with great character development..

Now, I've read lots of variations of shifter books. I loved the idea of a hedgehog shifter, and was not disappointed!
I loved Avery! Yes, he was selfish, judgmental and bratty in the beginning. But I knew just from some of the inner monologue, it was an act. At least, most of it was. He grew a lot throughout this book.
Dylan, damn Dylan was hot! Growly, protective, rugged and sexy-as-hell. I LOVED Dylan!
There was also a wonderful secondary cast. This is a great group of guys, looking forward to more of them!

So this is a enemy to lovers, shifter style. With a delicious slow burn and yes....knotting!
I liked the mystery plot, I think that had a big part in 1) Avery's demeanor change and 2) the relationship progression between Avery and Dylan.

Looking forward to rest of the series. Highly Recommend 4.5 stars

"It's okay, baby," Noah whispered. "I'll be strong for the both of us this time. You can have the next turn."

Omg, I was dying for Noah's book after reading "Crush." It did not disappoint!

Noah and Troy have been best friends since they were little kids. They are soulmates and are so damn beautiful together, it'll make you cry! And that proposal was oh so perfect! So many feels in this one!

I didn't think I could love a book in this series more than "Shatter" but damn if I didn't love this one just a bit more. These two guys broke my heart then pieced it back together. So very, very good! Def. recommend this series!

Looking forward to more in this series.
And I loved Gunnar in this one and his book will be the first in a new Charity Parkerson series called "Low Blow" coming this spring! *Happy Dance*

One of the most addictive series I have ever read!
Highly recommend if you're a fan of paranormal/fantasy M/M books.

Brenda, please don't ever end this series! 5 Mad Dog stars
This book was very well written. The plot was well developed and the characters were engaging. Just a fantastic read! I enjoyed the hell out of it and look forward to more in the series! 5 stars

users.query:
What a beautiful card for your mom one Mother's Day. No detail left behind.

The butterfly and components on the vibrant red cover are in relief. The flowers are glittery tulle and there are foil leaf accents.

Open the heavy-duty card and a beautiful message fills the inside, inlaid on a thinner detail-edged smaller sheet fastened but still "flappy," which makes it sound much less elegant than it is.

The envelope is silver and included is a sheet with instructions to place on the card front before placing in the envelope to protect it from mailing sorting machines.

It is definitely one of the pricier greeting cards out there but it is absolutely beautiful and high-quality...worth it, especially for mom.

cands.text:
Very cute birthday card with lots of detail and great quality. Comes to you in a clear mylar (?) sleeve to protect it. The card itself is 4 5/8" x 6 3/16". Printed on nice quality thick cardstock, the cover is double-thickness as the characters' eyes and two bellies are die-cut and it sandwiches a clear sheet to give those openings shine.

The whimsical swirl illustration continues on the inside, where it says "so glad you're in MINE. Happy Birthday"

The envelope is unique in that the flap is not only contoured unlike a standard envelope, but it is on the shorter dimension. It also has the Just Wink logo with partial embossing on the flap. On the addressing side, it has a printed rectangle to indicate the place to put your stamp. Not a fave for when you are delivering the card yourself, but not a huge deal.

This stamp set is very cool. Even if you never use the circular pattern templates, you will love the selection of 18 stamps included with the kit. Perfect for that decorative touch to stationery, wrapping paper, and more.

Easy to use, and with the grippy bottoms on the templates and stamp holder, it's simple to get even spacing when you are using the pattern templates.

What I didn't like about this kit is the packaging. While well-designed aesthetically, it was poorly designed from a functionality standpoint. It's hard to open without destroying it, and not meant to store the kit when not in use. I ended up tossing it, even though I tried to save it by using an X-acto to get the stamps.

Overall, a really fun set. It works well with both ink- and pigment-based stamp pads (not included).

Happy stamping!

I am a big fan of Fossil purses and handbags -- so when this bag arrived, was excited to unbox and start stuffing it to carry as my new purse.

Sadly, I was disappointed. What is shown in the photo is the trick of fabulous lighting and just the right retouches. In real life, the purse does NOT look like a quality Fossil bag as one would expect. It is the tooth-edged detail on the flap that "cheapifies" the bag. The tooth-edge is not cut uniformly so the imperfections stand out and look like snags in the leather. This does NOT look at all like a bag that retails for $178. Nowhere near. And although it is genuine leather, it doesn't have the soft feel one might expect and I had to second guess if it was real leather or not.

Putting the major flaws, the purse as a purse? I love the size. It is just right to put your necessities in, including the open pocket in the back that is advertised to hold an iPhone 6. I do not have an iPhone, but have a Galaxy S7 (not the exploding one) with an Otterbox Commuter on it, and it easily fits into the pocket and is easily retrieved.

The inside has two pockets -- an open one that goes half way to the bottom on the flap side (perfect for a lipstick or even a checkbook), and a zippered pocket that goes to the bottom in depth on the back side.

The strap is plenty long enough for crossbody wear on the average sized body, but it is adjustable belt-buckle style with 5 holes, each about 1 1/4" apart.

Sadly, not a good buy at all. You could probably find a knock-off style for much, much less, to be quite honest, and see the same visual quality. (Because I still think this is sewn quite well, so it won't fall apart after a month like a cheap brand might.) Keep shopping.

As a jotter and doodler, I always enjoy a nice journal notebook to have with me wherever I go. This journal, about 6" x 8", is lightweight, yet hardcover. Two features that don't usually go together, but in this case, delightfully do.

SPECS: The cover is about 1/8" thick, and the journal itself is 0.5" thick. It is a brilliant red (accurate to item photo pictured here), and has an alligator-texture. The elastic "fastener" is black, as is the inside cover and opening and closing pages. The writing pages are lined with 26 lines for all your brilliant ideas and deep thoughts (there are less pictured in the product photos -- wide ruled vs. college ruled? Not sure but mine has 26). Each page is also conveniently numbered and has a place for date. To the left is a small break in the lines so you can number things or indent or find some other creative use. Also has a black bookmark ribbon. The back inside cover also has a pocket that pleats out convenient for keeping receipts or notes, or leaves from your nature walk.

THOUGHTS: I've already stated above that I love how this is hardcover, but also light. Additional features I like:
-- "Loose spine" -- you know, it opens fully easily without creaking and cracking. Perfect for using back pages (left spread), and for lefties.
-- The paper is good quality. If I'm pencil sketching and want to erase, it will take a pretty good amount of erasing without ripping. Paper is smooth and really nice for rolling that ball point over it too.
-- It's PRETTY and BOLD. It looks professional -- you could take it to work for meeting notes -- and it isn't boring.

My only qualm is the price point seems a little high. Quality doesn't come cheap, but still. A few dollars less would seem more fitting.

First off, don't worry about shipment of this basket. It comes in a box inside of a box, so all your goodies will be intact.

Now, for the goodies themselves. Hate to say it, but they weren't anything to write home about. The best items in the basket were the nuts and the Ghiradelli chocolate squares. Everything else was in typical gift basket fashion -- big boxes with lots of padding and not much inside.

One of the most disappointing was the popcorn. It's a wannabe Harry & David's Moose Munch, but nowhere near as fresh or "plump" as the H&D. And I am not sure if it was just my basket, but the cheese looked a little old -- it had some browned edges and didn't look very appetizing at all.

The basket looks fantastic, but it didn't come with the quality of contents that I hoped for. I would not give this as a gift.

I cannot say enough about how fantastic the Buddha Board is. It's so much more than a toy -- it's a tool for artistic expression, stress release, and appreciation of the present.

Such a simple concept -- painting with water -- with a "magical" twist in that the drawing looks like black ink. Then, poof! It dries and you're back to an empty canvas to start again. If you're not into the "deeper" meaning of impermanence and learning to let go, then you can at least appreciate the environmental qualities of the board in that you are only using water, and you aren't wasting page and pages of paper. Perfect to practice calligraphy!

Although I bought this one for myself, I plan to get a few more to wrap up for the holidays. I can't pass by it once without painting something new. I can feel the stress fading away as I paint something new, and then as the water dries every time...
