I loved every single page of this book!!  I can't wait to read the books that will follow!  This is the first book I have read by this author, but it is only the beginning, I am now a fan!!  WELL DONE!!!

ABSOLUTELY AWESOME!!!!!!!!!!! This is an amazing conclusion to this trilogy! K. Bromberg did one heck of a fantastic job writing this trilogy! I was sorry to see it come to an end! The characters are so awesome and the story is WONDERFUL!!! There is so much that can be said about this but it would ruin it for other readers. I highly recommend this trilogy - you will be glad you read it!! I will definitely be reading it again! This is one of the best trilogies I have read since 50 shades!!! This author is to be commended!!!
This is the third part in this series! It is totally awesome,  each book in this series keeps you on the edge of your seat and involved in the story line!  I loved it!

I love this book. It's told in a different perspective and it's incredible! I read this in one sitting! I could put not it down!!! This is an AMAZING series that will hook you right from the beginning and keep you reading to the very end!! I look forward to more from this author. I highly recommend this entire series!!

I loved this book! What an AWESOME conclusion to this series. I ABSOLUTELY LOVED this series. I highly recommend this series. It is one that I will read again!

This was a TOTALLY riveting book! I could not put it down! I stayed up  until 2 am to finish. I loved it!!!!!  Gavin is my new hero.  He is wonderful!  I cannot wait till the second book comes out. I loved this book! It grabbed me right from the beginning and I could not put it down! An awesome rockstar romance  with plenty of lust, romance and intrigue! I can't wait to read the second book! I highly recommend this!

I loved this book! It grabbed me right from the beginning and I could not put it down! An awesome rockstar romance  with plenty of lust, romance and intrigue! I can't wait to read the second book! I highly recommend this!

I loved this story! It grabbed me right from the beginning and kept me hooked all the way to the end. It is very intriguing and had a lot of surprises right to the very end!  I totally loved it!!  Great job by this author!

Kelly Favor never fails to please!!! I love this series!!! Even though I hated waiting for this book to come out, it was well worth it!!!! I LOVED it!! I could not put this book down, the story is riveting! I think we each book the author writes, she gets better and the story becomes more intriguing! I was absolutely thrilled to find out there will be two more books to follow yet!  I highly recommend this!!!!

This is an amazing story for a first time author!!! I loved it! She touched on the subject of an eating disorder with delicacy and finesse. I was totally  hooked from thievery first page to the last page! Charlie and Colin are wonderful characters and their story is AMAZING!!!! I highly recommend this book! I cannot wait to read book 2.

users.query: great for getting the sliding door drapes away from the glass so we have better sight of the birds.

cands.text: Perfect for holding some things for outside that are seldom used.

We have these two plus two that the birds can perch on.  Between the four we have about 10 hummingbirds using our nectar.  I did put in the shade because it is very hot here and the birds seem to be glad to get out of the sun.
They are wonderful.  Bought them for parties.  Makes it much safer when there are lots of folks around.

I was surprised that it isn't light as a feather.  It should stay put.  Love the colors and glad it doesn't take up much space.  We put several trees in our bay window each year.  Decorated all sorts of ways.  This is another one.
We had one in our DE home and left it there.  I got two more for our new home.  I really like them.  Easy to use and easy to install.

We used them for hanging folders that the boxes weren't made for.  The lid doesn't fit perfectly because of that but we just wanted them for moving and then will put the files back in the metal cabinets, so we are pleased.
Excellent for holding the garbage cans in strong winds as well as the gas grill.  Don't seem to weather like the regular ones do.

very eye opening.  besides the expose of the clinton white house, this gives details of the jobs of security.  That part has opened my eyes to the tough job security has.  I could have guessed but was glad he spent the time detailing the jobs.

Fun.  Interesting to see light bulbs go on in the characters minds.  Also to read the changes they made in themselves.  Will be trying recipes.  Hadn't thought about potluck at noon.  Great way to get a prayer group or Bible study going.
Easy to read; easy to follow; great for relaxing reading.

This is a delightful who done it.  Don't want to give anything away but you will enjoy the humor as well as trying to figure who committed the murder.  Also, I liked the descriptions of the "old" house.  This is a quick read.
Easy to read.  Easy to follow.  Great for relaxing reading.

I love almost everything about this pot - being able to set for the next morning to pre-setting for the pot to cut off to stopping the brewing in order to pour a cup to having the filter for filtering water.  Only thing that need to be improved is the location of the place to pour in the water.  I am left handed so I sometimes have trouble pouring in the water plus the only guide as to how much is inside - all other pots I have had, you could see the amount of the water on an outside of the maker; this one is in the closed part.  It certainly makes good coffee.
delightful and fun.  Amazing that a snowman can hide a dead man.
These are great to wear when the weather is humid.  I even wear to bed if necessary to keep my hair out of my eyes..
These are great!  We will be using for laundry when we travel.  As for now, I use to transport clean stuff upstairs.

These are wonderful.  where I could, I partnered two colors of towels and bath sheets with hand towels and washcloths.  I also used a couple for beach towels.  This open cabinet is hard to get into.  So it was hard to keep it looking in order.  With barely an inch or so to the sides, I got almost all there.  I have two bath rugs and two special towels for hair drying.  They fit in the 1 - 2:" space.
very good at keeping splatters off the stove.  Have to center on the pot/skillet or there might be a spout where some splatters will escape.

We've been using this for a couple of years.  No major problems other than an empty and like most people I decided the time and money it would take to reconcile this.  Would be more than I want to take.
love it.  wear an off white hat with blue trim and either a  white shrug or stole with it.  lots of compliments.
I keep holding it too tight so one end is always thinner than the other.  I'll get it right eventually.
Very different with surprises along the way.  Quick read.  Flowed nicely.  Few characters so I was able to keep up with them.  Covered short period of time with memories instead of flashbacks.
I am in the process of reading another of her books and expect to read all.
Very enlightening and informative.  I already knew most of the names so was glad to see how they fit into teaching about God/Jesus.

I read to get lost in the book.  This is the third or fourth of the Advocate series and probably the best.  I love the fact there are advocates for the children!  Even if the child is not being "good", the advocate is there for him/her.

users.query: Well all can say is they crimp well & seem to be good quality. these are small enough to use a hand crimp tool if you need to.  I use a dab of electric grease on wire to cut down on corrosion. need to get a few more sizes to have on hand. there's plenty in a pack for the home wrench. nice not to run town just to get 2 or 3 of these for a job.

cands.text: Good heavy well made tool that will last a life time, or when they decide to change a clamp design witch ever comes first.  But it is one of those must have tools to do the job rite and make it easier .
here is one nice wrench, quality for the money. will last for years & torques in both left & right hand threads.
here is one nice wrench, quality for the money. will last for years & torques in both left & right hand threads.
Good quality basic set. bought for a friend who was always needing a sparkplug socket. takes care of problem & useful gift too. can use with crescent wrench if have too.

These are good air chucks to have around, just thread on your favorite fittings and ready to go. great for those valves that you need to get straight on or dual wheels where the valve is facing in. also nice to have long pressure gauge to read your tires.

Seems to be well made, fit & finish, gears are tight & smooth, has some weight, super nice handle, the jury will be out on these for how long they will last. there is a steel handle in there & a reel nice short click, so will work nice in tight spots. I had good luck with my ACE brand 1/4 drive set. ( composite handle ) have not broke it yet in 6 yrs. your not paying for a polished handle. Still have my craftsman of many years, time to try something new & so far so good. I bought all 3 and if you can not break it loose why skin knuckles , that's why they make breaker bars, impact wrenches and the torch set.

They do what you need them for & is full set , ( no skips ).  a little thin on chrome but good quality otherwise. you can't loosen bolts with chrome but they look nice for a long time. worth the money.

Good all around plier, not as good as a channel lock but does the jobs that most people would use them for. the grips are nice & the jaws seem to hold up well. plus you have a removable soft jaw on the big pair. the only week point I can see is the short rod ( if you somehow bent it.) that would mess them up from working right & the neck for the through jaw is on the thin side, I don't know how much side force it would take to bend it & I just won't find out, that way they will last awhile.

Have the 90 and it comes in handy time & time again, this is another tool that comes in handy to.  ( bent the old set doing a no no.) these are good quality pliers that are another must have in your tool box, sad to see these made in China too. have to live with it I guess. still well made & fair price.

Well made clamp, I think you can use these for mounting more than just flags like some other people have stated. real nice finish and thick. I will soon find out how strong they are as have idea for a rack made with aluminum to carry extra stuff and these don't cost an arm and a leg.

comes in good case, seems solid made . only torques right hand. I needed both so had to send it back. remember as long as your torques are equal on most stuff you are good to go. if you need dead nuts, buy a top of the line one.

These are nice, a lot more air flow for your impact. the holes are larger than the regular sets. but mine will not plug in to my other sets, so plan on changing, or like I did make a hose up just for the tool & add tee on your hookup for the Hi-flow fitting, that way you can use both styles & save some money.

its cheap, it's heavy made, the threaded holes are off center,  but will work and makes a great conversation piece with your friends on how to properly drill and tap holes, even free hand without glasses.
Have used their staples for years,  I can say flat out they are good quality & never had a bad batch. it also pays to have a good gun.

Well at last broke down an own a pair of these. been using side cutters for prying them pins up, I did get good at it, but my push pins looked like crap. these sure make life a hole lot easier & they aren't much money. would recommend to anyone that has a lot of pins to pop.
Now I can replace the bad with the good & bought the pliers to remove instead of using side cutters to pry the heads up. There are lots of these on a Teryx.

So far so good with this wrench, use it on my V twin valve covers and works smooth with a gentle click. main reason I bought it was just for that. you do have to take your time & go slow , ( it is inch/lbs ) no gaskets, just sealer, needs to be torqued even or will leak. wrench has done well.
Bought all three. had to try them. a new spin on an old tool, I have a post on the 1/2'' ratchet.
Bought all three, had to try them, a new spin on an old tool. have a post put up on the 1/2'' ratchet.

Good quality faucet for the money. I am having to rewrite my review on this board because of what I had discovered. While the board does appear to be an Arduino it is a copy made in China. The description does not state that it is made in China or a copy. Now this may or may not give you any problems as it is a cheap board. The originals made by Arduino come from Italy and state that. I found I could not use this board as it would not accept any of the drivers offered by Arduino for their IDE. If someone has a work around it may be helpful and I also imagine that if you are using Linux there might be a work around. For some projects the cheaper knock-offs might be OK, but if you are looking for the originals you should stick with the ones made in Italy. When I compared this board with one I have purchased several years ago I noticed it had been made in Italy and works fine.

I did not read the 2 prior to this but I still thoroughly enjoyed it. Shady, backstabbing " friends/family". A crazy chick. And drama for days! One can't go wrong curling up with this book

I absolutely love Ashley & JaQuavis' books. This one, while not my favorite, was still a pretty good book. Kasheef & Alijia had a strange relationship that at times seemed kind of predictable. But true to A&J fashion, a major twist was thrown in & blew me completely away. This love story had an explosive ending that truly left me wanting a part 2.

I loved this story simply because it was told from a different standpoint. When drama is involved, everyone kind of wishes they were the fly on the wall when everything went down. In the case of this story, it's actually told from the fly on the wall's standpoint.

James is a handsome man who is not too flashy. He is quiet in demeanor but a good catch for any woman. James has a secret though. He is a predator who preys on lonely single mothers so he can have access to their little girls.

In a chance meeting, James meets Dominga at a bar. Dominga is a down on her luck single mother with a little girl named Olivia. After months of dating, James solidifies his place in Dominga and Olivia's lives by proposing to Dominga. They move away to another state away from all of their family.

Every Saturday, Dominga has a anding hair appointment that James uses to his advantage. He teaches young Olivia a new card game called Even Numbers but tells her their game is their little secret. Their is a shift in their household that Dominga just can't put her finger on. Will things change for better or worse?

I felt every single emotion one could feel while reading this book. I felt the love of Nine and Leaf. I felt the hatred Alice felt for Nine. I felt the wrath of Nine for those who crossed her path. I feel like I need an anxiety pill, my nerves are so discombobulated! T. Styles continues to pull her readers into her web, keep them captive the entire book and then leave them wanting more. I cannot wait to read the next story she is working on!

Between all of the hustling and scamming, karma is out to bite Keema on her ass! People she thought she could trust, prove her wrong time and time again. As much as she wants to change, life keeps knocking her back down.

Kendall Banks has written ANOTHER amazing book. my anxiety levels were high throughout the pages of this story. I can't wait to read whatever Mrs Banks has in store for readers next!

Of course Boss Bitch picked up right from where the last book left off, but it left me wondering who is the real Boss Bitch??? I actually expected for Mya to be killed off by now cuz that bitch is truly working my last nerve! I also expected to read more about Aaliyah & less of Precious. Anyway, Aaliyah seems to finally walk in her own path in life & less of her parents shadow. I just hope the next 200+ pages don't end as abruptly as this one

Now that's how you end a series!! Never expected Pharoah to be who he was revealed to be. I still don't like Persia and Christian Knight is bae! Kids to K'wan for penning such an amazing series. Can't wait to see what he has in store for readers next!

users.query: There's no more hot, immediate attraction followed by passion than there is with Greg and Marie. This bolt of lightning comes at an unexpected time in their lives leaving them to ponder there whole livelihood and future.

cands.text: While this book pulls at your heart strings, it dares you to be hopeful that things can truly work out for Darrin and Marybeth.... After all, they've had a steamy passion for each other for years! hot hot hot

That electric spark that just can't be shook is what happens
with Chandler and Genevieve. Then add in a large dose of bossiness and alpha male who is just finding his stride. All
Of that together makes for a steamy whirlwind romance.
Some people just have a spark between them the moment they meet while others start as a slow burn and become fiery passion. Both can be said with Mallory and Beau. Great read.
Jase and Piper have an understood forbidden attraction that turns into a passionate bonding. Hot hot hot read of second chances and determination.
Nothing hotter than a sexy spy with a need to rescue the damsel in distress. Love how Marcus and Dani fight each other even though they are drawn like magnets together.
Sometimes when you least expect it and even fight against it, you fall hard for someone.... Or that's what happened with Zack and Jillian. To second chance love and Kristen Proby for a great read!
Sometimes when you least expect it and even fight against it, you fall hard for someone.... Or that's what happened with Zack and Jillian. To second chance love and Kristen Proby for a great read!

Will has a way with his charms but when he meets Harper, he's left breathless by the love that she bestows to her brother. When he discovers how loyal and driven she is, he's drawn to her even more. When they unite, things heat up quite a bit!

Drew and Ashley have sparks flying from the first time they meet. She may be timid at first, but a fierce fire ignited with her that just want let loose while Drew tries to avoid temptation only to fall deeper! Great read!

Nate and Jules fight their attraction for a long time but their electric, passionate, sexy attraction is too much to handle. After a series of unfortunate events, will they fight to the end to be together??
This book had me all tied up in the passion and protectiveness displayed by Matt and Nic as they explore their new found fondness of each other!!
Nobody's past comes into play like Megan and Will's. Now it's learning how to deal with the passion at present and questioning the future of their love!! Great read!

Nothing says hotness like a fireman willing to pose in his half naked to help fight for the woman he seems to be continually drawn too. Harper and Adam can't resist each other and seem to have a passionate blaze between them... so how long with this fire burn???

Time has a
Way of not only changing physical appearances but also showing who people are on the inside. After many years. A new light is shown on how much chemistry and passion are between Cara and Josh. Great read!

What starts out as a slow burn for Paige, dawns on Kale as a passionate fire ignites. Now as life challenges each of them, does the fire inside stay lit as hoped? Terrific read as you explore this simmering heat!

Nothing goes together like a feisty woman and a demanding fellow... Or maybe it does in the adventurous RL Matthewson Neighbor From Hell book. Danny and Jodi aka Tinkerbell certainly show their determination when it comes to restraint and each other while chemistry and passion persist.
This book is full of new experiences and mysteries while loaded with steamy hot scenes of passion unfolding for Sarah and Dante.

You know it must be meant to be when you fall at the feet of a hot guy who you assume is there to assist you but instead owns the place. Never know where love will find you like in Grace and Jacob's story. Good short read.
This story is not hot and steamy but rather real life changing up anticipated events. Cameron and Parker's love shows determination and how the truth shall set you free.

This book has all signs of new, passionate, obsessive love for Zac and Evie with a large historical twist like Etta and Damien. Love the continued passionate devotion shown while fighting for those you love.
Even though Schwartz may be rough around the edges, Janelle seems to bring out a totally different side to him bursting with passion and insatiable desires to push the boundaries of "protector".
Oh how this broken man finds the glue that puts him back together without even realizing it. Christian truly needs Ana in all manners of life.
I have enjoyed each of the bad boy billionaire books. Each book is unique but still has that mysterious sexy bad boy as a main character. What female character wouldn't be attracted to that?
Destined love overcome by a multitude of struggles. Best book so far of this season... Especially since I was not fond of Book #2.
Addison adds spice to the Mitchell clan when she meets her new beau. There are lots of unsettling times during their Chase of love but definitely a great read.

users.query: This is McDonagh's best but also darkest play- a literary love child of Harold Pinter and Stephen King...

cands.text: While this book definitely does not break new ground, it is a fine example of modern Irish literature. The story is moving and beautifully written.

Forget A.S. Byatt, forget Tom Stoppard! Both writers are amateurs in comparison to the top wordsmith of the 20th century, Alan Hollinghurst. If Proust and Mann met and could reproduce, Mr. Hollinghurst would be their  love child. A haunting tale of impossible love, packed with beautifully  written arcana, this masterpiece will keep reading all night.

While reading the book, I was struck by all the similarities to Hollinghurst's amazing "The Folding Star". Both books feature a teacher who lusts after teenage boys, a trip by this teacher to a non-English speaking "old world" country and an unusual blend of historical fiction, unabashed erotica, and Proustian pyrotechnics.
The writing is quite wonderful in this book, but is not as dense or as high-brow as Hollinghurst's. Instead of impressing us with his vocabulry, Stadler brings a unique gay American sensibility to the novel, which gives it quite a different sensibility than Hollinghurst's.
While both writers will obviously be compared to Proust and to Mann, I find both Holinghurst and Stadler to be reminiscent of A.S. Byatt. Just like in some of Byatt's writing, the search for historical truth also parallels the search for truth in one's own life. I definitely recommend this book, although If I were to only read one of them, I would read the better book, The Folding Star

A gay romance novel for intellectuals, Andre Aciman's debut novel is an exciting trip into precocious mind of a young teenager who falls in love with an older man. While Aciman's debt to Proust is acknowledged by the author, one can hear echoes of Edmund White, Allan Hollinghurst and even A.S. Byatt in Aciman's melancholy prose.
Simply a masterpiece of American theatre. I don't think this play will ever be revived on Broadway because it really asks the audience to think throught the entire play.
While Douglas Carter Beane has written some very funny plays, this is not one of them. This is truly one of the worst comedies I've ever seen on a major stage.

This is a highly over-rated play. When performed by two actors who are less than stellar, the play comes off as yet another slight play about some very usual targets: Drunk Irishmen, stupid and vain Hollywood actors.
A very fascinating memoir by a living Musical Theatre legend. The book does have x-rated parts which are more bizarre than titillating.
A highly entertaining  Broadway tell-all by a nebbish playwright who gets caught up in the intrigues and politics of Broadway.
Another disturbing but impossibe to put down play by the young heir to Tennesse Williams, Edward Albee and Mamet. A must-read for LaBute aficionados.

A show about gay soldiers in WWII has with one the most old-fashioned romantic score in years...I personally thought the Rodgers & Hammerstein-influenced score is beautiful, heartfelt and served the book well. I laughed and cried when I saw the show's original production....You will too after hearing this score!

A masterpiece of "gay" literature and a superb book by any standard, this baroque tale of decadence in fin-de-siecle London, is a good introduction to the work of Alan Hollinghurst, THE wordsmith of the late  20th century.  Do read this book before reading "The Folding  Star", Hollinghurst's masterpiece. While The Swimming Pool Library is  very, very good, it is "The Folding Star" that will convince you  of Hollinghurst's status among the greats of English literature.

A wonderful beginning gives way to a mish-mash of verbiage. This is not a book, but a splice job of a book that was far from finished. The Invisible Man is a masterpiece, but these are simply loose ideas floating around.
This is a good first novel but a far cry from Umberto Ecco and Donna Tartt. There is too much Princeton nostalgia in this book and the writers' immaturity is quite evident in every page.

Peter Filchia is one of the world's foremost authorities on Broadway musical theatre. His encyclopedic knowledge of Broadway is second to none. Even diehard musical theatre fans will find wonderful new tidbits in this great book.

Peter Filchia is one of the world's foremost authorities on Broadway musical theatre. His encyclopedic knowledge of Broadway is second to none. Even diehard musical theatre fans will find wonderful new tidbits in this great book.

I read this book hoping that it was deserving of the Booker Prize. Unfortunately, it is a mildly entertaining novel which reads like 2nd rate Philip Roth. Do yourself a favor and read ANYTHING by Philip Roth- it will be much better than this mediocre novel.

Mediocre garbage by the same guy who wrote "Driving Miss Daisy". Yet another mediocre play about Southern jews. There is probably a great book or play to be written about jews in the South, but this isn't it

A major disappointment from the writer who gave us the "Folding Star" which is my favorite book of all times. This is a very boring comedy of manners. The story line and the characters are completely  uninteresting. While Hollinghurst is the premier English wordsmith, this  book represents a complete waste of his talents.
A must-have for fans of Sondheim. Great material and a perfect cast!
Victoria Clark proves herself to be a fine interpreter of both classic and modern American song. Her take on "Before The Parade Passes By" is alone worth the price of the CD.
While well written, this is a standard movie-of-the week script which belongs on the Lifetime channel.
This movie is excruciatingly slow-moving. The pacing is glacial and not much happens...Even diehard anglophiles will do well to stay away from this stinker.

users.query:
As reported by student it was bought for:
Bought for a class, but unlike some required texts, it was worth buying. Good information in an interesting way. Would recommend to those interested in the field of firefighting.

cands.text: Bought this to help scouts make a personal first aid kit. Nice size. Also bought some burn gel.
small cheap camera and you get what you pay for. Used it in my classroom and it did not last the year.
Great gift for a scout or any camper. Cool looking and portable.

Fun, educational game. I teach preschoolers with special needs and they really seem to like it. It comes in a sturdy box that also is used in game play. All oaf the parts are sturdy, which is important to me as it needs to hold up to frequent use. Many of my students are working on learning counting, identifying numerals, and understanding quantity. This game involves all those skills and does it in a fun way. I do not think the children realized they were learning. The game play also increases social skills- turn taking, sportsmanship, following directions.  I would recommend this for home or a classroom.
Very nice gift for an Eagle scout. Well designed and made.
Got it for my 10 year old, but enjoyed taking turns playing it during a car trip.  Fun and educational.

Bought this for a college student. Nice size. They often don't think of the things in this kit until they need it. Added some basic meds-- ibprofren, gas pills.. to it. Also added emergency money. They may have liked the money best now, but hopefully they will appreciate the kit later.

One of the few books I had to purchase for graduate school that was actually worth buying.  Finished reading it before class even started and read it again at the start of the school (preschool)year.  Great resource with usable information.

Fun game. Good for language, vocabulary, and visual discrimination. Knew what I was getting, but in retrospect would like slightly bigger cards. Did not use the game as stated, but modified it to be less competitive and more turn taking/work together oriented. Would recommend it to other teachers and parents.
Nice gift for a Eagle Scout. Good quality and looks great.

Wonderful and fun teaching toy. Use for sorting and counting in a variety of ways or use it in pretend play. Good for joint play, turn taking, pretend play, and fine motor skills. Some of my students with fine motor needs need two hands to squeeze the tweezers, but it says a lot for this item that they choose it.
Son bought it for his guitar.  Seems well made.  Son is happy with it and it was a great price.
It was what I expected, but worked better than I expected. Use it to make "snow" and treats in classroom and treats at home. For California kids, a great way to experience a bucket full of snow.

Bought this for my classroom. I teach preschoolers with special needs. Cute educational game for working on shapes and colors. Also teaches turn taking and  counting one to one as the students roll the dice and move around the board- even typically developing kids need to be taught how to move there pieces on a game board. The pieces are strong card board and the tokens, cupcake shape, are a strong rubber. Pieces are descent size, easy to see, but probably not appropriate for children who put things in their mouth. Game play is quick enough to maintain attention, while still emphasizing the skills I want them to focus on learning. Nice game for the price. Don't know that I would buy this one as a birthday gift, not exciting enough, but would be appropriate for ages 3 or 4. Many 3 year olds are not ready for this type of turn taking move around the board game, but it could be used as for pretend play or matching game until the child is ready for board game play.

Great brand, recommend it over other brands you may get at the store. Ordered it after using the java color and finding it really was better then the brands I could purchase locally. Started a project with another brand, but will finish with this

Bought this for a college student. Also bought the commuter first aid kit. This one has a little more in it, but I don't think it matters much. I added to both some meds such as ibuprofen and gas x. Also added "emergency" money. They may like the money better now, but hopefully they will like the kit when they discover they need something it has.
Good for camping too although I would add tecnu and burn gel.

When I saw this, I had to get it for my classroom (preschool special needs). I thought the children will love this and including learning with play is exactly what I try to do. I was not disappointed. The children love it. We use it two ways- the children use the cards to fill orders or we verbally state what we want and see if they remember everything. Before we started I asked the children what they thought the different parts were and sometimes we call them other things - peanut butter is also mustard, jelly can be special sauce. Another set (or two) would be nice so I could add more elements of learning such as counting and adding (2 cheeses plus 2 tomatoes equals 4 ingredients on my sandwich) but that will have to wait.

a bit pricy for what it is, but a nice and unique item for a batman collector. Worked fine, a bit hard to control (even for adults), but about what I expected from description. Did not expect to control direction, but was even a bit hard to take off and land (at least indoors) without hitting the ceiling or crashing.
works basically how it should, but not to exciting. Great for a classroom or party.

Great product.  Easy to use. Makes me want to open a wine bottle (not that I need any more encouragement).  Have bought it for others who enjoy wine.

Originally got this in 2009 it is now late into 2011 and this product is still working great.

It finally broke in 2013 due user error.  Tried the rabbit we received as a gift, which broke after a few months of use. After using a twist one a couple times, made my way to amazon and bought the same brand.  Have friends who bought a different brand after using ours and it did not last.
Looking at this to buy for a friend and thought I would update my review. The one I bought in 2013 is still working great 2016. Well at least it was the other day. I'll go test it now, just to be sure :)

The business card pages are as described and will work great for my purpose. I am using them to store business card size labels for my classroom so I can swap them when I change items in my class. The pages will keep them organized and clean when not in use. Will make it easy to find the right one too. Also purchased self adhesive poly pockets to put on shelves and bins.
Bought these based on other reviews. Good choice. Nicely weighted and looks good. Would get these again, but hopefully won't have too ( for awhile at least)

Great value for the money. Have only been using this about a month, but it holding up nicely and looks great. Especially like the ability to choose different angles. Fits IPad 2 perfectly. Auto sleep function works. Case stands without falling over even when I have it resting on lap and a blanket unevenly spread underneath.

Yamaha guitar owners your guitar may not fit properly. I measured before I ordered and it seemed to fit, but when I tried to close it the lid and base did not match up. It closes fine empty, so I am assuming the guitar is pushing it out just enough to throw it off. I did not force the guitar in, but upon inspection it does seem like the padding is puffed slightly above the closing line. Yamaha guitars are sometimes slightly larger than typical dreadnought guitars. Could work with it and remove some padding, but I don't think it would look very good. Sending back - I pay shipping to return :(

I like it, but I don't love it. I was hesitant about getting a rain jacket with buttons and do regret that decision, but I did not rate it any lower for that since I knew what I was getting. I hesitated because buttons take more time compared to a zipper and if it raining I don't want to fiddle with buttons. But the style looked cute enough I decided to go for it anyway. I regret it because the buttons are more difficult then I expected. Oh, well.
I marked it down a star because it fits right in the upper half and flares way to much in the lower half. In the picture it looks balanced, but on me it looks a bit strange.  However, it is good enough for a rain coat and works so far in light rain. The color is very nice and it seems well made.

users.query: I just finished this book and I LOVED it!! This is the first book that I have read in the Legend series and I can't wait to read the rest. This story had me from the first sentence, which is what all of Claudy's stories do. She is such an amazing author and has a way of pulling you into the story. Her descriptions seem so real that you can't help but feel like you are there, among all of the wonderful worlds/characters that she creates. I fell in love with Breslyn while reading this book and I can't wait to see how the story continues to unfold. Thanks Claudy for yet another AMAZING book. :)

cands.text: I absolutely loved this book!!! The story was amazing and I found it impossible to put down, once I started it. Claudy is an amazing author and I know that you will enjoy experiencing the wonderful story that unfolds. She will pull you in with the first sentence and you will be unable to stop. It has suspense, mystery, sex, love, action and characters that you will either love or hate with the same passion that she writes with. If you haven't read the Through Time series I can promise you it is an absolute MUST!! :)

I would give this book 7 stars if i could. From start to finish I was hooked and found it impossible to put down. Claudy creates such an enchanting world that you are instantly pulled in. This book had me from the very beginning and I found it impossible to put down. Claudy has a way of pulling you into every story that she writes, and this one was no different. I loved the chemistry between Chaz and Jethro and the way they interacted with one another was very entertaining and hot!!! I definitely recommend this book and would've given it more stars if it was an option. :)

I absolutely loved this book from start to finish. I read it out of order but even so you don't miss a beat. I enjoyed getting the back story on what transpired with the Queen and her mortal love. This is definitely a must read in the Legend series.

Another great book in the Dulcie series!!! I loved the story line and her trip to the Underworld was unforgettable. I actually found myself laughing out loud at the uniqueness of Dulcie and the situations that she gets herself into. I can't wait to see how the story continues in the next book.

Another great series by Claudy Conn!! I was pulled in right away and found it impossible to put down. I loved the way the story unfolded and the characters were incredible. I have already purchased book 2 in the series and can't wait to start it. I know I will be adding this series to my "must re-read over and over again" list for sure!!

I absolutely LOVED this book. From start to finish I was hooked, and couldn't put it down. I loved the story that unfolded and fell in love with the characters. Babs was by far my favorite and was a wonderful heroine.

Claudy knocked it out of the park with this one, as she always does. I definitely recommend this book and I know you won't be disappointed. :)

Rating: 4.5 stars
