These were prefect for what I wanted. Cheap waterproof LEDs. I mounted them under my truck for low level lighting that doesn't kill your night vision.
Tons of light for the money . Used a few times, be aware they get hot
Its cheap, it works and has two wires to hook up. The screen is very bright also. Works as my night light in my RV
This thing is awesome. Lasts about 12 ish hours on a full charge on the low setting. Its plenty bright, packs down small.

It pukes light everywhere. Not a very spot beam, its ok for slow speeds, but really kills vision if you want to use it at night at higher speeds. Also WILL LEAK, must be sealed yourself if you want to keep water out.

For the price I still like it, its a cheap LED bar. It works and with a little silicone it should stay water tight. Its easy to do when its clean and new, just take all the screws out of the face of it and add a little silicone bead all the way around. As a work light, reverse light or slow speeds its just fine.

These were a little finicky about how they were inserted into the sockets on my truck. If I pushed them all the way down, they didn't make contact, pulling them back up a tiny bit worked. I thought they might wiggle loose being up a little, but so far so good. I used them for the cab marker lights on my 2008 Ford.
Great on my heavy truck. They make a bit of noise at times, but do great when hot.
Nice and light and slim. Works well. Keeps screen off the table if laid face down.
Works great. A little bigger than some but no separate pieces to lose. Blue led is bright, but it didn't bother me. Two USB ports and will charge two devices at once.
Good Quality. Conductors are appropriately sized. But the colors are a little non standard. They do give you a sheet with each wire identified.
Works just like it should. Used as a replacement for the large "box" style one that did the same thing.
Works great IF you valve is directly on the tank. Mine is a straight shot and th water hits the back of the tank before it runs back out. Works great for me.

Awesome, spent 10 days under it, rain, dew heavy winds, worked great. 13x10 was good for two adults, two kids and a dog. Was a little tight when it was really raining, but worked fine. It drys very quick, and its light weight.

The straps are nearly useless, ok for the ground side, but not long enough for much else.
Very good for the money. Lots and lots of stitch patterns. Comes with a couple feet and needles too.
Works great with the torque app! Reads and clears perfectly on a few different cars.

users.query: The powder works really well to stop the bleeding when I clip our guinea pigs nails too low.  It doesn't happen often, but when it does...this product really does the trick.  The only issue I have with this product is that it can get all over the place if you are not careful.  It is messy.  That said, it works quickly and stops the bleeding.  I typically try to place the product in a small tray and dip the nail into the powder.  That said, when working with animals, powder products can spill and transfer really quickly.  I am going to do some research, and look for this powder in another form.

cands.text: We have 5 guinea pigs...Every other week I use these trimmers to cut their nails.  Clearly a quality nail trimmer is important to our family.  I have found these trimmers are safe and easy to use.  I have had a few different types of nail trimmers.  The Kaytee are my absolute  favorite trimmers.  I will be ordering these again!

Works great for securing the eyes of my felted animals.  Just a tiny bit...and it holds them in place.  Easy to use, not much needed at all...no mess.  I love Gorilla glue for many projects.  I don't want to have to re-do projects...I want to glue and get back to life.  That is what this brand allows me to do.  I depend on this glue, and trust it.

Great product.

I purchased this product for the full price....and have not received any discount for using it.  We used this product to fill our guinea pig litter boxes.  It worked really well.  It kept the smell away and cleaned up really well.  A bag lasted for a while too.  We switched to fleece liners for our cages, but if those don't work....I will be ordering more of this product.  It was easy to recycle, easy to use, absorbed the urine really well, and was a good amount for the price.  I was told about this product from another guinea pig owner, and that is why we tried it.  Glad we did.  It is nice to know it is available if the fleece don't do the trick.  Love that it can be delivered right to my door, and with Amazon Prime that is free.

Update:  I don't like the fleece liners in the guinea pigs litter area.  They don't handle the smell like the pellets did, so we have switched back to our Yesterday's News pellets!  Since switching back, we don't notice the smell (and it is getting warmer here...so we would notice the smell much more this time of year).  We can even put off doing our "big clean" (meaning cleaning the entire cage) and just clean the litter area every week.  We make sure to clean out the waste that lands on the fleece morning and night...that said, now we can wash the bedding once every 2 weeks and the cages remain smell free.  Glad we made the change back...it is working much better!

2018...still using these pellets and they are doing a wonderful job.  Great product.

Our daughter lost her sweet guinea pig a few weeks ago and was having a tough time with her grief.  I thought having a few books to read about this topic might be of help. I contacted a friend who is a therapist, and she suggested this book and one other.  I ordered off Amazon, and we had these sent to us...they came quickly which was so helpful. We needed them to come quickly due to the situation. We read this book together as a family, a sweet story of a child who loves a dog.  The dog is a big part of that child's life...and the book shows that through lovely pictures.  Then the sweet dog passes away.  Our daughter cried and cried...she understood this was so much like the loss of her sweet furry friend Mr. Moo.  She has this book to read and read again if she needs to feel the loss.  This is a cute simple story with helpful and sweet illustrations.  I am glad we purchased this book, it has assisted us in helping our daughter grieve.

Our daughter loves guinea pigs.  She wears this shirt as a nightgown every night.  It is hard to get it away from her...even to wash!  It has washed well...keeping the color and the picture vibrant.  It is a soft cotton...That is great because our daughter does not like any shirt that feels rough or scratchy.
This is a safe healthy product!  Our guinea pigs love Oxbow.  You cannot go wrong ordering this food.
This is a safe healthy product!  Our guinea pigs love Oxbow.  You cannot go wrong ordering this food.
Our guinea pigs loved this hay.  It is great quality and healthy.  It came quickly to us...which was important..we were running out of hay!  Oxbow offers great quality products!
Our guinea pigs loved this hay.  It is great quality and healthy.  It came quickly to us...which was important..we were running out of hay!  Oxbow offers great quality products!
Our guinea pigs really did not enjoy this hay.  We have since ordered from another source.

I purchased these for our guinea pigs.  We have 5 little piggies, and none took to them.  They would nibble a bit at first, but then they would go untouched in the cage.  Most of them ended in the compost bin.  I will not be ordering them again.

This is our second purchase of this angora guinea pig!  Our daughter just lost her favorite guinea pig.  Mr. Moo was such a wonderful big guinea pig, and his passing has really made our daughter sad. I decided to purchase this stuffed guinea pig so that she could grieve and get some comfort hugging this stuffy.  The guinea pig came quickly (which was really helpful), and is exactly as pictured.  It is a good size, and looks like a real guinea pig.  Actually, my daughter placed the stuffy on the table and for a quick second I thought "What is Mr. Moo doing on the table...".  We purchased the 2nd guinea pig for a friend  of ours that loves stuffed animals.  Wonderful quality, very life like.

I highly recommend this stuffy if you are looking for a quality stuffed guinea pig.

We have never received a discount on this product at all.  We just have lots of pets that need great quality hay.  We have 5 guinea pigs who are always eating...like happy guinea pigs do.  We ordered Small Pet Select 2nd cutting Timothy Hay because we heard from friends locally that we could depend on the quality.  Some hay that we have ordered comes broken down...too much dust and not much quality.  You can tell the difference, our guinea pigs will actually turn their nose up at the less quality hay....it will stay in the hay bin more often.  When we ordered our first batch of this hay, the piggies started munching right away.  They continued to do the same each time we put this hay in the cage.  I also like that you can order more quantity of this hay.  With 5 guinea pigs we go through food quickly.  Saving a bit of money by buying larger quantity without sacrificing quality is important.  Small Pet Select is a quality product.  We have been lucky to find a local store that carry's quality hay that we can buy as a bale.  That saves us in cost.  That said, if you don't need large quantities, and you are looking for quality hay...Small Pet Select is great. Thanks so much!

Our daughter loves to sketch so she often has a number of pens and pencils with her as she goes through the house.  Inevitably, there are times where these items drop to the floor and get chewed on by our crazy pug.  Needless to say, we are looking for a better storage system.  I ordered this Pencetti delux pencil case for this very reason.  The case has 72 individual compartments that are well spaced for a number of items.  It is easy to open and fold up and has good quality chrome plated snaps to keep the pencil case secure.  It is not too big at 19" X 15.5" X .05" and is only 8 ounces.  In addition Pencetti includes a smaller black pencil case with a center zipper.  On both cases I could not find one stitching problem.  They are professional looking and all ready to go.  Great quality!  I did get this product in exchange for a honest review. Thanks so much!

We need some pre-school scissors in our Sunday School class at church. We have a number of crafts that allow these young children to use scissors safely. I ordered these scissors because they look really cute and attractive, and are very safe.  They really cut well, and the plastic blade works well keeping our daughter safe when using them.  The finger loops are comfortable, or so my daughter reports...and they are easy for her to use without any difficulty.  The colors are fun, and the cartoons on the packaging caught my daughter's eye!  Cute product that is safe and works well!  These will work well for the kids in our pre-school class!  Having extra scissors around the house that are child safe are a must.  I can't tell you how many times I look for our scissors.  They seem to just disappear.  Now we will have more available to use.  Problem solved!  Just a note, these scissors work fine for both left and right handed kids.  Great job Jakpopin!  I did get these scissors in exchange for a honest review.  Thanks so much!
You can't go wrong with Oxbow.  It is really a wonderful product.  Our 5 piggies have had it, and have loved it.  I order in bigger bags to save money now.  That said, Oxbow is one of the top!
You can't go wrong with Oxbow.  It is really a wonderful product.  Our 5 piggies have had it, and have loved it.  I order in bigger bags to save money now.  That said, Oxbow is one of the top!

We ordered the Sunjazz cute cartoon animal pencil case pouch for  our daughter.  She is a thriving artist, always taking her pens/pencils with her everywhere we go.  I hate to find the stray pencil or pen in the car, on the floor.  I like to keep them in a case because if they drop on the floor in the house or car our little pug will chew them to bits.  It isn't good for our pug and it isn't good for the pencil.  We ordered the case that has a cute little panda bear with ear phones on that says "Quiet Panda" on the front.  Love the picture.  I have included a picture of the whole front, a close up of the cute little panda bear, and the picture of the interior fabric design and color.  The size is 8X5X1inch and is 4 oz so very light.  The exterior material is canvas, so it could be spot treated for stains.  I am wondering how the outside will stay clean.  I would like to see how this pouch wears.  The interior is a much lighter fabric...like a cotton blend.  You can pull the interior fabric out of the main pouch a bit if you need to spot clean the interior.  Many times the pencils or pens will leave marks in the inside of the cases.  Again, I would like to see how it wears and lasts.

The only Con:  The price.  It seems a bit expensive for the durability that I have seen.

That said, it is a really cute design and fabric.  Cute pouch!  I did get this product in exchange for an honest review.

I was told about this product from a good friend.  I love peanut butter, but am trying to cut down on the fat.  After putting this in a smoothie, I fell in love with this product.  It has a wonderful taste, just like the regular peanut butter.  I am able to put it in my smoothies daily, and I enjoy the taste so much!  I purchased this from Amazon because of the larger size amounts being offered.  It gives me the product I love at a better price point!  What's not to love!

I ordered  these Stealth Wear Compression Tights, because I have a clotting disorder and when I work out and travel, compression clothing really helps with maximum blood flow to my body.  I wear these items when I work out, and when I travel all the time so quality and fit are important.  I really look for clothing that fits snug but isn't too restrictive and/or hot to wear.  If it isn't comfortable, I will take it off...or avoid wearing it.  That doesn't help me at all.  After wearing these Stealth compression tights during my daily workout and just around the house...I have to say here are the pros:

Fit as expected...not too tight or loose, they fit really well.  They are moisture wicking.  After my workout they kept me feeling warm even after I sat.  When working out in my typical cotton sweats, I need to change immediately or I get cold.  These tights were much better at keeping me feeling supported and comfortable.  The tights are light weight and don't feel to constrictive or bulky.  These tights are attractive and make wearing compression clothing fun...they are not the old fashioned compression clothing of the past!

I am so glad I purchased these Stealth tights for a discount (in exchanged for an unbiased review).  I am trying to test these items to see what clothing selections will best work for my body and activity.  These compression items can be very expensive.  For those of us who need them for safety and health...having the opportunity to try some of these products out is wonderful opportunity!

As I review this Toplife dimmable LED lamp, keep in mind I still have a couple of the antique kerosene oil lamps here.  I remember using them when we lost power when I was younger.  It brings back nice memories for sure.  Here this little lamp is a smaller version of those old kerosene oil lamps we used.  I purchased the orange/gold style and the lamp came quickly and packaged really well...so nothing was broken.  The lamp is 8.4" high X 3" X 3" and is made out of ABS and acrylic material.  I plugged the lamp into my computer and charged it initially for 4 hours (as directed by Toplife).  This Toplife LED lamp does not have the option of using batteries.  It is charged by using a usb plug and it contains a rechargeable battery in the base of the lamp.  Once the rechargeable battery is fully charged, all you have to do is blow into the top of the lamp...and just like that...it lights up!  On the side of this LED lamp is a dimmer control key that can adjust the light stronger or lighter depending on what you like.  This is a very light LED lamp that weighs only 7.5 ounces.  What I love about this lamp is the safety.  It offers a strong beam of light that really illuminates the area without the worry of someone tipping the lamp over and having a safety issue.  For a small lamp it really throws a decent amount of light.  We plan on keeping it in the covered deck area of our home.  When we play board games or read out there, having this cute and functional lamp will really add to the time we spend out there.  At this point, I have nothing but positives to say about this LED lamp. 5 stars.  I did receive this lamp at a discount in exchange for a honest review.  Thanks so much!

I purchased these Retevis Walking Talkies for our daughter for Christmas.  I researched a number of these walkie talkies...this is what I was looking for:

Not too expensive.
Easy to use.
Rechargeable.
Good range.
Long lasting when charged.
Nice looking.
Sturdy.

After months of use, I can report back that these were the biggest hit at Christmas.  My daughter has taken these everywhere.  They have gone on playdates, in the car...we have even measured how far away from the house we could walk and drive before we lost a signal.  They have been easy to charge, hold a good charge for a long time, and have not failed at anytime.  Having the pink color was an added plus.  My daughter loves these walkie talkies.  So glad I ordered them.

We just recently purchased Adele's new album 21.  As like her initial album, we purchased it initially to listen to her most popular songs...after listening to the whole album, all the songs have become our favorites.  Her voice is so expressive, rich and containing so much feeling.  They lyrics are heart inspired and touching.  She really is a true artist with her songs.  I feel that she puts her soul in every song.  A favorite at home or in the car!  Music at it's best!

Here in Maine winters are cold and long.  Just going out to walk the dog, shovel, getting to the car...you need full winter gear.  I love neck warmers.  They really do a great deal to keep my body warm when I am out in the cold.  I love the material of this specific neck warmer, it is thick enough...but not too thick.  You want the material thick to keep you warm, but not so bulky it makes the neck warmer difficult to wear.  This warmer is just right!  I like that the fabric is soft and the dark color will match with all the winter gear I have now.  When I go snowshoeing I need full winter gear to make the experience enjoyable.  I always wear a neck warmer when I am playing in the snow.  If you don't go prepared, you don't have a fun experience...or you cut the experience short.  This fleece neck warmer is stylish, warm but light enough to wear with your various layers, and comfortable.  So happy with my order!  I did receive this product at a discount for a honest exchange.  Thank so much!

users.query:
A friend recommended this book to me and I am so glad she did. I absolutely loved it. This book is so different than a lot of the other books out. I was not expecting it to turn out the way it did and I loved every bit of it. Drake is hot but is confusing at times with his moods. Ashley to me was hard to handle at times. Shes 20 something and the way she acted was expected of a girl her age but at times she could make me a little flustered. But it didn't take away from the book. I enjoyed the way everything played out and when I was done immediately bought the next one. ;)

I'm hoping if I ever get stranded a Drake comes along. Oooo lala :D

cands.text: Another amazing book by Christine Kersey. I absolutely love Travis and Gabriella. These two kept me on the edge of my seat with my heart racing for what would happen next. They were so cute together and seriously a perfect couple. I loved the friends in the book also. They gave the advice that I wanted to give Gabriella. Honestly an awesome book. I can't wait to see what comes next.

I was really looking forward to this book. Unfortunately I was a little disappointed because I was expecting a completely different book due to the teasers that were posted on Facebook. I still enjoyed it and think this is a great book. I loved Rose and Cole. I loved Lily and Colt. And of course loved Ruby and Cameron.

Rose and Cole went threw a horrible childhood. I felt for both of them threw the book. I enjoyed reading the flashbacks that Colt would have of the two. It really put more details into their past together. Rose having a rough childhood then changes her name to Lily. After years of not seeing Cole she goes to find him only to realize the Cole she knew was not the same and now went by Colt. He was a complete alpha male, bad ass, and mean as shit but with good reasons. :) I hated the stepfather and the ex-Fiance with a passion.

The love was real in this book. You could feel the struggles that Colt went threw. The sex was hot. I did expect more in that department but was content with what it had. This was a great story and it flowed perfectly. Another great book by Teresa Mummert.

This was my first Belinda Boring book and I am hooked. This book was awesome. It had me engrossed from the begining and I didn't want to put it down. I love Bri and her strength and her stubbornness. Quinn is the sexy sweet boy that is turned bad. Ohh and can't forget Liam. All I can say is HOT. Everything about this book rocked. When you get this book make sure you have nothing planned because you will get nothing done. 5 stars for a book that  flowed with no dull moments and perfect writing. Loved it.

This book was great. Had me laughing and almost to tears during some of it. I love love Simon. Ohh how dreamy he is. Not only sexy but sweet. Oh so sweet. Wallbanger had me from page one and kept me engrossed until the end. I never wanted to put it down. Carolina had me laughing as she talked to her O. The witty banter back and forth was awesome. This is a great book and a must read.

Clive is AWESOME!!!!

I received a free copy in exchange for an honest review.

WOW!! What can even be said about this book. This is book 2 and an awesome follow up to Learning to Trust. I loved the first one but I love this one even more. I fell in love with Garrett from the get go. His dominate side and his sweet side. He has them both. He found a way to surprise me all the time.

Laurel is so strong. She goes through a hard thing and still managed to come out stronger. Not only in her life but in her relationship with Garrett. This book will answer questions that you had after reading the first book but still has you wanting to know more.

The things I would love to say about this book simply can't be said. If I talk about what I want to then I will have massive spoilers through this whole thing. Which really sucks.

Lets just say there are ups and downs. Sad times and extremely happy times. Ohh and lets not forget the really hot, steamy, sexy times. This book was amazing and I can not wait for book 3. I need to know what happens next and if there is a happily ever after for this couple like I hope there is.

I received a free copy for an honest review..

I absolute loved everything about this book. It was perfect. Of course Beck and Decker are hot as can be. Summer and Biji are still as sweet as ever and Dawn is her usual bitch self. That will never change.

This book is about Beck and the struggles he goes threw. Not exactly like what Decker dealt with but close. Beck has to figure out what is happening to the light underneath the school. He is still learning his place as the Master of Light which is not easy because he didn't have someone to show him the way. Poor guy still has Dawn stressing him out.

Morgan is a fire witchling caught in between lights. She is neither light nor dark. Her trial will decide which way she goes. It is unusual to have a fire witchling that is Light. Morgan tries her best not to get comfortable or become friends with anyone. She has a plan to leave as soon as she hits 18. The threat of calling her father makes her change her ways.

Beck and Morgan realize they have a connection and both decide to walk away. Morgan because she doesn't trust people and because she plans on leaving and doesn't want anyone hurt. Beck because he has other issues he has to deal, one of many being Dawn, and doesn't want anything happening to Morgan. This does not last long and they finally both decide to stop fighting the pull. After that is when things start to go crazy.

"I will tell Summer to bring you more treats."

"Chocolate."

Sam Sam Sam. I love Sam. He is great and is definitely my favorite character in this series. I love his personality with the witchlings. If Sam was real I would make him live in my backyard and I would bring him Chocolate everyday.

"Beck's Pet Bigfoot"

Sam will have you laughing in every book. The witchlings say he is ugly but I say Adorable. He only talks to the Master of Dark and Master of Light with the exception of Summer and Morgan for other reasons. I would love to see a book threw Sam's eyes. He is great.

This book was amazing. If you are a Decker fan you still get plenty of him in this book and details about how things are going with him and Summer.

"Eight months, one week, and three days. I have a count down."

Decker making me laugh as always.

This is a book that must be read but make sure to read the two before so you know what is happening. This one did end with a cliffhanger like no other. I felt so lost when I read the last word because I had so many questions but I would not change anything. Thank you Lizzy Ford for another great addition to this series.

I received a free copy in exchange for an honest review.

This book is in the top favorites for 2013. I absolutely loved this book. I never wanted it to end and couldn't put it down. To see what Alana went through and what she had to deal with from her father was heart breaking. But to see her grow as a character and realize certain things was amazing. She was a great character and I loved reading about her.

Now on to the really good stuff. Ryan also known as Jack the Stripper. Ohh how I loved him. The way that Alana finally saw him at the beginning of the book after not seeing him for years was hilarious. I wouldn't know what I would of done if I was in her place. Ryan is of course hot as sin (duh he's a stripper) but also sweet. He has a twin brother that I wanted to punch the crap out of and a mother that should be ashamed of herself but that is life. Ryan makes himself better. He makes his life better. Even if doing it a little strangely with stripping.

This book was abo-freaking-lutely amazing. This book had me giggling, falling in love, and swooning like crazy. I will be telling everyone about this book. This is a must read in my eyes. I can't wait till it is out and I can read it over again because I will definitely be re-reading this one.

All of these books are awesome. I loved every one of them. You can not go wrong with these two Authors. They have a whole selection to choose from after you finish this so make sure to check them out.

Each book is unique in its own way. The characters in each of these books are well played and I love all of them. If you have not read these books then I suggest you jump on this box set.

I received a free copy of this book for an honest and unbiased opinion. I loved loved loved this book and can not wait for the next one to come out. This book will have its claws in you from page one. I had a hard time putting it down for dinner. Lol. I loved Ava and could understand her struggles with everything. Brea is the best friend anyone would want. Troy is the typical male (haha) and I couldn't stand him from the start. And Alec was just DREAMY. He was freaking hot and the sweetest guy going threw his own struggles with lose and love. Everything about this book was Amazing and I highly recommend it to everyone. I will be patiently waiting for book 2.

I really don't know what I want to say about this book. I was very confused for 3/4 of the book. It wasn't till the end that things finally started becoming clear. I couldn't believe that Bennett KNEW! I loved both Bennett and Declan. They were both great men. I felt for Elizabeth and all she had to go through. The poor girl. I was wishing for the fairy tale right along with her. I was heartbroken at the end of the book and can't wait to read the next one to see how things play out.

I received a copy of this book in exchange for a honest and unbiased review. This was the first book that I have read from this author. I was a little hesitant because I'm really not a sci-fi kinda girl. But I was pleasantly surprised. I really enjoyed it.

This had sci-fi, fantasy, romance, and adventure. The characters had a lot of depth that helped bring them to life. It was fun seeing the humans having superpowers, but that didn't make the story corny or any less enjoyable.

The author was able to create a world that actually helped give a greater picture to the reader. The storyline never experienced any flat points. I had a hard time putting the book down once I started. I would consider this more NA due to some sexual content in it. I'm really looking forward to more into the story with the next book.

I received a free copy for an honest review.

Wow. This book had me captivated from the start. I couldn't put it down till the end. I am a little speechless on this one. I felt everything that Katie felt while reading. My heart raced more then once. I felt her pain and heartache. I absolutely loved Katie and Holt. They were awesome not only as a couple but in their own ways.

Holt was hot and sexy but also the sweetest man I have read about in a long time where I could actually feel it while reading. He was tender and understanding. I loved that he kept enforcing that he would not push Katie to do anything or say anything she wasn't ready for. At the same time I loved how he was demanding and up front with how he felt.

I have to admit some things that came out of Katie's mouth was completely unexpected but also made the book that much better. I didn't expect a lot of the things that happened while reading which was refreshing. Nice to read a book where you can't guess what is coming next. I loved this couple. Really really loved this couple. This book deserves more then 5 stars and I really thing the ranking system should be changed. I will be recommending this to everyone.

I am writing this review without reading the next book. I have to admit I am a little worried. I loved this book and have such high hopes for the next one I really hope that it is just as good if not better. :)

4.5 stars

WOW!! Not many books can make me say that. Not many books make me feel what this one did especially after the book was over. This book had me from the beginning. Then again how could it not. A girl dating two men at the same time AND they know about each other. That grabbed me from the get go because I had to see not only how that worked but how it ended.

Madison being a beautiful girl who loves sex not in a slutty way catches the heart of Stewart. Someone who Madison will not become exclusive with because he puts his job first. So he tells her to find a boyfriend and in comes Paul. So over the course of two years she falls in love with both of them.

Stewart is HOT. Alpha male with a great job and body. Lets not forget amazing in bed. His only down fall.... He's married to his job. His job comes first and there is only time to see Madison once or twice a week. He loves her and understands she won't come second to his job and also understand her love for sex so he tells her to find a boyfriend for when he can't be there. What a dip shit. (sorry)

So then there is Paul. He is a sweet surfer. Also hot in a boy next door type with a great body and also good in bed. He knows about Stewart but he loves Madison so he deals with it. The other relationship doesn't get talked about between the two. But he knows there are nights she will go to Stewart.

Now let me tell you. I love Paul. I honestly do. But I am 100% a Stewart fan. I LOVE Stewart. I hoped he would do things differently through the whole book. Prayed he would change his ways. I wanted Stewart and Madison to end up together. Why? To be honest I have no clue. Just something about Stewart (no not his money) called to me. There was just something there that I can't put my finger on. Paul is great but to me Stewart is better.

So needless to say I was a little disappointed about the ending. I was even hoping for an unfortunate death to happen to a certain someone so that another ending could happen. So sad it didn't happen the way I wanted. So enough about how I wanted things to go. I think this book was great. I absolutely loved it. I did see someone refer to Fifty Shades of Grey and I have to say that this is no where near a FSoG book. I'm not sure what the person meant with the reference but I got nothing similar between them. This book to me was on a different scale compared to Fifty.

Now for those people who can't read a book that has mistakes.. Full warning. This book has mistakes. Not enough to take away from the story but to me they were noticeable.

I will definitely be recommending this book. Ha I already have to a friend of mine before I even finished the book. That's how good it is. A must buy.

I received a free copy of this book in exchange for a unbiased and honest review. This was my first book by this author and it was a great book. It kept me on my toes and had me so antsy I wanted to skip to the end to find out what happened and then go back to reading where I was at. I love romance and thriller and this book was the best of both worlds. I enjoyed this book very much.

Loved loved this book. Can I say LOVED some more?? This book was awesome. It will grab you from page one and keep you hooked till the very end when you want to cry because IT FREAKING ENDED.... Oh and lets not forget it's HOT!  I loved Louis and Emily. They are such a cute couple. I loved seeing how everything played out. This book is a MUST buy. You will not be disappointed.

This books was great. I never really read Sci-fi books but this is one I will be reading over. I am a huge Lizzy Ford fan and I love all her books. I have not found one that was not amazing.

Mandy is a beautiful model. On her way home her airplane gets sucked threw a warm hole. She doesn't remember much but there are plenty of people that help her and plenty of people that want her for her purebred human blood. She fights threw this book to stay alive and not to fall for the one Naki Prince that has saved her so many times.

Akkadi is the Naki Prince. Naki is half human and half Naki. He needs to find a mate and even though Mandy is beautiful he thinks they are not compatible. All Mandy wants to do is go home and since Akkadi is one of three people that can open a star gate she tries to convince him to send her home. Only thing is it takes a lot of energy cells to do that. If he sends her home it could put him behind for finding the cure to the plague.

Cesar is a big man that was sitting next to Mandy on the plane. He is spunky and I really enjoyed reading out him. Urik is a half human on the planet fighting for the rest of the humans. I liked him at first but then after a certain point all I could think was that sneaky little bastard. But apparently I am alone on this thought. Everyone seems to love him. Haha.  There are a few other characters that I hate but you have to have a bad guy. I really enjoyed everything about this book. As I was reading I really couldn't tell who Mandy was going to end up with. I had a feeling who but was never sure. The ending was good but I just wish there was more to it. If you are a Lizzy Ford fan or you like Sci-fi romances then you should definitely get this book. If you are just looking for something new and different this book is for you.

I have had this book along with Cabria Hebert's other books on my Kindle for awhile now. I hate to say but I had not gotten a chance to read them with the growing list of books that I keep adding. Thankfully a friend asked me to read it for her so I sat down today and read it in one sitting. This book was so good it was hard for me to put it down to even go to the restroom. It is that good. I loved this book and was hooked from the first chapter.

Piper is a sweet girl with the ability to have visions of the future. She has a best friend Franky who is spunky and fun. Piper is going to college to be a doctor and also working at a diner to pay for it. One night she runs into a guy (Dex) on the street who just so happens to pick pocket her tips on her way to the bus stop. Just seconds after the bus comes and loses control and is about to hit Piper but the guy that stole her money pushes her out of the way and in return ends up hit by the bus and dying on the street with his last vision being Piper.

Dex was homeless living on the streets. After helping Piper and getting killed he wakes up in a room without a true form only a purple mist. In this room that looks like an office there is a man named G.R who offers him a job as a Death Escort with tons of money and nice things. Something Dex never had before. His first target is Piper. Dex agrees because of the money and being able to live like he never has before. He has two months to get the job done or he gets Recalled and sent to a place much worse then Hell. Dex tries his best to do the job but what he didn't plan on or expect was to actually like Piper.

Piper knows there is something about Dex that she can't seem to figure out. Some things he has said makes her think he knows the guy that saved her life from the bus. She proceeds to try and figure it out by showing up at his house. This is Dex's first real chance to kill Piper. He invites her to stay for dinner with the knowledge that she is deathly allergic to peanuts and his butler Hobbs just fried chicken in peanut oil. But as Piper is on the floor close to dying Dex has a change of heart and Hobbs saves her just in time

After Hobbs saves Piper and Dex finally gets her home he meets a Ghost Escort named Storm. Storm doesn't have a body or really any form at all but grey  and is there to spy on the targets that Escorts are given. Once Piper is dead Storm would get a vacation where G.R gives him a body for a little while to do as he wants.

"I'd fist bump you, but that might be kind of hard."

"Like I haven't heard that before."

He tries several times to kill her but every time he ends up saving her again. G.R. which Dex learns stands for Grim Reaper shows him what it would be like to be stuck in the other place that is worse then Hell.  He fights with himself and the fear of the place he could end up. He finally comes to the realization that he is in love. Something he has never felt before.

Charming comes into the picture as Dex's babysitter. When the job is done and Piper is killed Charming will receive her gift of visions. He tries pushing Dex to get the job done. Charming ends up taking off and kidnapping Piper from her house. He takes her to the diner where he plans on killing her but Dex comes in and rescues her. After getting her away from Charming and driving down the icy road Piper realizes that Dex has been trying to kill her all along. She is crushed because she has fallen in love with him too. After finding out she starts beating on Dex resulting in a bad car accident placing her in the hospital yet again.

The ending to this book was damn good. I was so nervous threw this book not knowing what was going to happen. I really hate that Dex and Piper couldn't have a happily ever after. Storm made me laugh along with the times Dex made fun of Charming for his crazy name. This book was perfect and I am so happy I finally sat down and read it.

I received a free copy for an honest review. Review done Sept 2013.

Wow. This book was Amazing. Definitely deserves way more then 5 stars. I loved everything about this book. The love, secrets, pasts, lies, tears, and the way it kept me guessing. I thought I knew from the get go but only sorta knew. It was great.

Alec and Marissa meet each other at the apartment building they both live at. Marissa just so happens to live on the floor above Alec. They decide to have dinner with each other and one thing turns into another and they are in a relationship. The whole time Marissa knew Alec was hiding something from her. Nothing could prepare her for what it was.

During their relationship things kept happening that freaked everyone out. Marissa and Alec found themselves in a relationship that moved faster than either of them expected.

The things that happened between these two were hot and sweet and true love. They are such a cute couple and I wish there was more at the ending to let us know what happened next.

I didn't care for Kristian at all. He got on my nerves often. Justin was OK and Emily was exactly what a best friend should be like.

I was hooked on this book from the first till the last. I had a hard time putting it down to do anything. It kept me on the edge of my seat till the very end and then had me wanting to scream because it was over. I loved everything about it. L.P. Dover is a fantastic author and I can not wait to see what she comes out with next

This is a must read. Do not hesitate. Do not second guess yourself. You will not be disappointed.

Wow! I loved every minute of this amazing book. Gus is hot, sweet, sexy, and a smart ass. Reading about him and Aiden going back and forth at the beginning had me laughing so hard. I loved the banter and pranks between them. Aiden/Red is a smart and sassy firecracker. She's quick on her comebacks and is perfect for Gus. Watching these two grow closer together even with a bump in the road was fun. I even teared up a few times. I loved these two. There was one part during the story that had my heart exploding and putting Gus above his brothers on my favorites list. He is absolutely amazing.

I love the Brannock family. They are awesome. When someone is in trouble they all come running without question. They hold their family above anything else and they welcome people with open arms. I can't wait to read Protector to see what happens next.

I have to admit that the Epilogue killed me. Tears poured out of my eyes as I read it. And I don't know why because believe me it wasn't sad, but I have a soft spot in my heart for Liam.

This was my first book by Kassidy Carter. I don't normally start in the middle of the series but I ran out of time to read the first book. This is a standalone so you don't have to read book one to know what's going on. I loved Forever Lasting. The beginning of the book broke my heart and it broke several more times throughout. This is one of those ugly snot cry books where you need a box of tissues next to you to make it through. Oh and don't read it around anyone else. Lol. James is a sweetheart but what he went through really messed him up. He ends up being an ass for a bit which made me want to smack him but he redeemed himself nicely. The stuff Grace has to go through will kill you and then to have to deal with James being an ass makes it no better. I loved all the characters of Forever Lasting. It's an emotional cry with a HEA. If you've never read a book by Kassidy Carter this is a good one to start with.

Holy hell! Jessica Wilde is killing me with these men. Conned was more intense than Leverage and I wasn't sure that was possible. I'm still loving the dad though. Lol.

Conall and Emily. I just finished reading this and I'm not sure I can get my thoughts together. I absolutely loved these two. Conall might possibly be better than Lucas from Leverage and I really thought no one would top him. But Conall definitely does. He has the same going for him as Lucas. Hot, sweet, smart, caring and good at his job. But there is just something about him that pulled me in so deeply into the book. I couldn't stop reading. Couldn't get enough of him.

Emily is a sweet girl who is just trying to look out for her brother. He gets her mixed up in some crazy s*** and gets her to do things for him. Of course she's smart and knows it's wrong but wants to help her brother out. Her only family left. I really felt for her. I couldn't imagine going through what she did. A lot of parts during this book ripped my heart out and a lot made me want to explode with happiness. My emotions will be out of wack for a while.

When these two finally come together I swear it was earth shattering. Of course the first thought I had was "Finally!" but it was so much more than that. I could feel the tension with these two. It was driving me nuts. Emily definitely has better self control because I would have jumped on him a lot sooner. Ha ha!

I have only ever had the urge to peak at the ending one other time before I started reading this series. With the first two it was a constant struggle with myself not to do it. Just to prepare myself for what would happen. There is so much suspense and mystery on top of the crazy emotions already going on. I am loving these Brannock men and am excited to see what will happen in the next book with Gus Gus.

This series is a MUST read!!!

This book for ME was a awesome book. I loved both Karma and Jax. This story had me laughing, swooning, and sad at times..

Jax was a sexy as sin man but also was sweet as ever.. He is one of those rare breeds of men. I don't even have words to explain Jax and how great he was.

Karma is turning 20 and is unfortunately still a virgin. She has a dad that is gay and mom that is a model. She is a beautiful girl but her mom has really messed her up with a lot of negative comments. Karma having trouble losing her virginity is not something you hear about or even really think about so it makes this book different. Her failed attempts had me giggling along with her friend Eva.

"I love your hips and the way they fit perfectly in my hands, your nose gives you character, your thighs... Jesus, I can't even think about them without getting a hard-on, and your eyes make my heart race like a schoolboy with his first crush." - Jax

Karma and Jax have a lot of fun times through this book. Karma realizes a lot during her time with Jax and starts the process of changing things in her life. These two made a great couple. I loved them.

I read this book in one sitting. The story line flows nicely and there was never a dull moment for me. I loved it and would recommend it to everyone.

One of the best series out there. I love the Bradfords. They all have their own personalities but share their love of food... Thieving Bastards. That has to be my favorite line and I laugh every time I read it. I love seeing the characters from the previous books in this one. I can never get enough of Jason. The Game Plan did not disappoint. It had sweetness, romance, and brought tears to my eyes as I laughed at the Bradford men. This series is a must read.

users.query: I bought this as a replacement HD for my desktop. It is great! I really can't say much - just that it works perfect.

cands.text: I bought this enclosure because my kids broke my usb3 drive. I thought I would give this a shot. I removed the drive from the broken enclosure and inserted into this one. It works perfectly. Great price and great product.
Exactly what I needed to clone an msata drive. Works perfect. Great price.
Wow! I store all my data and backups on this and have them with me where ever I go. Fast! This is definitely the way to go. Easy to carry my data around without splitting it across drives.

I bought this because I needed a powered hub. It works fantastic for both usb 2 and usb 3 devices. I plugged several portable hard drives into the hub and they we instantly recognized. Great product - Great price - works perfectly.

Great value for this product. They worked perfectly right out of the package. The display port side is a bit of a tight fit but that way I know they will not fall out of the computer. The price was great and everything was as described.

You cannot beat this cable for the price. Works perfectly and allowed me to view my tablet on the large screen tv. We were able to show our pictures at a family reunion so everyone could see. Highly recommended.
I bought this to extend the HDMI cable off of a device to the back of the tv. It works perfectly. Can't beat the cost! Highly recommended.

I bought this to use as a presentation tool for my Asus Ep121 tablet with windows 7. It worked right out of the box! My son used it on his windows 8 laptop and again, it worked immediately. Great product for the price. Highly recommend this product.
I bought this to add a computer that was a little far from the router. It works great.
This was an excellent replacement. Worked perfectly. I would highly recommend the product and the seller.
This cable works perfect! It charges my Sony Z Ultra without a problem. You can't beat the price or performance. I would definitely recommend this product.
Works great! Easy to install. Easy to use color changing is excellent.
These were great replacement cartridges for my HP. The price and quality were excellent. They fit perfectly and the world is a better place again!
This little device works great as a media player. I connected via Hdmi and the device works great. It streams movies through my network perfectly. You can't go wrong with this little device.

We use this at the computer store all the time to check out power supplies that are suspected of failing. It only takes a second to use as it just plugs into the power supply. Our shop could not work without it. Highly recommend it.

Great replacement screen! I ordered this because it already had the glass, lcd, and frame. Had glue spots already in place. Easy to move parts from broken phone to replacement. I would highly recommend this product.

This was a great replace for my kids broken iphone screen. The product fit perfectly and had no flaws. The screen looks wonderful and everyone is happy. I would highly recommend this to anyone looking for a digitizer and lcd replacement.

This does what it says. It did does a very good job of diagnosing motherboard errors on older computer boards. It does not work in many newer boards with newer bios. It has helped me diagnose problems on several computers so it was worth the cost. The product is well built and I would not hesitate to buy it.
This product looks great and installed in seconds. I bought it as a replacement for a broken backrest and it works great.
This product looks great and installed in seconds. I bought it as a replacement for a broken backrest and it works great.

Excellent mirror glass replacement. Put this on the driver's side of a 2002 Tahoe. Fit perfect. Easy to install. I choose to just replace the mirror instead of the whole unit. Took about 10 minutes to scrap off the broken mirror then less than 1 minute to install the new one. Works great.
All I can say is this worked as advertised right out of the box! Great product and great price. I would highly recommend this product.

I bought this for my wife as her camera takes CF cards. This is a USB 3 ready and she loves it. She transfers her camera pictures to her computer with no problem. If she's happy, I'm happy. Great product.

This was as many others have said. It will charge the tablet but not while the tablet is turned on. I use it to charge at night when I travel so it works fine for me. 4 stars because it will not charge while using the tablet.

users.query: This book was simply captivating  from the very beginning. Through the eyes and history of how one family struggled with politics, wars, and basic human survival scheming and plotting with everything they had at their disposal just to see their family succeed, and yet to know in the very end the well made plans and all the alliances made failed to achieve the ONE dream the family so desperately tried to keep alive - to put a Queen on the throne of England with all her vast holdings in France - to make her powerful and strong from "sea to shining sea" so to speak.  GREAT writing and marvelous forethought and planning!!!  GREAT!!!

cands.text: This book was an excellent read for those who are interested in the history of the Tudor line and what this family had to endure to secure the throne of England!!! I was totally enthralled with this book from the beginning of the book, and absolutely deflated when the book came to a close. I was absolutely hungry for more indepth reading!!  It was Fantastic!! Please continue developing this story line of the Tudor family.  Thank you so very much!!!

It was a fantastic read!! I could hardly put it down at times. The author was brilliant in her mastery of weaving the different plots and themes throughout the book that brought in more flavor into the action of the storyline itself that made the reader hunger for the reality of love and survival during one of history's greatest moments of darkness and fear. It was simply a miracle these people survived and carried on another legacy of hope for the future while living under such harsh and violent times!!  GREAT!!!

Absolutely fantastic!!!! I was totally bored at first with the bogged details of Joan of Arc, but then the book exploded into painted words like colors splashed before me and I was amazed at what all these lady's held in common to survive the war across their lands, and the relationships they were forced to endure in the name of marriage and politics!!! It is more than amazing that any of these women and their children survived the cruelty and selfishness of the men of those times!!!

I loved every page of this book and all that went into creating it!! The author was exceptionally aware of the history of the time period that she sets her story line into and sews a tapestry of characters and tales within tales bringing the plot and subplots into view through the lives and loves of each of her characters in a world that s so hell bent on destruction through greed and selfishness that it honestly makes a person wonder how the human race survived with any civil structure at all. The complexity of her theme leads the reader to believe that only by family ties and lines of marriage through the generations will life as we know it in a civilized society come to fruition. It was a tremendous read!! I would highly recommend it to history buffs and those who enjoy the world of chivalry and romance in a time when life was not guaranteed from one day to the next!!!  I absolutely LOVE it!!!

Fantastic read!!! The author was well versed in her history and the cultural  surroundings of the people of the time and area the story revolved around. Everything had a very natural flow to it that kept you reading well into the early hours of the morning not wishing to put it down!!! Loved it!!

Absolutely LOVED it!!! She was such an amazing woman for all that she was allowed to do during that time and play in history when women were almost nothing but breeding stock. The details of this book are so riveting it will astound you!!!  ENJOY!!!

I absolutely adored "The Whispering Night" by Kathryn Le Veque!!!  It was one of her most heart stopping and thrilling novels I have read in her series of novels for the past 6 months. I can't get enough of her stimulating and intriguing writing about these different knights and how they all relate to the enclave of historical history in the making!! She has such a talent of spinning one story line into another and then pulling in another plot to throw you into another direction altogether. She is amazing with her style of writing that keeps the reader craving for more of the untold story of the knights of old and the strict codes they held themselves to through the years, long past their prime. I highly recommend this novel as a MUST READ of all her novels in order to completely understand where the threads of her tapestry are weaving in their intricate pattern from book to book and binding the characters more and more tightly into the total picture once you have read the books and learned the complicated relationships of these men and women as they struggle against the harshness of day to day living and surviving in such a dismal and cruel world they were forced to endure through those tumultuous times!  GREAT READING!!! I am a totally sold out fan for this author, and would probably follow her around for a first copy signature of her forthcoming novel if I were a young college student with boundless energy and plenty of time on my hands!!  Enjoy the read and the journey!!

I thoroughly enjoyed reading this delightful book! It was such a refreshing different approach to all the other historical romance books I have read. It really totally surprised me that the author chose to approach the subject matter the way she did and carried through to the end result that was so surprisingly refreshing! I look forward to reading more of her material in the future! She has such a "backdoor" way of introducing the topic of the story line, and yet she is so straight forward in her manner of dealing with the social mores of the time period. It was truly delightfully refreshing to read,

Although I have not been able to fully get into the material of this book completely, what I have read is fantastic in the ideas that are shared and encouraged to try for your total well-being! I love this new generation approach to life at its fullest!!! Thank you very much!

I truly did enjoy reading this book very much, I just wish it could have been developed a little more into their lives after marriage and getting settled. It was a excellent read I did not wish to put down and definitely did not wish it to end so soon!! GREAT!!

Again, the author has superseded herself in creating another superb storyline that is truly sumptuous in its tales of majestically created life and romance during the Middle Ages! When life was as harsh as the land and warriors that patrolled it for their own greed, she creates a storyline that weaves a tapestry of tales that are totally breath taking and glorious in the telling! Wonderful read!!  Grab a comfortable spot to relax and enjoy the ride through the world of unbelievable courage, hardship, and survival!! It will totally blow your mind trying to figure out how she will bring her story to a marvelous and wonderfully happy end. Fantastic read!!

It was very intriguing to say the least!!  I was so amazed at the women in the story and what they had to do just to survive during that period of history and protect their children from disease and death!! Then you put into the mix the mess King Henry VIII threw in for his selfish and paranoid reasons and it's a wonder the English survived at all!!! I was totally amazed at the way the book ended with the death of his old guardian and best friend to his mother. The one woman who held fast to her love and respect, and trust for Henry VIII from his cradle until he had her and her sons killed
Charlene Coburn

Absolutely awesome read!! I was so impressed with the methods the author chose to entice the reader into the depths of the storyline! She has such a marvelous way of twisting the plots and theme of the story it actually makes it difficult to put the book down and spend time with your family, or get a meal prepared for your household of eaters!!  Ha! Ha! She's great at leading the reader to think the storyline will actually lead in a particular direction, then totally turn your thoughts in another direction entirely!! She is great with surprise endings!! Awesome read!! Sit back and enjoy the journey!! You will LOVE every minute!!

Kathryn Le Veque is such a remarkable writer with these series of books that I have been mesmerized from the start. I can hardly put one book down to read the next one involving all the different families that she has brought forth in her books and woven such tales involving and interweaving all the great Lords, Ladies, and Kings during this perilous time in the history. It is truly a marvelous read especially as these families move from one generation to the next in their different achievements and ploys to maintain peace and control over England during its time of solidifying tis boarders and claiming their lands! I find her reading not only entertaining but so well researched and steeped in historical events the reader feels almost akin to these people and their families. Great reading for anyone!!

I absolutely adore this book and hope to read all the following books that link this story to a great epic series!!! The author has such a marvelous way of creating her characters like a painter  reveals a beautiful sunset over the ocean in dramatic climaxing colors that simply  amaze you and astound your senses at the same time!! She is artfully cunning with her plots and themes so carefully woven like a great tapestry through time!! She is marvelous at anything she plies her pen to no matter what the subject, and I totally look forward to anything and everything I can find written by her to read!! She's farther beyond GREAT and a writer NOBEL!!!  Thanks, Kathryn, for all the hours of research and wonderful hours you spent in reeling your stories of historical romance!! It has been such a wonderful time of enjoyment to me!!
Charlene Coburn

I was tremendously pleased with the total outcome of this book, and have fallen under the spell of the enchanting author until I have read all the books she has created and published for people like me to read for the enjoyment and the pleasure we derive from reading such marvelous tales of this time period in our history. GREAT!!!  Thank you.

This is one of the best book series I have read in a while!!!  The writer keeps the reader so much involved in the action of the story line ti makes putting the book aside to work extremely difficult! It's as almost as if you are right in the mist of the story taking place. I love it!!  An excellent read for where ever you are!!  I highly recommend the books and commend the author for er splendid style of writing!!

I totally enjoyed reading the story and am currently reading the third book in the series to fully appreciate the full flow of the story line as it flows through the lives of the different clans and characters the author has created from the pages of actual historical records to give the reader a glimce into what reality of life could have actually been like during that time in history from different human perspectives.

Amazing!!! I had to get the series of books to satisfied my since of closure for the whole story line.  It was more than GREAT reading!!! Totally recommended to anyone who love a good historical romance!!! Go for it!!!

I was so amazed at all the research that went into making this book so close to factual events!!!  It really captivated my attention like no other of its kind!! I could not honestly believe what these women must have endured just to survive in the world they found themselves living in during that time period!!  Amazing!!!

Most intriguing find in developing a tale of magic and romance that I never expected! I enjoyed this series of books and the very unique way the author lead the reader from one book into the next without breaking the theme of the storyline that threads through the entire series and delivers them to the reader ties with a silver bow. I totally recommend this series for a most interesting read!

My husband and I have been reading this together and discussing out comments and observations we write on the passages we read each day. We both love it!!!  It also give us some excellent together time for adult talking each evening.  Thank you so much!!

This entire series of books was very well thought out from so many different angles that it is almost impossible to give tribute to everything that was developed without the possibility of leaving out something important that added to the marvelous suspense and drama of the story line! I could go into an essay of all the different things I enjoyed throughout the reading of this book as well as the others that kept the pace searing and the reader curious to know the next move among the characters! The natural human element that she gave each character in their individual roles was well thought out ( almost like a story board ) in the interactions and reactions with one another!! You could tell a lot of research had gone into the writing of the storyline and the different historical elements that were placed within the story itself. I LOVED it!!!

users.query: Attractive coverlet blanket.  Bought king size for queen bed and queen/standard size for standard bed, both come down to box spring area.  I may order a skirt for each bed.

cands.text: Nice lightweight blanket, I ordered a larger size to use as a summer coverlet, it works fine.  Soft knit, washes well.
This fits a queen size bed perfect, with good length and width after washing. A mid weight cotton, good for year around.
Great Fiberbed mattress cover, this will be for our guest room.  We like them so much, we have them on two other beds.
This is exactly like the mattress covers you have to buy when getting a Tempuredic mattress, but half the price.
Very soft, inside material like a baby blanket. Fit is like a 40-42, I tried to shrink in hot water and long drying, no shrinkage.  OK as loose fit.
Very soft, inside material like a baby blanket. Fit is like a 40-42, I tried to shrink in hot water and long drying, no shrinkage.  OK as loose fit.
Very soft, inside material like a baby blanket. Fit is like a 40-42, I tried to shrink in hot water and long drying, no shrinkage.  OK as loose fit.
Very soft, inside material like a baby blanket. Fit is like a 40-42, I tried to shrink in hot water and long drying, no shrinkage.  OK as loose fit.
I ordered a larger size so I could wear it over another sweatshirt. Material is soft, good color, zipper works well. Warms me up when I have a chill.
Bright head cover, smaller than I could wear.  Gave to a young lady for her skiing.
Great headband, warm, covers most of head. I prefer headbands to hats, glad I have this for winter.
Soft, comfortable sheets.  These are as good as the Landsend knit sheets, just not as expensive.  They wash and dry well.
I bought a size larger than needed, XL, expecting some shrinkage. Washing in cold and permanent press drying, no shrinkage. I like a relaxed fit, colors are good.  I wear this over a sweatshirt.
Nice sewing kit.  After moving, I realized I needed a sewing kit for mending.  It has everything I need, plus convenient pouch for the items.  I will take it with me when we travel too.
Comfortable, purchased XL, regular has been 40B. Cups are soft, no show through, don't dent in. Best bra in a long time, hope it isn't too warm for summer.
Comfortable, purchased XL, regular has been 40B. Cups are soft, no show through, don't dent in. Best bra in a long time, hope it isn't too warm for summer.
Comfortable, purchased XL, regular has been 40B. Cups are soft, no show through, don't dent in. Best bra in a long time, hope it isn't too warm for summer.
My favorite 3 season night shirt.  Roomy, breathable cotton, I have all the colors they made.
Just what I wanted, a thick terry bathmat, nice design, dries well.
Lightweight bra, with light fill to cover show through,  not really padded.  A good comfortable fit, great price, the toasted coconut color is a mid range beige, maybe too dark for a white top.
Good rings that stay locked until you want to change them.  I couldn't find then at retail, fast shipping.
Lots of twists and turns in the story.  Good characters and story line, the clothing store was interesting along with it's customers.
A good book, it was our book club selection. The first third was difficult, sad. Then it picked up and I kept reading. It was a very lively club discussion.
I have totally enjoyed all the books in the series.  I have read them  1-5 close together.  A great insight to New England and their history.  A romance, but tastefully worded.
I enjoyed the third Chris Norgren mystery.  Plenty of twists and turns to keep you guessing.  I hope Aaron Elkins continues the series.

users.query: Just as expected. No issues. They are stickers! FYI: the seller, 'everything you need', will send you 3 e-mails for every item you order from them, even if the item is a $6 book of stickers. In a way that kind of dedication to service is admirable, in another way it's just plain annoying.

cands.text: Very Nice. Pattern, colors look just like they did on my computer. The material is a good weight, and held up well when I washed it in warm water and dried on high heat. I have bought a lot of duvet covers over the 10+ years I have owned down comforters and this set is a great value.

I am super impressed at the quality of this bag considering the price. There is nothing wrong with it, it looks just like the picture. This bag is very roomy, will work well as a beach bag or just around town shopping. Very happy with my purchase.

My glasses arrived on time and in perfect condition, no breakage. They look just like the picture. I got the light blue option, it was a little cheaper than the other colors (?). I think the quality for the price is good. These are thick walled, sturdy glasses. They are a good size without being too heavy. You can tell they are hand made but all four are very uniform in size and shape. I have not yet washed or used them, but they look like they won't break easy.
Very nice onsie. Soft and washes well, colors are vibrant. Definitely worth the $$.

Love this wall decal for my nursery! Very cute, colors are not too bright or crazy.  I just put it up last night so I can't say if it will fall over time, but based on the way it sticks to the wall it would surprise me if it started falling off. A few times I decided to change where I put the decals and had to work fairly carefully to get it back off the wall without ripping it. Once I did get it off the wall, it stuck really well to the new spot, very forgiving and easy to work with. The area I wanted to put it in was a different shape than how it shows you to put it together, but I improvised to make it fit the space no problems. It can go together any way you want.

The colors are a bit 'bolder' in person than pictured, but the mat is soft and non-skid and works for what I ordered it for. I noticed a slight vinegar like smell the first few days after opening the packaging, but it went away after the first wash. Overall, I am happy with my purchase.

What I got with this cake topper set is absolutely NOT worth $32!! I got 12 small figurines, a plastic trunk, 2 plastic sprigs of grass, the blue seaweed you see in the picture, and a small, reddish coral that is not in the picture. The large pretty pink coral decoration on the right side of the cake was NOT included in my set.
The figurines are available with the bubble guppies 'busy book' or just as the figures for less than half of what this set costs, (https://www.amazon.com/Nickelodeon-Bubble-Guppies-Underwater-Scenery/dp/B0161Q0H5E/ref=sr_1_1?ie=UTF8&qid=1485273843&sr=8-1&keywords=bubble+guppies+figures)
 so the plastic trunk and cheap coral are what you are paying for. Save yourself $20 and get something prettier in the aquarium section of petsmart.

These are totally cute flip flops. I love how the silver threaded through the navy gives them just the right amount of pop/sparkle. The first day I wore them I got two compliments from total strangers who asked where I had gotten them. They are reasonably comfortable in my opinion. I had no trouble wearing them all day, but the sole is not as soft as I expected from the description and the material on the upper part in not soft, but a tiny bit scratchy. I am big into flip flops and while these wont' be my go-to flip flop for running around town, these will be perfect for a casual get together, or summer dinner. The appearance of the shoes far outweighs any lack of comfort in my opinion.

I found this product to be just as described. Seems pretty good quality. Haven't used it extensively yet, but holds my 10.1 tab comfortably with a little room to spare for a few extra items. I like it!

Arrived as expected. The cats were on it as soon as I put it down, but they do that with anything new. They use it about as much as the folded blanket I had in it's place. Now I can have my blanket back and the mat looks way nicer. Maybe when the weather gets colder they will use it more.
This is super awesome chocolate. Worth the $7 a bar.

I'm not really sure how to review this ebook. It was not what I expected at all. If I had known how the story would play out before I bought it I probably would not have bought it, but I did enjoy reading it. It had its spooky moments, but was also a life story that was told so honestly and straightforward that I found myself liking it for what the story said about life and not what I originally bought it for, a scare.

I bought this book on a sale amazon had for the kindle copy. Have never read this author before but I am so glad I picked it up and even more glad I did so on vacation so I could stay up until I finished it. I love Jo Nesbo's descriptions of his characters and how not every chapter is told from the same point of view. This is the fifth book in this series where Detective Harry Hole is the main character (only the 2 books before this one are translated in English) and I hardly ever pick up a book in the middle of the series.  However the past events are summarized concisely and in a way that I felt like I got enough back story to understand everyone's motivations. The mystery will keep you guessing until the almost very end and I felt the end was satisfying. Would highly recommend.
I think this is a great quality suite for the price. I ordered one size bigger than I usually wear, and I think it will be perfect for when my pregnant belly starts poking out this summer.

This purse arrived looking just like the picture. The leather is soft. The handle converts easily to a wrist strap. The interior of it is a green satin. There is a metal snap closure on the flap, but no zipper or secondary closure for the inner compartment. I don't think this will cause a problem with anything working it's way out, but I haven't used it yet. I am happy with my purchase, it was exactly as advertised.

We love these rain boots. They are a bit more flexible and soft than the ones I saw in the store, and they were a few dollars cheaper. The handles make it possible for my 2 year old to put them on herself. Glad I purchased these.

Not happy with these Reef's. They look and feel like a $5 wal-mart special. The tye-die fabric part is secured to the bottom very high up on the footbed (close to your toes) so they don't wear well at all. They are not easy to keep on, I haven't even worn them outside of the house because I am sure I won't be happy wearing them for any period of time, thinking about returning them. The foodbed is also quite narrow, my foot almost hangs off the side. I am ususally very happy with this brand.

I liked reading this book. It is hard to put down and the writing is very straight forward. There are many twists and turns, it keeps you guessing the whole time. Much of the book is devoted to the relationship of a married couple in their first 5 years together. I felt that the portrayal of their relationship from both sides was heartbreakingly real and never watered down the raw emotions. Others have criticized the ending, but I thought it was appropriate for the story. I would definatly reccomend this book.
Great story, a little far fetched at times, but makes up for it in originality. Well done, a great read.

I have never paid so much for a bag of cat treats, but they were cheaper on amazon than at my vet. They were recomended because my 2 cats have Herpes eye and the Lysine suppliment is good at keeping the infection at bay. It makes their eyes less runny and they gobble them up like they were tuna.

Odd Interlude #3 is a great finish to the story of Harmony Corner. I found this episode in the Odd 'chronicle' to be one of the most compelling so far. I couldn't wait for this one to be released because the story is so engrossing. Odd's perspective is insightful and as optomistic as ever.

I almost didn't review this one because you should really read the first book, "Wool" before you read "Wool 2". And if you read the first book and don't immediately want to read this one, your crazy! You are also going to miss out on one of the greatest stories written by an amazing author about.....well, I won't tell you what it's about because it's more than just a story it's about humanity. Give "Wool" a chance. You don't know what your missing!
Three great short stories. Will be interested to read the spinoff series about Nell. Can't wait for Broken Soul's release!

Very pretty dress, unfortunately the cut of the material around the bust does not cover well at all. Its like extra material thats flappy, and just waiting to flash your goodies to everyone. Returned it.

I also like the fact that they seem to be water resistant, as i had a plumbing leak and wade through a small flood outside my house.  These do not seem to have a steel toe guard so be careful when lifting and carrying heavy loads to not drop them on your boots.
