The motion sensor is opposite my door on a large overhead beam. It has a 15 foot range from the peephole viewer. So far, after a few days use, it's worked well. It comes with industrial strength 3M double sided tape or you can screw it onto something. I used the 3M tape because I have had good experiences with it on other items (GoPro Surf). The power button on the viewer makes no noise at all like some reviewers have said. With the motion sensor, there is no need to press the power button unless I want to review pics because it comes on automatically when something moves in front of my door.

The exposure is perfect, but my front door has an overhang providing shading and direct sunlight never hits it.

The hardest part of this entire installation was setting up the date and time on the viewer. Now I'll just wait to see what it catches :-)

I've used this mug at work for a year now. It's great at keeping my coffee warm for about 3hours. It keeps my iced tea cold for 12 hours and there's still ice cubes inside!

It also is heavy and very durable. I drop mine at least once a week with only a few scratches to show for it. The weight could be handy if you need a quick defensive weapon... just bonk 'em on the head :-)

I'd highly recommend getting one.

I have been wearing the 8-ounce O'Neill Thermo L/S Crew for a year now. In the winter, spring and fall seasons it works great. It does not irritate my skin or make me itchy like some of the other reviews state.

Knowing it was a MUCH thicker rash guard with thermal layering, I bought one size bigger than what I wear in a regular rash guard. It fits like a glove and dries very fast after getting out of the water and my wetsuit. Anyone who surfs knows that you definitely don't want a loose thermo layer, it won't keep you insulated if it's loose. I do agree that they run a size smaller than what your normal clothing size is.

This year, I am upgrading to the O'Neill 13-ounce Thermo-X L/S Crew thanks to my friends bragging how warm they are in the winter water. The water has been in the mid to low 50's and the 8-ounce O'Neill Thermo-X L/S Crew has served me well. I usually am in the water for about 3 hours at a time, a few times a week.

You get what you pay for and this is a quality item that works very well.

I just bought the O'Niell 13-ounce L/S Thermo-X and it is like a warm sweater in the water! It dries almost immediately when you get out of the water. I actually started to sweat in my wetsuit when the sun came out! Thankfully it was a rainy day and the clouds, rain and large waves cooled me off a bit. The 13-ounce works VERY well in some very cold conditions. I highly recommend both products.

I bought this wetsuit 5-6 months ago. At first, I was impressed. It had a lot of features for an entry level wetsuit. Like a leg key pocket, soft lined inner stomach area, smooth neck area (to avoid rubbing). It also was very good at keeping me warm in 55 degree water.

Now the bad...

Since I bought it, I had nothing but trouble with the zipper sticking while trying to zip it up. Yesterday, one of the teeth broke off the zipper and the suit can't zip up now.

I noticed the inseam glue had come undone and it was coming apart.

The stitching on the collar came undone and eventually tore when trying to velcro it shut.

The stitching on the key pocket, on the leg, was slowly unravelling and the key loop felt flimsy.

My old entry level Body Glove Stealth 4/3 lasted a year and a half, surfing 4-6 times a week and I never had a problem. The O'neill Epic lasted maybe 6 months with me only using it 1-2 times a week.

I went to two local surf shops for a new wetsuit and both of them recommended other brands because they felt O'neill's quality control had gone down hill. I would have to agree.

I will be sending it back to O'neill and we will see what the warranty will cover. In the meantime, I am looking at getting a Body Glove Vapor because of the good reliability and quality that I've experienced with that company.

Easy to install with a nice brushed nickel finish. Nice, smooth opening and closing. Installation time was approximately 5 minutes and the Kwikset re-key to my existing house key took approximately a minute.

I really enjoyed reading this book. The author uses his own experiences and stories to illustrate each of the 12 codes that he references. The book was well written and fun to read. He kept me very interested throughout the entire book.

I surf, and I found that the author was able to use his words to paint a very clear picture with his own stories and experiences.

I would recommend this book even if you're not into surfing. It could be called a "Code of Life".

I have had this tool for a few weeks now and I have used every feature it has. So far, it works great and has all the right tools for a surfer that adjusts fins, changes leashes & uses a wax comb. I would highly recommend! Great for a gift.

This field guide has come in very handy when I'm out in the field using my camera. It clearly explains the hundreds of functions and the best uses for the settings.

 I keep it in my camera bag and have referred to it hundreds of times for clarification on the best functions for whatever my scene is. Well worth having. I'd recommend it to anyone who has a Canon T3.

I was a little apprehensive about buying this shirt without trying it on. The moisture wicking shirts always seem to run a size too big...well, not these.

The shirt fit perfectly! It was light weight and felt good on my skin. The colors are very nice and not too bright to draw unwanted attention (some companies colors seem to be almost bright neon).

I am 6 feet, 240lbs and the shirt draped nicely and didn't look like I was wearing a mid-drift like some t-shirts do after washing them.

The material hasn't snagged and it feels durable. It is true to size, so order your normal size when you place your order.

I have bought 3 of these shirts and I feel that Colombia has given me a quality product.

I would highly recommend.

The author has added yet another well written addition to The Remaining series. The story line continues to evolve with some curveballs and heart-pounding excitement. The writing is excellent, with kudos to the proof-reader/editor for making the story read smoothly with no errors or misspellings. I found this installment very hard to put down due to how intense the story and characters were.

The Remaining series has quickly vaulted itself to the top of the must-read category of Zombie fiction.

This series has become a must read for me and I am looking forward to the next installment.

No one likes arriving late at night or in the middle of a hot day and then having to put up a tent. This tent is easy...I mean, done in under 3 minutes easy. I only had to put down my beer once! It should be done with two people but can be done by one person.

Collapsing it and putting it back in the bag is also pretty easy but It does take about 5 minutes for that. It comes with a nice duffle bag to store it in and straps to hold it together.

Well worth getting this one. Although, I would't take it into extreme weather like rain or snow. It's definitely meant for spring, summer and fall camping.

The author has produced another great book. Continuing the great story line and excellent writing style that I've come to love about his books.

It's obvious the author takes pride in his work due to the fact that there are almost no grammatical or spelling errors throughout the entire book.

The story line is easy to follow and has excellent character development. I can't wait to read the next (unreleased) book in the series.

The story line continues, wrapping up all the loose ends. The story line has been solid with great character development.

I'm not a grammar freak but the proof-reader should look for a new job. It isn't as bad as the other books in the series, but if the author is paying someone for proof-reading, ask for a refund.

This book has it all. Great character development, very good writing, an awesome story line, lots of great twists and turns and almost no grammatical errors. I was very happy to have spent my time reading such a great piece of zombie fiction.

The series has been excellent and I'd recommend it to anyone into zombie fiction. Well done Mr. McKinney.

This book has it all. Great character development, very good writing, an awesome story line, lots of great twists and turns and almost no grammatical errors. I was very happy to have spent my time reading such a great piece of zombie fiction.

The series has been excellent and I'd recommend it to anyone into zombie fiction. Well done Mr. McKinney.

I purchased two of these for my daughter's room. I read all the reviews about the lack of instructions, etc. I consider myself well versed in this type of assembly. I call them "adult Legos". With that being said, at my top speed, it took me 45 minutes on each nightstand, for me to assemble them completely (1.5hrs total). The instructions were basic, with pictures, arrows and one sentence here or there. Pretty basic stuff, especially if you've ever had to assemble IKEA furniture.

The top is wood. All 4 sides of the drawers are wood. The rest of the nightstand is MDF (particle board). The drawer roller rails are metal and they roll well.

All of the screws, nails, etc. are in one big plastic bag instead of being separated into smaller bags containing each specific type of nail/screws...so a lot of your time will be spent just trying to locate the right hardware in the bag, unless you group them ahead of time.

For a little girls room, these nightstands are great.

The author uses facts to support his argument. The sarcasm of the author is needed to properly portray just how fake, controlling and money-grubbing Disney Corp has become. Well written, easy to follow and no grammatical errors. I'd highly recommend this book to others.

Great lock for the Yakima Ridgeback 4 Bike rack. It is very easy to install and simple to use. It is a nice added bit of safety for my bikes while I travel. I also use a HUGE Doberman bike lock in conjunction with the Yakima lock for overnight stays on the Yakima rack. The 2 replacement locks and accompanying keys make it super easy to access the lock and the Ridgeback hitch lock.

It's worth the price for piece of mind.

I thoroughly enjoyed reading this new installment in the series. It was well written with excellent character development and very few grammatical errors.

It's obvious that Jim Cook takes pride in his work and it shows in this presentation of a quality product.

I look forward to reading the next installment and would highly recommend this series to others.

I took this camera to the beach, more specifically, surfing. It did a great job of catching my friends riding waves and wiping out. Easy to operate the functions even through my 3mm surfing gloves.

I love the one touch video function. You can zoom in & out while in video mode. It also allows for "scene' modes. I didn't really need those on this trek so I kept everything on "Auto". The pics and vids came out really good.

I couldn't find the max zoom on it (digital), but I was in the ocean, so I wasn't going to screw around with settings too much.

Very durable display screen. I kept it tucked in my wetsuit and it didn't get a single scratch. I highly recommend the Olympus Float Strap for around $13 so you don't end up camera-less with it acting as a new fish home at the bottom of the ocean floor. Get a bright color so you don't lose it in all the white water.

Overall, it's a good waterproof camera.

I just used these for the 1st time on a camping trip.

PROS:
Non-Stick
Stack inside eachother
Cleans VERY easily
Removeable handle for easy storage

CONS:
Made in China
The removeable handle is black, so I can see that it may get lost but hoping it doesn't.

I cooked three meals with these pots & pans and used every single one of them with no issues. I even boiled 4 full size ears of corn in the big pot! They cleaned up easily, stored away easily and left no burn marks or peeling like others have mentioned in their reviews. I cooked on a Coleman stove, not over an open fire.

I would NOT recommend these for cooking over an open fire. You should probably get cast-iron pots if that's what you're into. I could totally see these not being thick enough not to melt or have paint bubbling issues over an open fire.

ON A SIDE NOTE:
Coleman is synonymous with camping in America, unfortunately almost everything they sell is made in China now. I purchased a lot of Coleman products through Amazon for my recent camping trip and was dissapointed to see that almost every item was "Made in China". Amazon should require the "Made in..." info in their listing of items.

These Merrell's are very comfortable shoes. I walk about 5-10 miles a day and these have held up well. I've used them for approximately a month. The sole has good gripping in wet and dry conditions.

I would recommend these shoes to others.

I bought this as a gift since it was on the "Deal of the Day".

The price was right. I was even more impressed with the quality. It is very eye catching and the light catches the diamonds real nicely. The chain is nice and durable.

It is definitely a good, quality piece of jewelry.

The frame looks fine from the front. The back of it is cardboard held in place by push down metal tabs. It is not a glass frame, it's plexiglass (plastic). It works for what I needed it for but I probably would not buy another one again.

I gave it as a gift with an odd-sized matted photo in it (12x18). It just feels cheap and very light. It's nothing like a real photo frame that you'd get at your local store, but it did the job as a gift. I can't say that I'd recommend getting one when there are better quality frames out there at around the same price.

users.query: They were larger than I expected but I made them work.

cands.text: They are pretty as well as doing the job they were made for.
They were just what I was looking for and couldn't find in the office store.
This was very cute and made a nice Christmas gift for the grandchildren.  They thought they were great and started using them right away.

My sister had showed me these needles when I told her I needed one easy to thread and small enough to to go through a small bead.  My Daughter told me to check Amazon when none of the bead catalogs showed them  There was a good selection and this solve the problem for me.
These were a Christmas present and made  a big hit. I don't know how well they lasted  because they went home with the grandchildren.
They go well on my table and look very nice.
The arrows were very small  and did not make the other children wan't some.  I thought they would be  more of a show and I would not choose them again.
These are very cute.  I kept one and sent one to my sister.  We both really do like them

They are very nice quality.  I wanted RFID Blocking and genuine leather wallet's, for my grandchildren this Christmas.  They are 13, 17 and 19 years old boys so we will have to see how that works out later.
They can wrap around whatever you want to keep cool. It works for me.
Very nice for the price.  They made nice gifts and I was happy with them.
These needles are very useful.  I have already found five uses other than beading. I saw them in Santa Fe, NM at my sisters house but couldn't find a place to buy them. Amazon to the rescue again.
For my granddaughter who wanted a dance costume.  they were what I expected.
Not as full as I would have liked but fine when decorated.

The silicone placemats  matched the table and stayed in place.  They were very thin and didn't cause the glasses to turn over if they were set on the edgef. They came in a lot of colors so you have a wide choice.  I like them.

These toys are not my thing but my grandsons seem to love them. I don't like the little parts that are left behind when they return home. They are always very important and need to be sent to them as soon as I find them.
We have had these for quiet a while and use them in the back of the house when my children and grandchildren are here. They seem to work well enough.
I tried them one morning and my voice cleared but I cant say they taste good.
I love them but they are very hard to find around here.
Frozen Elsa Action Figure. I collected all of them.  They are a very cute set.

This is another Donna Andrews Mystery.  She can keep me reading one of her books to the very end.  The people who die are never anyone that will be missed and I like that. I never like it when likable people die but I do like to try to solve the mystery's.
These are the only treats my dogs like and you have the advantage of clean strong teeth.  I don't want any other treat.
It is about a couple that were separated at a young age and find there way back to each other.
I like all of the Hamish Macbeth Mysteries that I have purchased. I have several of them and never have found one that hasn't held my interest.

users.query: I received this today and i used it today...  I was concerned when many reviews said that it was stiff; this is not what i found.  It has a quality feel to the movement of the pins.  I would not want easier movement.  I used this to get a curve off my gloss polyurethane dresser that i am building; there was no concern about scratching the finish.  I wish i had gotten this long ago, would have saved a lot of paper cutouts...

Works great for longer bits - But then why would i need this...
Love these for polyurathane - No brush lines - Easy to use and toss-out.

This blade was a major improvement over the blade that came with my saw.  Far less splintering.  The blade is very thin.  You might expect it to be delicate, but it has held up just fine.  On my cordless saw it enables me to cut more between charges.  For any kind of finsh work this is a must-have

I got this to cut a piece of baseboard out of the middle without removing the entire board.  Worked very well and a clean thin cut.  The tool is very smooth starting and running - Exudes quality.  Easy to handle.  The case is small and holds everything well.  I am quite pleased.  I expect that it will find many uses over my lifetime.

I have a Fiskers rotary for more than 10yrs - It was ok, but i rarely got a perfectly straight cut.  The blade got dull, so i decieded to try a new machine; i chose this.  WOW!  When I opened the box i saw right away that the quality of this cutter was in a whole new class compared to my old plastic one - This machine is solid.  The mechanics are excellent.  I was able to cut a hair's width off a photo, my earlier cutter could never do that.  I was a little concerned about a comment on business cards because i make my own.  In my case the review's concern does not apply because i cut my cards out of 8.5x11 stock.  What i can say is that the yellow plastic piece under the cutter is large enough that to cut anything smaller than say 2x2 it will be totally under the yellow plastic and difficult to move around(only by poking it with another piece of paper).  So if you do alot of trimming off small pieces of paper, this is probably not the machine for you.  The machine is also a couple of inches shorter than my old machine and fits on the shelf better.  I did not expect such a good quality machine, it is night and day over my old one-  My only regret is that i did not buy it earlier...

Too thick compared to Starbrite.  Impossible to get an even coating and difficult to get a continuous coating.  I have plenty left over, but buying a can of the Starbrite version because i am not satisfied with this.

I'm pleased with this item.  I was always having to run from my office to the garage to get the right size screwdriver.  I keep this in my desk.  It has the right sizes for working on my computers.  And they think ahead; the extended gripper and tweezers for screws dropped in the casing.

GOOP is the best!
I've used all the different versions - They all seem exactly the same, though there must be some slight difference between the various types.
I keep a tube around and it is my go-to glue(i have them all) for typical house hold fixes.
I used to use alot of these...  But i have switched to the aluminum type; they seem to be a better quality.  Though i must say that the aluminum is no clear winner; it just has the edge...

real solid - stays where you put it, almost too well.
some what large, took me a while to figure a good placement.
very pleased.  particularly good if you do not remove the mount often as it sticks so well as to make it difficult to remove; at least on glass.
Very good for well-directed, fine sprays.  Very high quality.  I am pleased with this purchase.

I got these after reading a magazine article.  I had my doubts because the tape solution never works.  Well i used this on acrylic caulk.  A month or two later i took it off and to my suprise there was absolutly no hardened caulk.  I can not speak for other calks/adheasives, but for the acrylic it worked great.  And they are very easy to apply and remove.

UPDATE-  Used on Polyurathane sealant and sealant was hardened in the nozzle after 3 months; i took 1 star off.
Still way more convenient than tape and i believe it works better.  I plan to continue using them.

I've been a wood working hobbiest all my life.  I got my first cabinet saw this week. This book is perfect for me.  I've had a benchtop saw, a contractor saw and I owned a radial saw.  I thought I pretty much knew everything i needed to know.  I am very glad i got this as it really fills the gaps between those saws and the cabinet saw. I would have had no clue what i was missing without the book.  I would put this as the appropiate book for anyone who has not had a lot of experience with a cabinet saw or wants to do furniture work on a contractor saw.  One reviewer mentioned it as not for the DIY with a benchtop saw; he is right, this is more high-end saw.  I got the book before the saw and i was not all that impressed.  Now that i have the saw and have used it for 1 day;  i've encountered several unexpected issues that this book addresses - Very impressive and useful.
Update-
Looking at the book again, I relize that it goes well beyond intermediate(and me) with joints and jigs.  It is just a great book!

i got this to sharpen my fat pencils that i use in my wood shop - This works really really well...  I lost the first one i got at the craft shop; i was very happy to find this on Amazon.  I was surprised to read a review about it containing lead; disbelieving, i went and read the package.  An yes there is a warning label.  I looked into it on Wikipedia- Lead is a problem ingredient in most brass; including those brass house keys...  As of 2001 California said lower the lead or add a warning sticker.  Who would have known- Too late for me; this is not the first piece of brass that i have handled, just the first with a warning:(  Good thing i don't live in CA, where i would get lead poisoning:)

Anyway it's a great sharpener, i will just not sharpen my pencils as often...

This is a very well made sponge - Two heavy layers of mesh compared to the single layer on the common yellow sponge.
I am completely satisfied with it.

All-in-all this thing gets the job done at what seems an incredibaly cheap price for all the various cables you get (the product picture does not show even half of them).

users.query:
This product is great for someone on the go who wants a laptop/touchscreen combination.  The Chromebook is specifically designed to work with the Google platform (storing all of your data on the google drive is a quick convenient way to make sure you always have your files with you).  I started using the drive a couple of years ago, and have never looked back.  This product helps you to access those files instantaneously and easily.

The overall design of this product is great because it can function as both a laptop, with a full keyboard (which I love, and really miss on other touch screen devices).  If you are working on anything that you will need to type for this is a must have feature, it also functions as a touch screen tablet instantaneously.  All you have to do is fold the screen over and you immediately have a touchscreen tablet.

The device is incredibly easy to use, and easy to set up.  If you have a google account set up will link you to all your files within a couple of minutes through the easy set up.  From there you are able to access all your files via the internet quickly.  The great thing about this laptop is that it also has USB and HDMI ports so that you can bring files with you, or connect it to other devices.  I love this feature as well, because many tablets do not give you the ability to connect via a USB or HDMI port.

This product is quickly replacing my old laptop because of its size and portability.  The speed is also fantastic on this device, and it allows you to surf, and work lightning fast.  The days of lugging around my oversized laptop are over.  The screen on the device is crystal clear (you can read all about the capabilities online with all the technical details).  For light work, and for portability I really like this chromebook.  I think the more I use it the more I will like it, and that it will soon become an essential part of the technology that I use daily.

cands.text:
This ipad (or tablet) stand does exactly what it promises to do.  No more no less, which is good if all you want is a very basic stand for your ipad (or tablet).

Personally I use this product with my Ipad and I found that it was a decent stand.  It is well constructed, and when used on a flat surface it will lift your Ipad for easier viewing.

It does have a few downsides however:

It is not adjustable in any way.  What you see is what you get, you get a simple slot for putting the device into and that is all that you can do.  You cannot move the device easily up and down, because it is all one piece.  If you are looking for something to put on your desk for viewing, this is a good device, however the lack of adjust-ability can be frustrating.

It will only fit smaller/thinner devices.  If you have a really thick cover on your device you may run into a problem.

Its not really useful at all if you want to use your Ipad as a computer and leave it on the stand while typing on it.  I found trying to type at an angle like  that annoying.

The product however is well built and sturdy and if you simply want to elevate your Ipad this is a good place to start.

I have never used a smart watch before (and this watch really does not qualify as a smart watch proper because there is no actual onscreen notifications).  However, this watch is a step in the right direction.  It has a nice design, however, I was torn because of a few flaws in the overall design of the watch.

The watch comes out of the box looking great.  It is well designed with a classic leather band.  The watch face is large and easy to read.  Set up takes only a couple of minutes, and you can connect it to your smart phone by downloading a simple app and syncing the watch.  This entire process takes less than 5 minutes.

The reason that I only gave the watch 4 stars (I would like 3.5) is because of some design flaws.  First, the watch is bulky.  It is about twice as thick as my other watches (I like a slim light design).  This is due to the watch being a "smart watch", it has an extra layer on the bottom for notifications (vibrates on your wrist).  I really wish this design was a bit more slim, and not so bulky.

A second flaw with the design is the watch face itself.  It has the classic time, but the three smaller clock faces on the watch are almost useless.  The first one is a 24 hour guide (at 8AM it is at the 8, at 8PM it is at the 20).  Not sure that I would need my watch to keep track of this, I know when it is morning and when it is night.  The other two clock faces are for a timer, that is almost useless.  I don't think I would ever use this.  I would much rather have a face showing the date, or other information that I might actually use from time to time.

The other issue with the watch is that there are no onscreen notifications.  Everything is done via an app on your smartphone.  While the watch will vibrate slightly for every notification, you have to open the app on your phone to track your distance, notifications, etc.  I found this to be cumbersome, and an extra feature that is not really needed on the watch.  If I want to track my steps I simply use the health monitor on my I-phone (which the watch will sync with).  The watch doesn't really provide any extra information that your health app would not have.  I would almost rather have a regular watch instead of the extra "smart" applications that come with this one.

Watches are definitely subjective in terms of style.  I liked this style except for the fact that it was a bit too large for me personally (although some may like that).  Overall this watch performed pretty well, it has some obvious design flaws, which I think become noticeable almost immediately when you put the watch on.  Overall I was somewhat satisfied with the product, but think that version 2.0 would be a better investment.

I picked this item for my 9 year old daughter who is now at the age where she wants a phone.  This smartwatch is great for her because it allows kids the option of taking pictures and video, and is interactive without the parent having to go all the way to a smartphone.

The band of the smart watch is adjustable, and comfortable, and overall the watch was not as bulky and obtrusive as I thought it would be.  Personally I like my wristwear to be lightweight and not overpowering, and this watch certainly met that goal.

As soon as the watch is powered up you have the ability to set the time and date, and take pictures or videos with the watch.  This is great for kids, because it acts as their own personal camera.  After pictures or videos are taken you can back them up using the USB cord that comes with the watch so you don't have to worry about filling up all of the memory space too quickly.

The camera can take JPEG photos at a pretty decent resolution for a small watch (640X480).  My daughter is camera ready all the time, so this was a great feature for her (plus it will keep them from asking for your phone every five minutes).

The watch also comes with games that the kids can play ( a little too easy for a 9 year old) but for younger kids I'm sure that they will find the games to be exciting and it is a great thing to keep them entertained for a while in the car, or when you are out and about and you need something to be distracting for a short while.

If you are looking for a watch/camera for a younger child I think you will like this product.  It is sturdy, and is a sort of go between for kid who is wanting a smart phone.  With this watch you get the advantages of some smart phone features without having to go the full distance to a smart phone.

This is a fantastic backpack that is perfect for older kids and adults alike.  Personally I use it for travel and whenever I need to carry several things with me to work.  The backpack has 4 different compartments (a couple larger ones, and two smaller ones).  One of the great features about this product is the fact that the outer pockets are reinforced so they are safe for your I-Pad or smaller fragile electronic devices.

One of the best features of this backpack is that it actually fits my larger laptop.  I have a slightly larger than normal laptop (17") and in most backpacks it either does not fit, or I have to struggle to place the laptop into the backpack.  This backpack fits the laptop perfectly with ease which is a great feature.  It is also reinforced so I don't have to worry about fragile things inside my backpack.

The overall quality of the backpack is excellent as well.  It is built well, and seems like it will last the test of time.  This backpack also looks nice enough that you could take it to work, or on a camping trip -- it is very versatile.  The space inside is excellent as well, and with all the zippers and compartments it will fit everything you need in there.

This backpack has replaced my previous ones, and I see myself using this for a long time to come.  I really loved this product, and I think you will be pleased with it as well.

This book has some great ideas for the classroom.  If you are a teacher that utilizes novels in the classroom this book is a resource that will give you ideas on how to integrate them into your curriculum.

The book gives you an overview of how to integrate novels, and how to engage students in active learning with the novels as the curriculum for the class.  This is a great resource for younger students especially in Junior High with activities that will help the students seek out themes in the novels that you are teaching.  The author stresses that it is important that students be interested and engaged in the novels you are teaching (which is not always an easy task).

I would recommend this book to teachers in Language Arts departments who are looking for a resource to help them teach novels in the classroom.

I found this router to have both good and bad qualities.  It was very easy to set up and get started with the router, the design of the router was very eye catching as well.  It just looks cool.  The router came with a set-up CD which guides you through the set up process, and makes it easy for the novice to connect quickly to the internet wirelessly.  There was simple instructions to follow and it was simple to set up.

The downside to the router I found to be the speed.  I experienced technical problems with the router, at times having to reset it in order to achieve an acceptable speed.  This however was only the case on one of my laptops that I used with the router.  Another laptop that I sometimes use worked fine with the router.  The router advertises it as the lower level offered by Linksys, and if you are simply using the router for home wireless connections then this is an excellent and affordable router.  If you are looking for something for multiple devices, or a tool for extremely fast wireless connections I would recommend upgrading to a higher rated router.

I picked up this book because I am a political junkie, and interested in the process of becoming a President in our country.  Throughout history some of the best candidates have sputtered and failed, while other lesser candidates have come along and won the White House to the surprise of many of the pundits.  The book overviews some of the most memorable recent campaigns for the White House and how they either succeeded or failed to achieve the White House.

I found the book easy to read, and engaging.  It was sort of like pulling back the curtain on the races that we watched from the outside on TV.  The behin the scenes views of what was really going on in the campaigns was engaging and interesting and provided both context and reasons for the success or failures of different candidates.

While hindsight is 20/20 the author points out some characteristics of sucessful campaigns, and some of the pitfalls that candidates can fall into.  I wondered as I read through the book if the candidates themselves were aware of these pitfalls, and could fall into the same traps that others had without realizing it.

This is a great read for anyone who is interested in the political process, or anyone who wants to go behind the scenes of some of the most recent elections to show what caused the downfall of some of the can't miss candidates in recent years.

This Bluetooth speaker is a fantastic addition to my home.  I have used a couple of different models of Bluetooth speakers in the past (all of them have been smaller than this one) but this one outperforms them all.  To say that it is rugged is an understatement, it is built to last and to last in the outdoors.  It is waterproof and spray proof, which makes it perfect for usage outside (where I primarily use it).  It is bulky and heavy, which is a nice thing because if you drop the speaker on the ground you don't have to worry about it breaking.

The sound quality is excellent as well.  The speaker can easily fill an entire room or your back yard with sound.  The bass and the clarity of the sound exceeded my expectations as well, I found that it provided sound quality that was equal to some of my more expensive brand name speakers.  This small speaker certainly packs a punch.

You can also accessorize this model with a large variety of add-ons to make the speaker even more powerful.  It charges quickly, and has a battery life of about 15 hours of continuous play.

Some may not the rugged look, for appearance reasons, but for me, putting this speaker outside the rugged look fit perfectly for me.

If you are looking for a rugged outdoor speaker that will last the test of time, and provide excellent sound I think you will really like this product.

I must say at the outset that I am a big fan of Brian McLaren and every time a new book of his comes out I immediately purchase it and read it.  So I am certainly a biased reviewer of this product because I am a fan of his work.  This companion book to the full version of The Great Spiritual Migration is a great resource for study groups, or even individuals that want to go a bit deeper into the ideas contained in the book.

McLaren's work has been about taking the Christian faith into the next century, providing pathways for progressive Christians to follow.  If you are a progressive who has grown tired of the same old stale faith, and are looking for those who want to embrace a more inclusive, loving, well rounded faith then his work is for you.  This participant's guide provides background to each chapter and questions you can interact with to go a bit deeper.

I highly recommend McLaren's work to you, it has really been a source of encouragement and challenge in my life and has certainly deepened my personal faith.  This is a great companion to the full book, and if you are planning on leading a small group discussion centered around the Way of Life I think you will really find this product helpful.

I must begin this review by acknowledging that I am not a computer expert by any means, so my review is from a common layperson who is literate in all normal computer programs.

I picked up this product because I was growing increasingly annoyed with the automatic scans and "your computer is at risk" messages from other anti-virus software programs that I have previously used (none of which would fix whatever the problem was on the computer, they would just give horrible warning messages).

What I like about Norton:  It's a name I've used, and trust.  It updates automatically to protect me from viruses (even new ones).  It runs in the background and doesn't seem to have slowed down my computer at all.

I only gave this product 4 stars because of the installation process.  I tried both the CD and the online download process, but it took me several tries because I had other anti-virus software that was apparently interfering with the installation.  It took me a good 30 minutes to restart, uninstall, and finally get the product installed.  However, now that I have installed the program I like it.

Let's face it, in today's world you need anti-virus software, and Norton is a name I trust, and I think others will like this product as well.  It's much better to buy the software now then to later have to throw your computer into a river because it is loaded with viruses.

This book is about 450 pages, which is a bit long for a novel, and a length at which I need to be engrossed the entire time in order to make it through.  This book did that for me partly because of the moving story line, and partly because the content is in my field and I find this type of novel interesting.

In the book Daniel Byrne is tasked with disproving miracles for the Catholic church, he is assigned to debunk the prophecies of his uncle, something that he is keen to do at the beginning, but of course things go awry from there.  The story moves along at a good pace, and for someone who is interested in religion, and the reality of miracles in our world, this book would work for you.

There are enough twists and turns in the book to keep you engaged, and it makes for a great summer read, or vacation read.  Personally I found it enjoyable as a break from more intense reading and a nice escape into the world of non-fiction.  This book may be the beginning of future novels, so I'm interested to see where the storyline will evolve.

I recommend this book for anyone interested in miracles, the catholic church, and for those who can remember that this is book of fiction and not necessarily true!

I love this portable speaker.  Personally I find the speakers that are on my phone (I-phone 4s) to be too small to adequately listen to music through it while I am at home.  This is a great little blue tooth speaker that allows you to play music at a higher level almost everywhere.  The clip attached to the back of the speaker is solid, and can be used when on the go (although personally I always use headphones when working out--I'm sure that some will find this useful).

This speaker is great for around the house, next to the pool, or just about anywhere.  It's small and compact so that you can take it with you just about anywhere, and its great if you want a boost for your music.

It connects easily via blue tooth to your phone (if you keep blue tooth turned on all the time it will automatically connect). It is portable size so the only drawback is that you are not getting robust sound.

I personally recommend this speaker.

The Night Market was my first experience with Jonathan Moore and I was pleasantly surprised.  The Night Market takes place in the near future in San Francisco in an almost alternate universe where some forms of technology have increased dramatically and portions of the city are desolate.  The book itself is well written with a great amount of skill.  Moore's descriptions throughout the book really bring the text to life, and you are transported to another dimension when reading the book.

The book focuses on a San Francisco police detective who after experiencing a strange call to investigate a homicide finds that his memory of the event is distorted.  From there the novel tracks the detective as he (along with a few friends) tries to piece together exactly what happened the night in question.  The book brings forward a bit of the technology of the future as well as showing what some cities could become.

The book is very well written and I found myself reading it voraciously at times. Trying to figure out who or what is behind the mystery in the book was a really great journey.  Enough answers are given to the reader to make the conflict in the story seem real enough, and to give you an open ended sort of understanding.  I don't want to go into too many details here because I don't want to spoil the book for future readers.

Overall I really enjoyed this book, it is well written, the subject matter is somewhat unique, and I really think I will be checking out future Jonathan Moore novels.

If your like me, a fan of John Eldredge, as soon as Walking With God was released, you were either on the internet, or in your favorite local bookstore ready to pick up a copy.  I've often wondered what it would be like to spend a day, a week, or a month with Eldredge.  Canoing the waters of the wild west, leading a cattle drive like the cowboys of yesteryear, or hunting wild elk.  His books stir in my soul a yearning for the beauty of God's creation, and a longing to walk with God in deep relationship.

This book represents a unique look into the journal entries of Eldredge over the period of a year.  There are no chapter divisions, simply a catalog of the seasons as they come and go. Eldredge invites us to walk with God over the course of a year with him, through the good times, the bad times, and the strange times that life offers up to us.

This book will stir your heart, and challenge your mind.  It's narrative is inviting and easy to read, you feel as though you are in deep conversation with a close friend. Eldredge has the ability to share with you his life in an authentic manner without pretense.  Eldredge will challenge you to view every event in your life as spiritual, from the moment you wake, until you lay your head on the pillow at night, God is intimately involved in a relationship with you.

Eldredge challenges our assumptions about spirituality, and our view of God in a non threatening way.  This book has the ability to stir the deep desires of our hearts, challenge our faulty views of God, and spur us onto living in deeper relationship with God, all in a unique narrative approach.

This book will be a great help to anyone seeking a deeper relationship with God.

I picked up this product for a 2 year olds birthday.  Overall I was really impressed with the toy.  It comes out of the box, and assembles in minutes, no major tools required.  Your child will immediately be able to play with the toy.  Overall the toy is constructed well, it will stand the test of time, and a toddlers playing with it.  This toy is great for children to begin to learn balance, and gives them something active they can scoot around the house on.

The toy is made for indoor use only.  I can't imagine that people would use the toy for outside use, but it is made of plastic and outdoor use would certainly limit the life of the toy.  The bright colors are great to keep a toddler entertained as well.  It house a variety of colors and sounds that young kids will find entertaining.

The VTech company makes a variety of toys, so you know it is a company that you can trust and a toy that will last.  This made a great gift for a 2 year old, and I think you will like the toy as well.

Passages is an enjoyable read.  Brian Hardin's basic premise is that reading the Bible, and reading the Bible in long chunks will help your overall life and faith in extraordinary ways.  I agree with his basic premise, and as someone who is a student of theology I have found that most Christians do not spend much time at all reading the Sacred Scriptures.  We too often settle for sound byte Scripture readings either in a daily devotional, or hearing snippits from a church service on Sunday.

Passages is a refreshing read, it reminds you of the purpose of Scripture reading,and the change it can affect in your life.  If you have never read the Bible before, or if you have been religious for a long period of time, but have never really read the Scripture in large chunks this is a good place to start.  The book contains a year long Bible reading plan (several in fact) which are helpful for those who want to read the Bible, but don't know where to start, or for those who get bogged down 2 months into the Pentateuch.

I enjoyed reading this book, it was a bit simplistic in parts (sometimes I got the feeling the author was saying just read the Bible and all your problems will go away).  The only other negative about this book was that sometimes if felt like the Bible was being touted as a talisman that had powers to transform.  (I do certainly agree that by reading the Scripture we come into contact with the revealed God which can change a persons life).

Overall I thought this was a good book, simple in its message, and simple to read.  I recommend it to anyone out there looking to start a Bible reading program, or to anyone who is curious about what Bible reading is all about.

This was my first ever experience with C.J. Tudor, and it was an exceptional one.  I am always looking to discover new and exciting authors who provide a novel that captures your attention by keeping you in suspense.  This novel definitely hit all the right notes for me, and kept me in suspense all the way to the final pages.  I found myself sneaking time away to read this book because I wanted to solve the mystery of the chalk man, and the ending of this book did not disappoint.

The novel centers around a group of friends in their early adolescent years.  The book jumps back and forth in each chapter from the past to the present, but both narratives are written so well that you don't find yourself losing your place during the time jumps.  The main character is trying to figure out exactly what took place years ago, as the infamous chalk man has reappeared and is leaving clues to what really happened in a murder case from his childhood.

I don't want to give too many details from the book, because I think the reader should experience everything for themselves, but this book is well written, interesting, and has enough twists and turns to keep your attention all the way through the end.  I really enjoyed this book, and am really looking forward to following this new writer in the future.  I loved this book, and I think you will like it too.

This book is a hilarious overview of most of the Presidents in our history.  Starting with George Washington it covers all the Presidents up to Richard Nixon (skips Carter and Ford and covers Reagan).

This book is basically a humorous look at each President giving you advice on how to beat them in a fight (if they ever come back from the dead and have a beef with you).  It gives interesting historical insight into their lives and some of the quirks and very strange things that they did either while President or in their lives before that.

This is not a history book, but a humorous look at what it takes to be President, but I thoroughly enjoyed it.  It's parts history and definitely parts ridiculousness and humor, but you learn quite a bit about each President as you read through the book.

The book is short, with chapters that are only a couple pages long on each President.

I think that anyone who enjoys history, especially history of the Presidents would enjoy this book.

A great toy for a small child.  I used this toy with a one year old boy, who was instantly entertained with the multiple colors and the noises that the monkey makes.  Small children need visual and audio stimulation and this toy provides both for you and your child.

The advantages of the toy are that it has multiple textures and sounds that will keep the child entertained.  The multiple textures allow the child to have a variety of experiences with the toy.

The toy is also very colorful which helps to keep the child's attention.  Although I haven't had to clean the toy thoroughly yet, spot cleaning was not a problem, and the entire toy seems to be able to be cleaned fairly easily.

The toy is basically a mish mash of colors, and toys put together to keep the child's attention.  It works great as a hanger over the car seat, or simply as something the child can play with to keep them entertained for a while.

I have used similar products in the past, like the fit bit to track my daily exercise and steps.  This product did have a few advantages over those products.  First and foremost the ability to clip the device on your clothes anywhere, or simply use the small chip in your pocket made it more convenient than wearing a bulky wristband day in and day out.

The product comes out of the box ready to go, however, you should charge it out of the box.  Mine was about half charged, but you will want to allow some extra time to charge the product to be sure that you get the full effect, and don't run out of juice in the middle of the day.

The other advantage of this product over some others is the display.  Other products will only show you a line of where you are at for your daily goal (which means you have to wear a separate watch if you want to know the time).  This product has both, and tells you simply and easily how much power is left in the device as well.

The only downside I experienced with this product is the name brand (never heard of it or used another product from them).  That can be a bit worrisome in terms of longevity, but so far I have not had any issues with the product.

This product is great for the athlete, and the everyday person that just wants to be more active.  I used it for both running, and simply to track how active I was during the day.  Setting a steps goal becomes a bit more fun when you have a tracker to see how far you've gone, or how much more you need to make up in the day.  I think you will like this product as a fitness tracker.

My niece is still in the Barbie phase (it seems to last quite a long time in adolescent girls) so I ordered the Barbie Spin N Ride Pups set.  The fact that it is a Barbie product means that it will be instantly popular, but the addition of some dogs made the toy even more appealing to my six year old niece.

The toy goes together very easily, and Barbie can ride the bike, her legs go up and down, and the dogs actually either run along side Barbie, or runs around her, which is a nice addition.  It adds that extra detail that made the toy even more appealing to play with.

Barbie is well made, and you can always add more and more to the Barbie in terms of clothes, etc.  Barbie's legs move up and down very easily.  the dogs are nice as well, and sturdy in construction.  You do need a smooth surface for the toy to work properly, however, you can detach the dogs and use the toy on a carpet without a problem.

The only downside to the toy is the price, a bit high, but Barbie toys do seem to run in the high range.  I think if you have a child that loves Barbie this toy will not disappoint in any way.

I use a face moisturizer every day, mostly because of dry skin, and the fact that I live in South Florida where the sun is a constant companion.  This moisturizer lived up to my expectations and then some.  While many moisturizers are greasy, or leave a residue on your hands this one was absorbed into my skin quickly with almost no residue whatsoever.

The other aspect of this product that I really liked was that it was not scented, and didn't leave a strange smell on my face after use (especially when combined with cologne this can be a problem).

I used the product primarily during the day, and not at night as recommended (when I normally apply moisturizer).  But I found that the product kept my skin soft all day.  I'm not sure that it would erase wrinkles (can anything do that?) but I certainly found it superior to my normal face moisturizer.  I think you will be very pleased with this product.

I picked up this coffee because I use K cups every day at work because of the convenience.  I really enjoyed this coffee, and really felt like it gave me a quality cup of coffee that was equal to some of the more expensive brands that I have used in the past.  On average a high end box of K-cups can cost you nearly $1 a cup, and this brand sells 40 for a little over $20 so the price point is great.

This coffee was not too dark or too strong for me (I like a mild or medium roast) and it tasted great with a little bit of cream in it (the way I take my coffee).  I was quite impressed with this brand and really enjoyed the coffee that it brewed.  At a little over 50 cents a cup, this is also a great deal for K-cups.

I can see myself using this brand again in the future.

Few Presidents have served in more tumultuous times than Woodrow Wilson.  In his book Scott Berg takes us through the life and presidency of Woodrow Wilson.

In his book Berg uses his formidable skill in writing biographies to take the reader through a detailed version of what happened during the Wilson presidency.  Special attention is given to the period following the World War when Wilson traveled through Europe trying to get a peace plan in place.  These few months were extremely important in American history following the first World War as Wilson basically left his home country to travel the world in search of peace.  The pitfalls and struggles are carefully recounted in this book.

I recommend this book to Presidential historians, and those interested in reading about the issues that Presidents have to face while in office.  The job as the most powerful man in the world is not an easy one, and that is clear in this book.

The writing is fantastic, the attention to detail is superb in this book.  Although the length of the book can be daunting, it is worth the readers time because of the vast amount of information contained in it.
