I didn't read these. They were recommended by our librarian who kinda knows my grandson's taste in books. I looked at the artwork, which I thought was pretty decent, and put in the hands of a nine year old graphic novel enthusiast. He read both of them by the next day and wanted to know if there were any more. I'll pick reading over video games and tv any day!

There are many really great reviews of this book already. What I will say is buy this book for the young men in your life- sons, grandsons, young men not that into reading. It is motivating and uplifting and will keep their interest from page one. I recommend junior and high schools put it on their summer reading lists!

When a child, a child who loves to read and does so voraciously, asks for a specific book and then tells you that you really need to read it, do it. Some of the tween and young adult literature out there is fantastic and I would include The Road To Paris as required reading for third or fourth grade up. I absolutely loved this story and the way the author handled some difficult subjects, foster care and why we need it. It's not always pleasant but the author did a very good job of developing the character of Paris and showing how the system SHOULD work. And just have to say, I love this author's work and have several of her books.
Very good book. Interesting storyline. A little predictable, but still fun reading it.

I, too, purchased this book from the Scholastic Club because my granddaughter (age 6) asked for it. She wanted it because the little girl on the cover looked like her. She read it to me, a few chapters each night. It was an easy, fun read. We both enjoyed the story of a little girl who has to start a new school where her three older brothers already have a lock on the popularity poll. It was a sweet, funny story with the perfect 'feel good' ending kids want. Having become aware of series, she asked me if there were any more. Needless to say, we got online and ordered several more!!

Another winner in the series! I like the fact that some of the words are a little more challenging than some other children's books. My granddaughter had no trouble reading and understanding them (she was in first grade when she read first one). There may have been 2 words in each book she actually had to ask help for (didn't know meaning of word). I also love the fact that each book has a little moral in it and in this one it's the consequences of jealousy and lieing. Kudos to Miss Goldberg on creating a series kids and parents will love!!

I just read this book for the second time with my granddaughter (11) as a precursor to reading the next one, Ghosts of Tupelo Landing. I think it was very well written and the issues handled were indeed dealt with in an age appropriate manner. After all, as much as we try to shelter our kids and grands from the world's ugliness, they see it every day. This book provides a jumping off point for different conversations, including spousal abuse and challenging the idea of what constitutes 'family'. I do read books I'm not sure about before giving them to kids. And I still highly recommend this book.

This book is a beautiful way to introduce your kids to another culture. I bought it for a 9 year old so wanted to read it first and determine if age appropriate. I fell in love with Ha, a little girl with spunk, intense feeling and insight beyond her years. I didn't know it was poetry when ordered. It's like a journal in prose and very well written. The poems each tackle a day or feeling or event, something in Ha's life. This is a gift worthy book. It is unique and inspiring, empowering for girls.

Usually, I don't like to give more than a brief idea of what books are about because some reviews tell too much and can ruin your read. I also like to read kids/young adult books before I give to the grands to judge age appropriateness. I did't get to read this one before I sent it to my sixth grade granddaughter, so I called and asked her about it. She gave me a very enthusiastic book review worthy of an A+ if it had been handed in as a written report. Willow obviously touched her heart and reinforced the basic ideas of tolerance, acceptance for those who might be different, and what love looks like. After Gdaughter's very insightful break down, I asked her the one thing she hadn't said, "So, did you like it?" She gave me the you-old-people sigh, and said, "Yesssssssss". I could hear her smiling through the phone.

I find these books mesmerizing! The artwork is beautiful and the story in each is empowering for kids, that they can work together to defeat the danger/foe. My little grandson just called to get number six. I sure hope it's in the works!

I read this book years ago in our book club. It was one of the few books  we've read that everybody enjoyed. If you've read the book, you know we had a lively discussion. If not, read it for yourself. I'm a little confused at the reviewers who gave it 1 star and said it was boring. This book is a hoot and it's worth the read. The ending was a  definite surprise. It was one of Ms. Mallette's earlier books, if not her first. Were there a few typo's or editing mistakes? Maybe. I don't remember. The story was too good to notice and not hardly boring! I actually was looking for my copy to read it again, but someone borrowed it and I decided to check if they had an E-book. So, read it yourself. It may not be a Nobel Prize winner, but it WAS a good read!

I checked this out from our library to read before buying for an 11 year old advanced reader. I didn't expect to like it, but now can't wait for her to get hers. She's at that age where many "kid's" books seem too babyish or too easy. The basic concept is that 13 yr old BB lives on an island with 3 eccentric older women (2 aunties and a Godma) and she longs for what she sees as a normal life with normal clothes, friends, and a regular school. In order to get off the island, she must fulfill certain requirements (and prove she's a princess). The way the story is written is what I really enjoyed. It sounds far-fetched, but from page one, LOVED IT! The language, the attitude, the little sketches in BB's 'diary', all add up to a fun, laugh-out-loud reading adventure. The best thing about this book is the metaphor drawn between BB's quest and the realities of growing up. It's probably best suited for 7 to 12 years old, but older kids will enjoy it as a break from some of the heavier stuff they're reading these days.

PS: Feb. 20, 2013 My granddaughter got hers and  read it in 2 days! She loved it!

This is one of those books where you need to know your reader. It is an EXCELLENT story about friends doing what friends do- stick together. The story is a little dark for some, but my granddaughter thought it was AMAZINGLY VERY GOOD. (Age 11) On that alone, knowing her extremely good taste in literature, I would have recommended it. But she had me read it so she could discuss it with someone who appreciated it (LOL). So now I can really recommend it!

Red Hats was a very pleasant surprise. I didn't know what to expect from Mr. Wayans. The story of Alma and her local Red Hats moved along quickly. The characters were cute but believable. I laughed out loud a few times, but then, it is written by Mr. Wayans. I highly recommend this as a little uplifting story, a perfect summer read. It will also make you think twice about holding long grudges against people you really love.... Kudos, Mr. Wayans!!

While this book is great for boys and girls, I think it's especially fun for boys. Ziggy is a cool, funny kid with quirky eating habits. His buddies are equally engaging and personable. Together, they have formed a little club called 'The Black Dinosaurs' and they seem to end up in the middle of mysteries, mysteries they just have to solve. The author has thrown in interesting little tidbits of history so the kids learn while enjoying themselves. In this episode, these city kids end up at an over-night camp, afloat in a canoe (without an oar) and running from.... something.

My little grandson (5-but an excellent reader) is on his third Ziggy book. He really enjoys the fact that they are about boys. It's great to have a series for when he finishes one and wants another of the same. I think would be interesting for kids 4-9.

I had already seen the play and just wanted to hear the amazing voices again, especially Cynthia Erivo and Jennifer Hudson.  This album has become a favorite in the house for everyone and it's not unusual for one of the kids to push the replay button, especially Celie's songs and the duet with Erivo and Hudson.

The pictures alone are worth buying this book. The story is the icing on the cake. This book is full of beautiful characters that act like people really act. Brothers call their sisters names and sisters try to one-up them. Mommas have to yell at them to stop. Hopefully someone in the family, like Sassy's Uncle Red, will give that needed encouragement. In the end, family acts like family...beautiful...sometimes. My grands were 3 and 5 when we got this book and they loved it, one boy, one girl. They laughed and claimed their corresponding characters in the book. They aahed and cheered when Sassy was feeling blue and then, ultimately, triumphant. They have both pulled the book and read it on their own along with 'Brothers of the Knight', another great collaboration between Allen and Nelson. I highly recommend this story as a lesson well delivered without preaching.

users.query: These sheets are really nice, and very soft. I did wash them before putting them on my bed.

cands.text: These are very nice. I bought some at Walmart a couple years ago which are really thin and didn't stay white at all! These are much nicer and thicker and very white!! Good cloths!!
Great!! They hold up well, and do a great job. I always wash mine prior to using, and did with these. They are much ore absorbent after being washed.
These socks are perfect when I wear slacks. They are warm, fit snuggly, and are warm in our cold winter. You won't go wrong with these!!
This is BEAUTIFUL!! And so delicate!! I've had so many compliments every time I wear it!! I have to remember to take it off when I go to bed. I don't want to bend it!!
I love these socks. They are so cushy, and definitely high quality! Recommend them to everyone. I have several pair of Gold Toe, different weights. Love the quality.
Just what I needed!! My bedskirt would either be up under mattress or hanging on the floor. This is the perfect solution!!

This scarf is very pretty, and oh, so soft. I love it. I can wear it for dressing, or warmth. This is a very versatile scarf, and pretty to boot. It can be worn different ways. It is really long, and I love that. Some are so short it is hard to change the style.
These are absolutely beautiful!! I have them on my mantle, and they look beautiful. I would recommend them to anyone.

I loved these when they were delivered. But I wore them almost every day for 7 days, and now they seem sloppy loose. These were so good at first, I did not expect them to stretch out on me. I have had many pairs of crocs and loved every one!! But disappointed these won't stay on my feet.

I loved these when they were delivered. But I wore them almost every day for 7 days, and now they seem sloppy loose. These were so good at first, I did not expect them to stretch out on me. I have had many pairs of crocs and loved every one!! But disappointed these won't stay on my feet.
These are perfect!! I have plantar fasciitis, and felt my first relief as soon as I pit them on!!
These are perfect!! I have plantar fasciitis, and felt my first relief as soon as I pit them on!!
I actually purchased these to use in a new home, to avoid installing rods with brackets. They work perfectly in the two bedrooms, and the curtains are held perfectly!

These pens are the best. When writing checks I don't like pens that write too lightly. These pens write smoothly and fluid. They write like an old fountain pen, but better. I read that these are 'the best' for writing checks as they cannot be altered.
These are really cool sunglasses. My only drawback is they are lopsided. When I put them on they just don't look right.

I was told by a doctor to try sport bras for a period of time. As I have never worn this type of bra, I wasn't sure what to expect. Some run really small, a couple  ran large, but this one ran perfect fit. It was exactly what I wanted.
Beautiful, true red. I've purchased others that are pink, or purple; these are the red I wanted!!
We just love these glasses. They are durable, and just the right size for my small hands. But my husband likes them too. They always come out of the dishwasher sparkling clean.
These are really pretty earrings. They are not small, and that I really love. They really shine. I would recommend them to anyone.
These earrings are really pretty. They sparkle like they are really expensive, they are great quality silver. I've worn them several times, and always get compliments.
I really enjoyed this Christmas story. The plot surprised me several times, and the characters were interesting. This was a good book, and kept my interest to the finish.
We play a lot of card games, and the stacks always get messed up. This is the perfect solution. And it is easy to slide down a long table so everyone can reach the draw pile.
Love Wranglers, but these seem to run larger and a little long.

This is great. I love the fact there is a center section to the rod which actually eliminates the need, for me, to have a center bracket. I am using it at a sliding door, and didn't want the center bracket to interfere with opening the curtain. it looks great, does not look cheap.  highly recommend it.

users.query: We have tile floors and the grout tends to rip off the usual stick-on felt pads over time, plus the chair legs damage the table legs. These prevent further damage to the table and the chairs slide much more easily on the tile. Highly recommended.

cands.text: As described, and the sticky pad is indeed sticky. Unfortunately, the carpet I'm using them on is deeper pile, and these sink in and don't slide as well as I'd hoped. These are better for shallower carpet fibers, on top of area rugs, etc.

Minor nitpick - the glazing on the rim of the bowl is not as smooth as I'd hoped - sort of like the stoneware mix wasn't as smooth as it could have been when the bowl was thrown. It's minor, but as something that's going to touch the delicate skin of the lips/mouth, it's a notable sensory issue. (Also, if you're using this in a proper tea ceremony, that rough edge is going to tear up your chakin.)
The color itself is gorgeous - a bright, summery teal blue, and the inside of the bowl is a bright white. It's a good size, even for those of us with larger hands, and if it's like the other Utsuwa brand bowls I have, it should whip tea nicely.

Our ancient Peke is a picky eater, and has been spoiled rotten by the Rabbit Zuke's treats, but also likes Nilla wafers and sweets. (In very small tidbits, of course.)  I figured dog-specific sweets were a better choice. ;)  She likes these quite a bit, and they're easy for her to chew - not too crunchy or hard on her old teeth and crooked jaw.  Frankly, I'm half tempted to try one myself - they smell good! :D

We have an elderly toy breed (well under 10 lbs), who rarely budges from her bed most of the day unless eating or tending to business. Since we're not always home and she's too old to bother to 'ask' to go out, these are our new go-to option over the mat by the back door (previously, it was old towels we would bleach, but those don't absorb odor). Given how pungent an elderly animal can be, these do a very good job of neutralizing the smell and absorbing the mess.  And if she had better aim, we would have bought the smaller sizes.  These "XL" size cover the door mat by the back door. One star off because there's no way to secure them (other brands offer sticky tabs, etc) and slipping/tripping is a possibility (the dog isn't the only older family member around).  Definitely a no-fuss alternative to thrice-weekly laundry loads.

This was next to useless with the board insert -- thankfully, the back opens and I could pull that out. Now it will actually flex against the chair. But it is very thick, and a bit narrow (I'm tall and have a 30" ribcage circumference) so I feel more like I'm balancing on the front of the curve than being supported by the full cushion. I do appreciate the elastic holds it in place, but I doubt it will last - it doesn't seem to be quality material. :/

The box is well made for the price, the hardware is line up properly (both hinges and clasp) and the finish is smooth without rough edges or damage. I bought it for a purpose other than decorating - I have a wide, shallow Japanese tea bowl that needed a sturdy home - and it works perfectly for my needs. I will gladly buy more if I ever need to.

The box is well made for the price, the hardware is line up properly (both hinges and clasp) and the finish is smooth without rough edges or damage. I bought it for a purpose other than decorating - I have a wide, shallow Japanese tea bowl that needed a sturdy home - and it works perfectly for my needs. I will gladly buy more if I ever need to.

This was totally an impulse purchase and I don't regret it for a second. These are ridiculously adorable. And functional! It stands on its own on the counter when not in use. I love it! I bought one for a friend and she said hers is staying out as decoration in the kitchen, because it's too cute to put away. :)

Bought this to use with some of the Trader Joe's pizzas/tartes we love, but the middle never ends up quite right when using a sheet pan (and on the bare oven rack is just asking for a mess).  It's great - doesn't warp in the oven heat and the crust of whatever we're baking can crisp up nicely.

For the price, they're not bad - I admit the color options swayed my decision as much as the price.  That said, they're not trim-to-fit like some, and if you have a Subaru wagon or sedan, these will not fit flush in the floor well. (Lesson learned.)  My biggest gripe is the packaging -- they're held together with some massive, heavy-duty staples that require a lot of elbow grease and fussing to get loose, and by then, the mats have been torn up somewhat from trying to pry the staples out. Removing two stars for that alone - it shouldn't take the better part of half an hour to get them separated!

Bought this to leave (unlit) in a desk cube near two very stinky coworkers. (Foot cheese. Enough said.)  It definitely keeps the stink at bay. If I need a more powerful throw, I put it on my mug warmer / candle warmer.

These are VERY stiff, as the other reviewer noted. I suspect they will soften with time and wear since they are leather, but in the meantime, I wear them with thicker socks that I roll around my ankles to protect the backs of my legs from the stiff edge. The burgundy color is true to the pictures online, and the stud detail livens up an otherwise plain boot.

We love Anne Taintor's saucy sarcasm in our house, so I just HAD to buy this to replace the old grocery listpad on the fridge. The magnet is strong enough to hold it up and the little picture at the top always makes me smile. (I did add another magnet to the bottom for reinforcement, but we're rough on our notepads at times.)

UPDATE -- best not to use essential oils. I did that and yesterday it let out a pitiful squeal and died after a week-ish of adding a few drops of EO to the water.  I'm guessing that was the nail in the coffin, since it worked like a charm up until that point. :/ Oh well - it was cheap and cute and I got a month of near-daily use out of it.  I may buy another, now that I know what not to do.
========
I figured this would last me a week or two, tops.  I bought it because it was adorable and I had a chest cold and needed something for my desk at work.  I'm going on month two now, and it is perfect for keeping nearby at my desk to combat the dry air conditioned climate of the office. A few drops of essential oil for aromatherapy work well, also - just run it in a bowl of warm, filtered water between oil uses to help clear out the filter and avoid cross-contamination.  Admittedly, it has a very limited range (but really, what can you expect for a tiny little thing like this?) but it doesn't leave puddles.  I unplug it from the computer port and take it out of its bowl when not in use. I hope it continues to last - it's adorable AND useful.

Living in a warm climate and not being a fan of visible panty lines, these undies are a lifesaver. They don't get 'muggy' like other no-show microfiber briefs (TMI...?) yet the elastic is not bulky like most cotton options. The leg bands don't dig in (I'm not exactly slim, so things that don't cut into my meaty thigh area are always welcome!) and the waistbands don't roll or creep. They're true to size but also forgiving - I bought the 7 like I do in most brands, and I'm probably closer to an 8 these days, but they still fit comfortably.  I do wish they'd consistently stay in stock - every time I go to buy another set so I can replace my unwanted bulky cotton options, they're out of stock.  So far, they've washed and dried well, and I refuse to take 'special' care of my undergarments; I wash by color and it all goes in the washer and dryer together, jeans with undies with workout clothes, etc. Unless it's "nice" stuff (work pants/blouses, etc), I refuse to waste my time on handwashing or anything.  These have stood up to that punishment with no issues - no pilling or tearing or fading. Given that they feel rather insubstantial to the touch, I am impressed.
Two of the four couldn't cut soft butter, but the other two are functional and convenient for stowing in my case or project bag with my crochet hooks.

Another handy pad and planner that lives on my desk at work. Minor critique - some folks are trying to SAVE money so maybe the "to buy" section could be updated to "errands to run" or something similar? I just write "Nothing!" on mine every day. :)

The back of the package promises non-stick, high-temperature performance.

If it manages high temperatures, it sure makes the kitchen smell like burnt plastic the entire time.

It is NOT non-stick - even following the instructions to wash and dry first, then coat with cooking spray - I still had to pry out the resulting baked food in chunks and crumbles, instead of actual flower shapes.

Save your money - this one isn't worth it.

So, the mug itself is great - it's cute and will be a perfect present. (Minor quibble - square handles are interesting but uncomfortable, especially on a larger mug. Since they're not part of the design, I question why the decision was made to use them.)  Just don't trust the shipping if you order it through Amazon -- better to go to a store and pick one up in person. It won't arrive broken that way.

These are good, but really should be used on wall calendars or larger-format layouts. I've been trying to use them on weekly spreads in my 5x8 planner and they're a little TOO big. There are plenty of them, though, and they cover both work and home life (conferences, business lunches, doctor appointments, etc). All in all, a good bargain. I think I'll sort out the business parts from the personal and stash them at my desk to make my work calendar more fun.

For something that promised to be "scented" sandalwood, it doesn't smell like anything, and the beads are in pretty rough shape. It serves its purpose of being a string of beads for counting. Honestly, though, I expected better quality for the price; the drilling on the beads is rough/splintered, the elastic has dried glue smeared on it, the charm wire is unevenly bent, the beads are not sandalwood (or scented). For what I got, I should have paid half as much.  Really underwhelmed by this one.

Came packaged well and promptly; I like the look and the size, but I can't get them into my ears. :(  The curve of the post makes it impossible to get into any of my piercings, so that was a disappointment. I'll try again later, but I suspect I now have four pairs of hypo-allergenic earrings I can't use.

Great - just what I needed for my desk by the window at work. As nice as having a window is, it gets ALL the afternoon (Southern California) sun, so even in winter time, it's pretty toasty after lunch. This is quiet, keeps air moving, and doesn't take up much space. So far, it's seen gentle regular use and doesn't seem to be having any issues. I'm pretty certain the ancient clip-on fan I've had for 10+ years is also Lasko brand, though the front logo piece (and some of the grill) have long since fallen off. :D  Minor design note - the on/level switch is a crank on the back side of the fan, which is a little awkward, but it's better than overheating.

Very lightweight, not too tight (the arms are a flexible enough plastic that they don't dig in to cause headaches, etc as some cheap sunglasses can do). They stay in place well for my moderate walk/jog needs and would likely hold up if I can ever get fit enough for proper running. :)  Worth the money to keep me headache-free during my morning workouts. (The evil day star is much too bright for my puny eyes.)

Perfect addition to my key ring to keep my car keys easily found in my purse/gym bag/etc. Definitely small - not much larger than a zipper pull, so don't expect a lot of capacity (getting it over the split ring for my keys took a bit of doing) but a small, handy clip nonetheless.

users.query: Perfect feet for the remake of my Lane hope chest. Looks great.

cands.text: A working shoe, perhaps not a fashion statement. Comfort, ease and durability- what more could a gardener ask for his/her feet? Love 'em! Have a pair at every door.
A working shoe, perhaps not a fashion statement. Comfort, ease and durability- what more could a gardener ask for his/her feet? Love 'em! Have a pair at every door.

For those with slender feet, double socks can be worn. And extra room for those with 'longish' toes is a big bonus. True to size and attractive. Suggest one adds padded inserts for more cushioned walk. A good purchase, as these are well-made and affordable.
Great rockhounder's hat. It fits great (can be adjusted). The material breaths and the white color and ample brim is cool in intense sun.  And it is very attractive to boot.

The top is flattering and I like the pattern, but the stitching shows at the shoulder as it pulls so much because the arms are cut way too small. It is stretchy because of the fabric blend. The rest of the top is actually rather large. Somehow the print makes it work, so I will reinforce the stitching and keep it.
Lovely addition to an outfit. Dresses up a casual look. It's lightweight for summer, but could enhance any look year-round.
Pretty cheesy. The price reflects the cheap quality of the fabric. No way it will ever look like the product picture.
Cute top, but... I ordered a size up for a loose fit and It is tight-fitting even a size larger.
Comfortable. I got the dark gray. Easy to put together a free and easy outfit with these casual Boho pants.
Really cute. Really warm. Really stretchy to accommodate a large head. The visor keeps the sun out of your eyes.
Great fit, good look with functional pockets. Also very reasonable price.

Always enjoyed this easy-to-listen-to artist. This has been one of my favorite albums for many moons- wore out the old vinyl and was happy to find a CD still available. Don't need the latest and greatest tech. Slowing the pace with JJ Cale.
Comfortable but tend to be long. A nice weight, soft jersey.
Looks great in pic, but I suspect it was gathered at the back on the model. I know it's supposed to  be large, but it's huge! I will take it in to make it work.

These seem well-made and comfortable. I hope they don't fade quickly as one review stated. In any case, when not in use, our boat is under a cover to save the interior. We bought a couple of the blue/gray/white- a very attractive combo as well as sleek design. Good for the price.

Perfect for French doors that separate our living room and my studio. They are fairly sheer during the day with light streaming in and at night they are a little more opaque-- just what was needed. These lend an elegance to any room. Happy with the purchase and they got here FAST.
Very comfortable in-hand. I like the thumb controlled volume adjustment. The bright green sprayer is easy to spot, so no hunting for it in the yard. It's substantial and should hold up over time.
Love these floating 'easy chairs' for the lake. Lots of laughter, splashing and fun when we clip all together (purchased multiple sets) and traverse the lake!

Strong character portrayal. Well organized story with all the pieces coming to a foreseeable end. But I found I was actually more interested in the original character of the mother and began to feel rushed to read to get back to her perspective. Opposite wisdom of "You can never go home".
A little too wide, but otherwise comfortable and great for around the yard projects.

I got the audio of these books. I listened while driving, cooking and working with headphones in the garden. Both books were fast-paced. Excellent writing, great dialog and realistic characters. At times it was difficult to enter into the dark story line, but I  couldn't put the book...well, the headphones down.

Replaced a shallow ceramic spoon rest with this. It has a fairly deep cup area to retain drips from utensils- keeping counter and stove top clean as you cook. The stainless steel looks updated and clean. Good purchase for the price.

Purchased two windows for our 10'X12' greenhouse.  We like how they open and close securely and also that the glass is tempered. We plan to apply the large bubble wrap in which they were packed as insulate during cold months. A little pricey, but we're willing to spend a little more for quality.

My spouse has collected frogs since childhood. This thermometer with frog motif is a great addition to the collection. It's accurate and easy to secure to a wall or glass, either by screwing into wood or using provided suction cups.
Works great even when applied in cold weather. Tape backing comes off fairly easily.

users.query:
Three people in our house wear approximately the same size but this shoe fit no one well.  It felt too small in toe area for one(which never happens), the arch was too small for another, and just completely didn't fit the third person.  No takers for these shoes!
The shoe is well made and has a soft flexible bottom, the three traditional stripes.  Everything is padded in the interior for a softer fit but there is nothing exceptional about the shoes.  If Adidas typically fit you then you may have luck with these shoes

cands.text:
I love this brand of quality shoes with arches but these aren't my favorite.  I have sandals and boots and they are by far more comfortable than these shoes.  It is mostly because they run larger but then the heel slips a little.  As you wear them more, they stretch a little and then seem to slip more often.  I can still wear them but I find myself only wanting to wear them in small spurts which completely defeats the purpose of buying more expensive shoes.  My other two pairs in this brand I can wear all day and be comfortable.
I think these would work nicely for a heavier foot or wider heeled person.

Fits true to size and is very comfortable and stylish.
The color is a chocolate brown and goes with most anything.  The boot is super comfortable and I wore them all day the first time with out blisters or tired feet.  I have never bought this brand but was impressed with the quality and fit.
Great boot, would buy again!  Great price on an amazon sale.

I love these shoes!  I have a difficult bigger size to find and Asics always carries it.  This shoe in particular is very attractive but doesn't stand out like the white colored shoe.  It has a nice supportive arch, is soft, cushioned and comforatable for both running and walking.  The "Gel" is  great and makes me feel light on the step and cushioned against the hard ground. The toe is not supper narrow like some other brands and leaves room for toe comfort.

I like them so much that I bought a second pair and wear them pretty much anywhere!  Wonderful!

I have a couple of pairs of these great flip-flops with an arch in them.  I ordered my typical size 10 and they are just a little bit too small and have to go back.  The ribbon strap is great and the "mushy" sole feels wonderful.  Once you try these you will never go back to your cheesy flips.
There are no half sizes so I guess these shoes are running smaller than they used to.  Order up a half size if possible.

This is a beautiful, well made, leather boot!  It is spacious inside to allow for comfort and a warm sock but not so loose that you can't wear it with a thin sock.  The trim, sole and laces of the boot match the leather very well and there is a soft, sock-like padding around the top, back of the boot.  The sole has a good grip and is soft enough to wear all day in comfort.  I love this brand because they never hurts my feet as other shoes do!

I have had these shoes for a year now and they still look & feel great!  They are a quality shoe, made well and with good matierials.  From day one I slipped them on and walked staight into my day in comfort and style.  I had to choose between a 10 or 11 as I am right in the middle.  I went for the 11 and it has worked out well.  I am able to wear a thin sock or none at all.  I love the support they give, the nice traction on the bottom, the bendable sole, the softness inside the shoe, and that they stay on the heel.
They are a great value for a casual shoe!

This Tamarac slipper is really nice, warm, and well made.  I like the bottome sole that allows one to wear the slipper outside if needed.

Note:I wear a 10 1/2 womens shoe and ordered an 11.  My toes touch the end.  I would say that the slipper runs a whole size small at least by my experience.

I have worn them around for a few weeks hoping that the sheerling would smash down and it has some-what.  Order a size up if you don't want your toe touching the end.

These high tops started to fall apart after one day of wear!
My son picked the light grey color so maybe it is only this shoe.
I wanted to return them but he wanted them so bad and there were none left in his size.  We had to glue them back together at the soles.  The front and back of each shoe had delaminated!!  I had to buy shoe glue because of my teens insistance of keeping these terribly made shoes.
He has worn this brand for years and this is the first pair to fall apart...especially the 1st day!

I was surprised to find that these boots were a little shorter and more narrow than the other Nine West boots that I have been trying.  This boot was one of 4 other styles of Nine West boots, and the worst of all.  I have always had great luck with Nine West boots, but not this year!  I can't seem to find one that is comfortable and doesn't slide on my heel!  I think I am giving up.  They are a pretty looking boot if you are not into comfort!  Sorry Nine West!

Super comfortable!!
These(Elevated Performance, no show) socks are padded in all of the right places!  They breathe while exercising or in the heat and feel great on my feet!  There are three of us that can actually wear these socks in my family and we just love them.  They seem like they will hold up to tons of wear and washing like we need.  We have the tri-color pack with grey, black and white.  Next time we need some more socks, we will be checking out Under Armour brand!!

My daughter loved the look of these VB shoes in the blue/black.  They were comfortable and felt good except that the heel slipped.  We tried to re-lace and tighten them but it just didn't work.  We couldn't keep the heel from slipping.  They were also a tiny bit shorter than other brands in the same size.

These boy-short shapers run small around the leg.  They feel terrible to me!  I have my usual size and they fit fine everywhere but the leg.  I don't have extra large legs or any problems with this typically.  The rest of the boy-short feels comfortable and fine.
The look of boy-short is not very appealing in the nude either.  It look like something for an elderly person.  I bet the black or red color would be fine and the price is fairly reasonable too.

These sandals are cute and have a lot of cut-out detail which is pretty.  They also have a big arch support and mostly well made.

The problem when I bought them was the price was super high and the liner of the footbed is synthetic material.  For a hot summer the synthetic liner will not do.  I would get blisters and sticky feet for sure.  I ended up sending them back, sad to say.

I like these panties and the way that they fit.
They are not too tight, but just the right amount of elasticity to hold you in a little and give some smoothing shape.

I love that they are seamless but yet have some definition to the back of them.  You can see the details on the rear side in the pictures.

I typically wear cotton panties but I actually like these and wear them when the weather is cool.
They are comfortable and stay put, no pulling and poking all day. They are made well and I just wash them on delicate and hang them to dry.

I have owned two of these bras in the past and they were quite good; supportive, soft, long lasting....That was the Past.

I ordered three of these in three sizes recently and sent all three back.  The interior was itchy, not smooth like they used to be!  I don't know what they did to make them so different but I couldn't bear to wear this bra.  I may reorder in six months to see if it was just a fluke thing and hope for the best.  At this time, I would not recommend this bra.

The "night owl" owl print on these is adorable and my daughter jumped with glee when she first saw these.

We bought an extra large since she wears a 14-18(and is tall)depending on what brand you are talking about.  They have plenty of room for her and even some for growing.  The gown we bought in this brand did not run large.
They are perfect for her...roomy for sleeping with nice long legs and arms to keep her warm.  The material is not too thick but your standard pj quality, poly, pajama.
I just tried to buy another pair but they are out of her size.  :(

Although these are over-priced typically, my teen daughter fell in love with them.
She has the light blue with white waistband and loves wearing them to sleep in.  They are super soft and comfortable and she can wear them around the house because they are a bit longer on the leg.

I bought this for my teen daughter as she wanted plain and simple black with no logos...this was a winner!
She wears a women's Med-Large so I decided to order up (since Amazon is so great about returns).
The Large fit her to perfection for her needs.  It is not skin tight though in case that is what you are looking for;you would order down.
 **The fit is perfect, not too long nor short, high on the collar but not choking, just comfortable, long enough sleeves, and a little wiggle room.**
I waited until the price dropped into my range before I bought this, it was not the higher price.

I find these very unique in their design and very comfortable. They are Sterling plated with 18k yellow gold and are very expensive looking.  They have a modern, simplistic look and can be worn as one piece or two.  The one piece, stud goes in the front of the ear and the 2nd piece or jacket, slips behind the ear and is threaded onto the stud, then you attach the ear backing.  I haven't seen anything quite like them.

Gorgeous, bold watch but not water resistant at all.
The face of this watch is over 35 mm and almost 1 1/2 inches across.  You can see in the photos how large it is.  I personally think it is very attractive but not too big, and if your eyes are failing, well...you can still see the time!
It is a classic yet elegant style, simple, yet lovely.  It is gold and black with little diamond chip that sparkle, at each time marker.  It has the AK emblem on the clasp and words across the face of it.  It is comfortable and easily snaps on and off without help.  I have a larger wrist and it fits well but with movement, the way I like it.
Since it is not in anyway water proof, I see it more as a piece of jewelry and most likely something to wear to work, out to dinner, etc.  I can't see it lasting very long in my care since I am very active and constantly washing my hands, etc.

This is my third Dirt Devil brand vacuum and I am finding that its Not my favorite for various reasons.  This is a vacuum for a tiny home, apartment, college student, trailer, but not for a large house.

First, something I love about it....its suction is great!
It is powerful and really sucks, especially when doing carpets.
This of course is a big bonus and makes a huge difference, especially at around a sixty dollar range vac. It is really great that it is bag-less and the container is clear.  You can see when it is full of dirt and easily empty it.  It has a HEPA filter and you can wash and reuse it.

Not so great aspects:
Overall, the vacuum seems flimsy in areas, especially how the hose and main vac attach.
-attachments kept falling apart from one another, you have to really shove them together
-It has an overall awkward/bad design compared to others.
-The cord is not very long.
-Cord when wound is very low and in the way.
-The back wheels don't roll smoothly.
-on/off foot pedal is hard to get to and small(compared to my other vac.)

This is a good vacuum if you have none, but I honestly would look at a different style if you will use it a lot.
My kids even are annoyed by the design.  They tend to wrap the cord around the entire vac

Since the title of this book says right across the front "A Boy Should Know", I figured it was for a boy, not a teen becoming a man.  This book is most definitely aimed at an older "boy"; I would guess 16-20 yr olds.
This book is full of good information, especially if there is no male role model around to teach it.  A lot of these things I know I learned from my Dad.  Guess I was a lucky one.  That being said, the book really does hold a wealth of information for a good basis in any older teens life or even just a written reminder.
Most topics are general life skills and knowledge.  Everything from cleaning, keeping clean, clothing one's self and looking sharp, taking care clothes, making a plan for your life, inventing and reinventing one's self, finding good role models, statistics on obesity and how to eat well, getting organized, managing money, car facts, everything in moderation, and developing a spiritual side.  These are just the general topics but most are discussed in detail for instance, keeping things clean entails; what to clean, when to clean, how to clean, and what to buy to clean.  This is a well written book that slides from one topic into another adding tid-bits of information around every corner.
I like that Fisher wrote this on a personal level with stories about his family throughout along with all of the good advice.

If you love roses, then you will adore these earrings!
I love that they are a little larger, not super tiny like some flower earrings (at about 3/4 inch across). They are the perfect size to be seen but not take over
They are entirely shiny-Sterling Silver (2.4 g) with no oxidation/darkening.  The roses are sturdy and made well and have a simple back.  They are nothing too fancy but look great, are priced well, and made well too.  They come beautifully packaged for gifting, in Amazons double gifting box.

I have been using WinZip versions for Windows for quite a while and it is great.  This version is fast and easy to use and helps email and store large files.  You can choose how much or the level of compression you would like and unzip files as needed. You can use it for large files including audio and video too. It has password security features that help protect your files. It is a must on my computer; don't know what I would do without it.  Great product!

users.query:
update 12/17/12:
The company that this product comes from is called USJUICERS dot com. This company is horrible. Believe me, the ten year warranty is worthless. They will not help you, they kept my screen and never sent it back. I am going to have to buy a new one now for 200 dollars. Wish I could buy it somewhere else. If I had a chance to get my money back, I would not buy this model, I would have purchased the nice juice press instead.
orginal review:
I have been using this everyday since it arrived about Christmas time. OK, I have another juicer, an older heavy juiceman. It still works ok for a centrifical juicer. But with green leafy stuff, it is not very good at all. SO.. I run everything care free through the juiceman, and then put all the wet pulp from that into my Angel. I get almost the same amount of juice again. It works much better this way because the feeder chute on the Angel is small, and the juiceman is about 2.5 inches. MY favorite juice is cellery, carrot, apple, a tiny bit of ginger, a half of lemon(half peeled), and kale or red chard, and beets. I love this stuff and can feel my vibrance and health increase as I swallow. Just wonderful. If you do not juice, you are really missing out on so many things those micro nutrients can do for your mind and body. Cheers!
Update 6/12/12: I have been using the superangel 5500 for 6 months now and the screen is plugged up with a brown hard mineral deposit, probably some polyphenols, because of the amounts of chard and beets I juice. I have soaked it in vinagar, lemon juice, scrubbed with brushes. this stuff is very hard and will not come off. 80% of the pores are pugged in some of the areas. The brush is comes with is useless for this precipitate. Has anyone found an effective way to remove this deposit. It is not simple scale, is is very resistant to acid and the  only way I have found to remove it is to put a soft wire through each hole. This is not going to get it clean though, as there are thousands of holes and I just don't have the will power to poke a micro wire through each pore space. The customer service is completely useless and does not even understand english. Be aware that this is a good juicer, but if you have a problem, you ARE on your own. ANy suggestions????
a final word 12/17/12:
avoid this entire company until they start to respect the warranty and back up the product. I have babied and used the best care and judgement with this machine and it has failed me. I guess because I used it alot. NOw it is a 1100 dollar thing is a box with no screen. US Juicers, you should be ashamed!!!!

users.query: This a nice, lightweight cork board that is in a convenient small size. With its simple black frame it would fit into just about any decor. If you need a small cork board to fit into a small space and have a classier, slightly more elegant look than the typical board, you might really like this one. I wanted it for my kitchen but didn't want the usual rounded-cornered-white-plastic-framed ones, so this one is nice.

cands.text: I am a school teacher with a rather ancient white board in my classroom. The board is old and scratched but still in good enough shape that my school will not pay to replace it with a new one. I can either replace it out of my own pocket or deal with it, so I'm dealing with it. Lately I'd noticed that the markers I was using were "ghosting" very badly on the board. I was having to use Expo white board cleaner every day to remove the traces of notes I'd just written on the board. After doing a lot of internet research as to how to properly clean my board, I came to the conclusion that the problem was the markers even more so than the board. The older markers, which were not marked "Low Odor" erased completely with no ghosting at all, while the new ones marked "Low Odor" ghosted to beat the band. The problem then was that I went to every store in town looking for the older type markers and couldn't find them. So finally I figured I should try Amazon, and here they are! These Expo markers are called Bold Color, and the box says nothing about Low Odor. When I erase these markers, the marks wipe off onto the eraser like a powder whereas the newer ones just smear all over the board and leave much of their color behind. After looking all over for these, I was thrilled to find them at Amazon, so here's where I'll order them as long as I can. If you're having problems with a haunted white board, try these Bold Color markers before you spend the cash to replace your board.

A Room With a View is a lovely novel, and this is a lovely little inexpensive paperback version. A love story set amidst "class issues," this story may seem slow to a reader who expects fireworks or major excitement, but if you allow the story and characters to unfold before you, you will be taken in and carried along for a delightful, romantic, charming tale. This book contains several of my favorite characters in all of British literature. So take a pleasant journey to Florence and on to Windy Corner, and I think you'll enjoy your trip.

The short version of my review is that you really can't go wrong with a Ravensburger Puzzle. They are very high quality puzzles made of thick, durable cardboard. This 1000 piece puzzle features the iconic photo of men taking a lunch break on a steel girder high above New York City. I enjoyed looking at this photo with my kids because it's such a great moment of American history and culture. It provoked lots of interesting conversation on the daring of these men and the growth of America's cities. The black and white photo makes for a tricky and interesting puzzle to construct as well. This is a great puzzle for lovers of jigsaw puzzles, American history, and iconic photographs.

I actually use a lot of these flags in my reading and studying since I'm a teacher and am always working up lesson plans. I've normally bought the Post-It brand flags but tried these through the Amazon Vine program. These are perfectly satisfactory flags that are less expensive. They come in 5 bright colors, stick where you want them to go, and are made of a matte-finish paper that's easy to write on. These do just what they should and cost less, so what's not to like?

This is a lovely planner that I already enjoy using. I like having a planner like this because it gives me plenty of space to fill in daily activities and helps with keeping everything straight. I guess people use their phones for this these days, but I prefer being able to see a whole month or week at a time and write right on the calendar. The colors are very pretty, the cover and binding are sturdy, and this is just a great planner for me to carry with me and keep my life in order!

I use a lot of sticky notes in my job and home life, and I like the fact that these are the only ones I've seen  made out of recycled paper. They have a less slick surface texture and a more matte finish than the usual sticky note, but they are a good quality paper which is easy to write on. Except for the fact that they are more muted shades and a more matte finish, they are indistinguishable from other sticky notes. And they have box tops on the package, so you may find that an added bonus.

Lonely Planet is now my new favorite brand of travel guide. I like their easy-to-read charts, colorful photos, rankings of"must-see" sites, and generally all the features they incorporate to make their guides so easy to use. Of course, like with any travel guide, there's no accounting for tastes, and something recommended highly might not suite everyone. But I have found after using several Lonely Planet guides that they tend to focus on making sure their information and advice is highly user-friendly and very practical. I like that they give various itineraries targeted to different budgets and that their descriptions are usually concise and to-the-point. This guide is super colorful and is bursting with practical info for the whole country, so it should be useful to tourists visiting any part of England. I got this copy after my first (and so-far only) trip to England (I'm American), but after checking it out myself I instantly loaned it to a friend who is heading across the pond for the first time this summer. I truly believe she'll find the guide helpful, and I plan to pick her brain about it when she gets back and add to this review if necessary. But after using several of them, I have come to the conclusion you can't go wrong with Lonely Planet guides.

I ordered this book for my AP English class, and I love that it has all four of my favorite Shakespeares together. I like the typeface, the footnotes, everything. It's small enough to carry around in your purse. I recommend it for the pleasure-reader, student, or teacher. It's a great value, too.

How very disappointing this kit was. My kids had done similar kits before where they dug a knight figurine out of a brick, so I thought this one would be fun and would yield some cool, real shark teeth. So what a letdown to find that the teeth in the block were its-bitsy, teeny-tiny things. Seriously, I can't even believe how small they were. Now I understand how some of the reviewers said their kids never found the teeth. The tooth-shaped block is so hard that it's very difficult for kids to chip away at with the tiny plastic tool they're given, so it takes hours to find the teeth. And all three of them, besides being minuscule, broke while my son was trying to chip them out. Honestly, I'm now wondering if the two stars I gave it are too many. I feel completely ripped off. Do not buy this. Really.

Basically, this is just a bag of gummies of various sizes that will stand up by itself. If that appeals to you, have at it. Otherwise I don't really see any difference between these and any other gummy candies I've tried. The package boasts "endless gummy variety" with many different flavors, textures, and shapes. They may have all looked different, but they all taste pretty much the same. My kids, the biggest eaters of gummy candies in my house, said they liked them fine but like other brands better.

Pros: The Paula Deen Amaryllis dinnerware is dishwasher and microwave safe, which is to me a great plus. The dishes are well designed to be sturdy and also comfortable to use. The cereal/fruit bowl is nice and deep, and the mugs have a large comfortable handle. They are also very colorful and would add a festive look to the table.

Cons: The dishes are made in China, which, unfortunately, is true of most dinnerware I can find these days. I thought the colors looked really nice in the pictures on the internet, but I found them to look different in person. I was hoping for a bright, festive set of dinnerware with a nice red palette. The artwork on these dishes is not attractive to me. The dark red band around the dinner plate and the bowl is a very dark crimson shade. By contrast, the flower bloom is mostly pink and light green with a wispy brownish outline. I don't think the crimson stripe and the paler flower coordinate very well. The flower looks rather spring-like whereas the band looks Christmas-y.

Overall, I would caution a potential buyer to see the dinnerware in person before ordering.
My 11 year old son bought this game, and he says it's awesome. Extremely so. It's an easy game for kids to have fun with and is fun for the whole family.

I ordered this scale for my son to use for his school science project. He needed to be able to weigh small objects with a relatively accurate degree of precision. The scale is tiny but works extremely well. We used some small weights to calibrate it and found it was perfectly calibrated when we received it. I think for the price that this is an excellent small scale that is perfect for young students.
