All these years, I've suspected that shredded coconut didn't need all that sugar. It really doesn't. I even made coconut bread with coconut milk (unsweetened), coconut oil, coconut flour substituted for part of the whole wheat flour, and a cup of this coconut, and I forgot to add any kind of sweetener. It came out delicious! This was as good a price as I could reasonably find, and it will last me a while, so I definitely recommend it.

I didn't really get this for the chart of equivalents, but it's nice; it has facts like: 48 teaspoons in a cup. I do like a dough scraper, but my favorite use for such a straight, flat blade is to cut brownies (wipe after each cut) or pizza. The downward push works better for various kinds of cutting and chopping than the slicing motion of a regular knife blade. It has a comfortable handle and is sharp enough to do the job.

I took this knife, which isn't serrated or anything like that, and cut two 1/4" slices from a loaf of bread I made yesterday. Granted, this loaf is pretty dense and has a fine grain, but wow!

Bigger than I expected: my estimate of the size was off. Beautiful wide, tapered blade, sturdy construction, well-molded hilt, and a good solid heft. I would cut things with this that I would usually reserve for my cleaver, though I like it too much to risk chipping it on bones. A pineapple would offer it little resistance.

The box opens from the side and is suitable for storing the knife if your block doesn't have a big enough slot for it. Safety first!

I tried the milled raw chia seeds in my coffee-flavored yogurt, and it was good. The flavor is fairly neutral, a bit like walnuts, with the nutty taste and a trace of bitterness that is not unpleasant. I didn't feel the need to add any extra sweetening to the yogurt, since it was already sweet. It was easy to tear off the top edge of the bag to open it, but not so easy to close up the recloseable bag. The chia seeds had gotten all in the top of the bag and the zipper apparatus. I'll be putting it into something more secure as soon as possible - and I'll probably not only buy this again, but try planting some chia seed in my garden.

When I first opened the pages of this cookbook, I expected one of those upper-class fancy cookbooks full of impractical recipes using unobtainable ingredients, and yes, some of the recipes involve unusual items. Most, however, were excellent ways to prepare seasonal, local foods, mostly in ways I hadn't thought of before. Some other recipes were similar to familiar, even nostalgic and traditional foods, but with interesting variations - and then there was my beloved childhood novelty: bacon and eggs in a paper bag. Try it!

I recommend this cookbook for anyone; maybe not as a first cookbook, but maybe even that. It would certainly be a pleasant addition to any cookbook collection.

I couldn't help rather liking Unusual Uses for Olive Oil, but it gave me a bit of the same feeling as when I watch a movie with Don Knotts in it. I find myself feeling embarrassed for the sake of poor Professor Dr. von Igelfeld. Poor guy can hardly catch a break, though it's mostly because he's a pompous blowhard - and yet, he does have a heart, and some of this friends do, too. Mixed feelings about this book. I can picture it as a movie with Steve Martin as von Igelfeld. If you don't cringe when a fictional character makes a total ass of himself, you will like this without reservations, especially if you have a feeling for the world of academia.

I am very fond of this little hippo, but I must admit that I am not using it as it was intended. I removed the jiggler-giggler ball that was tied inside him with a ribbon, and I gave it to the cat. You can always put it back in, but the cat's face when he bats it and it goes off jiggling and giggling is worth the price of admission alone! Meanwhile, Happy the Hippo serves as a neck support for me when I nap or work in my recliner. He's much better company than a traditional neck pillow.

This set of exercise bands is like a gym in your pocket. From extra-strong to light, they give a lot of options for exercising various muscle groups, and most of them can be used by people with limited mobility. The whole bundle folds up into the little mesh bag they come in.
My old house is a sieve, and I'm not very handy, but this is easy to use as well as fireproof. It fills up all those holes that old houses seem to come with.

Really strongly made, and perfect for a bedside table as well as a desk, if you're like us and have at least a tablet and a smart phone on that same bedside table. The USB charging ports are a huge help, as well as the three-prong plugs. I am hoping that even our touchy rural power with its surges and sags will not damage this: so far, so good.

users.query:
Like so many other reviewers have said, these have a better, richer sound than the HD headphones. They also are tighter, like others have said. After I spoke with Beats, I'm not confident they will get anymore comfortable with use. I wear glasses and these push the glasses arms into my head immediately upon wearing. Also, they came with a soft case, not the hard case that the amazon site says they will come in. So, better sound, glossy finish vs the HD that look great but show fingerprints really easily. Unfortunately these positives do not outweigh the negative uncomfortable fit.
UPDATE. I gave them a bit more time and now I'm really happy with these!  They loosened up and the fit is snug, but even with glasses not uncomfortably so. Here's something weird. The sound is much richer with my iPhone than my iPod. I have a recent version of each (most recent nano, and iPhone 5s). The plug is in the whole way with both. So why is the sound so much better with the phone? I asked Beats and they had no answer other than to make sure it's plugged in all the way. Which it is.  ,so, for using them with my iPhone, awesome. With my iPod, meh just ok. If that sound were the same as with the phone, I'd give it 5 stars.

cands.text: The big selling point of these is supposedly the rich sound of the bass.  This is my first pair of Beats and I used to use earbuds with my iPod and iPhone.  The sound is good, better than earbuds, probably partly because they cover the whole ear.  But I do not notice any considerable difference with the bass.  The other problem is with my glasses.  I have to wear glasses all the time. these press on my glasses which in turn press on my head.  But with headphones this is probably unavoidable.  The headphones themselves are really soft, and easily adjustable (though they do make my ears, ick, sweat as the weather is now 80, but I'd rather sweat than be cold so I can live with it). and usually when i adjust where they sit on my ears, it's better.  Overall, they have good sound and are comfortable and soft. I guess maybe I was expecting more from the sound.  Maybe too much?  Happy with them and I'd buy them again.

I didn't have the same sound issues (it didn't sound muffled or otherwise denegrated) that I have seen other reviewers mention, and no issues pairing them with my iphone 6.  My issues were with the comfort level, or lack thereof.  the part that goes around your ear, was so hard that they just were not comfortable to me.  the part that goes into the ear was fine.  also, i wear glasses, and I'm pretty much always wearing a knit hat, so those 2 accessories unfortuantely do not mix well with these wireless headphones.  maybe those of you who do not require glasses will be lucky enough to enjoy these.  I wish I could.  Good luck!

I am not a fan of these. Even after trying all of the earbud covers, not one of them sat comfortably in my ears. They dangled out. And the mic to talk didn't work. Lest you think I do t know how to use this function, the mic on my apple brand earbuds work just fine. I gave it 2 stars instead of 1 because when I was sitting still and the earbuds were actually in my ears the sound was good. Maybe I got a defective pair but because of the earbuds' fit (or lack thereof) I returned these and definitely will not be buying this brand again.

Great case, great protection. I just got it but I feel like the little notches you need to open to put in the charging cord and the earbuds could break off after more uses, but so far so good.  The screen is nice and clear, no rainbow effect. The strap was a little hard to put on, and I'm not sure how sturdy it will be because the part that hooks onto the case seems flimsy, but again so far so good, and the strap isn't really the big benefit of this case.  Good drop protection for my iPod touch 5th gen 64GB.

So small but such a powerful sound. The pill 2.0 is such an improvement over the prior model. Much richer sound. And very easily paired wirelessly with my iPhone. and since it's so small, it doesn't stick out too much except for the fool light up "b"'. Love it!

i bought this because i wanted a case that wasn't rubber, that lint/dust wouldn't stick to. and it does the trick. the iPod slides in no problem, and holds the iPod just fine. wish there was some protection on the top and/or bottom. so far so good with the clip working. the color (i bought blue) is just as pictured.

I very much am unimpressed with the matte finish on this case.  It also adds a LOT of weight vs the Speck Candyshell and Candyshell Grip. It may protect the case but if it makes the phone uncomfortable and unwieldy to use, like this case does, it is not worth it.

This isn't the prettiest case but it does as advertised. It fully protects the back and sides and on the front it covers everything but the screen so it really protects the phone. I've had no problem making calls or with any other aspects of the phone w the case on. And I received it from the seller within a few days despite the fact that it was being shipped almost coast to coast. Happy with this purchase.

yes it keeps my phone dry. But i get the constant rainbow effect on the screen.  Each time using it, whether on speaker or not, the caller on the other end said i sound muffled and far away.  I had to send two cases back because the earbud cord didn't work properly.  Each time I was on hold at least 20 minutes.  AND, i had to call three times to get the full credit I was due.  I will NEVER buy from this company again.

The clear shield which I bought for my ipad air, fits great. If like me you're not an expert in putting these on do yourself a favor and watch the video how-to's on the manufacturers site (web address is included in the little packet with the cloth). I biffed the first one but luckily there are 2 screen covers included. I watched the video before attempting the second, and it looks great. Crystal clear and no bubbles. Yeah it takes patience which is not my strong suit but it was worth it.

I'm really happy w this case. It's hard plastic but not hard to get it on. A little hard to get it off. It's a great material-not too slippery but enough for it to easily slide in/out of pockets. I love how it covers the bottom of the phone. I bought the black/white stripe one & may buy more to switch out as my mood dictates. Great buy.

These are the best shoes. I walk a lot. An hour every day on my lunch. And on weekends, a beverage of 10 miles a day.  I've tried a lot of shoes. And these are awesome. After wearing these, another pair of sneakers I put on, felt awful and stiff. They could have better arch support. But boy are they soft and cushiony. Wear them without socks and there is absolutely no discomfort or chafing or blisters. These are my new go-to. Love them!
Nice big case for my sunglasses just as I hoped it would be. I am concerned though that the hinge won't be long lasting. It seems a bit flimsy. I just got it so I guess time will tell.

Simple and does what it shows it will do. I have a 5S with a slim case and it fits both horizontally and vertically with room to spare.  I have a speaker and the charging cord plugged in to it as I'm using it which is awesome.  Tilts at just the right angle for viewing streaming video. Love it!!
Fits well, the slightly raised lip protects from drops, nice glossy finish.  As advertised.

I had bought one of Tech Armor's screen protectors for my iPad. This one for my iPhone is just as good. Maybe better since it is smaller so it's easier to apply. If you read the instructions and take your time to apply, it looks awesome. Very clear, and using the application as instructed, no bubbles. Highly recommend.

Works great, very clear, went on easily and as long as you take your time with it as I did, it should for you too!  It's just as good as some of the more expensive versions I've tried on other phones.
soft, fit well, the only small issue i have is the neck opening is a little small and can feel a little tight.  but overall really happy with it.
Works just fine, just as well as the Fitbit flex charger that came with the Fitbit.

Bought the navy for my iPad mini. Seems sturdy, soft leather and I like how the inside is lined and I like the hand strap. Two major cons: it doesn't always turn my iPad off upon closing, and doesn't have a stylus loop.

I bought the light blue and I'm unhappy with the color. It's not a baby blue like it looks. It's more like a dull, dirty blue. I like the strap and the stylus holder but Due to the negatives, which outweigh the positives, I wouldn't buy this again. Wish I returned it when I still could. UPDATE june 25- I received a reply from snugg saying I may have received a defective case and they'd send me a replacement.

Bought the Bear motion case in leather for the iPad air. Seems like a good case so far. I had but returned the Snugg case. With the Snugg, I didn't like the white stitching on the inside. I may be too picky but I have a black iPad and with the black case, the white stitching was distracting. This case works well in that it seems sturdy, the pebbled leather is nice, it can be used in both landscape angles, and the hand strap helps to hold it. It is a bit heavier than the Snugg case. But I'll trade that for the Snugg's distracting white stitching.  Plus the Bear case is $10 less!

He writes and reads with excitement, enthusing, inflections and pure joy. That, as well as the heartfelt nature of not just his writing of but his experiences, make this a must-read and/or -listen.  I got the audiobook, and his reading brought so much to the story.
Love, love love this audiobook. It made me laugh out loud and I was also touched by his stories. What an amazing listen. So much fun!!

I went back and forth between Kindle and Nook, and then between the Kindle touchscreen and the Kindle 4. I only read maybe 5 or 6 books a year so I didn't want to spend a ton of dough, and wasn't sure I wanted the touchscreen. and I made the right choice.  using the main button to get to the screen where you type the name of the book is very simple; I can't imagine why people say it is difficult. and if it is so hard, just buy the book you want from the website and transfer it! I just wish the Kindle came with the adapter to plug it into the wall to charge, but I can plug it into my apple adapter and it works just fine. very happy with my purchase.
The top part didn't fit together correctly. Maybe I got a dud/defective one?

users.query: I had to push myself to finish the book. It was tedious & the main character behaved as though there are no rules & it didn't look much like great police work.

cands.text: It was not a bad book but not a very good story line. The sheriff seems to be clueless & incompetent. It is more a police romance & not a great one at that. I had to just skip pages of stupid &  boring dialogue to get to the end. The fact that I finished the book means it was OK.

It started off good but then just dragged on with mushy and implausible events. The last few chapters were so bad I had to skip pages to reach the predictable end. I am really glad I did not pay for this book as I would have felt cheated.

Although I enjoyed reading the book, it is not the kind of book that will stay with you. It is not an emotional read or a great thriller or a fast paced book that kept you guessing. It is a slow paced book with well written police procedure. It looked like it took a long time to find and investigate the clues to find the murderer.

The book started great but then, after a while, story drags on too long, the plot is convoluted and rather implausible and there's no real payoff at the end. I am sorry I didn't like any of the characters. Just OK.

I liked the book and the story line. The pace was slow with lots of distractions and didn't keep my full attention and the book could have done better with a copy editor. I liked the main character and the assistant.

I thought the story started kind of slow and was almost inclined to return for refund. I am glad I didn't do so as the story kind of grew on me.
I liked the main characters, Mattie and Robo and the ending was good which I hadnt guessed. I thought it was the deputy who was involved in this whole thing. I was glad that the author didn't make Mattie a super woman but she did kind of managed the final conflict with applause with help from the K-9 dog, Robo.

It is an OK book and a good story line but the main character with extremely questionable judgement was too boring to stand for more than few chapters at a time. Too many characters and twists and turns and though the end was unexpected, I can't buy the ending.

The story line was OK, nothing like the 1st book in the series. Mixing the 2 murders, one present and one past did not bring anything to the story except to muddy it. The pace could have been faster. Good read though.

Abbott does it again. Great plot, lots of suspense and interesting characters. I loved the book and the writing style. Rachel Abbott knows how to write a real interesting crime mystery and keep the reader riveted to the end. The plot was good and kept me guessing. I felt from beginning the wife was the actual killer, but even then the story was very interesting. A real good story with plenty of twists.

The writing wasn't horrible but the whole premise of having sex just to get a baby is ridiculous. That is why we have sperm banks. The main character was bonkers. I couldn't finish the book.got it free and so only waste of time.
The story is original and suspenseful but very slow to read and I felt the ending is a cop out. With all the twists and turns, the end felt like too simple to be true.

This book was okay, but did not keep my interest for long. I didn't like any of the characters and thought there were too many coincidental meetings. There were a couple of surprise twists, but mostly predictable. OK read.

The Butterfly Garden was good. Narrative is boring and Relationships between victims and the FBI agents relationships are totally sickening and unprofessional. The depth of characters and killer in this book is weak and I couldn't make myself to finish the book.

I am writing this review to tell people this is a waste of time and money. It started off of OK; otherwise, I would have returned for refund. Too many characters that I had to spend time wondering again who they were, hard to follow, too much rambling and inconsequential facts. I couldn't finish the book.

I liked the original story line and the characters. The story was really creepy. A woman (Emma) is being stalked, and sh is positive it is her dead husband. Of course that can't be, and the police don't believe her. Luckily a young PI named Shaye takes the case. Shaye has a pretty terrible history herself. She didn't assume that Emma was crazy and worked to find the perpetrator.
I never suspected who the stalker was and that part of the story was well done. While the perpetrator was a suspense, the ending was flat and you didn't even realize you have reached the end. The book also was very creepy, disturbing and gruesome.

I was hesitant to select this book because of couple of critical reviews & I am glad I decided to get it. Granted first few chapters were very pretty slow & was going back & forth between 2 periods in time. Kind of confusing initially until you connect the dots.

This is one of the best books I've read since the time I have started writing reviews. It is at it's heart a story of a young womans self discovery and of forgiveness. It has a good story line, lots of research to lay the foundation for the story, well written, likable characters, emotional & at times soul wrenching.
Though you never meet Sarah Grace, you cant help like her & be part of her sorrow. Sometimes, it makes one wonders what tangled web we leave by our silence.
You have to admire the bravery, faith & endurance of Dinah and Emily.

I did not enjoy reading this book and had to skip pages of tedium, the unbelievable characters and plot points. The main character made several extremely stupid decisions and seemed clueless for a doctor and the end was abrupt and unbelievable. The writing was good quality and it was an OK read.
I enjoyed the book but the story had too many sub-stories and the characters are flaky. OK read; kind of disappointed.

I like Gimenezs books and this one is no exception. Intriguing plot And great character development. Rebecca Fenney's conniving life philosophy combined with her ex-husbands good will make for an interesting court room crime story. A little far-fetched with the introduction of the Italian mob and Mexican drug cartel but nevertheless was an interesting read. A little implausible to see an ex-husband like Scott Finley.

The story line is very good, the plot is kind of convoluted but easy to follow. I read a lot of mystery books and this is one of the good ones. Really enjoyed the twists and turns. Too much dialog and a little difficult to believe that the DSs get so much leeway in their work.

I had the vague notion that this book would help me find an easy a way to lose weight. Silly me because nothing is that easy. I found this book to be very complicated expecting the reader to go back and forth through many pages in order to figure out the exercises to workout the plan that you picked. You get better help at no cost online.

I have read 6 books by this author ad I like his writing style and the humor. I like the interaction between Mike and his ex wife, his brother and specially the character "Nick the Dick".
However, I think the whole concept of "whole family" handling everything, Mike, his ex-wife, the brother and the pseudo father-like police stalwart in case after case is kind of becoming unbelievable.

This is my first book from this author. I found the story line to be very good and original and the characters are well developed. It was suspenseful that I didn't predict the perpetrator and the ending. 4 stars because it was implausible that a psychologist can be a si gle father, a teacher and a detective.

They look really nice and not very pricey. There was no blue pendent in my package. A bit bigger than expected. Great for the price though.
Edit: on wearing it, I felt they look kind of cheap.

The Kite Runner is a book based on two young boys who lived together but were not close to each other due to their social status.
Amir, the son of a rich man in Kabul, Afghanistan is befriended by Hassan, a boy who is born to a low caste Hazara. Hassan is allowed to play, dine and assist Amir in his daily activities. The innocent loyalty of Hassan towards Amir is very high. But Amir doesnt replicate the same to Hassan and specially, one day when Hassan was attacked by a group of anti-Hazara boys from the neighborhood. This guilt of betrayal makes Amir to distance himself from Hassan and leads to Hassan leaving Amirs home forever. Amir and his father later migrate to America after Afghanistan was taken over by the Russians. After some years, Amir gets married in America and decides to visit Afghanistan. There he comes to know that Hassan is non other than his half brother born to his father and the servant maid. Hassan is dead and his son is abducted by the Talibans from an orphanage and sexually abused. Amir takes the responsibility of rescuing the boy from the Talibans and adopts him, as a way to reconcile his sin of betraying his father.
Very good story of the lives of two happy kids from different social status ending in betrayal and tragedy. The story illustrates how millions of lives are affected by war killings of the innocents and suffering of the survivors and makes one to ponder how some lives end up in tragedy simply by no fault of theirs.
The betrayal and the tale of child abuse to both Hassan and his son by the upper class was very hard to stomach. It may be the reality of that world but still very difficult to swallow.

users.query: Another exciting read from a great author. keeps a good pace.

cands.text: Wow this book is not like anything I normally read and it was awesome, I felt what they felt the ups the downs the author did an amazing job.
This story was well written and well plotted. The setting and character are very likeable. I am eager to read the next books.
Good well written book, I had to keep reading every chance I had.
This is very good book. Well written a likeable characters.

Good book. Moved a little fast, not much relationship build up so not as believable but still a good story. Characters could use a little more building but over all a good read and worth the time. I would be interested in reading more in this world and more about some of the other characters.
The story was well paced and yhe characters as usual stick with me after I have read the book. I always finish these ones wanting more or longer!

I loved this book! It was a fun read. The human characters can use some fleshing out. Maybe make em older and wiser. Regardless I recommend it for all ages and will read the rest of his books. Can't wait for the next one! Love the Loth!

For me this was the best book in the series, it weaved back and forth between present day and history, both stories left me wanting more and filled in back stories. All of the books are very different from each other. The only downfall is I wish they were longer, especially the last three books. This book in the Omega Force series was as always great, sucks you in and you can't put it down until you are done. Fast paced, funny and emotionally serious at the same time. The action s good as always. Now to hold my breath while I wait to see what happens next!
The book was fast paced and absorbs you right away. The depth thw characters have is good. Theres adventure, action, and a hint of love. Even cant help but like the dark witches.
One of the best books I have read and I read A LOT! The characters are quirky and memorable, I already have book 3 and cannot wait for Book 4!
Great book, great characters story is good paced with action and scarcastic comedy
The book is well qritten with likeable characters and a feel or the medieval times. Cant wait for the next one
Funding dunhhhh. Well written romantic sort of mystery. I enjoyed it so much I read all three in the series and love them. Two is my favorite though.
Great book. Fast paced that Carr I especially the story well. I get so emerged into these characters and their story I can't put the book down. I hope he comes out with the next one soon!

Good book,I like how it starts from right before the invasion begins and progresses. Has a sense of urgency. Family was interesting in it, I have read the next two as well,one more to go. They are still good in the next books.

Fast paced, action adventure and likeable characters that are very diverse. They also grow through their experiences. Top ten series I have ever read, Thank You Maas for sharing your Dealisously creative mind with us readers! Your writing is a great gift to this sometimes dark sad world! Keep it up! I hope this world keeps going for a long time!
Love his books, has great suspense and kept me reading all night and then again as soon as I could the next morning. Likable characters and not of the norm.
Remaking Skyrim in Lego's is a great deal easier with this awesome Lego medieval windmill!
Great product for a spouse who is deployed to the sand and bored, now he has a spider up his sleeve or moving on the floor to scare random people with hehehehe
well made and works like a pencil sharpener should! We use it for colored and regular pencils.
Good mystery not as good as stormy cove but it had a lot of twists and an ending I didn't expect.

cands.text: This was an easy read with lots of characters and intrige and suspense and a surprise ending with a touch of romance.
This story kept your interest with romance and I intrigue!!  There was suspense and family ties that bind also!! I recommend!
This was full of romance, intrigue, mystery, and romance.  What a great combination.  I am going to see if she we has other books.
A  very  quick read with a surprise ending.  Very real cast of characters with a believable plot that most people can relate too!!!!
A great book with lots of intrigue and twists and turn with a little romance and vert believable characters.
This I'd a great happily ever after book that was an easy read.  Characters were likeable and interesting. I recommend.
A quick read about a complicated small town full of intertwined relationships with a happy ending finally!!! I really enjoyed this feel good book.
This was an easily read book with lots of characters and a little bit of romance and was an entertaining read!!
This was an easily read short book with twists and turns and a surprise ending with a hint if romance!!  Well written!!!
The best book I have read in quite a while!!!! Great character development with a surprise ending that makes you not be able to read it quickly enough!!!!
Read this in one afternoon!!!!  Great rainy day reading with great character development and surprises all along the way. Highly recommended!!!!
Read this is one day.  Characters are well developed and plot is believable in today's society.  I highly recommend and greatly enjoyed.
BEST BOOK I HAVE READ IN A REALLY LONG TIME!!  GREAT SUSPENSE GREAT PLOT WITH A GREAT SURPRISE ENDING ALSO!!!!
READING FOR THE SECOND TIME. I REALLY ENJOY THIS AUTHOR.  EASY TO READ WITH GREAT PLOTS AND CHARACTERS!!
This was a fast read with a vast diversity of characters which were all tied together in a plot with a feel good ending.
The author writes in a way that is easy to read!!!  Well written and intriguing story!!!  Characters were easy to identity with!!!  Good first book--I will be on lookout for her next!!
Well written spellbinding plot with many turns and twists with a hint of romance and drama with dual stalkers and of course the loyalty of a pet!!!
Quick read with many twists and turns and a kidnapping with five different suspects and a really happy ending for all.
Could not put this book down.  It is full of great character that ate believable with a plot that thickens and a surprise ending!!!!

users.query: Lost both the valve and the icemaker within a few months of buying the Fridge. These are inexpensive and easy to replace (everything is color coded) and we have ice again!

cands.text: Easy to replace, works well, although the cord is longer than the OEM ice maker and has to be tucked out of the way.
Why are these lil growlers so expensive? Perfect fit and easy to replace.
We wore the first one out and this is a replacement unit. Works as designed and advertised.

Bought it to replace the burnt element in my Kenmore oven. The last number for the part is ONE number different, this part ends in 4 instead of 3, but the rest of the part number is identical. Me Bride changed out the element as soon as it arrived and had it done in about 10 minutes, most of that looking for a screwdriver. Then to test it out she made COOKIES! The down side is... Are you kidding? Cookies!!!!! There is no down side.
Great replacement unit for the proprietary, but now defunct, Zune.

I like coffee. I'm not a patient man. Bunn designed their home brew units with me in mind. This thing is FAST. As was my last Bunn which passed away, peacefully, at the ripe old age of 15. Now this unit doesn't have a burner. "What?!!?", you cry. That's right, friends and neighbors. No more burnt coffee. The stainless steel carafe is magical (Bunn hires wizards to make them) and keeps coffee hot for hours! Literally. Me Bride makes coffee at 3:00 am (poor dear has to be to work at 4) and when I get up at 7 it's still hot. Not scalding hot, mind you, but it is still hot enough to warm your innards. It takes it a good 7 hours to assume room temperature. It seems a bit pricey but it's money well spent. You'll buy several cheap models that take half the morning to brew, burn your coffee, and won't keep it hot much past breakfast during the life span of this unit. Hit that buy button. You won't be sorry.

*EDIT* Use the Bunn Filters designed for this machine. The cheap ones won't handle the velocity and you have to mop coffee off the counters, floors, dogs... you get the idea.

The unit works, once you get it installed, but it didn't work for long. The piece is taller than the space you have to put it in. Took about 10 minutes of careful maneuvering to get it settled and in place.  It only lasted a year, however, so I'll give it one more shot.

Perfect fit, perfect tea. Plastic doesn't seem as brittle as the original, either, so that's nice. The only thing that is different is the white vs the original blue! *gasp* I reckon that is of no consequence thought, so we'll keep making it.

So glad to find these again. Just got mine and it's mostly like I remembered. Less line art and graphics, more writing, but the quality is superb. I'm looking to find old ones like my grandmother had and got tossed when she passed away. I wanted them, but wasn't there when they cleaned out her house.

Perfect fit as advertised for the Z560. Getting the screen bezel off was the hardest part: two screws in the bottom corners and then snap it off by getting something between the bezel face and the back of the lid, slowly working your way around. The top and bottom are glued as well, so you have to be careful with than. The connector on the back of the screen is secured quite well, too. This took a bit of prying and peeling to get it ready to unplug. Four screws down each side of the screen and it comes right out of the frame! A second pair of hands make it easier to put it back in, but it's not too hard to do by yourself. Make sure that you take your time in getting stuff hooked up as the connector is delicate by design. Not poorly made, mind you, but small and ... delicate. A couple of pieces of electrical tape will help hold it in place as the adhesive that you peel off the old screen isn't made to be reused. The whole thing took me ten minutes to replace from first screw out to last screw in. It fired up just fine. Bright and shiny.

"My" chair lives! I kept getting that sinking feeling from a well loved, well used, office chair and after crushing my ankles, I got hacked off and looked at a new chair. I'm cheap people, so when I saw I could order these I bought it. Two things: you're gonna need to get brute with it to get the old one off and, two, measure the old unit. I didn't measure and my new lift is a couple or three inches taller than the old. Not a bad thing, but surprising. I can swing my feet in my chair! WHEE! But, seriously, I had to get brute with the thing using a 3 lb drill hammer to pound the feet off (the wheels all popped out with the percussive blows before the bottom came off) and a pipe wrench to twist it out of the top. The old one was destroyed, but you're throwing it away. Right? The new one just sits right in the hole, but the 'chair' on top and you press it in place with your butt. Simple. Violent, but simple.
I am seriously loving this bay. It made moving things around and working on projects that much easier.  The on/off switch makes swapping drives a breeze.

The header cords could have been a bit longer. I've got it stretched from a lower bay to a PCI header card and it's got nothing left as far as slack. It fits the bay nicely and the 'auto' tighteners in the Rosewill R5 case hold the unit tight. It looks wonderful in the new build, too.

*edit* I've discovered that when you try to eject any media from the unit it deletes the whole unit from the system and only a reboot will restore it.

Fits and looks like the original. It does NOT come with the rivet to hold it in, however, but they are cheap and easy to find. This is my second one and the handle snapped off inside after a couple of years.

It's got all the toys, really, that I need to really screw things up. And they're pretty solid, too, as in not cheap, cheesy junk. A small kit that will allow you to get most anything done except for assembling full cables.
Love the Campmaid system for cooking outdoors. Simple, useful and amazing!

We bought this for our two year old grandson who LOVES to listen to Papa's mp3 player. It's big, and he has mostly learned to operate the controls. He loves to listen to the same song over and over and over, but hasn't figured out to press the back button twice - but, hey, he's two! The menu functions are designed to keep little fingers away fom making changes to the unit, and are pretty intuitive. Music transferred easily and quickly, but you do have to download the manual, never a good thing in my opinion. After reading all that people hated about it and everything that was wrong, I was hesitant, but this is a solid little unit. So far. I'll update more as we live with it.
About 10 or so were broken towards the middle of the pack. Annoying. But they do well in distributing product to clients!
Changing the thing improved the vacuum's cleaning ability a LOT.

I love these. And, wouldn't you know it, they discontinued them. I'm trying to buy all of them I can find as my dog seems to have an affinity for nomming these things. Little blighter goes so far as to drag them off my nightstand. Punk. Meanwhile, I'll scour the earth to attain them until I find a suitable replacement. Won't pay stupid price for them, though.
Works as advertised and runs my system graphics in excellent fashion, even with all the toys turned on.

Having to return this unit as it won't connect with any vehicles ECU. The apps UI shows 0 errors, but 3 'other faults'. Well, it isn't terrible. It has a pretty good premise, but I agree with others that this book is much too simple. The plot is predictable. The characters are a little 2D. The protagonist has potential but gets annoying sometimes because she's a bit dense and always needs saving. She does some very stupid things in the book that are head-smack worthy. I agree with another reviewer that I would have liked a book about Fay, one of the side characters, she sounded awesome! The setting is quite nice described though and seemed like it was well researched. The themes in the book are a quite serious, so it's odd to read about them juxtaposed to some relatively shallow dialogue or interactions between the characters. The book drags in some places and the action/suspense is a little cheesy. There's an insta-romance with a can't-decide-if-I-want-to-be-a-love-triangle--I will say in this respect the ending is a huge strength in that it diverges from other YA fiction books and stays true to what I think the author's main theme (girl power) is for this book.
Overall -- it's not the worst of the YA lot (Twilight category) but its not the best.

I'm obviously in the minority on this, and to be certain I really wanted to like this book (it was even recommended by Tamora Pierce), since the premise was unique and interesting. Unfortunately, everything else sort of fails.

The plot is really predictable. You've already pieced together the whole story in the first 50 pages. Not to mention the plague understory is not well-researched. Like another reviewer said, you don't have to be a scientist to learn the basics about a pandemic, vaccines, drug trials, etc. Secondly, the romance really sucked. It was like a love-at-first sight thing (which can be done - see These Broken Stars) except it was unbelievable and way too cheesy.

The setting is a really cool idea but it's not well-researched or consistent. There not much world-building and things like netscreens and other do-dads are sort of jammed in their without planning. Moreover, the language - ok I get it, the in-thing right now is this teen speak - honestly, I think it's a cop out. You can keep a language colloquial and still introduce interesting language that helps you world build. Which brings me to the dialogue in general. It was kind of choppy and cheesy. Dramatic in a predictable way. Really good dialogue make you think about what's not being said and then when the light bulb in your head goes off you are just smiling all type of silly, replaying this scene in your head for the rest of the day.

Darkness. Ok so I think for an epic to be epic there has to be some mystery, drama, injustice. There's a lot of the sort of haphazardly thrown in here, but the author doesn't really address the ramifications of it:
- I find it really disturbing that there is a draft to test drugs on humans (cyborg or whatever, sentient beings) and everyone knows they die from it, so they are referred to as a sacrifice - and then the guy that's behind it all is conveniently a good guy. Has the author ever heard of the Belmont Report? I kept thinking, this guy is going to turn out to be a bad guy - because who does that without any moral ramification??? And the royal family is responsible as well -- including our lovely, cardboard prince.
- There is this prejudice against Lunars - ok I get it. But instead of telling us through a long monologue from two characters, how about show it through underhanded discrimination or what not. Stuff that makes you feel something is believably unfair.
- The whole interaction with Queen Levana. There was so much potential for court intrigue and mystery and underhanded dialogue, but instead we got blunt, 2D arguments and threats exchanged.

Earlier today I asked myself if it was just that I was getting too old for YA (I'm in my 20s) or something. No, because there are plenty of YA books I've read that are masterfully written, well-researched and developed. You don't have to dumb things down and employ teen-speak for it to be a great YA book -- maybe a popular book, but not more than that. And maybe that was Meyer's objective here - if that's the case then congrats, but I totally regret spending that $10.
Unfortunately, although I wouldn't put this book in the category of Twilight, I would say that it's mediocrity puts it with that general category of crappy tween fiction that's abundant nowadays, obscuring real works that deserve attention.

Watching Prince Gill come to terms that after all these years he might be wrong about everything he ever thought of her, as he sees her caring, loving, take care of everyone around her attitude. The two of them trying to get along to cause less stress for the Bride but falling for each other.

This was an amazing story and I loved every minute of it. This story has 2 best friends who meet at Camp 15 years ago with a brother who was around as well, Kat a woman who knew what she wanted to do since she was a child and that is helping animals, Sophie a Princess who has used her American friends name to try to get away with doing some of the things she wanted but wasn't wanted by her mother, Prince Gill a man who wants to protect his sister from Kat as he thinks she is a bad influence and that she has an agenda to snag a Royal Husband, with a Queen who will do anything to push Kat away, A love story. Sophie recently had her heart broken by her Fiance and didn't care to do much except lay around in bed being depressed. Kyle home for the Wedding weekend since he already had it off, see's Sophie as a totally different person than she used to be as all her light and fun is gone. Sophie and Kyle had this hate, love relationship when they were teenagers but its been 10 years since then, Kyle see's himself as the only one that can help her get out of her funk and offers her to go home with him to get out of the everyday for the Summer.

What I enjoyed most about Just Between Us is watching two people who are so different from the other, yet have so much in common. How in the 10 years its been that the feelings they shared are still there. Watching how Kyle treats Sophie like she is the only Woman in the World, and would do anything for her and to protect her. Kyle can be tough one to crack as he is mostly moody but when he is around Sophie everything about him is different. Sometimes first loves are not only hard to forget but it never goes away.

This book was amazing, I loved how we get the today story as well as Sophie and Kyle's past stories. This book has a Woman and Man who have grown up together but not always seeing eye to eye, One kiss between step-siblings can change everything, A budding relationship that neither can help, with lots of hurt because they just don't know how to do this the normal way as its not normal, years later he is there for her as a friend but lots will come to light of what it is they really wanted all along. If you like stories like this, then Just Between Us is a must!!

Aj is a man who has a lot on his shoulders, he isn't the type that smiles or has a good time, until the day Kat comes into his life. They have struggles with so much going on within his company and she only wants to make things easier for him even if it means that she hides that she is pregnant with his baby to lesson his stress. But when her morning sickness gets to her to the point that she is in need of medical attention, she will find if Aj wants her and their baby or to walk away.

This is another fantastic book by Krista Lakes I really do enjoy her writing style and love stories. This story had a rich CEO that meets a girl who has no clue who he is so to him its the best to have a woman like him for him and not his pocket book. A Woman who is always there for others and finds someone who is there for her in a way that she has never had before. A love story that has its struggles but in the end they have their own little family. If you enjoy stories like this, then Yours Truly is a must!!

Austin is a playboy through and through and has a different girl every night not remembering their names the next day. Austin has some secrets of his own one he has shared with his best friend and the other is his own secret he has never shared.

Seeing Austin and his true feelings and how when all his dreams came true there was still someone missing from it all. Austin and Nicola had been dancing around each other for years but when the truth comes out and all the feelings it leaves them in their happy place.

Nicola from a small town living on her own after her brother moved to the big city for his dreams she stayed behind, Austin a man who works in the same bar he has been in for years waiting for his big moment in life when he finishes his music and moves onto something better and bigger, Nicola and Austin share what is a great night for her to realize she needs to move on and live her life, a love story. She lives and breaths for one thing and that is for her families inn, which she will inherit once she turns 22 of course after working it for 5 years. One day Ella's life will take a turn and someone special will end up in her life, its then that she will realize that there is something more important in life then the inn.

What I enjoyed most about Your Completely is for one I love Cinderella stories and the Happily Ever Afters for one. A step Mother that will try at every turn to mess it up for her. A love story. If you like stories like this, then Yours Completely is a must!!

Both of them growing up more, and learning to deal with the demons together to get better. But first trust needs to be there, and that they will learn along the way! How Lucas takes on Charlee's baby girl and treats her like she is his very own child. While he has losses in his life as well, he is learning to live and be happy.

This book is a slow read, not as fast paced. There is loss, depression, drugs, and alcohol when it comes to her mother, and father, and lots of demons to get through. Also child neglect, (in the past memories), This story has a love story that includes family, and lots of stuff to learn about her childhood when she grows up.  If you like stories like this, then Pitcher's Baby is a must!!

I received an ARC in return for my honest review!

There are many short stories in this box set. This is all about the supernatural's out there, and the loves of their lives or the ones they want to have. There is Romance, Spell's, dark side, getting the person you love and want to be with, and Halloween themed. All these short stories were great and all caught my attention and very well written. Im not one that normally reads short stories but this set sounded so good and I gave it a try, and I was NOT disappointed.  If you enjoy the out of this world Paranormal stories then you will love A Wicked Affair box set.

I received the book as an ARC copy in exchange for an honest review.

Bella and Seth Meet years ago, went to school together and when they both graduated Bella wanted to loose her virginity before heading off to college, she had heard all the stories about how great Seth was in the bedroom and figured she would be in great hands. After that night Bella never seen or heard from Seth again, until one night when things would change. Seth is in the Navy Seals so he wasn't around so much, but when his mom asked him to come over for dinner one night to meet her new fiance, he never would have thought that he would finally see Bella again as his new step sister to be. Of course things didn't change and they still drove each other crazy but they have this intense thing between them that they cant seem to get rid of.

What I enjoyed most about Hard is the passion between Bella and Seth, they are trying to try something out between them when they have all the odds against them, their parents are getting married, he is in the Navy and will be deployed. But when you really want something in life you have to work at it everyday, even when its hard. I enjoyed their story and seeing them get closer and building a lasting relationship, at first they were not sure where it was going to go but then they feel in love.

This book is fantastic, if you are into Military type books, where you have your real family and then the family of the life you have picked out for yourself, a love story with plenty of intimate moments, some dangerous moments, great friendships, and a father who thinks he knows what is best for his daughter and a daughter for the most part has listened to everything he has ever said, until one day she puts her foot down for the one thing in life she wants and cannot live without. There is ups and downs in this story but I loved it.... If you like stories like this, then Hard is a must read!

Gabe and Stella are back with the story of their Wedding. Gabe has agreed to plan their whole Wedding saying that Woman are just being Bridezilla's for no reason that it will be a piece of cake. Gabe will play the Alphabet to plan their Wedding, with plenty of entertaining moments that will make you laugh out loud!

What I enjoyed most about The Alphabet Wedding is watching Gabe plan the Wedding and watch as things fall apart or not go as planned, seeing him buying Wedding Dresses, lingerie, the things he thinks of but not every detail.

This is a great ending to the Alphabet Series, I laughed so hard at certain area's of this book, If you have read the other Alphabet books, then this one is a must.. Its a short quick read that will leave you wanting more.

I voluntarily reviewed an advance reader copy of this book.

Melita is living a double life, while she is Melita she pretends to be her sister Kalliste. Which has passed away. She takes care of the people and doesnt have an ice cold heart like her sister had. She gets away with it due to how much the sisters looked alike. Thereus is the Lord of the house, yet 5 years ago he was in a shipwreck and was assumed dead. Now he is back in his Castle, and is there to stay, and willing to do whatever he can to make Melita (Kalliste) see that is he a changed man. With only 5 weeks to show her, or he will step down and let her out of their marriage!

What I enjoyed most about Earth Borne is watching Thereus go from not wanting to be with a Wife, to being away and now doing what he can to show he wants to be there for his Wife and Son. Trying and wanting to be a better man. To do anything for Melita. The Sacrifices he would make for her, to have her in his life forever! Melita will also sacrifice everything for the people she loves most in the world.

This book is Fantastic, I couldn't put it down as I had to know what was going to happen next and how the story would end. This story had its sad and happy moments, and the OMG what is she doing moments as well, and a Man who loves her that would do anything to make sure she stays with him no matter what it took. This is a family story, mixed with a love story, with mystical creatures and not your everyday story which is always a nice change from the normal. If you like stories like this, then Earth Borne is a must!!

I received an ARC in return for my honest review!

Emma wins an exclusive vacation through the radio station, which she is excited for as she has never been to the beach. Her first day there she meets this very handsome man named Jack, when then her life will forever be changed. Jack is the CEO of his company and he realizes that Emma doesnt know who he is, so he doesnt tell her right away. Emma decides that with her vacation she is going all out, she is going to try new things as this might be her once in a lifetime opportunity. That includes spending lots of time with a total stranger.

What I enjoyed most about Saltwater kisses is watching Jack go from all business to being able to turn and look at Emma is a soft way that he doesnt look at anyone else like. I liked how Emma had her life pretty much planned out yet when it came to Jack she feel in love and was willing to give it all up for him, how Jack had never really had true friends that were not looking just at what he could do for them, but with Emma she had no clue as to who he really was and she feel and they had this deep connection and could just be in each others company for hours on end and enjoy every minute.

This book was very good, its about a newly CEO of his business as he is taking over for his dad, but on a last vacation of sorts, Emma and Jack meet on this wonderful exclusive vacation spot. They don't plan on it being a life commitment deal, but what happens when their special secret gets loose? Trust will be tested, hearts will be broken, a love story. If you like stories like this, then Saltwater Kisses is a must!!

I received an ARC in return for my honest review!

Sometimes horrible things happen to good people, some say things happen for a reason yet some times they just don't make sense when there are innocents involved. Tara was a reporter when the unexpected happened and she was shot leaving her in a Coma and loosing her baby. Alex her husband thought that with her demands after this all happened would blow over, but when she asked for a divorce and distance he picked up and moved out of state, now back in San Diego Tara still doesnt want Alex yet when things start to form between Alex and Tara's sister, she realizes she can loose the only man that she loves and that is her soul mate unless she makes a decision if she wants him or not.

What I enjoyed most about Coronado Beach is watching family be there for each other, with good friends that will help but yes they will get you into trouble as well. Watching Alex want nothing more then get his Wife back but not knowing the way to go about it, watching a sister fall for her sisters ex even if it isn't love, but being eye opening for Tara that if it isn't her sister it will be another woman that will com along and get his attentions. Watching a family heal over the horrible loss of the baby, but learning to heal and realize that you need to appreciate life everyday, and life can be short and its not worth living it from the past, but the future.

This story was amazing, there are hard times, loss, love, learning to grow past the horrible things that they have lived through, def area's where trust comes in, A love story, a triangle love story between two sisters and a man who is one of their ex-husband, a story of everyone growing and learning what is most important and what they want the most, This story is really unique as you got many characters point of views, This story is a Happily Ever After but to which sister gets her ever after in this story is to be seen as I don't want to ruin the surprise.  If you like stories like this, then Coronado Beach is a must!!

I received an ARC in return for my honest review!

Amber and Freddy had this instant attraction and want for each other the first time they meet, Freddy is two years older then Amber. Amber a teenager who has lived a hard life with parents who don't really like each other and don't act like they are married or even in love. But Amber knew pretty quick that she was in love with Freddy and would do anything for him. Freddy a car mechanic and race car driver that had two loving parents growing up knew that he wanted that same kind of love for himself and that he wouldnt waste his time on a girl until he found the one.

What I enjoyed most about This Love is watching Amber be pushed away and having done a lot of growing up on her own with a child, and even being married to another man and realizing that she can never love another man besides for Freddy. Watching her face her fears to go home to take care of her sick mother but watching both Freddy and Amber have a second chance at love and a family. Freddy a man who never gave up hope on Amber coming back home, and showing up pretty quickly to let her know that she is still what he wanted.

This is another great Anna Bloom book. This story grabs you and pulls you in, you can feel all the emotions in her words and how the characters feel. This story has a woman who got pushed away by her boyfriend because he thought she needed to go for he dreams and not give them up because they started dating and her wanting to stay, a man who only wanted the best for his girl so thought he was doing the best thing for her but ended up being the biggest mistake, a time for second chances that she isn't looking for and that he keeps on putting it out there that he will wait for her, a second chance at love. If you like stories like this, then This Love is a must!!

I voluntarily reviewed an advance reader copy of this book.

users.query: Good in theory. Too small for our spigot. Not strong enough for the hose we ended up with. Will find some use for it.

cands.text: I really wanted this to work out. The materials seem ok to me. I just can't get it to work on any of my faucets. Not even on the sink because that is too small so then there is leakage and/or it just falls right off. The tub faucet is too large. I'm keeping it because I have ideas about combining parts from a couple of different products to try to make them work for my needs. They are all good in theory but each has some aspect that keeps it from being a winner. I will not give up though!
So far so good. We still get some strays here and there, but the little cups are getting pretty full so they're obviously working. That's all I can ask for.

This particular grabber is a very high quality product in my opinion. I have owned a few with varying results. One was really cheap and that was a total get what you pay for scenario. The other one I own is a mid-range price and it works just fine.

This item was even better than my usual one though. The reach is longer, the grasp is stronger, and it was able to hold on to smaller objects better. I was really happy because I was keeping my previous grabber downstairs and this one upstairs in my bedroom where I was recovering from surgery. It got me through the first month or so, which was the most tedious and definitely the time where there was to be no bending, twisting or lifting. So this was kind of a lifesaver. Unfortunately, one of the rubber grippers broke off at that point. I didn't realize you could purchase them separately or I would have ordered a replacement by now. I have been doing without for about 6 weeks unnecessarily!! So I will now try to find a compatible suction cup replacement and I will be back in business with this very helpful item!!

2/13/16 Update: I just went ahead and ordered a whole new grabber because I couldn't find the old one. Got it today and am so happy to have one back in the bedroom again! I've already used it several times. Honestly, it really saves the back not having to stretch so much! I love this thing!

Bought this for my husband for Christmas. It is not big but is very sturdy and substantial. Feels very solid and expensive. Anyway, he thinks it is great! He says it holds exactly one bottle of beer and keeps it very cold. He also uses it to keep his milk cold (cookies/peanut butter crackers, LOL)!! Supposedly this is also good at keeping hot drinks warm as well, but obviously you can't put the mug itself in the microwave. I think that is highly likely because it is a great item. It is The Man Mug!!
Seems to work pretty good. Don't love the smell but it's better than the typical insect sprays.
These are nice. Smaller tipped than others I had. Therefore, more precise. Good buy.

So far it seems to work well. The material is soft and is a nice color. I haven't used it for long periods of time outdoors to test the UV protection under those circumstances, but it did well under short periods of time. I will check back if I use it for significantly longer time periods.

Wanted this to work very badly. Unfortunately it seemed to trap heat and make things feel hotter than disperse heat and keep itself and whatever is on it cooler. Had to send back, but no issues with that. Amazon is always very good about returns in my experience.

Husband is very happy with this product. Uses it to measure rooms when doing painting estimates. Says it works better than his last one. Much more accurate. The price was reasonable and it had many good reviews. I'm happy that he's happy <3

Looks cheapish. Won't use.

Update Jan 2016: Was unable to use this for the purpose I purchased it for, but I think I may be able to use it in another way. I am adding a star because it has the potential to be a nice, organized, stylish product, it just wasn't exactly what I was expecting when I first got it.
Great color, great sheen, really good coverage. Bought it to spray paint over a bright red metal cart and it covered well. Easy to use as well.

I like this product. I don't love it. I would like it a lot more if they found a way to make it more attractive...I bought it because it wasn't super-over-priced and I liked the way it fit in the corner of the bathtub/shower without jutting out and taking up unnecessary space. It they could have accomplished that exact same thing but found some way to make it a little less utilitarian I would definitely consider it a 5 star product. As it is I find it very useful and am glad I was able to find it. Just, you know, we women like all our stuff to match and look good. My sister put it together for me since my back isn't quite ready for this type of task yet. She seemed semi-frustrated but she got it done in a decent amount of time. It probably would have been much smoother had she read the words and not just looked at the pictures, so you know, I would advise doing that. I didn't realize that's what her plan was or I would have made the suggestion to her as well...Gosh it was almost as if my husband were doing it! I was trying to be nice and save him the trouble! All in all a good purchase though.

We love our new shower system!! We bought this because my daughter and I are both short and I personally like to use the handheld shower head for rinsing the shower after cleaning, but with all of our previous shower heads, I had to stand on the side of the bath tub to reach them. After a recent back surgery I decided this was a definite no-no. So we decided to try this out. I love that the bar slides down far enough for me to easily reach the removable showerhead and that the control for diverting the water from one to the other slides down with it - so that is also within reach! (Another HUGE flaw with other dual shower systems). I also like to soak in hot baths with Epsom salts and essential oils several times a week, so now I can reach the shower head to wash my hair in the bath tub rather than skipping that day, taking a shower after my bath, or washing it in the sink - all rather exhausting options with chronic pain issues. I will admit that the water pressure could be a little better, but if you are only using one at a time, it's fine for us. All in all it has definitely met my expectations.

Great in theory. Good to have when I just can't take the on-screen keyboard on my smart-phone for another second. The shape and the placement of the "pad" makes it a little difficult to reach the right side of the keyboard, but you can make it work. Better than having nothing. I would buy again.

Good color and price. Same product I got at Target. I ordered another and am using one as a liner and one as the main shower curtain. I'm going simple in my bathroom right now, and I'm liking this look right now. Mine are both weighted and do not blow around or stick to my legs, etc. It is a nice light to medium gray color, which I think is good for helping to mask issues until you get time to take it down to wash it.

Good color and price. Same product I got at Target. I ordered another and am using one as a liner and one as the main shower curtain. I'm going simple in my bathroom right now, and I'm liking this look right now. Mine are both weighted and do not blow around or stick to my legs, etc. It is a nice light to medium gray color, which I think is good for helping to mask issues until you get time to take it down to wash it.

Very inexpensive item. Use this to keep on wall lower in tub. When taking a bath I will set the handheld showerhead in here and I can wash my hair this way. It's not perfect, but it's the best solution I've found so far. Chrome coloring isn't really my thing, but we needed a certain type of showerhead and chrome was the only choice we had. Therefore, we got this to match. No issues with it sticking/falling off so far. No complaints here, especially considering the price. Good buy.
Works well to connect my daughter's smart phone to her car's auxiliary port. Now she can play her music in her car. Price was good and the product is working well so far.
Neither one fit my bathtub correctly. Was pretty bummed out as I really wanted to get away from the white that gets mildew so quickly.

Love these little cans of coke. Wish they were a little less expensive. But I buy them anyway because portion control is more important when it comes to stuff like soda that really has no nutritional value whatsoever but is sometimes hard to cut from our lives completely. This is a good way to have one every now and then without overdoing it. Also it cuts down on wastefulness as my daughter was always leaving half-empty cans of soda everywhere.

Good price on these wonderful pistachios. Less expensive than I can find locally. This is a nutritious, tasty and healthy snack, especially when you want something on the salty side but don't want to reach for those chips. They are high in fiber and protein plus provide a plethora of other benefits. Also I find consumption is a little slower with these because you have to take the time to open the shells. Gives the brain a chance to tell the stomach you are getting full. That 20 minute rule. Eaten in moderation these are a delicious addition to a well-rounded eating plan.

My favorite Adele song. I think it's beautiful and the words/meaning are very poignant. I think it's the type of song we can all relate to at some point in our lives - missing an old love we may have residual feelings for  when we are in a vulnerable place but they are unavailable. It is a difficult position to be in but if you are prepared to do the morally right thing than you must, indeed, find "Someone Like 'Them' ". She's a great artist and this song is amazing. I'm very happy to own it and I listen to it often.

Love this song from the movie Country Strong by Garrett Hedlund. I can't believe he was actually singing all those songs! He has a true talent for it, I feel. I had to make my husband watch it with me (chick flick, he said) and he said, "Hey that's the kid who played Brad Pitt's cousin in the movie Troy!" I was like, "There is no way! He looks NOTHING like that little kid! This is a full grown man singing about manly stuff!" So I had to look it up online to prove him wrong and of course he was right. Ugh. His memory sucks but he has a thing for faces. I should've know better. Anyway, I just thought he was so great in this movie. The song will always remind me of it and it is a great addition to my playlist. Nice to add in fresh stuff to the mix! Very happy to have found this!

It's really cute, but the torso is on the short side (and I'm very short) and the legs are too long! Have not worn it anywhere yet. Might work better if I lose a little weight. Hope so because it is soft and really nice!

users.query: I've been buying and using these caulking condoms for years.  They are great, keeping caulk sealed for a couple YEARS after opening.

cands.text: I've been sorely disappointed by tons of brass bristle brushes over the years.  The wires are not hardened and fold over at the mere sight of work, let alone actually doing some.  Forney has put quality wires in these brushes so they don't do that.  I haven't had it long enough to say how long they'll hold up, but so far, they're working as required.  Thanks, Forney.
Great stuff, but too darned expensive.  I just used it to lube up an old bicycle and the difference was dramatic.
I much prefer the Sharpies to the cheap Chiwanese clones.  They stink just as bad ;( but they last 2-3x as long and they make a nice, dark mark.  Stick with Sharpie.
I much prefer the Sharpies to the cheap Chiwanese clones.  They stink just as bad ;( but they last 2-3x as long and they make a nice, dark mark.  Stick with Sharpie.

I ordered this from Amazon twice, two different sizes/vendors, and both were not as advertised.  I hope they got their description corrected.  I wanted the advanced formula, with triple protectants.  The number on the Permatex jars were correct, but that was aluminized A/S.

I used to get a box of these with a stapler for a buck at Dollar Tree.  <sigh>

I have been using a single bag since 2007 around my roses, and it is still potent, keeping all growth of grass and weeds from the area around the rose plants. I wrap it in two trash bags between uses, but it has not degraded in the least in a decade.  I love this stuff since it doesn't take much to do the job and it lasts all year.  A few sprinkles keep my fence line clear, and I am now trying it (today) over the wood chips on the front yard.  I removed the grass 12 years ago and some is coming through the landscape fabric and thinning chips.

Extremely satisfied with these bars.  Fair price, quality ingredients, lower in sugar, and much better tasting than most other bars.  I bought a passel of 'em on Subscribe and Save and will continue buying the delicious treats.  Thanks, Pamela.
Good stuff at a great price, and it helps a great cause.  I'll be back for more soon.

I was lost without one, so thanks for making these.  They're light in weight and heavy on work.  The small length and wide jaws are just right for daily repair needs.  These little guys are tough.  I love 'em!
Good stuff, easy to sew through. Kudos to the vendor, Country Brook Design.

Won't buy the one with single-layer elastic at the top again.  It rolls.  The other style has knit over elastic and those are better.  These are all I wear nowadays, and I love them.  Retirement Gear!  <g>
I was skeptical about the polyethylene fabric, but it's great.  Warm and breathable at the same time.  Nice!  Good fit, too.
These fit well and should keep my hands safe when under duress.
3x better than Mrs. Cubbison's.  I use it as croutons on my salads, too.  Yummy!
3x better than Mrs. Cubbison's.  I use it as croutons on my salads, too.  Yummy!
Initial thumb-thru looks good.  I'm sure it will add another dimension to my herbal knowledge.

I really like this blanket.  It's not anything like the flimsy mylar blankets sold for this purpose, which tear and wear out with one night's use.  This one should last you many months (if not years) of concurrent day's use.  It's made of regular tarp material (woven polyethylene) for the two outer layers. Sandwiched inside are layers of Astrolar fabric and aluminum.  They're amazingly warm in the winter. I wore mine outside in a tee-shirt at 22F to get the mail and was too warm by the time I got back.  (grin) The hood is stitched on and folds inside when you fold it up.  The handles are extra stitched material, so they're flat, too.  They work wonderfully to hold the blanket around you, fan it open in front of the campfire, etc.  This thing goes into my Bug-Out-Bag as a definite MUST HAVE item.  Don't waste your money on single-use mylar.  Get the hooded Grabber.  It is -well- worth the extra ten bucks or so.

I have been buying and using virgin coconut oil for several years now and this is the best deal I have found.  It is even better than the gallon pricing I've seen.  This last shipment was a bit grainy, not as smooth as other shipments, but it's still good quality oil.  I fry foods in it (omelets fried in coco oil are scrumptious and light!), use it in baked goods (Imparts great flavor), and sometimes just put a dollop of it in my tea or coffee.  A couple tablespoons a day internally keeps my skin from flaking and it helps me keep weight off. I'm a believer!  My neighbor uses it externally for her dry skin, and it has helped her slowly take the 1/4" thick calluses off her elbows, stopping the cracking and bleeding.  Also read _Eat Fat, Lose Fat_ by Dr. Mary Enig and Sally Fallon (available here on Amazon) for the total information about coconut oil uses and nutrition, plus tons of recipes.

I bought this book several years ago and it was so good, I got her Sacred Spaces book, too.

After taking her concepts to heart, I had a garage sale and grossed $3,000.  So I know they work.  <g>

Thank you, Karen.  Everyone should read your book.  We would be a better species for it.
This is a decently priced and excellently varied combo kit for all my polishing needs.
A lofty title compared to the sparse 38 pgs of info offered.
Egad!  I only got through seven minutes of this one.  Low budget effects, half the actors couldn't act their way out of a paper bag, etc.  I just couldn't do it.

This went into my bugout bag because it was so lightweight and high-performance.  Microfiber is happenin' stuff in towels, very absorbent and soft. The little bag keeps it in a compact roll, too.  Me like!
